title: Arcuz II: Dungeons
description: The little hero is back! This time he is going to explore the dungeon in the village Arcuz and save the world!

title: Tyfortress: Tactical Typing
description: Protect human race last fortress against the robots by typing phrases and single words! Build and evolve towers that will help while you destroy robots by typing their words! Oh, and don't forget... Before that, you'll need to type phrases fast to gather a good amount of resources to build towers!

title: Paper Boats
description:
Paper Boats is a small, experimental game about sharing and contemplating. There's not much to do, no enemies to kill or puzzles to solve. You can just look around, interact with the things around you and take screenshots.

Every once in a while, though, a paper boat will come sailing and stop in front of your dock, carrying a message for you, written by a stranger. Maybe it's a kind word of encouragement, or somebody emptying their worries into the void.

Good thing is that you can also send a message in your own paper boat, and let it sail for a stranger to read.

When you need a small break from reality, you can just hang around on the dock, watch the day go by and read messages from strangers.

title: Canvas Colors: In the Moving City
description: While doing routine deliveries in a moving city, Postman Maggie and her companion Vale seek out a house that was left behind. Who answers the door of that house was the last person either of them expected...

title: Light Infantry
description: Play with Glitch

title: Medium: The Psychic Party Game
description: In the game Medium, players act as psychic mediums, harnessing their powerful extra-sensory abilities to access other players’ thoughts. Together in pairs, they mentally determine the Medium: the word that connects the words on their two cards, and then attempt to say the same word at the same time!

title: Dichotomy
description: Team online game for 4-10 players, about the fight against traitors among the crew.

title: Legend of Chilli Tree
description: Adventurous, explore-and-combat 2D game witch spicy storyline and wonderful sceneries. And of course, lots of deadly chilli peppers! Special focus is given to the fighting system inspired by Samurais and Ninjas with variety of moves, combos and tricks... Literally, the hottest fights ever!

title: Disenchantment Heart
description: 祛魅·格心（祛魅3）是一款小清新像素风回合制角色扮演游戏，祛魅系列历代作品第三部。剧情故事发生在二代入灭事件结束后的东方异大陆。艰难的生存于市井之中酷爱讲鬼故事的贫苦少女，真情感动披坚执锐勇猛御敌的巡捕营参将？温婉善良双剑乖巧的少女能否寻得真凶手刃仇敌？由高人驯养获得真传的猫妖会成为合格的圣痕守护者吗？得传叶灵流刀法灵武士一生守护嗣潘王？喜欢蹂躏欺辱各种非人类生物的降妖师...不可描述？？？

title: Hentai Brick Breaker 2
description: Unlock beautiful hentai scenes with boys and girls, hidden behind bricks that you must break. Choose your scenes and level from the gallery.

title: Officespace
description: OFFICESCAPE is a first-person puzzle-platformer adventure game. In OFFICESCAPE you play as yourself, you are stuck in a dream and you are trying to wake up.

title: Metal Faith
description: A 3D adventure puzzle game

title: Little adventure 2
description: Little adventure 2 is a sequel to the adventure 2D platform game set in a fantasy world full of dangers and adventures. You have to play as an assistant to the blacksmith named Ben and go on a fun adventure, but this time alone!

title: TripleBuilder
description: Triple Builder is a typical three-match puzzle game. Place Building, Make your own city!

title: Zoelie
description: Zoelie is an action-puzzle platformer that tells the story of a young girl exploring her town of La Colina alongside her imagination-powered quilt, Sueño.

title: Terafall
description: You are a mercenary on the dying planet of Tera, where every day is a struggle for survival. Create your own legacy as you overcome a planet dominated by dangerous beasts, cutthroat brigands, and a ruthless and powerful governing corporation.

title: The Airtight City 2
description: This is a third-person perspective, horror-type action shooting game. The game will draw players into a terrifying dark world with detailed atmosphere rendering and weird story. Here, you are not defenseless, but even with a gun, you can't suppress the trembling from the heart.

title: Godkiller
description: Play as a WW2 Soviet soldier in a post apocalytic landscape ravanged by a corrupt god.A 2d action adventure through the beautiful yet disturbing dystopian world,with crazy cults,Nazi scum and the forces of the corrupt god.Do you have enough might to save the world?

title: I Am Human!
description: I Am Human! is an intelligence gathering bluffing party game where one of the players is a disguised alien impostor that has infiltrated the group of humans for an upcoming alien invasion of Earth. Players take turns interrogating each other to try and unmask who among them is the alien impostor.

title: Wind: A Breath of Heart
description: Originally released for PC (Windows) under the same title as an adult visual novel, the game was then ported to consoles with removed adult contents, but also with additional CG events and story elements added to compensate for the lack of erotic scenes. The game follows Makoto Okano as he returns to his hometown after 10 years away. Before he left, he and Minamo Narukaze made a promise to each other to meet again. She told him she will keep on playing the harmonic and even though he may be too far away to see it, the wind will carry the melody, hopefully all the way to his place.

title: Midnight on the Milky Way
description: In the depths of space, without a memory or face, you find yourself aboard a train of mystery and stars. The passengers abroad—some dangerous, some odd—offer you no answers as you search throughout the cars. The clock is slowly ticking. Your stop is coming into sight. Will you find what you are looking for on this lonely, starry night?

title: And Other Stories
description: And Other Stories is a mixed media mess of bitsy, unity, photography, sprite work, and more. Play through 4 slice of life stories simultaneously, with your attention jumping every which way.

title: Gura's Birthday
description: Gawr Gura / Hololive EN NES-style Fangame

title: Roniu's Tale
description:
Polish those magic and thinking skills, because there's no turning back! Help Roniu find his way through a death-defying dungeon and take down a plague of enemies hellbent on keeping him there. Watch your step, you're no longer on stable ground!

47 Levels of Dangerous Pathways
Head Scratching Puzzles
A Whirlwind of Enemies and Epic Bosses

title: The Crew 2: Special Edition
description: Take on the American motorsports scene as you explore the USA in one of the most exhilarating open worlds ever created. With a wide variety of vehicles to choose from, experience the thrill and excitement of competing across the USA as you test your skills in a wide range of disciplines. The Special Edition features the Digital Special Pack which includes: Dodge Challenger SRT Demon Interception Unit & Porsche 911 Speedster

title: Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons - Deluxe Edition
description:
Join the fight for Tyria’s future in Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons. The Deluxe Edition includes a boatload of items, including skins for your personal skiff and raptor mount.

- The expansion
- Shared Inventory Slot
- Additional Character Slot
- Canthan Raptor Skin
- Max Level Boost
- Shining Jea Dragon Boat Skiff Skin
- Identity Repair Kit

* Pre-Purchase Bonus items includes a Shining Jea Mosaic Cape, Flame Serpent Weapon Chest and Prodigy of Shing Jea Title.

title: Disciples: Liberation - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Take your journey even further with the Digital Deluxe Edition. Within, you will find two unique sets of armor, two weapons, an Emotion Shard for Avyanna, wallpapers, a compendium, the Soundtrack and two Packs, which can be used once per new game session.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 31 - Deluge
description: Starro’s back…but he isn’t alone! This time the invasion is worse than ever. Head below the surface to Spindrift Station, the all-new Atlantean Embassy, to figure out what’s really going on. Encounter new and updated characters like Aquaman, Black Manta, Mera, and more!

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 38 - Wonderverse
description: Take up arms with Nubia, Flashpoint Wonder Woman, Red Son Wonder Woman, and more, face the Olympian Gods and the New Gods, and restore order before it is too late.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 32 - Teen Titans: The Judas Contract
description: The Teen Titans are back and recruiting new heroes to join their ranks! Head to Titans Tower and test your skills alongside fellow recruits Damian Wayne and Terra. We hope you have what it takes, because after an attack on the Tower, all of the Teen Titans will go missing! Can you save them?

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 30 - Earth 3
description: Superman, Wonder Woman, and Batman are back! Get ready to unite with the Justice League to take on the infamous Crime Syndicate, the League’s doppelganger foes from an alternate universe.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 28 - Age of Justice
description: Travel back in time to Europe circa 1944 where multiple timelines are merging and unraveling. The most classic heroes and villains of the DC Universe are racing back in time to protect or rewrite history, including Wonder Woman, Per Degaton, the Justice Society of America, and the high-flying Blackhawks!

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 29 - Riddled With Crime
description: Gotham City is in peril, Batman is missing, and Gotham’s villains are vying for power! The Riddler has taken over Amusement Mile, a turf grab from The Joker and his cast of misfits. Batwoman and Nightwing are on the case to keep everything from spiraling out of control, and they’re going to need your help.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 36 - Metal Part II
description: The epic conclusion to the Metal saga is here with Episode 36: Metal Part II. Thanagar threatens Earth with the Phoenix Cannon in order to prevent the merger of the Dark Multiverse with ours. Take the fight to The Dark Knights and Barbatos, the Bat God, before Thanagarians have no other option but to destroy humankind.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 33 - Atlantis
description: The battle for the Crown continues in Episode 33: Atlantis. Corum Rath has set his sights on the Throne and has plotted a rebellion with his Deluge conspirators. Go beneath the sea to a brand new, stunning rendition of Atlantis, and put a stop to the uprising. Do you have what it takes to save the city and restore power to the throne?

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 34 - Justice League Dark
description: An ancient evil magic from another plane has surfaced in Episode 34: Justice League Dark. A daemonic threat looms over Gotham City. Join Constantine, Zatanna, Shazam, and the Justice League Dark to stop the invasion before it's too late!

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 37 - Birds of Prey
description: Help Harley Quinn, Black Canary, The Huntress, Poison Ivy, and Catwoman - the newly formed Birds of Prey - reach Oracle (aka Batgirl / Barbara Gordon). Lex Luthor has detonated his own LexCorp Tower, sent Metropolis spiraling into chaos, and has Oracle in his sights.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 39 - Long Live the Legion
description: Join forces with the future’s bravest team, the founding members of the Legion of Super-Heroes! Lightning Lad, Saturn Girl, and Cosmic Boy’s lives are in jeopardy as they confront one of the most powerful sorcerers in the universe, Mordru.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 35 - Metal Part I
description: Batman is missing, replaced by twisted versions of Batman from the Dark Multiverse. The Dark Knights invasion has begun in Episode 35: Metal Part I. Get ready to fight through disturbed and distorted versions of Gotham City, Central City, and more.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 27 - Amazon Fury Part III
description: Amazon Fury Part III: Ares and Circe are finally ready to challenge Zeus, king of the gods, for control of Olympus! Wonder Woman knows that if she doesn't intercept Ares and Circe, her mother's soul could be lost forever.

title: Dangerous Lands 2
description: In this action game, you join the dark side to bring prosperity in the evil ascension.

title: Samurai Revenge
description: Samurai Revenge is an intense old school platformer with mixed RPG elements. Main hero is Kabuto - famous samurai which has been being imprisoned for 13 years. Now he wants to have his revenge because he finds out that his wife is killed. He knows who did this... And he is going to find him.

title: Lapin
description: Lapin is a precision 2D platformer game about abandoned rabbits in the park. Help rabbit 'Liebe' to search for a new home for rabbits through a expedition out of the burrow. Expedition involves a lot of dangerous things, so you need elaborate control. Enjoy five rabbit’s brilliant episodes in Lapin!

title: Pollute & Conquer
description: An economic war over territories and resources is raging on the planet. Will you destroy the planet and all life on it in the chaos of pollution... or prevent the end of the world by developing new technologies?

title: Love 3
description: LOVE 3 is a precision platformer where you control fiveEight, a lone survivor searching for others in a mechanical, apocalyptic world. Face challenging obstacles, discover hidden secrets, and try to find hope within the hopeless as you overcome each new danger.

title: Word Game
description: Word game is literally a game of words. Player controls "I" to find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best "I” win!

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Starship Troopers
description: Starship Troopers (1997): features the license for the popular film of the same name released in 1997. Designed by Joe Balcer and Joe Kaminkow, this table conveys the style and feel of the movie with its vibrantly colored playfield, music from the movie and custom speech.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Phantom of the Opera
description: Phantom of the Opera (1990): is based on the classic novel from Gaston Leroux, published in 1910. Designed by Joe Kaminkow and Ed Cebula, this game makes excellent use of its license with outstanding audio effects and imagery that tells the story of the Phantom.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Last Action Hero
description: Last Action Hero (1993): 'Did somebody say action?' This action-packed pinball powerhouse harbors the license for the summer blockbuster hit movie of the same name.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: AC/DC
description: AC/DC Premium (2012): perfectly captures the head banging vibe of one of the most legendary rock bands in the world, AC/DC. Designed by Steve Ritchie, the gameplay centers around 12 unique song modes based on the band's biggest hits, including Back in Black, Thunderstruck and Highway to Hell.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Harley-Davidson
description: Harley-Davidson / Third Edition (1999): Designed by industry veterans, Lonnie D. Ropp and John Borg, this table grabs your attention with its chrome trim, classic rock n’ roll soundtrack and loud shaker motor that simulates the roar of a real Harley motor.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Star Trek
description: Star Trek Vengeance Premium (2013): is another outstanding game from designer, Steve Ritchie. Based on the new series of Star Trek films, players take on the role of Captain Kirk commanding the USS Enterprise in a fight to save the Federation.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Ghostbusters Premium
description: Ghostbusters Premium (2016): highlights the humor of the original Ghostbusters film released in 1984. It was designed by John Trudeau to be easy to play but difficult to master. The distinctive playfield features beautiful and unique hand drawn art by renowned illustrator Jeremy Packer a.k.a. Zombie Yeti.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: High Roller Casino
description: High Roller Casino (2001): puts players in the roll of a high stakes gambler with money to burn.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Ripley's Believe It or Not!
description: Ripley's Believe it or Not! (2004): This is possibly the most complex table to come from legendary pinball designer Pat Lawlor (who also created Funhouse and Addams Family). It allows players to travel with Robert Ripley across seven continents to discover the strange, the bizarre, and the unusual!

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
description: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein (1995): is a deep and atmospheric table designed by John Borg. This Sega produced table, released in 1995, features interesting modal gameplay, spectacular music and a fully animated Frankenstein Monster that actually throws the balls across the playfield during multiball.

title: Stern Pinball Arcade: Mustang
description: Mustang Premium 'Boss' (2014): celebrates 50 years of one of the most iconic muscle cars ever made, the Ford Mustang. Players are challenged to race a variety of Mustangs against an array of colorful characters in eight different racing scenarios including drag racing, drifting and road racing.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Two
description: Fresh from your recent close encounters and near misses, you continue on your involuntary Alternian vacation. Two new trolls arrive on the scene and your burning thirst for companionship hasn’t waned. Quench it in Hiveswap Friendsim Vol. 2!

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Three
description: Following your recent brilliant FRIENDSHIP story successes (or brutal failures, just depending on your personal truth) you arrive in Vol. 3 of the Hiveswap Friendsim, ready for a deep dive into more companionable roguery.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Four
description: Burned and lightly battered, this serial befriender is still truckin’ along. In a stunning departure from the rest of the oeuvre, Vol. 4 of Hiveswap Friendsim uses visuals, music and text to tell a story where you meet two trolls and try to make friends with them.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Five
description: Coming in hot and fresh from a distant galaxy to the digital media platform of your choice, it’s Hiveswap Friendsim Vol. 5! Now with two new trolls to friend and be friended by. Delve deeper into the hostile urban landscape of an alien world as you brush up on your Alternian culture.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Six
description: They say the more things change, the more they stay the same. For instance, you. You move on to new trolls, but your goal is an ever-fixed mark. Friends, comrades, a modicum of sympathy in this deep, dark world. They also say you should be careful what you wish for. Desires give way to pain, disillusionment, failure.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Seven
description: Crimes? Well, you know all about those. You’ve seen some stuff in your time. One might even go so far as to call you… ”hardcore." How does one become hardcore from playing a video game of the visual novel and social simulation variety?

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Eight
description: Wow, these potential friends just keep on showing up, huh? Ready yourself for some more hard yet beautiful truths about life, connection, yourself, and video game downloadable content. All that and more is coming at you in Hiveswap Friendsim Volume 8.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Nine
description: Your expedition through an unforgiving alien planet continues in this newest volume of the Hiveswap Friendsim! Visit breathtaking natural vistas and architectural gems where you'll soak up Alternia's rich cultural traditions — and where you'll encounter two of your toughest customers yet.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Ten
description: Back at it again at Hiveswap Friendsim—here, at the auspicious tenth volume. Wow. Ten whole volumes. That’s over TWENTY WHOLE FRIENDS! You can feel the sparkle of your success stories billowing in your wake, leaving a trail of stardust wherever you go. Seems like this might be a good time to sit back, relax, coast a little bit.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Eleven
description: Volume 11? Of Hiveswap Friendsim? Eleven volumes, 23 trolls, and you’re still alive, still in an approximation of fighting form, and still kicking it in this hostile alien environment. Hell, you’re barely even an outsider anymore. You know the games, you know the memes, you got this.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Twelve
description: Webster’s dictionary defines friendship as the emotion you feel when you’ve successfully purchased, downloaded, and played a volume of Hiveswap Friendsim. Luckily for you, round 12 is here to fulfill that weirdly narrow definition for you. Enjoy the sweet, sweet feeling of having burrowed your way into these two hearts. You deserve it.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Thirteen
description: Are you aware that most accidents happen in the home? It’s true. You’re just minding your own business, sitting in your living room, and BAM. A large chunk of ceiling falls on your head or a harpoon flies in through an open window. Provided you live near a lot of whale hunting. The point is, it kills you. You’re dead. Randomness abounds.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Fourteen
description: Ah, another week, another volume of Hiveswap Friendsim. It’s a way of life now, honestly. This steady ramble through the dramatic horrors of the alien countryside, where the only rule is that there are no rules. Anything goes. As long as it can fit in our budget and timescale. Volume 14, for instance! No rules! Just right! Just clowns!

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Fifteen
description: Here in this life we all have thoughts, feelings, motivations, and passions. They're what keep us going when times seem dark, especially on alternating Fridays. Some people seek the catharsis of artistic self-expression. Some of us yearn only for FRIENDSHIP. Others still find meaning only in playing short visual novels about aliens.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Sixteen
description: You guys wanted more hot clowns, right? That's why you're here? That's what you've been waiting for all this time? Well, take a bit fat slurp on THIS monkey's paw. Savor every last one of its feculent simian digits for as long as you like. This other guy will have your grave ready for you when you're done.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Seventeen
description: Penultimate. The second to last. The not-quite-final. The calm before the storm. Here at the beginning of the end, teens both moody and muscular await you. More heartwarming candor, more laughs, more weird time nonsense, and more memes that were outdated the second our pens left the paper.

title: Hiveswap Friendsim: Volume Eighteen
description: It’s finally here: the last volume of Hiveswap Friendsim. We’ve had a long, memorable journey together, haven’t we? Around now is typically when we’d play a slideshow highlighting all your best moments, but we aren’t Facebook. We don’t feed off of personal information, just your tears. Your sweet, sweet tears.

title: Hentai Coloring Game
description: Hentai Coloring Game - Coloring Game. A new coloring game that can win the hearts of players! 10 beautiful arts, 10 hot ladies are waiting for you!

title: Da! Russian Quiz
description: A quiz that helps you review words and phrases in Russian. Over 3,500 Advanced phrases, 350 Verbs, 1500 nouns and exactly 33 letters for all your learning efforts.

title: SuperHero
description: What makes a true hero? When a man known only as Gray Crow first found out how different he was from everyone else, he went on a journey to answer that question. Witness the different stages of his life in this power-packed action game. Fight treacherous foes and uncover the true meaning of heroism.

title: Chill X
description: Chill is a relaxing, minimalist maze game.

title: Solar System Colonist
description: The conquest of the Solar System has begun – prove yourself as a space colonist! Pilot the spaceship, choose the planet you wish to inhabit and build your new home. However, remember that there are no rules or laws in outer space. Don't underestimate the danger and stay vigilant – enemies are near!

title: Tabletop Simulator: Tortuga 1667
description: The year is 1667 and you are a pirate sailing the waters of the Caribbean. Captain the high seas, or crew for a stalwart and trustworthy captain. Or throw them overboard. For 2-9 Players. 20-40 minutes to play.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Down in Flames - Locked-On
description: Down in Flames: Locked-On brings the Down In Flames system to the jet age, by adding missile combat and range.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Xia - Legends of a Drift System
description: Xia: Legends of a Drift System is a 3-5 player sandbox style competitive space adventure. Each player starts as a lowly but hopeful captain of a small starship.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Superfight
description: Superfight is a hilarious card game based on fights between characters with superpowers and super problems.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Zombicide
description: Zombicide is the board game that lets 1-6 players live out their zombie survival nightmares! Players take control of one of six survivors, each who have their own special abilities and skill trees. Using unique and clever mechanics, Zombicide is designed as a fully cooperative game where no player has to play as the zombies.

title: Tabletop Simulator: The Red Dragon Inn - Battle For Greyport
description: The Battle for Greyport is the game of the adventurers after the adventure but before the pints. Maybe the big bad guy's underlings are seeking revenge, or maybe an even bigger bad guy is coming over to show the city who's the new boss in town.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Tiny Epic Galaxies
description: Tiny Epic Galaxies is driven by an exciting dice-rolling mechanic that rewards thoughtful programming of the results. Players control a home planet and a series of space ships within their own personal galaxy. As players upgrade their galaxies they gain access to more ships and more dice.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Draco Magi
description: Draco Magi is a fast game, playable in 30 minutes. It incorporates themes of area control, bluffing, hand management, deck building and deduction. Play with a friend, and enjoy the expansion decks as well.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Scythe
description: In Scythe, each player represents a fallen leader attempting to restore their honor and lead their faction to power in Eastern Europa. Players conquer territory, enlist new recruits, reap resources, gain villagers, build structures, and activate monstrous mechs.

title: Tabletop Simulator: The Great Dinosaur Rush
description: In The Great Dinosaur Rush, players compete to grab bones from the best dig sites, and build new dinosaurs for prestigious museums, gaining notoriety in the process by stealing bones, sabotaging dig sites, and otherwise impeding your fellow paleontologists.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Cavern Tavern
description: In a war torn land, a magical land of heroic feats and epic quests, there is a place that has never felt the wrath of the ongoing and everlasting war between the five realms. Hidden in the hills of Strongcliff, deep in the shadows of a cavern lies the best kept secret for many years.This place is called the Cavern Tavern.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Unearth
description: Unearth is a bend-your-luck game of dice placement and set collection. Designed by Jason Harner and Matthew Ransom, it plays in under an hour with 2-4 players. Each player leads a tribe of Delvers, represented by five dice (3 six-sided, 1 four-sided, and 1 eight-sided).

title: Tabletop Simulator: Boss Monster
description: Inspired by a love of classic video games, Boss Monster: The Dungeon Building Card Game pits 2-4 players in a competition to build the ultimate side-scrolling dungeon. Players compete to lure and destroy hapless adventurers, racing to outbid one another to see who can build the most enticing, treasure-filled dungeon.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Blood Rage
description: In Blood Rage, each player controls their own Viking clan's warriors, leader, and ship. Ragnarök has come, and it's the end of the world! It's the Vikings' last chance to go down in a blaze of glory and secure their place in Valhalla at Odin's side! For a Viking there are many pathways to glory.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Viticulture
description: Old-world Tuscany awaits your wine making skill and strategic cunning. You'll plant vines, harvest grapes, age wines, and fill merchant orders to create the greatest winery in Italy!

title: Tabletop Simulator: Rarrr!!
description: Rarrr!! is APE's card game of earth-shaking battles between giant Japanese movie monsters. Each player creates a monster, builds up its power, and then battles against other monsters to destroy the world's greatest cities.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Mr. Game!
description: Mr. Game! is a modern take on the classic family "roll-and-move" genre of board games. It's a race-to-the-finish where the goal is constantly changing, and so are the rules! An innovative tabletop experience where one player wields the power to dramatically alter the game at a moment's notice. What kind of "Mr.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Darkest Night
description: Defeat the Necromancer and save the kingdom in this one- to four-player cooperative fantasy game, Darkest Night.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Deck Quest
description: Deck Quest is an open-ended tabletop RPG condensed into four decks! Made up of 335 unique Items, Roles, Adversaries, and Locations, Deck Quest is a new and innovative take on the classic tabletop RPG.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Abraca...What?
description: Abraca...What? is a family game of deduction and spellcasting.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Wizard's Academy
description: Wizard's Academy is a co-operative game of magical experimentation for 1-6 players. In each game, the players select a scenario, such as summoning and binding a demon to steal its powers, defending the academy against an attack by an army of Imps, or (in the most difficult scenario) facing an academy inspector whom they must impress with...

title: Tabletop Simulator: Tiny Epic Quest
description: A world of peace has been torn asunder by the opening of a vile portal from the goblin kingdom.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Cosmic Encounter Connector
description: Cosmic Encounter Connector is the Tabletop Simulator version of the award winning game where you become an alien with a special power to break the rules. No two games are the ever same!

title: Tabletop Simulator: Dungeon Drop
description: Dungeon Drop is a lightweight dungeon crawler for 1-4 players, featuring unique gameplay elements that assures no two games could possibly be the same. Dungeon Drop blends strategy with a novel spatial element that will challenge casual and hardcore gamers alike!

title: Tabletop Simulator: Simurgh
description: Simurgh is a game for 2-5 players who become heads of powerful clans in a fantastical world where humans and dragons live, hunt and go to wars together.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Spirits of the Rice Paddy
description: Ancient Balinese legend describes a host of powerful spirits who help poor rice farmers achieve success. These farmers have long used a sophisticated irrigation system to organize rice cultivation by integrating religious devotion and social responsibility with traditional farming methods.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Dawn of the Zeds
description: You must lead the good citizens and emerging heroes of these communities to halt the Zeds' advances by (re)killing them, attempt to coordinate the discovery of a cure to this vile scourge, and preserve as much of the area and as many of its inhabitants as possible. There's no time to lose...

title: Tabletop Simulator: Three Cheers For Master
description: Three Cheers for Master is a fast-paced, multi-player card game where each player creates their own cheerleading tower of cards depicting Master's violent, war-hungry minions.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Adventure Mart
description:
Outsmart your competition and serve a fantastical array of adventurers as you battle to make more gold than your opponents! Adventure Mart is a fresh new take on deck-building games with added twists and plenty of player interaction.
The life of a store manager is brief, but glorious. Can you become "Manager of the Week"? Or will you be banished to the abyss?

title: Tabletop Simulator: Rise of Tribes
description: In Rise of Tribes, players control a tribal faction in prehistoric times looking to Grow, Move, Gather, and Lead their people. The board is modular, composed of hexes in various terrain types.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Scuttle!
description: In this fast-playing card game, players scheme, battle and steal to be the first to collect 21 doubloons. Each turn either draw a card or play a card - cards can be played as either treasure or as an action. Do you want to draw 2 cards, or steal the treasure chest your opponent just played? Or would you rather wipe the board...

title: Tabletop Simulator: Wingspan
description: Wingspanis a competitive, medium-weight, card-driven, engine-building board game from designer Elizabeth Hargrave and Stonemaier Games.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Battle For Souls
description: Battle For Souls is an epic medieval card and dice game for 1-4 players pitting the forces of Hell against the forces of Heaven in a fight for the eternal souls of humankind.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Warfighter
description: Command the world's best Special Forces operators and complete vital assault missions around the world!

title: Tabletop Simulator: Euphoria - Build a Better Dystopia
description: A dystopian cityscape awaits your leadership as you make strategic choices to construct markets, enhance allegiances, and expand control in this thematic dice worker-placement game.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Mistfall
description: Mistfall is a fully cooperative adventure game set in a fantasy world of mystery, eldritch powers and high adventure.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Indonesia
description: Indonesia is a game in which two to five players build up an economy, trying to acquire the most money.

title: Tabletop Simulator: In the Name of Odin
description: In the Name of Odin is a strategy game for 2-5 players, each with a claim to become the new Jarl. You are all brave warriors, shrewd traders and bold explorers, but only one of you will become the new Jarl to rule in the name of Odin!

title: Tabletop Simulator: Khronos Hunter
description: The Empress of Time inadvertently triggers a malfunction that causes different time intervals and parallel words to intersect. You are an adventurer who is unwittingly sucked into this time spiral. Your objective is collecting a form of energy called mana and bringing the world back to order, allowing you to return to your own time.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Pillars of Eternity - Lords of the Eastern Reach
description: Pillars of Eternity: Lords of the Eastern Reach is a 1-4 player card game based on Obsidian Entertainment's award-winning and best-selling Pillars of Eternity computer role-playing game.

title: Tabletop Simulator: One Night Ultimate Werewolf
description: One Night Ultimate Werewolf is a fast-paced game for 3-10 players where everyone is dealt a secret role. In the course of only one night and the following morning, the players will determine who among them is a werewolf...hopefully.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Three Kingdoms Redux
description: Three Kingdoms Redux is a board game that seeks to recreate the tripartite between the states of Wei, Wu and Shu. You assume the role of one of the three lords – Cao Cao leading Cao Wei, Sun Jian leading Eastern Wu or Liu Bei leading Shu Han.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Darkrock Ventures
description: Only the host needs to own this DLC. 2-5 Players (1-5 Variant available) | Ages 14 & Up 30-45 MinutesAbout Darkrock VenturesDarkrock Ventures is a worker placement board game about deep-space asteroid mining. Each player takes control of their own Asteroid Mining operation with little more than a ship and a skeleton crew.

title: Tabletop Simulator: Tiny Epic Western
description: The West is growing day by day, and you're looking to stake your claim. To win, you have to gamble your relationships with the most powerful bosses in town to win influence.

title: Russian Fishing 4: Lower Tunguska River
description: Lower Tunguska is the largest tributary of the Yenisei, one of the most famous and majestic rivers of Siberia. The harsh beauty of the wildlife and the abundance of fish make the Lower Tunguska incredibly attractive for fishing enthusiasts. Your RF4 Team

title: Russian Fishing 4: Amber Lake
description: Amber Lake – This reservoir offers a large number of comfortable fishing spots and of course many exciting new carp species. All common methods and baits, that make carp fishing so special, will now be available. The new quad will enable you to comfortably reach even remote fishing spots.

title: Tower!3D: ZBAD Airport
description: Beijing Daxing International Airport (IATA: PKX, ICAO: ZBAD), ZBAD is Beijing's second international airport that has been nicknamed "the starfish" because of its look.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite - Black Widow
description: A DLC adding Black Widow as a playable character to the Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite team. It includes an additional Premium Costume for Black Widow.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite - Venom
description: A DLC adding Venom as a playable character to the Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite team. It includes an additional Premium Costume for Venom.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite - Black Panther
description: A DLC adding Black Panther as a playable character to the Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite team. It includes an additional Premium Costume for Black Panther.

title: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite - Monster Hunter

title: Hyperbolica
description: Hyperbolica is a whimsical Non-Euclidean adventure with mind-bending worlds full of games, puzzles, mazes, and secrets! Immerse yourself in reality-warping geometries where lines can never be parallel, horizons are curved, and space grows exponentially.

title: Stalker
description: The background story of "Stalker" is that a teenager encounters various events on the road following a young girl. title: Chaos Combat Chess
description: Welcome to Chaos Combat Chess, a competitive 8v8 auto chess battle royale!

title: Only One Rectangle
description: Platformer with a variety of disorienting gameplay for an interesting gaming experience. A lot of colors, invisible painted platforms, traps, various puzzles.

title: The Curse of Kubel
description: An earthquake swallows up the city of Kaldesta and splits it into two. Now many adventurers travel there in search of treasure. However, a curse suddenly appears and starts infecting the adventurers...

title: Missy's Transformation Tournament
description: Rogue-lite meets single-player battle royale! Enter Missy's Transformation Tournament! Preserve your humanity at all costs! Defeat the other contestants by transforming them into submission. Survive in a dynamic arena where anything could be a threat. Will you lose yourself to Missy's power?

title: I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 3
description: Gunfire rings out, shattering the safe haven of the town hall. Violent death. People driven to suicide. A mystery group behind the scenes. An imminent horde of zombies. And the intelligent zombies are finally on the move. What will become of Yuusuke and the others?

title: Splash King's Tournament
description: Splash King's Tournament is an exhilarating, fast paced tournament style multiplayer battle royale, third person shooter game for PC.

title: Pain-T
description: Pain-T is an exploration-driven metroidvania where color is your greatest weapon. Restore a world drained of paint, overcome hostile creatures, unlock colorfull powers, reveal hidden paths, and paint your own destiny.

title: Domino Simulator
description: Domino Simulator is a physics-based sandbox game in which you place various domino tiles and pieces to construct domino chains. Enjoy the odd satisfaction of watching your creation fall one after the other. Ultimately, the floor is yours to fill and the how and the what is completely up to you.

title: DockYard
description: Bad physics meets first game project. Dockyard! It's a game. Best send it to your friend as a joke. At least they'll get a good laugh out of it.

title: System Invaders
description: Experience waves upon waves of viruses that have infected your computer. 5 Chapters with over 125 Waves of enemies! Play with your friends in local or online co-op! Can you destroy all the viruses?

title: Hero Mini Maker
description: Build fantasy miniatures using over 800 stylized parts. Export them as STL files for 3D printing, or use one of our online 3D printing partners to bring your creations to life.

title: Successor of the Key
description: A shooting game where a beautiful girl defeats enemies using magic.

title: Microodyssey
description: Microodyssey is a narrative-driven 2D platform game, representing a travel into the greater scientific question: what there is at the start and at the end of everything?

title: SwordBall
description: SwordBall is a free to play 2D sword fighting football game. Football meets fencing? Join your team in the most exciting, fast paced game! Swing your sword and defend your goal or grab the ball and score. Lead your team to victory and join the future of sports!

title: Cubecois
description: Cubecois is a fast and challenging arcade style game with great music. You can choose various skins and upgrades for your mission!

title: Shoot Covid-19
description: Let's try our covid-19 shooting game. In the game, you need to clear all kinds of monsters infected by pneumonia virus in the infirmary, and finally eliminate all the viruses to reach the destination.

title: Chaos Groove
description: CHAOS GROOVE! Classic fast-paced, over-the-top fighting action, featured with upgraded HD 2D Sprites, online play (RollBack Netcode), ground-breaking effects, and a dynamic system that earns points for unlockable goodies. Fight like a hero, play like a legend!

title: Nyxx
description: A classic 2d bullet hell shoot'em'up.

title: Wolfie's Break Out
description: A retro-inspired brick breaker game that takes players on a nostalgic trip down memory lane. With its classic arcade-style graphics and upbeat chiptune soundtrack, the game is designed to transport players back to the golden age of video gaming.

title: Dark Solitaire: Mystical Circus
description: Visit the weird circus now! Open the mystery world to yourself!

title: Alek: The Lost Kingdom
description: Alek, the young man who will change Zarabon's World forever. In this adventure, you must rebuild the world of Zarabon in your image. Build villages and manage your production lines with the help of your villagers.

title: Not An Angels: Erotic Puzzle

title: Cyber Fight Challenge

description: The game recreates the campaigns and battles of Erwin ‘Desert Fox’ Rommel’s legendary Afrika Korps, in Libya between 1941 and 1942. Play the Axis forces to conquer the most valuable prize of all: the Suez Canal. Or command the 8th Army soldiers, the famous Desert Rats, to repel the invaders.

title: Metal Banana
description: The forest was invaded by an army of robots! Use your skill to help Monkee, Donkee, Tinkee and Pinkee save the day. Metal Banana brings classic elements of arcade games in a new title full of action and colors.

title: Outside the Grid
description: Imagine that you are in prison. Not everyone can escape from the hands of justice, you need to have an IQ above average. Blow up, destroy, hide, kill, evolve - all this can be done in the game Outside the Grid. But do not forget about Kerbalai, help him finally find peace!

description: Dylan has lost everything and now wants to forget everything, help him in this little journey. One/Iro is a 3D first person puzzle game, explore the rooms to find letters and parts of the dream machine so you can discover the truth.

title: Spookyard
description: Spookyard is a local 2D multiplayer computer game that has different and competitive dynamics for each arena, offering game modes that can vary within the topdown and sidescroll camera styles.

title: Watcher Chronicles
description: Become a glutton for punishment and persevere against 20+ merciless bosses and legions of skeletal nightmares in this savage yet charming 2D souls-like.

title: Frag Grounds
description: Immerse yourself in the classic military shooter experience or obliterate your foes with state-of-the-art, prototype equipment such as plasma rifles, remotely controlled mechs or with some good ol' tanks and attack helicopters in this dynamic FPS.

title: Hentai Balloons
description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

title: Keep the Balance
description: There's only one rule in this game: Keep the Balance. Everything else is a comical and frustrating war between you and gravity. Take good care of your keyboard.

title: Railroads & Catacombs
description: In this exciting Card Building Roguelike game you create your cards from scratch adding different upgrades. Build your train, explore the Labyrinth and survive. Discover infinite synergies. How far will you go?

title: Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County
description: In the exciting series finale, The Detective and Lobster Cop are tasked to solve the conundrum of a sheriff-less county. But not all is as it seems here, when a surprisingly simple solution to the case reveals a sinister scheme. Maybe crime is real after all...

description: An erotic drag 'n drop puzzle adventure where you play three versions of yourself - at the same time! You're a sexy slime hero... Change the outcome of your story in real time! Explore the Smutty Scrolls, find legendary items and stay alive to date and pleasure all the girls!

title: Pixel Fixer
description: Restore 100 pictures, which were accidentally shredded. Click and drag the rows, and the will be glued when you release them so that they fit together. You can zoom the pixels to see how they fit, and you can choose 7 difficulty levels to find the best amusing challenge.

title: Super Circuit Breakers
description: Back with new weapons, new enemies, and with more circuits to break than ever! Destroy millions of robots in this free-to-play shooter with up to 6 players.

title: The Curse of Feldar Vale
description: Can your party lift the curse that has befallen the once peaceful Vale? An adventure for 4-6 characters of Level 1-3, loosely based on Dungeons and Dragons Open Game License (OGL 1e/2e).

title: Nibiru Voyage
description: Nibiru Voyage is a classic scrolling game with weapon upgrades and hordes of enemy ships.

title: Offcoast
description: The rogue-like strategy game Offcoast takes place in a subterranean, underwater landscape.

title: Ace Campus Club
description: Receiving a call from your lawyer, and was informed that if you are capable of leading the campus‘s club to become the most popular ones, you will inherit a large sum of money. With the rare chance to finally stepping out, there will be money, and even girls.

title: Flash Snooker Game

description: The Mystic is a dark fantasy, turn-based strategy game. Become a follower of the first gods, gain their favour, overthrow the High King by innovative combat and magic systems and establish harmony. The game offers an exciting campaign full of twists, battles and difficult decisions and multiplayer.

title: Professional Team
description: The popular global coffin carrying culture is coming. Many different coffin carrying heroes, DIY coffin system. Come and hold an unforgettable funeral for him in your heart!

description: Blured Angel is a kind of somatosensory game that uses a camera on a Windows host to capture and interact with each other. It weaves a heaven I see from the spiritual world of the Bible from the perspective of a not so smart but persistent angel "Mehoo".

title: Ephemera
description: Guide your character through it all, from their birth to their last breath. Make sure they remember you.

description: The Book of Distance blends techniques from mechanical sculpture, film, and stage to redefine personal storytelling in virtual reality. Family archives add a haunting layer of realism. 2D and 3D hand-crafted sets reminiscent of Japanese woodblock prints, evocative character design, and seamless choreography combine with surprising moments of interaction to gently whisk us across the ocean and through the years.

description: A modern remake of classic vertical scrollers which were popular in the arcades of the 1980s. Control a spaceship with directional keys or WASD, and shoot rockets upwards with the Space key. Destroy incoming waves of alien spaceships and dodge rockets they fire at you!

title: Rise of the Overlords
description: Rise of the Overlords is a combination of TCG and war board games, bringing new depth and giving new strategies to the players. Place your units wisely and take advantage of the battlefield to defeat your opponents. Who will be the Supreme Overlord that will rule the world? A new era begins!

title: Hentai Fantasy
description: Hentai Fantasy — Beautiful girls from different places want you to help them.

description: Apprehend;Girlfriend is a Yuri Visual Novel about two young women living together under the same roof.

Trying to keep his friendships afloat before it's too late. And just wondering what the future has in hold for him...

title: Free Solo: One Life

title: No-Zero

title: Synonym
description: Synonym is an atmospheric puzzle game with mechanics inspired by mimicry. Manipulate blocks that will copy your position, height and rotation.

title: The Un-Beatable Game

description: Beyond Polaris Guardian is a action-rpg and TPS on a flexible campaign system with different stories. Incarne 3 unique characters and develop your personal story thanks to the innovative Galactic Network system.

Why can't you remember a time before the snow started falling?

The Cabin is a short, first person, slow-burn psychological thriller set in a cabin. Why is this cabin here? Better yet, why are you here?

The Cabin is proof-of-concept game created in 15 days for the November 2020 AGS monthly adventure game challenge.
