description: Pilot the Kotel One aircraft. Survive the samozbor invasion.

title: Stone River
description: Because of the tornado, you are blown to a mysterious island, which is full of crisis and unknown. Exploring this island is still your only chance to survive. In this new environment, you will be tested and constantly remind yourself how close you are to death.

title: Chromatic Labyrinth
description: Chromatic Labyrinth is a first person shooter with roguelike elements. The game features a random level generator and collectable items with passive effects.

title: Color Souls
description: Color Souls is a Fast-paced Splatformer where platforms are invisible and you have to paint them. Walk, Jump, Double Jump, Slide and Wall Jump to paint everything, A vast amount of difficult levels for you challenge and powerful bosses to beat.

title: Monkey vs. Dino
description: Choose for whom you will fight a dinosaur and a monkey, fight.

title: Remorse
description: This game takes place in an ascending void where walls flank the sides and platforms of varying lengths rise upward.

title: LouveSystems' TrackMasters
description: Create your own tracks - challenge your friends!TrackMasters is a multiplayer arcade racing game inspired by MicroMachines, packed with a full level editor to make your own tracks the way you want, and share them with your friends!

title: Frog World
description: Venture into the depths of the Swamp as an adorable frog! Grapple, swing, jump, and swim to complete a secret quest in this short side scrolling adventure.

title: Hadrian's Villa Reborn: Stadium Garden
description: Take a virtual tour of the Stadium Garden at Hadrian’s Villa, the World Heritage Site located in Tivoli, Italy. After the virtual tour you will know far more about how the place was designed, decorated, and used than even a visitor to the actual archaeological site, now reduced to a grassy field.

title: Alan Wake Remastered
description:
Alan Wake Remastered is an updated version of the original psychological horror action-adventure game developed by Remedy Entertainment. The game retains the core narrative, which follows bestselling thriller novelist Alan Wake as he struggles with writer's block. He visits the small town of Bright Falls with his wife, Alice, in search of inspiration. Shortly after their arrival, Alice mysteriously disappears.

Alan finds pages of a thriller novel he does not remember writing, with events from the manuscript coming to life. He faces supernatural entities called the "Taken," who are controlled by darkness. The remastered version features enhanced graphics and improved performance, but the gameplay and storyline remain consistent with the original, focusing on themes of reality, fiction, and the power of the written word.

It also includes the two story DLCs "The Signal" and "The Writer".

title: Mugen no Shinzou
description:
Cursed by the gods, on the verge of death, the protagonist of the game is transferred to a different realm - a fantasy land ruled by sword and sorcery, in which humans are threatened by rampaging goblins, orcs, and a mysterious dragon. The hero must find a powerful artifact known as the Heart of Phantasm in order to return home.

Mugen no Shinzō is a role-playing game similar to early Ultima games. The player controls a lone character with basic attributes who roams the vast land, visiting towns and dungeons. Overworld navigation is done by scrolling with arrow keys, without an icon to represent the player character. Town locations have little to no graphics; along with the dungeons, they are displayed in small windows. The maze-like dungeons are represented by abstract pseudo-3D vector graphics. Combat is random; the protagonist fights enemies one-on-one in simple turn-based fashion.

title: Dot Dash Dot
description: "You were the only applicant. You have been accepted. Please report to Locke Key by Monday." Take the role of a lighthouse operator, and use your spacebar to send Morse code messages to ships in the sea.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Imrik
description: A direct descendant of Caledor the Phoenix King, Imrik is widely known as the greatest living Dragon Prince and shares a unique bond with Dragonkind.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Gor-Rok
description: Gor-Rok, or the Great White Lizard as he is known, is a veteran Saurus Warrior with the scars to prove it.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Tiktaq'to
description: Tiktaq'to, Master of Skies for the Temple-City of Hexoatl, is the greatest of all the Terradon Riders. Atop his fierce terradon, Zwup, he patrols the firmament, leading his squadron through the narrowest, ravines and steepest valleys, surprising the enemy by appearing from unexpected directions and bombarding them with a deadly hail of rocks.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Alith Anar
description: Alith Anar appears as a new High Elf Legendary Lord in both the Eye of the Vortex and Mortal Empires campaigns. Voiced by Hollywood actor Dylan Sprouse, Alith Anar brings a host of unique traits and abilities to High Elf campaign and battle gameplay.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Lokhir Fellheart
description: Lokhir Fellheart, the Krakenlord of Karond Kar, is loosed upon the world! The latest and most notorious of his line, he plies the coastlines and seaways of the world, plundering ports and settlements for their riches and enslaving their inhabitants.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Twisted & The Twilight
description: This Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II introduces two new Legendary lords for the Skaven and the Wood Elves. Each leads their own faction and features new characters, units, unique gameplay mechanics and narrative objectives.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Hunter & The Beast
description: The Hunter & The Beast is the latest Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Introducing two rival Legendary Lords from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, each with their own objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle, for use in both the Eye of the Vortex and Mortal Empires campaigns, and custom/multiplayer battles.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - Repanse de Lyonesse
description: Repanse de Lyonesse, or the 'Damoiselle de Guerre' as she is known throughout Bretonnia, is a revered knight of the Chevaliers de Lyonesse.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Warden & The Paunch
description: The Warden & the Paunch is the latest Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Introducing two rival Legendary Lords from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, each with their own factions, objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Shadow & The Blade
description: The Shadow & The Blade is the latest Legendary Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Introducing Malus Darkblade and Deathmaster Snikch both with their own objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle.

title: Total War: Warhammer II: Steps of Isha
description: The Steps of Isha is a free downloadable Map Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. This Map Pack contains 4 new battle maps for custom and multiplayer battles in Total War: Warhammer II.

title: Total War: Warhammer II - The Queen & The Crone
description: The Queen & the Crone is the first Lords Pack for Total War: Warhammer II. Bolstering the forces of the High Elves and the Dark Elves, it introduces famous rival characters and new iconic units from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles to your campaigns and battles.

title: Total War Saga: Thrones of Britannia - Blood, Sweat and Spears
description: Rule Britannia with a bloodied iron fist and experience the true brutality of war. Blood, Sweat and Spears adds ultra-violence and gore to Total War Saga: Thrones of Britannia.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Eight Princes
description: The year is 291 CE, and a generation has passed since the tumultuous events of the Three Kingdoms period began. Despite the tripartite division of power which brought the conflict to a stalemate, and the brief unification of the kingdoms under the Jin dynasty, civil war is no more than a heartbeat away.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Tao Qian
description: Tao Qian has long been a steward of the Han and his own territory. He is renowned as a dependable and respectable governor, and one who focuses on building tall. He wants to make life better for the people he governs, and defends his lands against those would dare to encroach upon it.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Shi Xie
description: Nepotism rules in the world of Shi Xie, and he is determined to spread his inner circle across the whole of China. Shi Xie will stop at nothing to get his family into power; After all, it’s all about who you know.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Reign of Blood
description: This pack introduces a number of new gory and mature-rated effects, animations and kill-moves to the game in both Campaign and Battle.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Yellow Turban Rebellion
description: A brand-new sub-culture to play as: rekindle the Yellow Turban Rebellion, lead their struggle against the corrupt Han and bring about the Era of Great Peace.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - A World Betrayed
description: A World Betrayed portrays a seminal moment in the history of the Three Kingdoms. Many of the iconic warlords of Total War: Three Kingdoms have now passed on, a catalyst that has spurred a new generation of warlords into making a play for their own dynasties.

title: Skyforge: Bounty Hunter Collector's Edition
description: Let the hunt begin! This Collector’s Edition unlocks the Bounty Hunter, a powerful new AOE damage-dealing class armed to the teeth with explosive weapons, plus trick anti-grav and shield gadgets. You'll also receive an exclusive Costume, Legendary Weapon, and a host of useful items:

title: Ancient Souls Tamag
description: Help Erlik Khan to get out of Tamag. Defeat your enemies, solve puzzles and overcome challenging obstacles. Prince of Souls-Like kind a game.

title: American Truck Simulator: Texas
description:
Howdy, partners! Hope y'all will like your visit in the Lone Star State, Texas. This place ain't full of cowboys anymore but the spirit lives on, especially in ranches you can find all 'round. We also got a lot of cattle and other livestock so your truckin' adventures will be lively.

We also love music. Like, really love music. Just look at Austin, the live music capital of the world. Party on. Look plumb over yonder and you'll see the city which got the message about the problem. Sure'nuff, we're talking about Houston. So enjoy the drive.

Get your lasso ready and catch all the news by hittin' the follow button and wishlisting Texas. This probably ain’t your first rodeo.

title: American Truck Simulator: Colorado
description: Welcome to Colorful Colorado, a state that has some of the best wildlands and mountain ranges in the US. See a big metropolitan area of Denver on the edge of the Great Plains, travel across the beautiful Rocky Mountains and through deep canyons to see vast desert landscapes around Grand Junction.

title: Metal Swarm Infinity
description: Enter an ever changing, randomly generated galaxy and battle the Metal Swarm menance in this arcade style shoot 'em up. Blast through hordes of bugs, collect powerups and battle giant bosses as you harvest their power cores to upgrade your ship.

title: Escape From School
description: Confused, you wake up sucked into an empty classroom. You have to try to escape from school by solving puzzles and discovering secrets.

title: Blon
description: Blon is a cute pixel-art 2D platformer game. Unlock spells, heroes and weapons, fight monsters and bosses and explore an unknown world in hopes of rescuing your family.

title: FGTeev Goozy
description: Explore a house full of weird technology and slimy surprises as you attempt to save the FGTeeV family.

title: Payday 2: The Charlie Santa Heist
description: The Charlie Santa Heist is the first annual OVERKILL Xmas heist for PAYDAY 2 and lets players do a classic bank job - robbing the GO Bank, based on a map from Counterstrike: Global Offensive, in the outskirts of Washington D.C. This heist was a part of update 20 and is completely free for our players.

title: Payday 2: The Diamond Heist
description: Time to Shine.The Diamond Heist DLC is the 13th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and adds the fourth heist from the new contact known as the Dentist. It's time to shine for the PAYDAY gang with the most exciting heist yet - the Diamond heist. You've heard the legend of the Diamond. A meteorite that was found by Genghis Khan.

title: Payday 2: John Wick Heists
description: THE LEGEND IS BACK IN TOWNThe John Wick Heist Pack is the 38th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2. The John Wick Heist Pack comes with 2 brand-new Heists: Brooklyn 10-10 and Yacht Heist, 2 new weapons, 4 masks, patterns, materials, 2 songs and 12 new achievements.

title: Payday 2: The Shadow Raid Heist
description: The Shadow Raid Heist is the fourth free heist update to PAYDAY 2. It allows heisters to take a new contract from Bain and Gage called the Shadow Raid job. A stealth only heist, it includes a free mask, the “Somen Mempo” mask, as well as 6 new achievements. This heist was a part of update 29 and is completely free for our players.

title: Payday 2: Buluc's Mansion Heist
description: Vlad contacts the Payday Gang and wants them to infiltrate the crime lord Buluc’s well-guarded mansion and assassinate him.

title: Payday 2: The Alesso Heist
description: Gang! Listen up!The Alesso Heist DLC is the 23rd DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and is a collaboration with the DJ Alesso. Navigate through the Gensec arena, quiet or loud, and keep the show going while trying to crack Gensec's state of the art exhibition vaults containing loads of cash.

title: Payday 2: The Bomb Heists
description: Bombs Away!The Bomb Heists DLC is the 15th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and adds the first two heists from the new contact known as the Butcher. It's bombs away as you help the Butcher succeed with the heists Dockyard and Forest as a part of the Bomb job.

title: Payday 2: The Golden Grin Casino Heist
description: Las Vegas is a Desert Mirage, a Jewel Amongst the Sands.The Golden Grin Casino Heist DLC is the 24th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and is the final contract from the Dentist. She boasts more Five Diamond hotels than any other city in the world. Her shine and sparkle attracts tens of millions of dreamers every year.

title: Payday 2: The Point Break Heists
description: Crime Has No Limit.The Point Break Heists DLC is the 29th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and represents a dream come true collaboration for us developers in the OVERKILL crew. For those of you who've been playing PAYDAY games since the first one came out, you know Point Break was one of the heist movies that was the core inspiration for PAYDAY.

title: Payday 2: The Diamond Store Heist
description: The Diamond Store Heist is the first free heist that was released for PAYDAY 2 and lets players do a classy heist against the Gioielli Di Famiglia jewelry store in downtown Washington D.C.This heist was a part of update 11 and is completely free for our players.

title: Payday 2: Armored Transport
description: The Armored Transport DLC is the second DLC pack for PAYDAY 2 and lets players do every heisters dream – robbing armored transports, full of valuables, right in the middle of Washington D.C. If they're lucky, they can hit it big with a classic train robbery.

title: Payday 2: The Election Day Heist
description: The Election Day Heist is the third free heist update to PAYDAY 2. It allows heisters to take a new contract from the corrupt politician the Elephant called the Election Day job. A free pistol weapon, skill changes, a big stealth update and new assets have been added.

title: Payday 2: Scarface Heist
description: YOU WANNA PLAY ROUGH?The Scarface Heist Pack is the 37th DLC pack for PAYDAY 2. The Scarface Heist Pack comes with The Scarface Mansion Heist, 2 new weapons, 4 masks, materials and patterns and 6 Achievements.

title: Payday 2: The Ukrainian Prisoner Heist
description: This heist DLC sees the Payday Gang hitting the San Francisco docks in order to rescue a friend in trouble.

title: Payday 2: Border Crossing Heist
description: The Payday Gang is going to Mexico! This DLC contains two heists. The main heist is playable in both stealth and loud and includes pre-planning options. The secondary "cooking" heist is loud only and takes place in the same location but with a different scenario.

title: Panel Attack
description: Fast, flashy, and free.A modern twist on classic Panel de Pon / Tetris Attack–style match-3 action. Swap tiles, trigger insane chains, and push your skills to the limit as the board rises beneath you. Easy to learn, hard to master, and built for pure, arcade-speed fun.

title: Hentai Beach Girls
description: Visit sunny beach with the cutest girls walking around. But your intentions are very vulgar. Use beach balls to knockdown girls and kidnap them with drones.

title: Touch Melbourne
description: Explore the city of Melbourne through its various, tiny everyday interactions.

title: Inside the Void
description: Inside the Void is an exploration game where you must navigate through seven alien structures in an effort to unravel the disappearance of lost crew members. You will encounter messages left by the lost crew members that offer a glimpse into their fate.

title: Floating Sandbox
description: This game is a realistic two-dimensional particle system, which uses mass-spring networks to simulate rigid bodies (such as ships) floating in water and exchanging heat with their surroundings. You can punch holes in an object, slice it, apply forces and heat to it, set it on fire, and smash it with bomb explosions. Once water starts rushing inside the object, it will start sinking and, if you're lucky enough, it will start breaking up!

title: Can Androids Survive
description:
Becoming a walking, 2-ton supply line in a new shortform sandbox mech FPS from the writer of Can Androids Pray. In Can Androids Survive, you are a battlefield courier, sent to an active warzone on the Moon to deliver supplies to Starbound Alliance bases--even if it costs your life in the process. Battle a draining fuel gauge, hordes of mechanized hazards, and a treacherous lunar surface to unravel the nature of your existence. Jettison fuel through your exhaust ports to escape stellar float mines and launch your chassis across craters. End the war itself--by destroying the field.

In 2143, a rogue AI commandeers the defense satellites surrounding a dead Earth, and blows up the Moon.

This is how you do it.

title: Scourge Outbreak: Blindside
description: The brutal struggle between Echo Squad and Nogari continues with "Blindside", Scourge: Outbreak's first Multiplayer PvP Map DLC Pack, featuring six new action-filled Versus maps. With extreme heights, speeding trains, death-dealing lasers and toxic gas, danger lurks around every corner.

title: Zoners
description: Zoners is a fast paced, 1-on-1, competitive sports action game. Featuring a cast of atypical characters, a Milky Way galaxy not exactly as you know it, simple but deep mechanics & tons of profile based accessibility & customization features. It's time to get into the zone!

title: Scary Buddies
description: Play online in VR with 3-15 players in a mysterious mansion, identify the killer and get him down!

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: USA Utah
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the fantastic state of Utah with many airports, like Salt Lake City and the Monument Valley area. Additionally this DLC features high resolution aerial images of Utah with up to 1 meter resolution.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Monterey Regional Airport
description: A classic Orbx destination brought to life for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator, virtual pilots are welcomed to Monterey Regional Airport, one of California's most scenic airports.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Switzerland
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator feature over 30 of the best known airports of Switzerland, including Zürich, Grenchen, Samedan and Birrfeld. Furthermore this DLC features high resolution aerial images of Switzerland with a resolution of up to 1 meter.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: USA South Florida
description: Welcome to south Florida and the Florida Keys! This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the southern part of Florida, including historic Key West. You will be mesmerized by the breathtaking views while you fly over major attractions like Fort Zachary Taylor, the Martello Museum, Duval Street, Key West cemetery, The Key West Southernmost Point, etc.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: USA Colorado
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the fantastic state of Colorado with over 30 airports, like Denver International, Aspen and scenic airports like Telluride. Additionally this DLC features high resolution aerial images of Colorado with up to 1 meter resolution.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Eagle County Colorado
description: Located in the heart of the Colorado Rockies, Eagle-Vail is famous for both it's dramatic scenery, as well as it's dangerous approach. Surrounded by difficult terrain and prone to bad weather, KEGE is a high-altitude airport that will test even seasoned pilots.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Palm Springs International Airport
description: A classic Orbx destination developed by Jarrad Marshall, Palm Springs has been brought to life for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator! With one of the most dramatically scenic backdrops in the United States, Palm Springs is a resort city situated 100 miles east of Los Angeles in Southern California.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Innsbruck Airport
description: A destination that needs no introduction, Innsbruck is one of the iconic airports of the world, with a jaw-dropping backdrop, heart-stopping approaches and a location in the heart of Europe.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Aerosoft - Lukla Mount Everest
description: “Gateway to Mount Everest” and “World's Most Dangerous Airport” are certainly the most commonly used attributes for Lukla – an airport that seems out of this world.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: France VFR - Paris-Ile-de-France
description: Take off to Paris, the romantic and artistic city with a thousand faces ! Fly over the capital but also the entire "Ile de France" region by discovering the diversity of its landscapes and its rich cultural and tourist heritage...

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Orbx - Netherlands TrueEarth
description: TrueEarth technology is finally landing in Aerofly FS 2 starting with The Netherlands! Expect to find extremely dense building & vegetation cultivation, incredible crisp terrain textures, and effortlessly smooth performance.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Aerosoft - Germany Helgoland
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the famous island of Helgoland in Germany with detailed buildings and a a very detailed airport. Additionally this DLC includes surrounding landmarks like the fishing and tourist town Büsum as well as Germany's largest oil field Mittelplate.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Northeastern USA
description: This DLC for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features the area of New York with detailed city buildings and over 10 airports, like KJFK John F. Kennedy International and KGLA La Guardia. Additionally this DLC features high resolution aerial images of New York and the surrounding area with up to 1 meter resolution.

title: Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator: Q400
description: One of the most famous turboprop regional airliners, the Dash 8 Q400 for Aerofly FS 2 Flight Simulator features realistic flight dynamics, a detailed auto flight system and avionics system as well as an accurate turboprop engine simulation. The Dash 8 Q400 is the largest regional airliner of the Q Series and can seat up to 86 passengers.

title: The Necromancer's Tale
description: A story-rich gothic RPG. Master the rituals of an ancient spellbook. Raise an undead army to march against your enemies. Commune with the realm of the dead & struggle with your descent into madness. Progress through secrecy, diplomacy, blackmail, coercion & seduction until ready to reveal yourself.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Shingo Aoi
description: Shingo Aoi is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Taichi Nakanishi
description: Taichi Nakanishi is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

description: Singprasert Bunnaak is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

description: Xiao Junguang is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Ryoma Hino
description: Ryoma Hino is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

description: Pepe is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

description: Stefan Levin is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Mark Owairan
description: Mark Owairan is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Ricardo Espadas
description: Ricardo Espadas is now available as a new playable character in Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

title: Free Kick X
description: Become the legendary freekicker in the Football arena with Free Kick X. Play with different countries. Think tactical, be quick against the time and enjoy the free kicks!

title: Lost and Found: What if I Come and Find It
description: "Lost and found - What if I come and find It" is a first-person narrative game whose story will take you to the depths of working in a great corporation. After finishing your studies, you have achieved an internship in the maintenance department of SilverCup, the most renowned technological company in your city. A unique opportunity which will bring you a promising future.

title: HyperViolent
description: An ancient evil has awoken in the depths of a remote mining asteroid, stirred from its slumber by man's lust for power. Unaware, you answer a distress call and become stranded, surrounded by monstrous foes. Unravel the mystery of this madness and stop its spread in this violent retro shooter!

title: Video Horror Society
description: Choose between good and evil and fight for your life in Video Horror Society, a thrilling 4v1 asymmetric action tribute to the 1980s horror era-- where small town teens face off against terrifying monsters brought to life from the aisles of a 1980s video store.

title: The Enthralling Realms: The Blacksmith's Revenge
description: A challenging fantasy match-3 game! Help the Blacksmiths daughter Ara to avenge her village and defeat a vicious dragon.

title: Doom 3: The Lost Mission
description: The Lost Mission is the second official Doom 3 expansion pack, released in 2012 as part of Doom 3: BFG Edition. The player takes control of a surviving member of the marine squad Bravo Team, which the hero of the original campaign was meant to rejoin. The primary objective, given to the marine by Dr. Richard Meyers, is to shut down a high-powered long-range teleporter in the top secret Exis Labs in order to prevent the demons from using it to reach Earth.

title: Lotus Simulator: München Tram
description: The first add-on for the Lotus Simulator: the Munich Tram. With the tram R2.2b of MVG you can virtually drive through the city centre of Munich and explore the scenery along routes 27 & 28. Detailed reconstructed and perfectly animated. Take control at the driver's seat, let's go.

title: Covid 2069
description: Short descriptione were told to wash our hands. We were told to wear a mask. We were told to stay at home. We didn't, now we've got countless undead on our hands

title: Mafalda: Jugando con Números y Palabras
description: An Argentinean edutainment game featuring the characters of the comic strip Mafalda. You play as the main character, Mafalda, who has to aim at various posters in order to unlock her birthday party (Math) or a trip to the beach (Language). There are also a couple of mini-games in between.

title: Conan Exiles: Isle of Siptah
description: Isle of Siptah is a massive expansion to the open world survival game Conan Exiles, featuring a vast new island to explore, huge and vile new creatures to slay, new building sets and a host of new features.

title: System32
description: Teleport into a 1988 personal computer running a visually intense bullet hell simulation. Fight alongside your team to destroy Russian hackers in real-time.

title: Viscera Cleanup Detail: House of Horror
description: In an old house, on a gloomy Halloween night, a dark force was woken and terrible deeds were done. Now it's your turn to remove the stains of evil and clean up this mess!

title: Viscera Cleanup Detail: The Vulcan Affair
description: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to get on with the job and clean this place up! In this DLC for Viscera Cleanup Detail, you will have to deal with the aftermath of a mission on Dr. Hades lair.

title: Myth of Mist: Legacy
description: In the mist-surrounded City of Time and Eternity, you are the son of a noble family, going between various factions aiming to fight against the upcoming disaster of the Mist of Doomsday. This game is for players who love SLGs and multi-ending RPGs. Join us and write your own legend!

title: Darq: The Crypt
description: Lloyd's adventure continues. This time he explores a mysterious crypt full of dark surprises.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: ETR 1000 - Frecciarossa
description: The ETR 1000 "Frecciarossa" is a train, that lives superlatives: being one of the world's fastest trains, it reached a lunatic 400 km/h.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: NYC J3a-Dreyfuss Streamlined Hudson
description: New York Central J3a-Dreyfuss streamlined Hudson built by American Locomotive Company in 1938.

title: Space Crisis
description: The enemy is attacking in the spaceship. You are a combatant, so you have to fight.

title: Unshaded
description: A game from the creator of Within the Blade. Complete 100 hardcore stealth missions. Become a ninja master.

title: Push the Box 3D
description: This game is based on Sokoban in 3D with new mechanics and puzzles.

title: Rekkr: Sunken Land
description: A retro FPS set in a faux norse-celtic fantasy world in the midst of a war with the dead. Grab an axe, get revenge.

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Lauren Shiba Super Samurai
description: This unlocks Lauren Shiba - Super Samurai Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

description: This unlocks Dai Shi - Jungle Fury Villain, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

description: This unlocks Robert James - Jungle Fury Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

description: This unlocks Lord Zedd, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

description: This unlocks Ryu - Crimson Hawk Ranger in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Trey of Triforia: Gold Zeo Ranger
description: This unlocks Trey of Triforia - Gold Zeo Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Chun-Li Blue Phoenix Ranger
description: This unlocks the character: Chun Li - Blue Phoenix Ranger for Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

description: This unlocks Anubis 'Doggie' Cruger SPD Shadow Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Pulsar

Get ready to take on the great outdoors anywhere because ACTIVE LIFE Outdoor Challenge is back on the Nintendo Switch! From kayaking to obstacle-filled races, you will engage in real-life exercises to complete a variety of fun minigames. Improve your hand-eye coordination and work up a sweat with the Joy-Con and Leg Strap!
Play over a dozen single and multiplayer challenges. Simple controls allow for easy-to-pick up games that anyone can enjoy. With ACTIVE LIFE Outdoor Challenge, you can bring the adventure wherever you go!

Players wield a vaccine-firing gun and a massive syringe to stand against the rampaging virus. The only thing that can save these giant girls is your extra-thick injection!? An flashy rescue mission of extraordinary scale and intensity is about to begin.

Adventurers explore a vast, randomly generated world with a variety of biomes and cities with different characteristics, crafting equipment and items to take on strongholds of vicious monsters to save the world from the clutches of evil. Set forth on an adventure and create your own lasting story. Explore the map in earnest, collecting items, excavating terrain with explosives, and even creating block art. The ultimate goal in this open-world is yours to decide.

description: Step into a world straight out of the classic films. SummerCamp brings slasher themes into a thrilling new multiplayer video game experience!

title: One Day in London: Chapter V
description: The final chapter of visual novel One Day in London! Trapped enemy is the most dangerous... It's time for extreme measures!

description: A Wild West themed incremental/clicker game, but this time you type WASD to shoot. Utilize and customize the various weapons to find a combo that works for you, or use the Showdown and Training modes to benchmark how fast you can type WASD.

description: Your conquest of offworld markets has taken you not only to Mars, but to the moons of Ceres, Europa, and Io. Each world comes with its own trials and challenges - now, you can face all of them down at once in Offworld Trading Company: Interdimensional.

title: Offworld Trading Company: Market Corrections
description: Market Corrections is a new piece of downloadable content for Offworld Trading Company that features 12 brand new maps and 3 new character campaigns that share why humanity began to colonize Mars.

title: Offworld Trading Company: The Europa Wager Expansion
description: If you thought turning a profit on Mars was tough, just wait until you try your hand building a business on Europa. The smallest of Jupiter’s Galilean moons, Europa presents new challenges - and new opportunities! - for brave space entrepreneurs.

title: Fill and Cross: Trick or Treat 2
description: Trick or treat? No tricks! 120 new Halloween-themed levels is a real treat for griddlers fans on Halloween!

title: Alien Attack: Zero
description: You are a brave stormtrooper, Alien Forces Annihilators Squad member. Your mission is to destroy every single enemy inside of your sector. At least, to try.

description: Atomicrops: Invasive Species update introduces four new bosses, rare Blood Moon nights, and vicious enemies. New content includes an Alien Ant, unique scrolls, 10 achievements, and Topiaries with permanent bonuses. Changes modify gameplay mechanics, seed sowing, and boss interactions. Balance adjustments fine-tune weapons, tractors, and enemy spawns. Bug fixes address audio issues, seed drops, and various gameplay mechanics.

description: It's a maze game with 60 levels, you are alone, find the keys and the exit.

title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - I Am the Boss
description: Embody the four powerful bosses - Azexez, Count Carlyle, Ludmilla, and Azh-Rafir - in Quick Battle, online or offline Multiplayer modes. Master their four new spells: Azexez's Demon Portal, Ludmilla's Spider Swarm, Count Carlyle's Bile Blast and Azh-Rafir's Palm Blast!

title: Arslan: The Warriors of Legend - Skill Card Set 2
description: Adds 15 set of Limited Skill Cards. A set contains 3 cards. The Skill Cards can be acquired in Free Mode by selecting "Add" under "Skill Cards".

title: Panzer Corps: Grand Campaign - '40
description: May 10th, 1940The Maginot Line, shield of France and the battleship on land, was supposed to be impenetrable, but the Germans have a secret and daring plan aimed to topple their old enemy! Import your experienced troops from the first campaign, or start with a pre-generated brand new core and lead your forces to victory.

title: Panzer Corps: Grand Campaign - '41
description: 1941The largest invasion in the history of the world, Operation Barbarossa, is about to begin! Before it can, however, the Balkans must be secured! Take command of your forces once again and lead them to victory in this next installment of the Grand Campaign!

description: For the first time in its 10 year history, Panzer Corps series is going to thoroughly explore the Pacific Theatre of Operations in the Second World War.

title: Extinction: Ravenii Rampage
description: As the sole warrior equipped with the skills to save humanity, you must use everything in your arsenal to defeat the ogre onslaught.

title: Hitman 2: Mumbai
description: Nicknamed 'City of Dreams', lose yourself in the crowds of Mumbai's infamous slums, or admire Bollywood movie locations from afar; Mumbai will not disappoint with its colorful life and countless hidden secrets.

title: Hitman 2: Isle of Sgàil
description: The Isle of Sgàil, North Sea, is one of the most secretive places in the world. Rumored to have served as everything from a Roman outpost to a "black site" prison for Russian spies, the island is a mystery to virtually everyone.

title: Hitman 2: Himmelstein
description: Perched in a sniper nest overlooking a lush Chateau during a lavish wedding ceremony, eliminate an international gang of thieves. Play alone as Agent 47 or choose a new operative and play online co-op with a friend.

DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 2 is the second part of a five-part story.

description: DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 3

title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4 - Road to Boruto Next Generations
description: We're celebrating with the Next Generations DLC, which comes with a bonus theme and new playable characters: Momoshiki Otsutsuki and Kinshiki Otsutsuki. That's not all! 11 famous shinobi are joining the battle in new Boruto-era costumes!

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier - Khyber Strike
description: The third downloadable content pack for Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier, Khyber Strike features three new multiplayer maps, a new multiplayer game mode called Takeover, a new Guerrilla Mode co-op map, new achievements, and an increased level cap.

title: Pro Strategy Football 2021
description: Manage, Coach, or enjoy watching live sims! Create custom schedules! Configure playoffs formats, create manual brackets, or standalone tournaments! Enjoy custom sounds, music, and more! Season play with up to 130 teams! Career play with custom leagues!

title: Blaster Master Zero 2: Kanna Raising Simulator
description: Adds the ultra weird mini-game "Kanna Raising Simulator" to the EXTRA menu. Capture a variety of materials to make fertilizer and grow your very own Kanna! There are loads of potential Kannas to grow, and you can check out every one you've completed in "Kanna's Strangallery"!

title: Grim Tales: Trace in Time - Collector's Edition
description: Bad omens are on the horizon…

title: Vanguard Princess: Online Deluxe
description: Vanguard Princess: Online Deluxe features online netplay support for the Steam version of Vanguard Princess. The DLC is also an updated version of the game that also features unlocked characters, additional battle stages, in-game music, and story-lines.

title: My Lil Horror
description: Just a basic puzzle solving/survival game. Kill zombies, have fun, get to the end without dying! Updated versions may include more weapons, extra chapters, and more.

title: Quantum Conundrum: IKE-aramba!
description: Just when you thought you were done with rescue duty, it's up to you to save Ike! In this all-new adventure, rescue Ike and leap seemingly endless chasms as you travel through an all-new wing of Quadwrangle Manor.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Night Striker
description: From the unique arcade machine with an analog joystick and pseudo 3D, comes Night Striker. Pilot Inter Gray in 2D sidescrolling levels, and shoot down enemies with your homing missiles.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Galaxy Force II
description: An extreme motion game in a fantastic universe, Galaxy Force II was a pioneer in pseudo-3D graphics. Use your evasion roll while shooting missiles to down enemies.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Mahoudaisakusen
description: A game set in a world pervaded by the smell of oil and steel, where fantasy and steampunk are fused together. In true RPG fashion, your rivals reappear with new gear time and time again!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Soukyuugurentai
description: A 'lock-on' shooter set in a science-fiction world telling the tale of private armies and a battle for resources in the near future. Featuring a targeting system and widespread use of Japanese lettering at key moments to enhance the near-future setting meant it stood apart from its peers.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Space Harrier
description: Space Harrier is an all-time SEGA classic and pioneer in pseudo-3D graphics. With Harrier, you can set up fixed bursts and shoot all around.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Fantasy Zone
description: Fantasy Zone is famous for its free scrolling and shop system. Similar to the original, shooting down enemies will drop coins, which you can use to buy stronger attacks.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - RayForce
description: The beginning of the lock-on laser series, RayForce! Lock on to multiple enemies, before firing your laser, to get the highest multipliers.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Ketsui
description: Hyper aggressive game design brought many enthusiastic fans to this side scrolling shooting game. Welcome to special round!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Side Arms Hyper Dyne
description: Robot shooting with the tagline "Ultimate combination of α and β". The player ship, Alpha (nicknamed Mobichan), would go on to appear in many Capcom titles, including Varth!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - DoDonPachi Resurrection
description: Dondonpachi, the Cave masterpiece receives Resurrection after a Blissful Death. Feast on firepower in bullet hell!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Battle Garegga
description: Widely considered as both the origin of the bullet hell sub-genre and one of its standouts, the true joy of Battle Garegga's lies in unravelling the game’s various complex systems.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Metal Black
description: From its hard-boiled world, comes Metal Black. Gather Newalones to fill up your gauge and use your Focused Beam and Release Beam.

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Deathsmiles
description: Side scrolling shooting in a Gothic Horror world! That distinctive cave touch wasn't lost with the switch to horizontal scrolling!

title: Dariusburst: Chronicle Saviours - Varth: Operation Thunderstorm
description: Varth had the tagline "The Final Battle. Regain the planet VARTH!!" and was 30 stages of classic, vertically scrolling shooting with bullet-shielding pods and a self-charging bomb. Planet Varth wasn’t the final battle! Saber returns!

title: The Outbreak Guardian
description: The Outbreak Guardian is a third person open-world game where you are in charge of ensuring the welfare of the citizens of Patriam by managing the cities resources and agents, which involves delivering equipment and some driving.

title: The Pit: Infinity - Juggernaut
description: Summoned to Arbuda by the promise of a huge reward, Tor Makari is here to rescue a kidnapped human from a high-security alien facility and pull down the biggest bounty of his career. He is a force to be reckoned with, nigh unstoppable. He is a Juggernaut!

title: The Pit: Infinity - Healer
description: With a planet ravaged by disease and the only cure at the bottom of a long-abandoned alien science facility, SolForce medic Astryd Jemison must lay down her oath to do no harm, pick up her Transfuser pistol, and enter... The Pit.

title: XOXO Droplets: Full Version Extension
description: Bump your boyfriend prospects up by six more with the option to date Bae Pyoun, Jeremy King, Pran Taylor, Kam Sung, Adrian Wulu, and Lucas Kaiser.

title: Hardcore Mecha: Round Hammer Particle Cannon
description: Self-explosion is always the basic for ace pilot, don't you wanna go for it? This DLC includes a multiplayer mecha: Round Hammer Particle Cannon.

title: Hardcore Mecha: Thunderbolt Otome
description: Created by simulation battle developers in private, according to their preferences. Although it has exactly the same performance as the original Thunderbolt, it unexpectedly increased the pilot’s moral.

title: Hardcore Mecha: Graeme
description: This DLC includes a multiplayer mecha "Graeme" and a multiplayer pilot "Vulphaes Bonaparte".

title: Hardcore Mecha: Shepherd Jaeger
description: Shepherd Jäger, with its melee attack strengthened around its sabre, and Captain Morris, the sword master, will always be an opponent others can't ignore. This DLC includes a multiplayer mecha "Shepherd Jäger" and a multiplayer pilot "Morris Yasir".

title: ClickCells: Winter Lady
description: ClickCells: Winter Lady is an erotic casual puzzle! The player's goal to keep the blue block on the platform for 3 seconds in order to pass the level. As a reward you get pictures of a beautiful girl!

title: Watch Dogs 2: Zodiac Killer
description:
Zodiac Killer is a DLC-exclusive mission in Watch Dogs 2, available by pre-ordering the game or with the Season Pass. It is unlocked after completing the story mission Looking Glass and reaching 1,185,000 followers.

It features the return of the infamous Zodiac Killer, who haunted San Francisco for years. Players also receive an exclusive outfit and bonuses after completing the mission.

title: Kanamono
description: Destroy your enemies and use the scraps that come out to destroy them even more! Side-scrolling space fantasy shooting game, that is "Kanamono".

title: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Ostfront Veteranen
description: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Ostfront Veteranen is a new faction DLC for the critically acclaimed RTS series and expands on the game with a new unit selection, unseen in the franchise so far.

title: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Airborne
description: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Airborne is the second DLC for AS2. It comes with a set of new features and additional singleplayer content. Fight as airborne commander behind enemy lines and support allied landing operations. The success of these operations will depend solely on you!

title: Sokoban: Bunny Tales
description: How smart are you? Try this cute indie modernized take on the classic puzzle game Sokoban. The player must place colored boxes and balls on their goals to solve the 200 fun, interesting and increasingly challenging puzzles. Entertaining Bunny Tales stories included throughout the game.

title: Assau!t
description: Assau!t is a defense first person rail shooter. Defend yourself against the advancing, enemy charge. Although you have to stop it yourself, you can do it with good handling of the gun. Apply and use a variety of weapons to survive long with your guns from enemies.

title: Mira and the Mysteries of Alchemy
description: After making a big mistake while trying to craft a potion at the alchemy university, the apprentice alchemist Mira finds that she has exposed herself to an elixir that made fundamental changes to her body. Now she must go in search of the ingredients in order to craft the antidote.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Aya, the Calm Big Sister Swordswoman from "OneeChanbara"
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. Aya, the calm and composed swordswoman from the zombie-infested world of "OneeChanbara," has joined the fight, wearing not only her trademark 10-gallon hat and bikini, but also with a katana as her weapon.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Hostess Setsu from Dream Club, Giving the EDF a Try!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. This hostess was chosen to join the fight from "Dream Club," a club for adults that can only be joined by those with a pure heart.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Prowl Rider (EDF: IR), KR Prototype & Special Gear
description: In the world of "Earth Defense Force: Iron Rain," the Kindred Rebellion ceded from the EDF and developed their own experimental Prowl Rider PA-Gear.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Saki, the Crazed Little Sister Swordswoman from "OneeChanbara"
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. Saki, the crazed swordswoman from the zombie-infested world of "OneeChanbara," is here and ready to fight using her super long katana and acrobatics.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Colonist: "We'll Help, If It Means Saving the Planet"!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. The Colonists who invaded the planet in "Earth Defense Force 5" have rushed to join the fight.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Hostess Mian from Dream Club, Giving the EDF a Try!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. This hostess was chosen to join the fight from "Dream Club," a club for adults that can only be joined by those with a pure heart.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - Hostess ILI from Dream Club, Giving the EDF a Try!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. This hostess was chosen to join the fight from "Dream Club," a club for adults that can only be joined by those with a pure heart.

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers - The Legendary Mr. Y, Reborn as "Mecha Yuki" After His Acid Incident!?
description: This allows you to use a special character and that character's weapon. There was once a soldier who defended the Earth valiantly against the Invaders until he was defeated.

title: Electrified
description: Electrified is a captivating 2-player puzzle platformer. Switch your charge anytime to interact with other charges, the other player, and circuits to solve tricky puzzles. Use your skills to work together against a power-hungry corporation and reclaim your honor!

title: Planet Coaster: Knight Rider K.I.T.T. Construction Kit
description: The Knight Rider K.I.T.T. Construction Kit features in-game replicas of K.I.T.T., K.I.T.T. in Super Pursuit mode, and the evil Knight Industries prototype K.A.R.R. with silver and black finish.

title: Planet Coaster: Back to the Future Time Machine Construction Kit
description: The Back to the Future Construction Kit features in-game replicas of the DeLorean Time Machine in its original 1985 form, and in its 2015, 1955 and 1885 variants, with optional standard tires, ‘hover’ wheels, white-rimmed classic tires, or railway wheels.

title: Planet Coaster: Quick Draw Interactive Shooting Ride
description: Sharpen your aim in this target shooting ride. Ride the track, shoot the targets and log your high score in this test of accuracy. Or create your own themed interactive shooting galleries for a different experience every time.

title: Planet Coaster: The Munsters Munster Koach Construction Kit
description: The Munsters Munster Koach Construction Kit features in-game replicas of the Munster Koach and the DRAG-U-LA drag racer from The Munsters episode ‘Hot Rod Herman’ and the classic 1966 movie Munster, Go Home!

title: Dungeon of the Endless: Deep Freeze
description: Deep-Freeze adds the “The Refreezerator” spaceship that unlocks a new mode for the game, and adds Kreyang to the hero cast of the game.

title: Dungeon of the Endless: Rescue Team
description: Add-on for Dungeon of the Endless, the critically acclaimed Rogue-like Dungeon Defense hybrid, featuring 3 new heroes from the Rescue Team. What could go wrong? Open the Door!

title: My Hero One's Justice: Playable Character - Pro Hero Endeavor
description: Unlocks Endeavor as a playable fighter.

title: My Hero One's Justice: Mission - Above and Beyond Endeavor
description: Unlocks the additional mission ""Above and Beyond."" Complete it to acquire new items and accessories.

title: My Hero One's Justice: Mission - O.F.A Deku Shoot Style
description: Unlocks the additional mission ""O.F.A"" Complete it to acquire new items and accessories.

title: My Hero One's Justice: Playable Character - Inasa Yoarashi
description: Unlocks Inasa Yoarashi as a playable fighter.

title: Mr. Fish and his Assistants Sardines
description: Explore Mr. Fish's underwater museum on Human Evolution! This game attempts to make culture accessible to as many people as possible through a simple and fun style. The collections and objects belong to the Leibniz Research Museums.

title: Overmorrow
description: Overmorrow is a serene, nonviolent, exploration adventure game that deletes your save after 30 days.

title: Gravity Oddity
description: Defy gravity and warp your way through a procedurally generated galaxy in this roguelike space adventure. Put on your gravity boots and ready your teleport gun to find the best approach to defeat your enemies and loot their spaceships.

title: Crazy Lemmings
description: Control entire armies of lemmings and solve puzzles.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Urban Defense Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Urban Defense Tactics; Muster your defenses to fight the enemy street to street and house to house. Plant traps and build forward emplacements to strengthen your line. Incendiary Artillery Barrage: Areas if the map can be bombarded with incendiary round to burn infantry and deny access.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Anti-Infantry Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Anti-Infantry Tactics; Kill or drive off your enemy’s infantry forces with short-range shock troops, artillery and flamethrower tanks. Fear Propaganda Artillery: Airburst propaganda leaflets make targeted soldiers question the morality of their actions.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Elite Troops Doctrine
description: German Commander - Elite Troops Doctrine; Utilize Germany's most elite companies using stronger base troops with added abilities. Tiger Ace: High command sends in a legendary Tiger Ace. Only one is available, once deployed fuel income will be reduced by 90% and manpower will be reduced by 25% until the Tiger Ace is destroyed.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Storm Doctrine
description: German Commander - Storm Doctrine; Focused firepower and the ability to weather enemy counterattacks are hallmarks of this doctrine. Stuka Bombing Strikea JU-87D: Stuka will dive in and drop a 50kg bomb on the target location. Capture points are neutralized if hit. LEFH 18 Artillery: This light 10.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Osttruppen Doctrine
description: German Commander - Osttruppen Doctrine; Mobilize early-game infantry and improved resources to overwhelm your opponents and gain early map control. Railway Artillery Support: Off-map railway artillery will fire three large caliber shells at the designated target.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Mechanized Assault Doctrine
description: German Commander - Mechanized Assault Doctrine; Move quickly and strike hard with a variety of units trained for fighting at close quarters. Use vehicles and infantry together to outmaneuver your opponent. Tiger Tank: Allows the requisition of the Tiger Heavy Tank to the battlefield.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Luftwaffe Supply Doctrine
description: German Commander - Luftwaffe Supply Doctrine; Using the power of the Luftwaffe, keep your troops on the front lines as long as possible, even if cut off! Stuka Bombing Strike A JU-87D: Stuka will dive in and drop a 50kg bomb on the target location. Capture points are neutralized if hit.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Fortified Armor Doctrine
description: German Commander - Fortified Armor Doctrine; Your vehicles can live longer and fight harder with better vision, recon, defensive options and the presence of a Command Tank. Elefant Tank Destroyer: This heavy tank destroyer has a massive armor envelope and one of the most potent guns ever mounted on a fighting vehicle; the 88mm Pak43.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Encirclement Doctrine
description: German Commander - Encirclement Doctrine; Combine stealth and mobility to outflank the enemy and destroy them. Stormtroopers can be deployed to scout ahead or cut off the enemies supply lines, while vehicles and air support can be utilized to complete the encirclement.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Joint Operations Doctrine
description: German Commander - Joint Operations Doctrine; Spot your enemy and disrupt their operations, troop concentrations, and armored spearheads with artillery. Light Artillery Barragea: light artillery barrage from nearby 7.5 cm le. IG 18 infantry support guns can scatter enemy forces. LEFH 18 Artillery: This light 10.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Soviet Industry Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Soviet Industry Tactics; Using the built up Soviet industry, make use of more and stronger vehicle units at the cost of infantry numbers. KV-2 Heavy Assault Tank: A KV-2 Heavy Assault Tank can be ordered in to the battlefield.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Armored Assault Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Armored Assault Tactics; Heavy and medium armor is supported by IL-2 attack aircraft. Enemy forces identified through radio intercepts. Il-2 Sturmovik Attacks: IL-2 Sturmovik will loiter over the battlefield, strafing targets of opportunity with its powerful 23mm cannons.

title: Company of Heroes 2: OKW Commander - Elite Armor Doctrine
description: OKW Commander - Elite Armor Doctrine; Use superior equipment and experienced crewmen to augment your armored forces. Plan your tactics with Signal Relay or recover your armor with an Emergency Repair. Use the Sturmtiger to spearhead the assault. Signal Relay: Boosting signal range briefly reveals enemy vehicles on the mini-map.

title: Company of Heroes 2: OKW Commander - Fortifications Doctrine
description: OKW Commander - Fortifications Doctrine; Hold back the enemy at all costs with heavy defensive structures. Infantry can construct advanced defensive buildings. Heavy weapons such as the Pak43 can be combined with zeroing artillery to zone out and eradicate breakthroughs. leFH 18 Artillery: This light 10.

title: Company of Heroes 2: OKW Commander - Scavenge Doctrine
description: OKW Commander - Scavenge Doctrine; Gather whatever resources you can from the battlefield and defeated enemies. Troops are trained to be more thorough in their salvage operations while infiltrating light infantry can disrupt enemy supplies and lay traps.

title: Company of Heroes 2: US Forces Commander - Mechanized Company
description: US Forces Commander - Mechanized Company; Light vehicles provide valuable support to advancing American infantry units. Take advantage of a wide range of light US vehicles along with air support, as the battle escalates withdraw lighter units to replace them with more armored counterparts.

title: Company of Heroes 2: US Forces Commander - Rifle Company
description: US Forces Commander - Rifle Company; The Rifleman is the backbone of the American army emphasizing the American doctrine of versatility and individual firepower. Riflemen receive additional time in training to be more experienced against multiple threats as well as having access to more versatile weapon packages.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Partisan Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Partisan Tactics; Make use of the Soviet Partisan network to harass enemies from behind the lines while destroying them with the soviet main army. Mark Vehicle: Targeted vehicle is subject to an increase in focused fire from nearby opponents.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Tank Hunter Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Tank Hunter Tactics; Disable enemy tanks and armored vehicles more easily with a variety of upgrades and abilities to support existing AT options. Conscripts gain increased versatility against tanks, when that fails IL-2 planes can deliver a devastating anti-tank bombing run.

title: Company of Heroes 2: Soviet Commander - Terror Tactics
description: Soviet Commander - Terror Tactics; A pantheon of combat forces guaranteed to cause fear in your enemy. IL-2 Precision Bombing Strike: The IL-2 will make a high-speed bombing run, clustering four FAB-50 50kg bombs into the target area.

title: Company of Heroes 2: German Commander - Spearhead Doctrine
description:
German Commander - Spearhead Doctrine; Crush enemy defenses with heavy armor and powerful airstrikes. Recon enemy concentrations for mortar halftracks.
Fragmentation Bomb: High-explosive fragmentation bombs are dropped on the target location. Tiger Tank: Allows the requisition of the Tiger Heavy Tank to the battlefield.

title: Battle of Empires: 1914-1918 - French Campaign
description: The first campaign of the series - Battle of Empires: France - is devoted to the battles between the French and German armies on the Western Front.

title: Enchanted Kingdom: The Secret of the Golden Lamp - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save your dad from a genie bent on revenge?

title: GunBlocks
description: Stranded on a mysterious planet you need to find your ships lost cargo and collect resources to repair your ship and get off planet. Use tetrominos to make your way through the strange new world, solve puzzles and get to know its not too friendly inhabitants.

title: Faction Wars
description: A grid based single / local multiplayer strategy game where two factions clash in deadly turn based battles.

title: Dracula Frames
description: Dracula's castle consists of 8 floors. Each floor has a large picture with a magnificent painting representing landmarks of Dracula's life. Your goal is to rebuild each painting through a slide puzzle and get to the top floor!

title: Max, an Autistic Journey: Max's Birthday
description: Spend a day with Max as he excitedly wakes up eager to celebrate his birthday!

title: Dark Disciples II
description:
DD2 is, unsurprisingly, the sequel to DD1. The look and feel is therefore similar to that of the first game. However a number of significant improvements have been made to the game system:

DD2 features a new story line (unconnected to that of DD1). It takes place over 4 continents and ~130 levels.

The game features non linear gameplay - feel free to explore (there are tons of side missions, secret areas and off the beaten track oddities to discover).
There is now a proper skill system. There are 11 skills available from Pick Locks, to Dual Weapons to Curse to Gemlore.
Monster AI has also be greatly improved (DD2 uses the A* pathfinding algorithm).
Monsters now have proper abilities (called 'powers'): they can shoot arrows and cast spells.
Speaking of arrows, missile combat has been implemented in DD2 (there were no missile weapons in DD1).
Also new is mp3 quality music (if you choose to download the 'music pack').
The level editor is more useful and much better laid out. It's now possible to completely design your own campaign using the editor, including importing new item, tile and monster pics.
A Bag of Holding has been implemented - characters can now carry twice as much once they have purchased the bag.
There are also 'super' monsters: 3x3 tiles in size!

title: Disharmony
description: A dialogue-heavy turn-based RPG featuring a rhythm-based battle system, a world inspired by music, and a retro aesthetic. Explore the dreams of the game's characters, solve puzzles, and find cryptic secrets to uncover the true nature of this mysterious world. (Or don't. Most of it is optional!)

title: Malfunction FPS
description: In Malfunction FPS, your job is to defeat the robots and escape the robots to get to a door at the end of each level.

title: Ardarium
description: Watch nations grow and forests spread in this casual sandbox game where everything is automatic and gameplay is optional. It's like a screensaver that you can play. Make explosions that deform the ground, start forest fires, trigger earthquakes that wipe out civilizations, or just watch the sunrise.

title: The Dawning Clocks of Time
description: A classic story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic turn based RPG with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms with energy and exciting weapons and skills for the battle of the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity?

title: Neon Depth
description: In this puzzle-platform game, you must make mistakes in order to progress. Place blocks when you fail, and shape the level in your favor. Discover how to use blocks with different effects to escape from within yourself while learning to live with your mistakes.

title: Shine Within
description: A top-down action-adventure game as you collect & solve puzzles in order for you to explore & unravel this mysterious world.

title: Big Klondike: Classic Solitaire
description:
Big Klondike is a version of the very popular Klondike variation of solitaire. This version of solitaire is what generally is called Windows Solitaire, or what some people think Solitaire just is as a general term (when the truth is that Solitaire is a huge genre of games just as wide as FPS is).

Big Klondike features 1 Draw, 3 Draw, Random shuffles and Winnable shuffles. You can choose to have the Timer enabled or not if you prefer a relaxing experience.

Our Winnable shuffles are originally Random shuffles which our custom coded solitaire bot has play tested to ensure is actually possible. We ship the game with 50,000 known Winnable shuffles for both 1 Draw and 3 Draw variations. The 1.0.0 version of our solitaire bot was made to not be too incredibly clever, so all Winnable shuffles are guaranteed to be possible below 200 moves. Though a Winnable game is guaranteed to be possible, that does not mean you will always win it first time as sometimes moves can be made in ways where the game becomes bricked - impossible to finish in that state. If that happens you can Retry that same game and go for different moves to beat it!

In Big Klondike, cards can be dragged or clicked to move them to possible moves. Right click is also supported.

Once a game is deemed as mostly complete, Big Klondike will show a button to Auto Complete the game and move the rest of the cards into place in the foundations.

title: Smash MAGA! Trump Zombie Apocalypse
description: Anti-fascist gamers fight the Trump Zombie plague in this spree of rioting and looting!

title: Bubble Breaking
description: Bubbles come in different sizes (depths) and they rise at different speeds. Players have 60 seconds to pop as many as they can. When bubbles are popped points are scored. The smaller, faster bubbles score more points than the bigger, slower bubbles. Beware of the 'stink' bubbles.

title: Brambles in the Mist
description: In this SRPG, you play as a bard traveling in a foreign land in search of your muse. During your journey, you will meet numerous women to serve as your muses and also have romantic interactions with them. Faced with a common enemy that threatens the kingdom, you fight together to save it.

title: The Lion's Song: Episode 2 - Anthology
description: In "Episode 2 - Anthology" you play as the aspiring painter Franz who has a unique but unsettling ability to see the hidden layers of his subjects' personalities. Can he overcome his fears and self-doubt to finally see himself?

title: The Lion's Song: Episode 4 - Closure
description: "Episode 4 – Closure", will take players on a mysterious train journey that brings together four strangers and connects the storylines of all three previously released episodes. What stories will they share along the way and where will their journey end?

title: The Lion's Song: Episode 3 - Derivation
description: In "Episode 3 – Derivation", you take on the role of Emma, a brilliant mathematician, who struggles to make her voice heard in the male-dominated world of academics at the beginning of the 20th century. Can she lift the curtain of reality to get a glimpse of the principles governing her world?

title: Logistical 2: Suriname - Xmas 2018
description: Logistical: Suriname - Xmas 2018 is a small add-on module for Logistical 2 that covers a couple of tiny countries on the north end of South America. Suriname is the first module to fully make use of the road upgrading ability. There are many businesses and towns that would be so much easier to do if the roads took bigger trucks.

title: Logistical 2: Mall Rats
description: This Logistical 2: Mall Rats has over 150 towns and 1,000 businesses to complete. There are many malls throughout the United States of America. Mall Rats (teenagers) require large amounts of resources from these malls. Complete the malls to unlock critical resources to further unlock more of the map.

title: MotoGP 13: MotoGP Champions
description: MotoGP Champions gives you the opportunity to race as, and against, legendary riders of the past, including Doohan, Schwantz, Rainey, Spencer, Gardner, Capirossi and many others. Ride their historical 2 stroke 500 CC bikes and experience all the excitement of being a Motogp legend.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft Seychelles XP
description: The Seychelles are a group of islands in the Indian Ocean but what comes into most people’s minds when they think about the name is a tropical paradise, luxurious holidays, excellent diving spots and breathtakingly beautiful nature.

title: The Alpha 001
description: Dive into the simulation, explore, play mini games, break loot boxes, grow plantations on your farm, fight orcs, play with your friends, rescue robots, increase your village's population, mine resources, conquer villages! The simulation will prepare a lot of different things for you, get ready.

title: Zooma:Chapter 4 - "Temple of the Damned"
description: Nobody is welcome at the Temple, and only the moans of ghosts and the breath of the volcano that slowly devours the once-mighty fortress break the silence. Do you have what it takes to defeat the prehistoric evil and revive this dark stronghold to its previous glory?

title: Fallen Enchantress: Legendary Heroes - Battlegrounds DLC
description: Enhance your tactical battles and map options with this new DLC. Adds more than a dozen new tactical battle maps and over 20 new stamps to expand the random map generator.

title: Fallen Enchantress: Legendary Heroes - The Dead World DLC
description: Take command of the Empire of the Dead and lead them to grim victory as your undead armies strike fear into their mortal counterparts. Includes new monsters, spells and monsters to play with or against.

title: Betrayer: Curse of the Spine
description: Betrayer: Curse of the Spine is an Action-Adventure Metroidvania. The game features decision making, crafting, fast-paced combat, multiple endings, intricate storytelling, an open world to explore, and more!

title: Day of the Dimetrodon
description: A short little game about a day in the life of the prehistoric predator Dimetrodon.

title: Death Wore Endless Feathers
description:
Jakob is a hacker for Sector H, a new branch of Black Sun, a crypto-anarchistic organisation that looks after its own.

Funded by mysterious benefactors, Jakob and the rest of Sector H break open ractives to ensure that everyone can play them. It's a dog-eat-dog political minefield that Jakob wants no part of.

All Jakob wants to do is play ractives, watch the new Ripsaw Bloodgore concert, and have fun. He has no place in this war - but fate conspire against him, dragging him into the very core of this matter. He will never forget the day

DEATH WORE ENDLESS FEATHERS.

title: Dinner for Pigeons
description:
Dinner For Pigeons is a freeware, snack-size adventure game with candy-colored cartoon graphics and a gentle arcade slant.

Close your eyes. Imagine you are a pigeon. You are a hungry pigeon. Fortunately, these are the streets of plenty. So fly over to the diner and steal an evening meal from under people's noses. Try not to get killed in the process. That is this game.

title: Donald Dowell and the Ghost of Barker Manor
description: Donald Dowell is a nice old man in his eighties, retired for many years. Donald's life, except for his "intolerable" wife, is quiet. But Donald feels empty. He has the so-called retiree's syndrome : he's bored to death! The only way to cure his boredom is TO GO BACK TO WORK. After many hours spent in his city, trying to get hired for various jobs, he finally finds his calling: to be a GHOSTBUSTER! Donald will try to become Bob Delano's assistant (the most famous occult detective in Ireland), be involved in the investigation of Barker Manor and, hopefully, solve the mystery.

title: Draculator II: Byte of the Draculator
description: Corporal Merrick was on leave one evening and tried to hook up with some cute vampire twins. In an attempt to impress them, he allowed himself to be made into a vampire. Unfortunately his army found out and enrolled him in a secret experimental bionic implant program. Now half vampire, half robot, and more than half confused, Merrick must escape the base where he is being held or spend the rest of his life being drip-fed poodle blood to keep him obedient! Can you help Merrick escape?

title: Echoes of The Past
description: Welcome to Echoes of the Past, where the past comes alive and fears take shape. You are a night guard in a psychiatric hospital. Sinister creature emerge from the darkness, and your survival depends on cameras, light, and hiding. Every action matters. Can you survive the night?

title: Star Wars Racer and Commando Combo
description:
Get two classic Star Wars games with the Star Wars Racer and Commando Combo which includes Star Wars: Episode I Racer and Star Wars Republic Commando. Climb on, strap in, and experience the pure adrenaline-pumping excitement of the Podracing sequence from Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace in Star Wars: Episode I Racer. In Star Wars Republic Commando you are the leader of your elite squad of Republic Commandos. Your mission is to infiltrate, dominate, and ultimately, annihilate the enemy.

Star Wars Episode I Racer: Choose from 25 playable racers including: Anakin Skywalker, Sebulba, and Ratts Tyerell
Star Wars Episode I Racer: Race tracks spanning 8 unique worlds including: Tatooine, Baroonda, and Malastare
Star Wars Republic Commando: Boss, Fixer, Scorch, and Sev, better known as Delta Squad, are back! Relive the legendary campaign
Star Wars Republic Commando: Battle a variety of highly intelligent and deadly enemies-from brutal Trandoshan mercenaries to the flying insectoid warriors of Geonosis

title: Egress - The Test of STS-417
description: Egress is a short form sci-fi adventure game set in the outer reaches of space. The story begins when you, the commander of a two man recon team, are sent hurtling into space during maintenance on an interplanetary probe. After a sudden attack from an black alien substance, you awake on a mysterious planet. Where are you? How did you get there? And why is your partner screaming for help down the intercom…

title: Emerald Eyes
description: "It all startet with a dream. I saw myself - standing in front of a swimming bath. I felt strange. I felt strong. I felt the desire to kill. I knew my victim. She was in there. She had to die, she had to drown. Water was the first element. I couldn't stop myself. I had to kill..."

title: X-Plane 11: Add-on - Aerosoft Reggio Calabria XP
description: Fly to the tip of Italy's distinctive boot shape with Reggio Calabria XP. This highly detailed scenery brings you to Reggio Calabria, named after Italian Royal Air Force war-hero Tito Minniti, who was born in Reggio Calabria.

title: X-Plane 11: Add-on - SAM FollowMe
description: Don't get lost on any airport by using SAM FollowMe service to guide you to your parking position.

title: X-Plane 11: Skyline Simulations - MKJS: Montego Bay Jamaica
description: In partnership with LatinVFR, Skyline Simulations brings you the very first detailed Jamaican airport for X-Plane 11.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - Faroe Islands XP
description: The scenery Faroe Islands XP now recreates the entire archipelago for XPlane 11.

title: X-Plane 11: FSDG - Sharm El-Sheikh XP
description: The popular Sharm El-Sheikh International Airport scenery from FSDG is now available for XPlane 11!

title: X-Plane 11: Add-on - JustAsia: Real World Malaysia
description: Realworld Malaysia covers a whopping 330,803 km² and covers west and east Malaysia. JustAsia harness the lastest autogen technology especially for XPlane which allows for region specific houses, shops, highrise and buildings to be placed using XPlane built in OSM data to ensure maximum immersion.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - CRJ 200
description: The Canadair Regional Jet CRJ-200 is a short-range, single-aisle commuter jet and with 1021 built units the most popular regional jet today. The JRollon CRJ-200 brings this famous airliner to the simulator known for its accurate flight dynamics.

title: X-Plane 11: FSDG - Mauritius
description: Paradise at its best - the unique Ile de Maurice, one of the most beautiful and scenic islands in the world, now available for XPlane!

title: X-Plane 11: Global Scenery - Africa
description: X-Plane 11 Global Scenery: Africa is a free DLC that you can activate thru your Steam Client. It will give you the default Africa Scenery.

title: X-Plane 11: Skyline Simulations - KSNA: John Wayne International
description: John Wayne International Airport (IATA: SNA, ICAO: KSNA, FAA LID: SNA) is located in Orange County near Los Angeles, USA. KSNA provides General aviation operations, commercial operations and several facilities.

title: X-Plane 11: Skyline Simulations - KCVG: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International XP
description: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport offers non-stop passenger service to 62 destinations with 179 peak daily departures. The airport's international destinations include Cancún, Cozumel, Freeport, Montego Bay, Paris, Punta Cana, Reykjavík, and Toronto.

title: X-Plane 11: FSDG - Agadir
description: Agadir Al Massira - one of the biggest airports in Morocco and just a stone's throw away from the Canary Islands - now also available for XPlane!

title: X-Plane 11: Add-on - Aerosoft Helgoland XP
description: Helgoland XP is a scenery for XPlane 11 that recreates Germany's only island in the open sea at a high level of detail and with many thrilling new options.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - Ibiza XP
description: Bring home some holiday feeling and enjoy the detailed airport as well as the fantastic sceneries of the two islands Ibiza and Formentera.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - German Islands 1: East Frisia
