title: Dark Deception: Chapter 2
description: The 2nd Chapter of Dark Deception! New enemies await you in the next 2 nightmares. You're still alive, but for how much longer? There's nowhere to hide and nowhere to catch your breath. Run or die - it's your choice.

title: Dark Deception: Chapter 3
description: The 3rd Chapter of Dark Deception! New enemies await you in the next 2 nightmares. The darkness is growing and your demons are closing in. Can you change fate? Run or die - it's your choice!

title: Dark Deception: Chapter 4
description: The 4th Chapter of Dark Deception! New enemies await you in the next 3 nightmares. The darkness is growing and your demons are closing in. Can you change fate before your time runs out? Run or die - it's your choice!

title: The Dream Machine: Chapter 5
description: In Chapter 5, Victor must gain access to the last two neighbors' dreams and try to stop the dream machine once and for all.

title: The Dream Machine: Chapter 3
description: In an effort to shut down the mysterious dream machine, Victor enters the dream of his sleeping wife.

title: The Dream Machine: Chapter 4
description: In Chapter 4, Victor must gain access to his elderly neighbor's dream and find his way through her frail and decaying mind.

title: The Dream Machine: Chapter 6
description: In the concluding chapter, Victor must journey to the heart of dreams in order to rescue his loved ones from the dream machine.

title: FortressCraft: Chapter 1
description: FortressCraft : Chapter 1 Anniversary Edition is the PC-update to the world's first and best Creative-focussed Voxel block builder.

title: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 5
description: Azurael's Circle is a horror-mystery adventure game. Navigate the manor and piece together the real reason why you're here. Combine items in your inventory to get into locked areas of the house and find other useful tools that can help you uncover the truth while meeting a few familiar faces.

title: The Strange Story of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2
description: After escaping from the old cabin, and falling down without consciousness, Brian Fisher traveled in time and space. He woke up 30 years ago, when he was a little boy, in a place that he doesn't remember where it is, and how he got there.

title: Ice Star: Chapter 2
description: Action shooter with story elements.

title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles - Chapter 2
description: Experience the second chapter in Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles. Lydia's fight for survival in the manor has taken her into the tunnels underneath. What horrors will she discover as she attempts to escape the nightmare? This DLC includes Chapter Two Story Mode and Battle Mode content.

title: Iwaihime: Extra Chapter - Musubihime
description: Mayu Hinagata is the LCSC's dear advisor, a veritable fountain of inspiration and wisdom. But being so kind can be draining... An additional chapter by Ryukishi07.

title: Flappatron: Episode 4 (Chapters 11 - 13)
description: The conclusion to Nathan's story, twists and turns unfold as Nathan's journey finally comes to a head! Includes: Chapter 11 Chapter 12 Chapter 13 A new Survival Character

title: Flappatron: Episode 3 (Chapters 8 - 10)
description: Episode 3 Includes: Chapter 8, Chapter 9, Chapter 10 and an extra survival character

title: Flappatron: Episode 2 (Chapters 4-7)
description: Episode 2 Includes: Chapter 4, Chapter 5, Chapter 6, Chapter 7 and an extra survival character

title: Awoken: Chapter One of Reverie
description: In Awoken you will have to weave your way through the horror that is Mount Moira Hospital. You must navigate through obstacle filled halls, fearful dead ends, and the overall confusing structure of the facility. As you try to piece together your broken past and discover what binds you to this hell.

title: ChuSingura46+1 S: Chapter 4 & 5
description: ChuSingura46+1 S: Chapter 4 & 5 is the second DLC package for ChuSingura46+1 S, an adventure themed erotic visual novel. This DLC contains the last two chapters, "Revenge Blooms, Settling Old Scores" and "Of Loyalty and Heroism".

title: ChuSingura46+1 S: Chapter 2 & 3
description: The second DLC package from ChuSingura46+1 S which contains chapter two, Edo radicals which is the story of Horibe Yasubee and her comrades in Edo. And we also have Harbinger of spring which is the story of Ohishi Chikara.

title: Sovietpunk: Chapter one
description: Sovietpunk is a cyberpunk story set in the setting of the Soviet Union after a global nuclear war. You have to guide the main character through the gloomy tunnels, in which the struggle for life is in full swing.

title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles - Chapter 4
description: Experience the final chapter in Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles. Featuring the final glimpses of Lydia's journey in a new Story Mode chapter and a slightly remixed Battle Mode experience. Will Lydia survive the nightmare?

title: Anemoiapolis: Chapter 1
description: A short atmospheric terror game about liminal spaces. Escape the grasps of an underground neighborhood that is equal parts comforting and disturbing. If you've explored a dead mall, a foreclosed pool, or a school at night, you might already know what it's like to be in Anemoiapolis.

title: Paranormal Files: Ghost Chapter - Collector's Edition
description: The World’s Mysteries awaits...

title: Adventures of Sadukar: Chapter I
description: Adventures of Sadukar is a turn based RPG that follows Sadukar and his friends through an open world plagued with monsters.

title: Maguntsche: Chapter One Remastered
description: Darkness closes in fast on the town of Macungie, Pennsylvania. Explore the depths of the Realmverse and put a stop to the Superior's demonic forces. The Maguntsche Demon is on the hunt. Will you be able to stop this entity once and for all? Or will it find new victims to take in your place?

title: Time For You: Chapter 01
description: A story-driven adult dating sim / visual novel with a detective style twist!

title: Ghost of Tomorrow: Chapter 1
description: Experience a horrifying time-traveling adventure in Ghost of Tomorrow

title: Spaghet 2: Al Dente Chapter
description: You just couldn't keep your hands to yourself... could you?

title: Lands of Peace: Legends - Chapter 1
description: Lands Of Peace: Legends is a 3D anime, hentai, adventure, adult game with sexual contents. Myths, Legends, Monsters about a place? Does it really exist? Is it really peaceful? After much research, you have arrived to the secret Lands of Peace...adventures await you!

title: Space Hulk: Space Wolves Chapter
description: Amongst the annals of the Imperium, few warriors have reached higher honour than the Wolf Guard of the Space Wolves. Devastatingly ferocious in attack, immovably resolute in defence, these savage warriors have broken many foes down the long millennia.You can now command these fierce warriors and take on hordes of Genestealers.

title: Dead by Daylight: A Binding of Kin Chapter
description: A Binding of Kin is a new Chapter for Dead by Daylight. It includes a Killer, The Twins and a Survivor, Élodie Rakoto. Purchasing the add-on will unlock its new Killer, its new Survivor, and an exclusive item for the survivor.

title: Christmas Griddlers
description:
Christmas Griddlers is many great prizes on this magic night.

The most magical night of the year. It's coming... RIGHT NOW! Today you have a unique opportunity to feel the atmosphere of great Christmas time! Start your jolly adventure with Christmas Griddlers.

title: SDST: Deluxe
description: SDST: Deluxe is a 2D-Platformer with a semi-Open World. Tons of fun, content, and fast-paced platforming awaits you in this deluxe edition of a classic title.

title: Arma 3: Helicopters
description: Fly the brand-new CH-67 Huron and Mi-290 Taru heavy-lift helicopters, and master Sling Loading to provide ground support in the Arma 3 Helicopters DLC.

title: Arma 3: Tanks
description: Roll in heavy firepower and take control of the battlefield with three brand new armored vehicles in the Arma 3 Tanks DLC.

title: Arma 3: Zeus
description: Arma 3 Zeus is a new form of multiplayer where improvisation is the key to success. Inspired by popular tabletop games such as 'Dungeons & Dragons', this free DLC for Arma 3 enables you to assume the role of Zeus, a game master with the ability to curate the multiplayer experience of others.

title: Arma 3: Jets
description: Fight in the sky with brand new air-superiority jets and use advanced targeting systems to shoot down the enemy in the Arma 3 Jets DLC.

title: Arma 3: Malden
description: Welcome back to Malden, soldier! This is where we started our amazing journey with the Arma franchise sixteen years ago. We hope you'll enjoy this re-imagination of Malden.

title: Arma 3: Creator DLC - CSLA Iron Curtain
description: Engage your enemy in mechanized infantry operations, Special Forces raids and long-range patrols in an alternate 1980s Cold War Czechoslovakia!

title: Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals - Monstrum
description: Monstrum is a new Chapter for Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals. It includes 2 playable monsters (Brute & Fiend), 1 playable mortal (Prisoner Borisov), and a new map (Monstrum Madness).

title: Brother!!! Save him!
description: The legendary game is now on Steam! Can you prove that you are a good player, go through a difficult path and save your brother? This challenge is not for wimps!

title: Half-Life 2: Year Long Alarm
description: Year Long Alarm is a Half-Life 2 single-player mod that is set in an abandoned mine outside of City 17. A Scanner has discovered you, and the Combine are closing in on your position. Fight your way through a vast underground mine to try and meet up with the Resistance members of Station 12.

title: Half-Life: Absolute Zero
description: Half-Life: Absolute Zero is a fan-made modification that re-creates the original ideas and plans from the award-winning classic: Half-Life.

title: Gate
description: Gate is an action-adventure game for the Macintosh. It blends action, adventure, and brain-teasing challenges into an addictive fast-action game with smooth animation, exciting music and sound effects. Escape the castle's prison, battle enemies, solve puzzles, and defeat your captor to restore peace to the land.

title: Hunted
description: Run. Hide. Survive. A ruthless butcher stalks your every move in this tense first-person horror experience.

title: Cooking Simulator: Cooking with Food Network
description: Play the new Contest mode with fresh recipes inspired by various Food Network TV shows. Set yourself up for an exciting culinary adventure or cook at your own pace for a more relaxing experience. Change your ordinary kitchen into a professional TV studio!

title: Cooking Simulator: Shelter
description: Master the art of post-apocalyptic cooking in an underground shelter. Gather scarce resources, trade with other settlements, and become the best food provider in the wasteland!

title: Time Freeze
description: Stop time whenever you want! Dive into a sandbox world where you infiltrate enemy strongholds using various crazy skills and tools. Combine them and conquer your enemies with your own creative ideas.

title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout - "Ever Summer Queen & the Secret Island"
description: A story set on a private beach is added.

title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout - Klaudia's Story "Atelier Klaudia"
description: A new story is added in which Klaudia is the main character. During the story, the player controls Klaudia as they play the game. After installing the content, the story can be selected via the title menu.

title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout - Tao's Story "Interwoven Fate"
description: A new story is added in which Tao is the main character. During the story, the player controls Tao as they play the game.

title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout - "The End of an Adventure and Beyond"
description: A new story is added in which Lila is the main character. During the story, although Empel also appears in the story, the player controls Lila as they play the game.

title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout - Lent's Story "True Strength"
description: A new story is added in which Lent is the main character. During the story, the player controls Lent as they play the game.

title: Waveform: Eris
description: Eris, a world of discord and darkness, needs your help! Restore the light to a new planet in Waveform's first DLC pack. Play new levels and even re-play in challenge mode for remastered experienced. Interact with the brand new object - the PulsarExperience another mind-bending bonus level in Reverse Mode!

title: 112 Operator: The Last Duty
description: The time has come for your last duty. For how long can you protect your area? What threats await you? This semi-realistic DLC brings new exciting gameplay to the game.

title: 112 Operator: Water Operations
description: New DLC Water Operations will extend your responsibility to rivers, lakes, and seas.

title: 112 Operator: Pandemic Outbreak
description: New DLC will challenge you in the direst situation - the pandemic taking over your city.

title: The Chase
description: “The chase” is a first-person survival horror game developed by RAM Studios. The story revolves around a couple that has been separated for some time. The only hope for him is to strive through the darkness and pray to God that everything will be alright.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Africa
description: Join us in a safari through the Heart of Africa and discover new common and uncommon inhabitants for your Wildlife Park! Encounter Spotted Hyenas, Red river hogs, Black-backed Jackals, Kudus, African Buffaloes and other species on one of the biggest and most variable continents in the world.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Down Under
description: An adventure trip to "Down Under"! The continent offers a wide range of the fauna and flora: kangaroos, koalas, emus and - of course - the cute wombat and the weird platpyus, the trademarks of down under.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Amazonas
description: Plunge into the amazon rainforest and be stunned by the abundance of fauna. Encounter Giant Anteaters, Pink River Dolphins, Amazonian Manatees, Armadillos, Tapirs, Capybaras, Ocelots and other species native to the biggest river basin of our planet!

title: Wildlife Park 3: Asia
description: Wildlife Park 3 Asia - A true animal resort Asia is the largest continent on earth. It covers about one third of the total landmass. The rainforest of Southeast Asia is probably the richest ecosystem in the world.

title: Wildlife Park 3: Creatures of the Caribbean
description: Get the fantastic Caribbean experience now! Create magnificent palm beaches with lagoons and bays. Animate these with dolphins, dangerous sharks, giant turtles, colourful flamingos and many other animal inhabitants of the Caribbean Sea. Let your park visitors immerse themselves in the world of pirates.

title: Zup! Z
description: Minimal physical puzzle with explosions

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Eyes of the Nine
description: In the name of the mighty Tzeentch, god of magic and sorcery, Vortemis the All-seeing and his sworn acolytes seek to open a pathway between Shadespire and the Realm of Chaos. Unlock this warband and play as the Eyes of the Nine in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Sepulchral Guard
description: Sworn to the God of Death's service, the Sepulchral Warden and his fleshless undying swarm the streets of Shadespire. Their sheer numbers overwhelm all who would oppose them. Unlock this warband and play as the Sepulchral Guard in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Spiteclaw's Swarm
description: Seemingly infinite in number, the devious and malicious ratmen known as skaven blight every corner and crevice in the city of Shadespire. Unlock this warband and play as Spiteclaw's Swarm in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: The Farstriders
description: Clad in gleaming sigmarite and armed with heaven-forged weaponry, the grizzled hunters of the Stormcast Eternals are the sworn enemies of Chaos. Unlock this warband and play as The Farstriders in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Ironskull's Boyz
description: Iron-clad and muscle-bound, these brutal Orruks are trapped in an endless battle within the shifting city of Shadespire. They wield huge, rusted weapons and thirst for combat. Unlock this warband and play as the Ironskull's Boyz in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: The Chosen Axes
description: Honor, gold, and a desire to banish the curse that haunts the city of Shadespire - these are what drive the mercenary Fyreslayers. Unlock this warband and play as The Chosen Axes in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Thorns of the Briar Queen
description: Dragged out from her crystal tomb beneath the city of Shadespire, the Briar Queen and her spectral army of geists, and spirits are ready to combat all who trespass in the Mirrored City. Unlock this warband and play as the Thorns of the Briar Queen in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: The Storm of Celestus
description: Drakan Celestus, accompanied by his loyal gryph-hound and an elite retinue of Castigators, is tasked with the investigation of the curse that has taken hold of the city of Shadespire. Unlock this warband and play as Storm of Celestus in Warhammer Underworlds: Online now.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Garrek's Reavers
description: This warband, led by the brutal killer known as Garrek Gorebeard, are frenzied cannibals, mortals whose dark excesses have drawn them ever further into the thrall of the Blood God. Blinded by battle madness, lost to the exultant sensations of combat, they care for nothing but the kill.

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Online - Warband: Drepur's Wraithcreepers
description: Eternal hunters in service of the Great Necromancer Nagash, this band of Glaivewraith Stalkers are driven ever onwards toward their prey by the ceaseless beating of the Patrician's skin drum. Unlock this warband and play as Drepur's Wraithcreepers in Warhammer Underworlds: Online.

title: Mibt
description: Help the government agents in black thong to end the alien threat and the invasion of the machines. 1 or 2 players. Individual and cooperative. Gamepad compatible. Demo available.

title: The Evil in the Forest
description: The Evil in the Forest is a 3rd-person fantasy horror adventure game. The game tells you the dark story of a man named Derek Bain - a single father who, being a researcher in the field of natural resources, arrives with his daughter Kate in a mystical forest...

title: Aerofly RC 8
description: Aerofly RC 8 is THE model flight simulator with extremely real flight physics, fantastic graphics and VR mode. Targeted model flight training and incredible fun with airrace, limbo flying, balloon piercing, helitrainer, aerobatics, landing contests, slope flying, 4D scenery and much more.

title: Infinite Mana
description: Infinite Mana is a RPG about exploration, a light sandbox, and glitch mechanics set in the magickal world of Arukea. You are the Wanderer: branded and without memory. Make friends and discover who you are, unlock unique Guises (classes), seek Relics, talk to animals, collect items, fish, and more!

title: Dreadful Shadows
description: A Survival Horror, team based brawler. Hunt and Be Hunted, Defend or Destroy . Its up to you to collect weapons, spells and traps and tear through enemies all on your pursuit to become a Legendary Hunter. A Hunter who can be the most Dreadful in Shadows.

title: Kong's Wrath: City of Mayhem
description: Become the banana-hungry kaiju, Kong. Climb, fight, and leap your way through a highly militarized concrete jungle. Collect bananas, and compete for the highest banana count on a world-wide leaderboard. This is a roguelike, arcade style game with no ending, only further mayhem.

title: Hate Free Heroes Tactics
description: Hate Free Heroes Tactics is a community based online game and adventure. Help your city reduce aggro levels by building your agency, defeating aggromites and researching new ways of keeping city aggro levels at a minimum. Play from any web browser, PC, tablet or phone.

title: The Importance of Choosing: Second Chance
description: This story tells us about a girl who went through a lot in her life, and each of her decisions led to certain consequences. In this game, you will see the consequences of one of the elections, and understand what decision will be correct.

title: VR Skydiving
description: Welcome to our spaceship! You can choose different landscape scenes on the Earth, including mountains, deserts, and Gobi deserts etc. By pressing the touchpad and the trigger of the left controller for selection. Using the touchpad of your right controller for movement.

title: Doodle God Blitz: Doodle Kingdom
description: It's time to get MEDIEVAL! Try a new fantasy brain-teaser where you can create your own Kingdom with Castles, Knights, Warlocks and Dragons! Great for gamers of ALL ages. Create a New Kingdom Today!

title: Happy Valentine's Day
description: Happy Valentine's Day is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Secret Agent Allan Martin in ... Phoenix Erupting
description: You are Allan Martin, an occasionally suave British superspy armed with a licence to cause an international incident. Can you survive international assassins? Can you stop an evil mastermind's nefarious plans? Can you avoid contracting an STD?

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 20 'Chopper' Loco
description: A veteran in every right, the Class 20 has earned its place among enthusiasts' hearts; and now Type 1 traction comes to life in Train Sim World, ready for hard-working duty on the Tees Valley Line!

title: Train Sim World 2020: LIRR M3 EMU Loco
description: Take the controls of a "Big Apple" railroading classic with the Long Island Rail Road M3 electric-multiple-unit (EMU) for Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 2020: DB BR 182 Loco
description: In Train Sim World, the DB BR 182 adds a dash of red to the "Rapid Transit" route, and depicts the Mitteldeutschland S-Bahn S2 line during the transitional period where DB BR 1442 EMUs were still being delivered.

title: Train Sim World 2020: CSX GP40-2 Loco
description: Arguably the ultimate edition of the Geep road-switcher was the GP40-2 and now you can challenge your limits as this famed diesel workhorse comes to Train Sim World in classic CSX "YN2" livery!

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 52 'Western' Loco
description: Built to work top-link expresses, the BR Class 52 spent its days racing through BR's Western Region and now enjoys retirement on heritage railways.

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 33 Loco
description: The Train Sim World BR Class 33 now joins the BR Class 47 and BR Class 09 to further bring to life the heritage festivities of the West Somerset Railway route's diesel gala.

title: Train Sim World 2020: DB BR 204 Loco
description: A hard-working classic comes to life in Train Sim World with the stunning DB BR 204 diesel locomotive!

title: Train Sim World 2020: DB BR 155 Loco
description: The "Electric Container", as it's affectionately known to railfans, has stood the test of time and you can take to the rails hauling heavy freight with a nostalgic twist.

title: Train Sim World 2020: BR Class 31 Loco
description: After having a career spanning decades, and a successful life in preservation, it's time to turn back the clock and experience the iconic BR Class 31 in its heyday in Train Sim World!

title: Forsaken World: Gods and Demons
description: The most popular Fantasy RPG of 2021 is finally available!

title: Tower of Origin 2: Worm's Nest
description: This is a traditional rpg game which contains multiple maps and a great story enough to play for several hours.

title: Escape the Outbreak
description: On a remote island, Jack Colt finds himself isolated after being kidnapped. After the accident with the helicopter transporting him, Jack has his first contact with the island, and soon discovers that he is not alone in that place, and will have to be careful if he wants to escape alive.

title: Space Battle SVF
description: This game is a 3D space flight shooter. Arcade type game. It's a game to shoot a lot of missiles.

title: Bot Wars
description: Bot Wars is an action RTS about managing a squad of kill-bots and their bases as you work to take over all the capture points across the map. Featuring corporate kill bot armies, ranging from a firearms and beverage manufacturer to a lovecraftian burger cult.

title: Prop Factory
description: 100% 3D Prop Factory is a fun puzzle where you memorize an object and need to assemble it in order but before that you will need to find the pieces in a mess of scraps and throw them on the conveyor simply by dragging.

title: Osylla
description: Osylla is a horror game based on real events. Try to escape from your own house and help your mother to get medical help. Are you able to help everyone in the household?

title: Time Voyeur
description: Save hot babes from the emperor's claws. Be rewarded in a very delicious way. Remember...stay hard!

title: Dungeon Crawler Daniel
description: Daniel and a group of adventurers must complete the Ravana Dungeon to win the ultimate prize so he can buy his house back from his parents.

title: Basic Rogue
description: BASIC ROGUE is a turn-based dungeon crawler. You have very limited inventory space, skills, weapons, armor, and stats which all need to be managed while fighting enemies, gathering treasure, and figuring out what your primary objective is. This game will appeal to players looking for a challenge.

title: Terraform Inc
description: Terraform Inc is a game to build a reliable physics-based delivery network. You will get new planets, add enhancements in transit, then deliver to buyers. Construct elaborate designs to prove your ingenuity. Choose your friends wisely, working to earn respect and unlock even further opportunities.

title: Battlefield 4: Night Operations
description: As day turns to night, the Graveyard Shift begins. A new set of soldiers takes the battlefield. Adapt to the darkness... or else. Use night vision and thermal imaging to expose enemies. Flashlights and flares are at your disposal, but beware – they can give away your position. The night is your ally – use it.

title: Battlefield 4: Legacy Operations
description: The Return of a Classic

title: Battlefield 4: Community Operations
description: Welcome to the jungle.

title: Furry Shakespeare: The Reverse Hamlet Championships
description: Partake in an underground arcade game competition. It's gonna be so cool.

title: Furry Shakespeare: Hamlet(s)
description: Uncover what exactly happened to the Hamlet twins, and interact with a new character.

title: Furry Shakespeare: Dashing Dinosaurs & Sexy Centaurs - The Meerkats from Arkham
description: Kit Marlowe, Amber, and Quince meet another acting troop.

title: Electronic Super Joy: A Hot Sticky Mess
description: ***WARNING: HARDCORE!*** You thought the adventure was over? BAD NEWS SUCKER! The new pope Boris the Super Sexy has a mission for your mute buttless self so listen up! A bad Boogie Bro has stolen the only food, a giant pudding! He’s probably going to do weird and kinky science to it! You gotta save it! Save the Boogie Bros!

title: Blaster Master Zero II: Copen from "Luminous Avenger iX"
description: Adds COPEN from "Luminous Avenger iX" as a playable character in EX Character Mode. Blast mutant scum across the galaxy alongside your robo-partner, Lola!

title: Blaster Master Zero II: Empress from "Dragon Marked For Death"
description: Adds EMPRESS from "Dragon Marked for Death" as a playable character in EX Character Mode.

title: Space Ship Drift
description: Drift in space on spaceships.

title: The fairy tale you don't know
description:
Little Red Riding Hood, Snow White, Alice in Wonderland, Thumbelina...
Let's travel to these well-known fairy tales' world, and play hide and seek with the heroines! In this game, you can rewrite the ending of these well-known fairy tales.

title: Atomicrops: Feline Good
description: Atomicrops: Feline Good update introduces numerous new features and improvements to the game. New achievements, farm timelapse, elite enemies, surplus mode, cat plushies, and stats and upgrades expand gameplay content. Balance changes adjust game mechanics, rebalance enemy and player interactions, and modify reward systems. Bug fixes and quality of life improvements resolve spawning issues, correct art and sorting problems, and enhance tractor and ability mechanics.

title: Atomicrops: Doom & Bloom
description: Atomicrops: Doom and Bloom update introduces Deervil's Den, a new high-risk, high-reward location, and a powerful Motivator Tractor. Extensive upgrades focus on transforming weeds into flowers, enhancing farm animals with unique abilities, and adding new mechanics like bullet-blocking cows and truffle-finding pigs. Balance changes adjust enemy behaviors, game progression, and item pools. Numerous bug fixes and quality of life improvements refine gameplay mechanics, UI, and player interactions.

title: MX vs. ATV: All Out - 2017 Yamaha YXZ1000R
description: Start your engines! Purchase the YXZ1000R UTV from Yamaha and experience real off-road riding!

title: MX vs. ATV All Out: 2017 KTM 250 SX-F
description: Start your engines! Purchase the 250 SX-F MX bike from KTM and experience real off-road riding!

title: MX vs. ATV All Out: 2011 KTM 450 SX

title: Neon City Riders: Super-Powered Edition
description:
Players can look forward to an easier default difficulty, with an extra challenge relegated to “Old-School” mode. Navigation has also been enhanced while updating the UI. There are some other changes as well.

Here’s the full rundown:
- New Difficulty
By default, Neon City Riders’ enemies, hazards, puzzles, checkpoint locations and map designs were re-balanced to be more accessible.

And, if you are a fan of challenges, like we do, the new option “Old-School mode” is available to increase the overall difficulty of your quest.

- Enhanced Navigation
We introduce Cypher Kid, a chatty little robot who will gladly (and optionally) sell you maps for the different turfs to help you navigate its sections.

Also, your mentor, Evergray, will help you at the begging of each zone by pointing you at the right direction.

- Optional Flashy UI
Thinking on the players with light sensitivity, we decided to add a new option that turns on/off the fast paced colors in the user’s interface across the game to make their journey as comfy as possible.

In addition to this changes, tons of small improvements were added, and, If you already started your adventure, this changes will be compatible with your current save file.

title: Scars of Summer
description: A slice of life RPG. Due to family circumstances, Keita finds himself living with his childhood friend Ryoka for the summer. Explore a contemporary Japanese setting, and enjoy spending time with Ryoka.

title: Lrrl or Rllr
description: LRRL or RLLR is a puzzle game in which you enjoy increasing your score by choosing left or right according to one recursive rule. You can enjoy it as long as you don't make the wrong choice. All choices are divided to the left or right when you start, and either contains all of your later choices.

title: CurryKitten FPV Simulator
description: Take charge of a powerful and acrobatic quadcopter and learn to fly it around the mountainous landscape. Rip through the partly-constructed building site, bash into the beach ball, chase cars, or fly up close and personal with an AI plane. Play it solo, or online with friends.

title: Angel Tears
description: Angel Tears is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: 7n7
description: 7n7 is a 2D, bullet-hell platformer, set in a world inspired by World War 1. Unlock new weapons and find a clever way to destroy 14 bosses that you may find on your path. Experience the story in non-combat levels with plenty of NPCs and the main character.

title: Military Base War
description: Top Down Shooter, Face a group of enemies where each type has its own behavior, trying to either destroy you or the blue cube that you have to protect. Eliminate all enemies in the stage, then move to the next stage

title: StreamGods: Streamer Tycoon
description: The ultimate streamer life simulation! RPG simulation featuring in-game AI-powered social network, robust Room Build mode and a ton of customizations.

title: Shanghai1920
description: This game is a suspenseful visual novel style game, Players will play a 20th century police in Shanghai, China, Discover the hidden story and truth behind the murder through exploration and investigation.

title: Tower of Ardia
description: With her sister's health in decline, Rayla searches for a legendary magic called Ardia. Relia challenges the dungeon tower of Ardia in hopes of finding a cure for her sister's weakened body. However, the tower is cursed with the witch Ardia's powers, and it will be no simple feat for Relia to conquer the spire and attain the wish-granting magic to save her sister.

title: Little Devourers
description: Little Devourers is a casual and relaxing game in which you control a black hole that does a great cleaning.

title: Star Tank
description: Star Tank is a tribute to the arcades of the early 1980s (Galaxian, Galaga, Space Invaders, Missile Command) and games from the early 1990s (Operation Wolf, Cabal). Show your skills with the controls and become an outstanding pilot of a Startank.

title: Countess in Crimson
description: Countess in Crimson is an erotic visual novel / adventure game hybrid with a horror theme. Uncover the dark secrets of the secluded Carpathian village while engaging in passionate romance along the way.

title: Matchsticks: Coffee Break Club
description: We’ve been taught not to play with fire, but the matches of this game aren’t going to burn you! Challenge your mind moving, adding and removing matchsticks until you find the correct solution. How many tries do you need to solve each level?

title: Welcome to the Adventurer Inn!
description: Having just opened an inn, you set out to create a comfortable environment to bring in tired adventurers looking for respite after their questing. Earn money, upgrade your inn, and befriend a diverse cast of characters!

title: Small Ball
description: This is a casual game,control small ball arrive at the destination,include 4 mini games

title: This Rain Will Never End
description: You are in a noir adventure game where you will play a cat detective who needs to investigate the suicide of the Mayor of Sunny city. Suddenly the rain started to drop endlessly and no one knows why.

title: Survival RPG 2: The Temple Ruins
description: A magical artifact lying among the ruins of a lost temple? Embark on a journey full of adventure, quests and exploration. You will need your survival skills in this retro 2d pixel art universe. Survival RPG 2: The Temple Ruins is the sequel of the first retro game Survival RPG: The Lost Treasure.

title: Marswar TD
description: Get ready for the most entertaining 3D tower defense game to give hours and hours of the best strategy gaming and protect the first extraterrestrial civilization against an unknown enemy.

title: Circular
description: Circular is an arcade scoring game.

title: The USB Stick Found in the Grass
description: This is a forensic challenge game – find out who the owner of the USB stick was and reconstruct their story.

title: Street Karate 3
description: Street karate 3 is a game in the genre of Beat'em up, in which you have to fight in an unequal duel with many opponents.

title: Rainbow Laser Disco Dungeon
description: Rainbow Laser Disco Dungeon is part twin stick-shooter, part rhythm game, part dungeon crawler. Every action, every laser blast and robot explosion, happens according the rhythm of the music. Pick up your weapons and get ready to dance!

title: Cursed Mummies
description: Cursed Mummies is a classic Sokoban. With each level, the task will become more difficult!

title: Flappy Bee
description: Flappy Bee is a high-score chasing thrill ride based upon staying alive while dodging lava and birds. Press the Space bar to fly or click the screen to dodge obstacles and keep your lives for as long as possible.

title: Allotropy
description: A game in the genre of "survival game". Your goal is to live as many as possible. One of the main tasks is to look for food, thirst. Look for shelter. Look for ammo boxes. Lots of firearms. There are also melee weapons. Several types of enemies. Do your best to survive.

title: Lost Dream
description: Discover the world from the eyes of a fox. Explore the unknown and rescue your captured friend

title: Galvatia
description: Galvatia is a PC game where you are an invisible conservationist for animals. It contains 5-enviroments such as a European meadow, a mixed forest, an American rainforest, an African savannah and an ocean.

title: Outland Rapture
description: Three strangers wake up in a mysterious place and working together without being noticed is the only way to survive all the dangers and return home.

title: Traffic City
description: Choose the city, you can freely drive in the city, mark the location, use the shortest path navigation.

title: Fragmented Mind
description: Fragmented Mind is a single player short indie horror game, starts when you wake up and find yourself in a strange house, going through series of paranormal events related to a crime happened in this house years ago .

title: Sqwark! A Nutty Adventure
description: Sqwark is just your average Green parrot who lives at 85 Acorn Drive. But when some multidimensional beings show up and attempt to take every delicious nut in the world to use as fuel for their weird and wonderful contraptions, he has to do something about it.

title: Mini Words: Polyglot
description: The most used nouns in English. Can you recognize them in another language? Unscramble frequently used words in a unique mix of logic puzzle, word search, and hangman.

title: Atomic Cards
description: Collect food, weapons and materials, face enemies and make difficult moral choices that will affect the gameplay.

title: Operation TP
description: A Post-Apocalyptic store run gone wrong, keep moving, don't get hit, get that TP!

title: Super Retro Fighter
description: Classic STG game Have fun with your friends just like your childhood!

title: Megania Online
description: Megania online is a fantasy medieval world set in the Age of Dragons. Many adventures and puzzles await you, but you will also have to face players in clan wars, mythological creatures, monster raids, powerful final bosses ...

title: Ero Tennis
description: Play tennis and admire the girl.

title: Training Grounds
description: Make your way through unique and challenging gun courses as fast as possible while clearing all red targets and avoiding green ones. Compete for the fastest times!

title: Andromeda 2 Zombies
description: Andromeda 2 Zombies is an First Person Shooter video game featuring zombies. The game take place in the far future where spatial exploration of galaxy is possible. A virus has spread and now zombies are rampant. The hero is in the military and try to bring order in the Andromeda galaxy.

title: Alien Cat 3
description: Having found his home on one of the distant planets, the space cat decides to settle down on it. But the local creatures did not appreciate this choice and decide to drive away the furry alien. Our task is very simple, to protect yourself and your shelter from the attacks of unfriendly monsters.

title: Menagerie: Archive
description: You have been lucky enough to be tasked with sorting the files in one of many archives across the land. However, you must share your income with 3 fellow citizens of a similar rank, and consequently decide their fate.

title: Signals
description: Signals is a casual planet hopper strategy game. Explore systems, harvest resources and repair alien devices. You’ll need to strategically work with the market to maximize your income while covering the cost of your operation in order to follow strange signals and discover what waits at the source.

title: Orb Tour
description: Snowy the snowcone is an alien who has been asleep for many years. When he wakes up, his people have VANISHED! He is the last of his kind, and he needs your help to find all 30 of the missing power orbs, so he can rebuild the mothership and bring his people back, before they face extinction.

title: Ties
description: Explore an oniric world and discover all its secrets during a dangerous and memorable quest.

title: Slime with a Sword
description: Enjoy the latest in slime simulation technology from Quantum Isles as you try to survive this grassy gauntlet.

title: Bunny's Ban
description: An adorable and relaxing puzzle game for people who love cute pets

title: Varmalis
description: Old-school psychological horror inspired by Silent Hill series, based on exploration of abandoned places, combat with monsters, puzzles solving and objects and texts to find. Vincent remembers a murder he never witnessed. What if his memories were mixed with those of a real killer?

title: The Last Islands of Man
description: The Last Islands of Man is a retro rpg that forces you to manage your time. The waters are rising. Can you save yourself? Can you save your family?

title: Magia X
description: The Real Fantasy 2D Action, Magia X. Splendid actions beyond the limits of 2D, unique characters, breathtaking adventures, and warm pastel-colored world awaits you. Stimulate your action urges.

title: Among Us Arena
description: Among Us Arena is a 2D multiplayer fighting game based on the game Among Us.

title: Escape From the Chaotic City
description: It's the Apocalypse! It's an experiment! It's just a movie! Armed just with a bat and courage, Eddy, an idle teen has to turn into a hero..in one night... But outside, on those desolates streets of Portland, the terror was released, the TV hasn't any broadcast, the telephones are out of order... A lethal disease is running through his veins...it's a time race... *Fight against an horde of zombies *Search for survivors *Make a plan to escape *Walk through a big city with: a hospital a mall a subway a church a bar and much more! *Reveal the dark secret behind this hell of epic game!

title: Escape the Barn
description:
Oh no! Someone has locked you in the barn - can you escape using only the stuff you find inside? Find your way out in this colorful, childfriendly escape-the-room game.

This game was part of the AGS Bake Sale, where we collected money for Child's Play. If you like the game, why not donate a few bucks to the charity of your choice?

title: Fading Shades
description: Fading Shades is a small 1st person adventure game, set in an unknown location. The only way out is by crossing the rainbow bridge but you can't as long as there are colours missing...

title: Fallen Soldier
description: The story of a soldier of the German Wehrmacht in WWII who falls in battle and laying lifeless surrounded by an ongoing war, he starts questioning what led him here and pondering his role in the grand scheme of things...

title: Fasmo
description: Everyone else has left the colony, you're stuck back to keep an eye on things. What you don't know is that someone else has also stayed back, and he doesn't have such benevolent intentions.

title: Fasmo 2: Fasmo Goes West
description: In this game, you take control of Fasmo, the sentient stick bug from outer space. He's accidentally teleported himself into the wild west, and must contend with ferocious bandits, and scheming policemen. Features two controversial mini-games, and an original score.

title: Featherweight
description: In the fight against the machines, featherweights play a minor role - scouting, recon and spying. Considered as mere data collectors rather than true warriors, they're untrained in combat and ill equipped for any encounters with the enemy. However, when Thadd, a young featherweight, sees a fellow featherweight captured by the enemy and taken to their base, he decides that he will sneak into their compound and help her escape - even if he has to do it all by himself. Using your left mouse button (Walk, interact, select items) and your right mouse button (look, deselect items), guide Thadd in his daring attempt to break his fellow featherweight free!

title: Frank the Farmhand Part 1
description: Frank is a farmhand who tries to find his missing physicsprofessor who's being hunted by some mysterious agents. He'll uncover a truly evil conspiracy and meet some really nasty people in his adventures to save the professor and later on the world itself. NOTE: This game deals with racist themes.

title: Frank the Farmhand Part 2
description:
After having escaped from the agents, Frank and his friends are captured by the american military and brought to a military camp on the island of Guija.

In the second part of Frank's adventures you'll find yourself on an exotic island with lots of new characters to interact with, and many challenging problems to solve.

This game is bigger, better and more beautiful than its predecessor!

title: Pirate Galaxy
description: Pirate Galaxy is a 3D, sci-fi brower-based MMO from Splitscreen Studios and Gamigo with real-time action. The game's story concerns the invading alien Mantis and the fight to stop them.

title: Thats Life of Ralph
description: This is the life of Ralph, a teenage raccoon, in this story you will experience the most incredible moments of his life. In this relaxing experience, accompany Ralph, his friends, his girlfriend and his family, told in 5 handmade illustrated scenes. Have a calm and relaxing experience.

title: Hot Swap: Cyberlust
description: Time for the Hot Swap series - back with one of the sexiest themes ever to satisfy all your cyber needs! Swap and rotate square blocks in the correct order to solve the puzzle and reveal high quality, realistic, naughty & sexy girls!

title: Crazy Derby Racing
description: Crazy Derby Racing is a destructive race in Low Poly style, get behind the wheel of a Formula 1 car, or a brand new sports car and show what you can do.

title: TechBeat Heart
description: SCORCHING TECHBEAT ACTION! A frantic combo-based score attack shooter with roguelite elements. Make combos to earn more time. Master all weapons and defeat a raving mad machine. 100% arcade action. Online ranking. Lots of achievements. A Dual Gunstrike spin off.

title: Mighty No. 9: Ray Expansion
description: A mysterious robot named RAY has appeared and our hero Beck has been tasked with infiltrating an abandoned lab to search for her. Discover the origins of RAY and join her in her quest for answers.

title: Card Battle Spirit Link: Mini Expansion 1
description: 7 new Leader cards arrive in the first expansion for Card Battle Spirit Link! Each leader provides a fresh take on an existing attribute!

title: 2076: Midway Multiverse
description: The multiverse is in danger! Take control of your space combat ship, fight the Nazi Galactic Empire and relive the thrills of classic scrolling shooters in a unique retro Virtual Reality experience.

title: Bridge to Another World: Secrets of the Nutcracker - Collector's Edition
description: Something is terribly wrong in the toy world, and only you can help!

title: Girls Guns and Zombies
description: Girls Guns & Zombies is exactly that, girls with guns shooting zombies. While, having some poolside fun in between. Scavenge the ruined city overrun by the undead, collect resources and throw a party for the girls!

title: Dininho Adventures: Definitive Edition
description: Help out Dininho in what might be the most heroic adventure of your life! Explore this colorfull and dangerous world, rescuing all the defenseless babies. But be carefull, "He" will be waiting at the end of every road. I trust you! Go and be the Dinoland hero.

title: Lifespawn
description: Lifespawn Is a 2D Platformer With a Twist: You Place Your Own Checkpoints. Good Luck.

title: Experience the Energy: Take the Challenge
description: Play a series of fun minigames to see how your skills align with 10 exciting careers in oil and gas.

title: Pulseball
description: Merging sports with first-person shooters, Pulseball is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer game. Now with better netcode than Halo Master Chief Collection!

title: B.Y.O.O.L.: Best Years of Our Lives
description: A visual novel about love, full of odd humor, dark humor, meta humor and hopefully, heart. Join Nastya Byool as she goes on a dark, surreal adventure that will change her life forever. This kinetic novel will take you about 40 minutes, making it a good way to pass the time if you're short on it.

title: Heroes of The West
description: Heroes of the West is a community-generated mod for Red Orchestra 2/Rising Storm. It pits US and British forces against German forces in iconic battles on the Western front in WWII. It introduces a new faction, the British Airborne, 4 new maps, 5 new character sets and 10 new weapons.

title: Tank Guards
description: "Tank Guards" is an independent game of strategy and defense based on tanks. Terrible enemies will invade your base, you have to upgrade your base, arm your tanks, and take advantage of the terrain, with friends to defend against their crazy attack.

title: My Living Things
description: My name is Jeremy. I can bring things to life.

title: Push-Ups Workout
description: Are you ready for the 200 Push-Ups Challenge? Body shaping is always good for our body. These workouts are perfect for men and women, beginners and professionals. Do you want to gain muscles, lose weight, increase strength and stamina? Effective workout plans created by professional fitness coaches will help you to see the results after 1 week! Set a goal for what you want to reach. Don't give up, just follow the training plan. Just simply follow and perform the instructed number of reps, and after 10 weeks, you will be able to do 200 push-ups straight!

title: Love Colors
description: Love Colors is the relaxing paint by numbers pixel art game. Choose from over 150 stylish paintings from lovable themes and become the Picasso of the pixel. Playable solo and up to 4-player couch co-op.

title: Saint Kotar
description: Saint Kotar is a psychological horror adventure set in an ancient rural town of Croatia. Take on the role of two godly men trying to unravel the terrifying truth behind the town's occult happenings and the disappearance of their relative. Find your humanity -- or descend into madness and death.

title: Lip! Lewd Idol Project Vol. 1
description: Welcome to the world of Lewd Idols! But… What exactly is a Lewd Idol? Join Kairi, the shy aspiring star, and Ranko, her depraved self-proclaimed producer on this lewd journey! Explore Akihabara, form an idol group, and overcome the odds while having lots of girl-on-girl action! Are you ready for it?

title: Touhou Block Fall: Yukari
description: Reimu and Yukari team up in this puzzle game inspired by classic 8-bit Nintendo games. Manage the incoming youkai so Yukari can gap them away!

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist Arc-V - ARC League Championship
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Prediction Princess Deck and Igknight Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Waking the Dragons - Yugi’s Journey
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Fang of Critias Deck and Aromage Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Zexal Dark Mist Saga
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Dark Mist Deck and Evilswarm Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V Sora and Dipper
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Fluffal Deck and Constellar Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: 5D's For the Future
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, TG Deck and Vylon Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V - Shay vs Dennis
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Raidraptor and Performage Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Waking the Dragons - Joey’s Journey
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Red-Eyes Deck and PSY-Frame Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V Yuto v. Sylvio
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Stellarknight Deck and Monarch Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V - Yugo’s Synchro Dimension
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Speedroid Deck and Goyo Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: GX Lost Duels
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Masked HERO Deck and Darkness Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V - Jack Atlas vs Yuya
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Red Dragon Archfiend Deck and Dinomist Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V - Declan vs Celina
description: Play 3 pre-constructed decks, D/D/D Deck, Zefra Deck, and Lunalight Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V Gong v. Kit
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Superheavy Samurai Deck and X-Saber Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: GX - Leaders
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Toons Deck and Kaiju Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Arc-V Zuzu v. Julia
description: Play 2 pre-constructed decks, Melodious Deck and Gem-Knight Deck. Includes additional duels in Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Campaign and Challenge Mode.

title: Jixxaw
description: It's jigsaw puzzle time! Put the pieces together to solve the puzzle and reveal high quality, realistic, naughty & sexy girls!

title: Spinning Kid 2
description: Spinning and parkour platformer!

title: Fright Night Sex Fest
description: This is no Hack-n-slash... this is HACK 'N FLASH! Dark and stormy nights are filled with cock-starved, horny frights. Leave your Carnal Fear behind, on this Night of the Giving Head!

title: Endless Battle: Return of Hero +1
description: Help Hero rebuild the entire universe, and beyond! An idle incremental adventure.

title: Murder by Moonlight: Call of the Wolf
description: Play a thrilling Match3 game with a suspenseful crime story. Find clues, search for evidence, and talk to witnesses as you unlock new upgrades to reveal the truth.

title: Succubus Affection
description: In a world of human-like monsters, a young man lives in a quiet, remote village with his sister. However, he is attacked by monsters when he leaves the village. Now he works hard to become stronger so he no longer burdens his sister.

title: Furry Finder: Dating Visual Novel
description: Furry Finder is a visual novel game about finding the love of your life. After turbulent moments in your life, you will have to stand up to your shyness. The main goal of the game is to use a dating app called "Furry Finder" and give Alexis (the main protagonist) a chance to find true love.

title: Minimum Wage: Influence the Election
description: Nail biting mischief. Manipulate the powerful with every decision you make.

title: Diamond Hands: To the Moon
description: A game with one objective - to get to the moon. A game for apes by apes. A game as frustrating as stock market manipulation, a game that will make you want to hold on for dear life...

title: Rat Prison
description: Rat Prison - pixel 2D simulator with horror elements.

title: The Beast Awoke to Eat Your Darlings
description: The Beast gets hungry. The Beast devours your cats. The Beast sees you. The Beast comes for you. You have no weapons. You have rules to learn and turn against them. Know each nightmare, outsmart the Beast and its Sentinels, and carry your darlings to safety. Every cat you save counts.

title: Kavel
description: Drag Tetromino blocks onto a board of gems to make a match. Use bombs for impressive explosive effects. Kavel is an action-puzzle game that brings together block puzzles and match-3 in an exciting new twist. A truly unique new entry in the genre.

title: Kraken Smash: Volleyball
description: Squids play volleyball! Smash the ball in your friend's face and start a fight with them that will last at least for the 10 generations to come. You can play with up to 4 players, which means you can lose 3 friends at the same time.

title: Being Centered
description: Balance your chakras.

title: Pandemia: Virus Outbreak
description: Swipe cards to face the deadly virus threat in this story driven strategy game. Step into the world in which you will face the decisions that world leaders make in the event of a deadly virus threat. Every decision have consequences.

title: Equaline
description: Equaline is a "one-stroke calculation puzzle" where you have to connect numbers and symbols with lines to complete a calculation. There is only one correct answer for each combination of nine squares, and the target number increases with each puzzle. It's a highly competitive action puzzle game.

title: Different Stories VR
description: With hearing and sight! Discover the secrets of the beautiful lands. Look for differences, solve puzzles, perform various activities such as cleaning :) Find the differences and learn all the stories!

title: Tears of Luna
description: Danmaku style STG. What is The cause of the Emergency? Why the artifact finally appeared? Travel through time and space,dodge the bullet-hell, defeat the sorceress, and save your own world line!

title: Spacebug
description: Embark on an interplanetary journey in this space shooter game with many levels to pass or a Sandbox mode to break your record each time you play!

title: It's Harvest Time!
description: It's Harvest time is a simple 2d puzzle casual game. Be the simple farmer at a farmstead on the countryside. Build and upgrade the farm. Protect the farm animals from wild animals.

title: Color Pixel Heroes
description: Color Pixel Heroes is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!

title: A Cure for Jessica
description: An emotional story-driven game, where you play as Dr. Olivia, a scientist trying to find a way to cure her daughter. Explore the world and save Jessica from this deadly virus, as you recall some memories.

title: Uncle Nook's Monster Emporium
description: Explore your way through a procedurally generated haunted mansion. Watch out for monsters and deadly traps that block your way. Only with creativity and persistence will you make it out alive!

title: Apsis Online
description: Apsis Online is a minimalist multi-user roguelike (MUR) in which you play a Voyager. A human, mentally and physically augmented for a new life in deep space.

title: RagDoll MadDoll
description: RagDoll MadDoll is an arcade based ragdoll dropping game with 8 levels, unique art direction and diverse score outcomes.

title: Heliopolis Six
description: In Heliopolis Six you construct and manage your own space station. Join station parts together in 3D, extend them with modules, collect and distribute resources and ensure live support. As station director, good management is the most important aspect of your job, since space is a dangerous place.

title: Present Danger
description: It's only a matter of time. Use your agility and trusty pistol to survive as long as you can against an onslaught of corrupted holiday paraphernalia.

title: Hell Blasters
description: Hell Blasters is a bullet hell shoot 'em up where you can blast the bullet hell away!

title: The Darkest Island
description: You are the only survivor of a plane crash. You are on a mysterious island and must face surprises and fight to stay alive. Lose yourself on an incredible journey of survival. Can you find a solution and leave the island?

title: DF-41 Simulator
description: 3D visualizer and simulator of the Dongfeng-41 (DF-41 东风-41) road-mobile intercontinental ballistic missile.

title: Bubble Bubble Ball
description: A boring little ball is wondering in space while it meets those lovely colorful bubble A place is big enough to kill time A giant stage filled with endless and all forms of bubble Various tricks will lead to different paths Dangerous space will strangle the live out of your balls

title: Our Hero! Two
description: Play in the shoes of 3 different heroes, each one with their skills and peculiarities, to pave your way through this new story of the funniest Hack and Slash of the world!

title: Silk Roads: Caravan Kings
description: In Silk Roads: Caravan Kings you follow in the footsteps of the legendary Marco Polo on a journey into Cathay in search of riches and adventure.

title: Moirs
description: Moirs is a 7 Keys rhythm game, step into the world of music and enjoy the journey!

title: Christmas Elf
description: Christmas Elf will help you to fully decorate your Windows desktop for Christmas. The app offers many ways to decorate for the holidays, including lights and garlands, different types of snow, Christmas trees, festive tunes, and beautiful wallpapers.

title: Briddle
description: A wonderful riddle game, where you need to solve 25 riddles with just a few hints. Can you reach level 25? I will be waiting for you there. You will receive some hints for each riddle, and then, is up to you to find the right answer. The difficulty will grow each level, can you reach the end?

title: Tiki Tiki: The Tropical Memory Game
description: Tiki Tiki: The Tropical Memory Game is a family friendly memory game where all can improve their memory, speed of thinking. With 3 game modes and 3 difficulties its the perfect way to train your brain.

title: Tear and the Library of Labyrinths
description: The twin sisters Tear and Lumiere enjoy a happy life running their clinic. But when a demon abducts her sister, Tear must summon her courage to venture through worlds within magical tomes to bring her sister home safe.

title: Alien World Millionaire
description: This is a chess game for strategic players. Players can buy real estate by rolling dice, play small games or go to the counting road to get tickets, buy cards and become their own winning secret. Use tactics to defeat other players, and finally become a millionaire in the different world.
