description: Stretch across lands of unforeseeable cold, and trouble in Urizen Shadows of the Cold Deluxe Frosty Edition which includes a massive 54 warrior, 69 stage "head bopping", sword slashing lineup with characters raging from beasts, ogres, ninjas, knights, aliens, sorcerers, mermaids and demons.

title: Comet Crusher: Block Breaker
description: While exploring deep space, you have come across our solar system. It is up to you to crush each layer of every planet in our solar system in this beautiful block breaker. See if you can complete each set of levels corresponding to each planet in order to unlock the next.

title: The Crafter's Defense
description: An active strategy game where you customize your dungeon and defend against waves of invaders. Create your dungeon, place monsters and traps, and protect your core! Take direct control of any of your dungeon's monsters to directly engage in the combat or sit back watch the battle unfold.

title: Car Constructor
description: Car Constructor will allow you to build, repair and paint your own car, then check it out on the race track!

title: Waifu Secret
description: Exciting, puzzle game with fancy girls. Control yourtube and find the way to pass the level and unlock a lot of beauty in the gallery. Gameplay is beautiful and relaxing.

title: Space Castle
description: Space Strategy. A mix of tower hold games and role-playing action.

title: Soarocity
description: An exciting 2d platformer with a painterly art style and unique rotation mechanic.

title: Crazy Mafioso
description: Crazy Mafioso is a addicting multi-level survival game. Don`t let yourself be killed! Upgrade your barricades, weapons and gun power. Kill and earn game money.

title: Save Aisha
description: Help Emran rescue his daughter (Aisha) who has been taken from his arms. You will join him in his journey through the castles and forests to meet the king.

title: Magissy
description: Magissy is an Open-World Story-Driven Adult RPG where you take place as a charismatic adventurer and excellent lover, who fears not the danger of dark corners of the Lyrn nor the darkest fantasies of it's behaviors.

title: Critter Clicker
description: Casual farming simulator with unique, flexible gameplay. Autoclicker is built-in and free. Gather resources, upgrade critters and buildings, sell your farm when you want a bigger one and never stop expanding.

title: Nami
description: Nami is a pixel art horror game based on the Brazilian coastline and the works of Junji Ito.

title: 1x! Space Adventure
description: 1x! Space Adventure is an arcade top-down shump with gradually increasing difficulty.

title: Hardcore Trivia
description: Challenge your brains and have a fun time with multiple challenging questions! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. With a Commercial licence, you can arrange a new event easily for example in your bar and provide entertainment to the customers.

title: We Die
description: As a Reaper Class 4, Unit 82 (R482), your current job is to collect the remaining souls from a previous reaper's attempt. Your outcome is determined by your exploration, your reaping, and your attitude towards the many lost souls. You only get one chance to make an impression.

title: Destroy All the Cubes
description: Classic Endless Balls without ads, a unique minimalist design and lots of cannons to destroy all the cubes before they hit the ground. 2 game modes: get as many points as possible in Rush Point and complete all levels.

title: Hack Grid
description: Hack Grid is a puzzle game & love letter to DOS gaming. Only one piece must remain on the board. Each type of piece has its own set of rules. Retro Sound Blaster 16 style audio will accompany you throughout the game. Hack the Grid!

title: Snowman Saves Christmas
description: Snowman Saves Christmas is a 1980s Inspired 2D platformer. Featuring 250 Levels of retro inspired platforming fun split across 5 game modes and Multiple PowerUp items.

title: Atlas Wept
description: A Humanist retro-style RPG game about sincerity and empathy, featuring friendly robot dogs and evil smiley faces.

title: Aisling and the Tavern of Elves
description: “Aisling and the Tavern of Elves” is an Isekai Fantasy-Comedy Dating Sim Visual Novel, where you play as Aisling Whitehorse, a hapless mercenary turned tavern owner eking out a living in the Elven Kingdom of Eiredagh.

title: Mayday: The Survival Island
description: After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a strange island. Survive by hunting, farming, and crafting, then explore a vast archipelago filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and magical totems. Build your base, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

title: Amira
description: Amira: A story driven adventure about a girl born in a middle eastern-fantasy world who finds by chance that her life is written and predetermined as she was helping her family, thus she fights for acceptance, love and writing her own life.

title: Amulet of Time: Shadow of La Rochelle
description: When the ghost of the beautiful Diane de Poitiers appears in front of you, you are transported back in time in "Amulet of Time: Shadow of la Rochelle"! Explore France and an incredible love story in this amazing Hidden Object Adventure game.

title: Museum of Extravagance
description: A surrealist experience in a strange museum

title: The Scary Square
description: The Dark Side Of Mr.Square To Be Discovered.

title: Get Tanked!
description: Why settle for regular tanks when you can drive a super tank? Forget about physics laws and challenge your friends in dynamic and rule-free clashes on one of many exciting arenas. Wishlist now and Get Tanked! in multiplayer combat arena.

title: Hikikomori Life
description: Adventures of a reclusive gamer with elements of a simulator, quest and roguelike. Explore parallel worlds in an attempt to remove the curse from a magician in the body of a cat. Conquer a changing dungeon with many enemies. In the real world, equip a home, create objects, cook food, travel.

title: Qubie: Invader of Worlds
description: Qubie is an in-development platformer game designed to bring happiness and joy to all. Squash enemies, collect coins, and avoid various traps to progress through the levels. Oh and try to keep your cool!

title: Danger Forever
description:
Danger Forever is 3D Shoot'Em Up with RPG elements. Lone human rides her mecha-dragon through a hostile world of mechanoids and techno-demons.

Unlike most scrolling shooters, you fly through a 3D environment — use it to your advantage, and beware of bumping into walls or ground. Also, instead of traditional showering enemies with bullets, you must think ahead a bit - the fuel/heat system adds more depth to combat.

title: Endless Soul Light Solitaire
description: Help your friends in their search! Classic solitaire in a fantasy setting!

title: The Curse of Esrevni
description: Turn-based strategy game Use your cards well Survive Board game Don't give up !

title: TinyCrack
description: 'Tiny Crack' is a story-based, stage-breaking action game in which you must defeat all enemies within the time limit. Enjoy the action and story of each character and check out different endings.

title: Buyhads
description: Buyhads -2D puzzle platformer in which you have to fight robots to find the codes you need to complete.

title: Sand Witch Adventures
description: Sand Witch Adventures is a roguelike game with bullet-hell elements. Cursed lands full of undead are fraught with wealth and knowledge for the young witches.

title: The Curse of Illmoore Bay
description: A 90's Halloween/Horror comical platforming adventure! Can you stop Illmoore Bay from a world of perpetual Halloween?

title: Nofrills Solitaire
description: A fresh take on Solitaire Klondike with no distractions.

title: Timothy and the Tower of Mu
description: Ascend the tower to save your grandfather in this classic, hardcore action-platformer. The Tower of Mu is waiting for you... Push past each check point to the next awaiting challenge; dashing, jumping, and slinging your way up to the towers peak. Die. learn. Overcome.

title: T.W. Burgess Presents: Pylons
description:
It's a beautiful day to play in the countryside! Just make sure to not play near the PYLONS.

Abandoned in the late 70s and restored today for all to play! Play PYLONS and learn of all the safe ways to avoid an accidental death by PYLONS.

title: Mr. Krasnoludek, Teach Me Your Magic Spells
description:
In this game, a cat named Theremin tries to learn the magic spells of Polish dwarves.
Wield devastating dark magic and explore an enchanted forest.
Experience a day and night system which changes the nature of enemy mobs.
Pick onions and potatoes and stuff, or make a friend!

title: Smack Studio
description: Smack Studio is a sandbox platform fighting game with built-in creation tools for characters and stages.

title: Space Blaster (Lines)
description:
An experimental horror game. A simple space blaster game made from code borrowed off the internet becomes angry it was never finished.
The game starts off simple, but develops itself to entrap the user.

title: Spirited Thief
description: Scout, loot, and get out in Spirited Thief, a tactical turn-based stealth game with a twist. Search ahead as spirit, Trin, and grab the goods as thief, Elaj. Just make sure you have the loot before the guards come looking!

title: RollMe
description: RollMe is a physical-based platform puzzle game, where you can roll over 120 levels in 6 different places. Your ball can change the direction of gravity and you can use jumpers, teleporters to complete levels soon as you can. You can earn points when you collect consumables and finish the levels in a shorter time. Every act has new challenges and riddles.

title: Ghost Suburb Zero
description: Ghost Suburb Zero is a RPG where you, as May, become thrown into a bizzare world and it's many inhabitants- such as, crazed gun-holding girls, bizzare cryptids from foriegn realms, persistantly blurred memories, daemonic brothels, strange bird viruses, and much more!

title: Beyond the Phone Screen
description:
Welcome to the latest and greatest in Geolocation based Augmented Reality entertainment!

Thanks to our deal with Shivers City we've integrated the hit videogame Civilian GO! in an unprecedented way with your town! Enjoy extremely immersive events and activities while you stroll around your beautiful home.

Go out there and make your Mayor proud!

title: Fun, Sun & Mishaps
description: A light-hearted comedy about a girl, an island and a vacation gone wrong. That is, until you meet someone you think has the answer to all your problems. But, is his solution all it's cracked up to be, or is something else going on behind that smile? Find out as you scour a tropical island in search of a way to salvage your ill-fated vacation. Along the way, you will meet many interesting characters, some of whom, might need a little more convincing than others. But, no matter who or what you encounter, it will always be an adventure in......Fun, Sun & Mishaps

title: Goat Herd and the Gods
description: Life was pretty peaceful for Atl the Aztec goat herder. That is until the legendary El Chupacabra showed up to decimate his four legged friends. Against such a mighty foe, how can Atl save the day? Maybe with a little divine intervention? Join our cowardly goat herd on his journey and find out in Goat Herd and the Gods! Goat Herd and the Gods is a short point and click adventures game, and is the second title from Dropped Monocle's team.

title: Graveyard
description:
Short game about three kids trying to save a friend.

Dave, Phil and Clarence will have to cooperate to reach their goal, and save their friend Ron from a gruesome fate.

Entry for MAGS September 2016.

title: Grr! Bearly Sane
description:
Daniel is having a bad day.

Forced to wear a rancid bear suit and endure endless torment from his boss, and an endless multitude of horrid children, just so he can afford to keep his small crummy suburban flat, Dan finally SNAPS!

title: Hang-On
description: PC-88 port of arcade game Hang-On.

title: Headbanger's Heaven: A Rock & Roll Adventure
description:
Jason Miller is a typical teenage rocker. Loves to stay up all night and sleep all day. And of course, headbang to his favourite music.

When he enters a competition in Kerplow Rock Magazine, he never dreamed he would actually win first prize!

But won, he has. And now he gets to spend the afternoon with his favourite band, Uptempo Maniacs, and get a private performance of their new song.

He is SO excited! He still can't believe it, even when the limo driver drops him off at the band's mansion.

He has his autograph book, all ready to get autographs from all 6 of the band members. And he CANNOT WAIT for the special private performance.

But if he thinks he's in for an easy afternoon, he's got another think coming.

title: Agora: Soul of the Oracle
description:
Reminiscent of Diablo, but instead of maps, the game consists of eighteen 3D globes. There are no boundaries, you can walk all the way around the globe if you want to. This does get somewhat confusing at times though. In order to move to the next globe, you have to find all the pieces of a stone disk.

However, your enemies will also pick up the disk pieces and you have to defeat them to get them back. When you die, you are reincarnated at your "oracle", a stone structure which you have to defend. If your oracle is destroyed, you can no longer be resurrected. This is also true for your enemies.

title: Barricadez ReVisited
description: This is the Crafting × Tower Defense game you have been looking for. Gather materials and items to upgrade your base and protect a cradle after the collapse of civilization. Mine and explore in caves In The Caves, you can mine randomly generated resources that are used to craft traps and blocks. Venture deeper and deeper to find a number of rare materials and secrets. Craft the perfect defense In your base, you can craft dozens of facilities and traps to repel approaching enemies. Mix and match the attributes of each trap to counter each attacker's behavior and survive one more day. Immersive story Dive deeper and survive longer to uncover pieces of the truth. Find out what happened to cause the destruction of the world and the origin of our little robot!

title: Sprite Generator
description: Sprite Generator lets you rapidly create thousands of interesting procedurally generated sprites.

title: Tangent Rush
description: Tangent Rush is a casual game with unique controls and tricky levels. Challenge yourself through dodging obstacles and breaking records. Get the hang of throwing yourself around tangentially and getting to the goal in time!

title: Atlas: The Gift of Aramai
description:
There is great unrest in the realm of Ammeth. A new evil has risen in the northern reaches of the kingdom, and darkness spreads throughout the land. A young diplomat named Jarreck is dispatched by the crown. His mission is urgent: to seek the root of the evil, and to eradicate it.

Atlas: the Gift of Aramai is a classic game of exploration and adventure in a realm on the brink of magical reawakening. Take the role of Jarreck as he leads an eclectic band of adventurers on a mission of reckoning and rediscovery. It is a pivotal moment for the realm of Ammeth: will a hero arise to challenge the darkness?

title: Veneficium: A witch's tale
description: Veneficium is a cute and magical 3D platformer in which you help Alice uncover the faith of her coven. Alice has to use her magic to interact with different objects within a vast and magical world to overcome puzzles and obstacles.

title: Beached II
description: Whilst travelling out on the open sea, your boat sinks. You, and two others are washed onto a tropical island. The island is a paradise, with trees, bananas, coconuts, and vines. However, you suddenly remember the long range weather forecast. A tornado will form in this area in about one week. You must work hard to build a raft to get off the island, but also make sure you keep alive by eating, drinking and sleeping. The other survivors must build their own rafts too. You must decide if and when you help them, or if you line your own pockets with gold.

title: Death Crown: Demonic Menace
description: Lead the Demon invasion and go down to the giant Undead's Dungeons to face Death.

title: Pesky Humans
description: Pesky Humans is a real-time, top-down, point-and-click sci-fi shooter. It is single player, with setting-appropriate music unique to each difficulty level. Talkative Ship AIs respond to players actions, spoken in English but subtitled for other languages.

title: Camel
description: An addictive, though very short game. Guide your camel across the Gobi desert, trying to avoid dying of hunger, thirst, or fatigue. Also, you need to avoid the cannibals who are chasing after you.

title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing: The Dirt Track at Charlotte
description: Welcome to The Dirt Track at Charlotte, the home of Saturday night action!

title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing: The Dirt Track at Las Vegas Motor Speedway
description: Roll the dice and go all-in at The Dirt Track at Las Vegas Motor Speedway!

title: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing: Knoxville Raceway
description: Head to Iowa and take on Knoxville Raceway!

title: Cauldrons of War: Barbarossa
description: Cauldrons of War Barbarossa is the turn-based strategic wargame you will launch whenever you want your WW2 shot but don't have time for a monster strategy game.From June 1941 until the Battle of Moscow, play the USSR or the Axis forces in one of the largest and bloodiest operations in history.

title: Hope VR: Emotional Intelligence Assistant
description: H.O.P.E is designed to be a calming experience in Virtual Reality that allows you to disconnect from the stress of the real world, and reconnect with your self in one of the many spectacular environments available, along with guided breathing exercises.

title: How to Survive 2: Dead Dynamite
description: Dare to go deep underground to solve the ancient curse that could be the root of the undead apocalypse. Meet a mysterious psychic lady with a good hand for explosives and help her get rid of this curse. You can stop the undead plague once and for all!

title: Tennis World Tour: Alex De Minaur
description: Play as Australian revelation Alex De Minaur in Tennis World Tour.

title: Tennis World Tour: Rafael Nadal
description: Play as Rafael Nadal, playable with two of his latest outfits (Roland-Garros 2018 and the 2019 Australian Open).

title: Tennis World Tour: Caroline Garcia
description: Play as Caroline Garcia, one of the best French female tennis players, in Tennis World Tour.

title: Tennis World Tour: Kristina Mladenovic
description: Play as Kristina Mladenovic, playable with two of her latest outfits (Roland-Garros 2018 and the 2019 Australian Open).

title: Life Simulator
description: Life Simulator is a simulation game with relaxed atmosphere. Players will play as a college graduate getting into the big city, you will fight for your life for four years, you can be a winner with cars, houses and soul mate, or maybe a salty fish with nothing, and you can also find love...

title: Mage: Enchanted
description: Unlock Mirror Mode and Skin Packs

title: Home Designer: Living Room
description: In this classic hidden object game, Hazel wants to help her aunt with home refurbishment. Sell off the old stuff and renovate the empty living room with real world furniture and design the room of your dreams!

title: Banner of the Maid: The Oriental Pirate
description: While on a reconnaissance mission with Lannes, Pauline accidentally boarded a British warship. Just as they are about to be found by enemies on board, a strange figure appeared in the cabin.... Mu Zhiyun, the oriental pirate who serves under Ching Shih, sailed across the oceans to Europe with certain purpose.

title: Banner of the Maid: Miss Elisa's Journal
description: Banner of the Maid is a turn-base strategy game set in the time of the French Revolution. You will lead the army to break through the difficulties and experience the different stories of that most uncommon time with wine of salon and the smoke of battlefield.

title: Eisenbahn X: Modellset 1 - Bahnhof, Häuser, Scheunen
description: MODELSET 1 for Railroad XThis MODELSET contains 63 individual models consisting of a railway station, houses, townhouses and barns.

title: Rugby 18: The British and Irish Lions 2017 Team
description: Slip into the prestigious jersey of the 2017 British and Irish Lions. 35 players, including Owen Farrell, Jonathan Sexton and Leigh Halfpenny, available in "Quick Match," "Online Match" and "My Squad" modes.

title: Jewel Match Origins: Palais Imperial - Collector's Edition
description: Play a Match-3 game like you've never seen before! Journey back to the Baroque Era in this imperial Match-3 adventure! Traverse 180 vast levels and collect resources to construct a breathtaking palace.

title: Aggressor
description: Aggressor is a flashy air combat shooter with simple destruction physics. Fly the greatest planes of the cold war and bring down the enemy with an arsenal of unique weaponry, ranging from gunpods to bombs and air-to-air missiles.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C - Aggressors BFM Campaign
description: The FA-18C Aggressors BFM campaign puts you in the cockpit of an FA-18C Hornet, as a new Aggressor pilot with VFC-12 the "Fighting Omars" on loan to the 65th Aggressor Squadron at Nellis Air Force Base. Based on real world procedures you will fly as Red Air against Blue Air Forces.

title: Mend Arcade Battle
description: MEND Arcade Battle is a turn-based RPG inspired by Fighting Game core mechanics. Players must tackle the Fighting Game staple challenge known as Arcade Mode with a Turn-based RPG twist! Choose your character and follow their path to defeating the final boss awaiting them at the end.

title: Steel Storm: Forgotten Prison
description: Of course you all remember Steel Storm, well known for its fierce and intense action. This DLC is not only action packed, but also brings a challenge full of puzzles and traps, you need to think your way through. Think outside the box, explore, observe, and you shall succeed at your mission!

title: Portal 2: Community Edition
description: Portal 2: Community Edition is the best way to play and create Portal community content. This community maintained game can be used by anyone to create their own unique never before possible puzzles. Portal 2: Community Edition is built on top of Strata Source, a community maintained fork of the CS:GO engine.

title: Yuna: Sugar Hearts and Love - New Love
description: Hello and welcome to Yuna World. Help Yuna collect candy hearts and accompany her through the day. Candy hearts are an important currency in the world of Yuna. Get to know her better privately, maybe you will like each other. You like collecting achievements? You've come to the right place.

title: The Book of Yorle: Save the Village
description: This DLC, the first of four, entitled Save The Village, allows access to the warehouse and to the tavern's wine cellar. Is there more to discover than these areas? Yes! Search and explore to uncover the secrets hidden therein. Seal the gates to the village and prevent further infiltration from the Evil Ones.

title: Star Tactics Redux
description: Turn-based strategy game full of spacefleet battles. 30+ hours of gameplay, randomized battles, huge campaign with different ways of completion. Experience infinite tactical situations and outsmart the tricky AI using dozens of ships and special abilities.

title: Clown
description: You're trapped inside a series of mazes with a killer clown. Find the 8 playing cards to banish him before he finds you. Can you escape?

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Gigantica Road Lake
description: The Gigantica Road Lake is a fully-licensed venue in France known for the number and size of the carp present. With over 900 carp in the lake, including 50 trophy fish, you are assured plenty of action! The stock in this lake weigh in at an average of over 30lbs, with the biggest being over 60lbs.

title: Odd Adventure of Chub, Color, 23 and You
description: Very funny, very short and very sweet text adventure game about Chub, Color, 23 and You.

title: Metropocre
description: Felix is an ordinary rabbit trying to get a brand new pair of wings. To accomplish that, he must go through a bloody and unusual adventure.

title: Europa Universalis IV: National Monuments II
description: This pack adds new graphical national monuments to the already stunning Europa Universalis IV map.Hagia SophiaThe Hagia Sophia traces its origins to the year 4th century, with the current structure being constructed in the 6th century.

title: Kselebox
description: Kselebox is a sandbox game, which means you can do whatever you want in it! You can build a rocket and go to explore the vastness of space. Or maybe you want to build a huge car? No problem! Players can save their buildings and then publish them to the Steam Workshop.

title: Chronicle of Ekan
description: Chronicle of Ekan is a shareware RPG with Final Fantasy-esque gameplay (turn-based combat). It features an emotive science fantasy storyline and an interesting card magic system.

title: Citadel of the Dead
description: A first person dungeon crawler and re-release of the dungeon RPG DragonBlade.

title: Classic Cribbage
description: Cribbage is a card game with a pinch of board game. Freeverse have dressed it up with a roaring 20s look.

title: Country House
description:
COUNTRY HOUSE is illustrated, interactive fiction. The environment and characters are - on the whole - historically credible. They didn't exist in eighteenth century Sweden, but they could have.

You are not out to collect swords to kill monsters or to search for keys to unlock doors. There will be a few ghosts and some supernatural events here. But you won't risk your life, neither by hunger nor thirst. A fall through a window won't hurt you much. You can study a map whenever you like, but it will reveal no secrets. Your task is to gather information, to do historical research.

title: Heed
description: An encounter with a strange spirit and an even stranger fly leave a traveler with questions about purpose, fate and the source. Follow this traveler as they seek to find something more from their life and find their true purpose.

title: Hjarta
description: Hjarta is the Norse word for "heart". It is a collection of short stories and a point and click adventure game. It is set in a futuristic world and has three chapters, which you can play in any order you want.

title: How They Found Silence
description:
I am the last of the treasure hunters.

I've spent my whole life finding treasure: not boring ordinary treasure, real treasure, under mountains, in dark jungles, at the very ends of the earth. You'd think I'd be rich, but I'm not. It usually gets taken away. Museums get rich. I don't. I just keep going. It's all I really love.

Not long ago I got an unusual call. Most people don't know I exist, except government interferers and museum curators, and a few real die hards of treasure hunting who wish the good old days would come back. They won't. But I digress. I got a call from a man called Lord Fern, asking me to find a something for him. It's not something I ever do, find things for other people, but I've been getting bored and tired with my usual expeditions, and besides I haven't been on a usual expedition for over a year now. I'm beginning to fear that there isn't anything left for me to find.

So I accepted.

title: Airwave: I Fought the Law and the Law One
description: Elodie Major has been running a little indie radio station called Airwave Radio with her friend Zak for 5 years now, and they've manage to win a strong following amongst the people of the small town of Wave. Recently, however, they've found themselves under pressure from mainstream record labels to play their music, and have resisted quite forcefully, but they haven't seen an end to this attempted interference just yet... This is the first part in the ~airwave~ series of games.

title: Jacqueline White: Bad Trouble in the Red Desert
description: In the 1920's Jacqueline White, aviatrix and adventuress, is hired by the Two Bad Pennies Movie Studio. Soon mysterious things starts to happen.

title: Jessica Plunkenstein and the Dusseldorf Conspiracy
description:
It's been a peculiar day for Jessica Plunkenstein. By a freak twist of fate and airline security, our heroine finds herself battling evil barons bent on world domination, evil headmistresses bent on pathological propriety, and evil yodelers bent on nothing in particular. Full of llamas, ninjas, French people, pickled herring, dubious German accents, yetis in heat, and musical theatre up the wazoo, Jessica's adventures bring her from the Amazonian Rain Forests to the Norwegian Alps with layovers along the Eastern seaboard. So tag along, and you, too, can unravel The Düsseldorf Conspiracy in what the New York Times calls the Best Adventure Game of 2005!

Features:

* Zany intercontinental escapades with absolutely no mammoths or talking robots

* Eight hours of addicting gameplay, divided over four parts and fifty unique locations

* Full score and professional voice acting

* Writing that would put James Joyce, Jane Austen, and Anton Chekov to shame

* Art that would put them to suicide

title: Beyond Contact
description:
Beyond Contact is a fiercely formidable survival game, inspired by the art and style of pulp science-fiction comics, the moral dilemmas of contemporary science-fiction films, and the unforgiving gameplay of survival genre classics.

Taking place on the often mysterious and always deadly, procedurally-generated, alien world of Ketern, Beyond Contact features exploration and discovery, a robust system of research and crafting, intuitive base building and defense, farming and creature feeding, narrative-driven objectives to save the inhabitants of the planet, and enough flora, fauna, extreme weather, and environmental hazards to kill even the toughest players 1000 times over... and trust us if the planet gets the chance, it will.

title: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars
description: Embark on a journey full of danger in this action RPG, inspired by Greek and Roman mythologies. Explore the breathtaking city of Aphes and forge your way through legions of unique foes and mythical bosses to discover the truth behind the city’s curse.

title: Bassmaster Fishing 2022
description: Bassmaster Fishing 2022, the official video game is coming this Fall, bringing the thrill of competitive big bass fishing to PC. Dive into the fully licensed content from the Bassmaster series from amateur to elite events.

title: Dreams of Being
description: An Exploration Through A Dream Journal

title: Courage: The Videogame
description: Fan horror ARG game based on the cartoon "Courage the Cowardly Dog"

title: Peppered: An Existential Platformer
description:
A light hearted 2D platformer about the meaningless of existence. Dark humour. Big focus on narrative-driven gameplay. Regret. Currently being developed for PC and Mac.
You play as a nameless civilian of an immortal world an hour before a return of the God of death. Life presents you with an opportunity to take this matter into your own hands. And then presents you with countless ways to fail spectacularly.

title: Azazel
description: A roguelike about goats, sin, and the Book of Leviticus

title: Corpse Party D2: Depths of Despair
description: Corpse Party D2: Depths of Despair is an RPG Maker VX Ace game based on the original NEC PC-9801 version of CORPSE-PARTY featuring influences and designs from Corpse Party for the PlayStation Portable. The game was written by Jackkel Dragon and illustrated by Hiragi-HOUX, and was released on November 15, 2013. It is known under the abbreviation CPD2.

title: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands: Next Level Edition
description:
Embark on an adventure full of whimsy, wonder, and high-powered weaponry! Roll your own multiclass hero then shoot, loot, slash, and cast on a quest to stop the Dragon Lord.

This Edition Includes:
-Full Game
-Optimized for Xbox Series X|S
-Dragon Lord Pack

title: Zoo Explorers
description: Join Splash the Penguin, Hedda Feathers, Gilda Gorgeous and all the characters of Zoo Explorers for hours of fun and learning.

title: Total War: Warhammer - Dark Gods Edition
description: This edition includes three race packs (along with unique Legendary Lords and gameplay mechanics), new artwork, and a free Warhammer ebook.

title: My Universe: My Baby - New Edition
description:
New Edition content:
My Baby first edition on Switch stopped when your baby was 24 months old. Now you can keep raising your baby up to 3 years old!

title: Beyond A Steel Sky: Utopia Edition
description:
The Utopia Edition includes:
- Game: Beyond a Steel Sky
- Steel book
- Stickers
- Original Digital Soundtrack
- Exclusive Hologram Lamp
- 50 Page Mini Artbook
- Enamel Pin
- Exchangeable Dog Tags (Keychain & Necklace)
- 5 Holo-ad-Cards
- 2 XXL Premium Stickers
- Unique Collector's Box

title: Treasures of the Aegean: Collector's Edition
description:

description: It’s Kuma Bear’s anniversary with his girlfriend, Cinnamon Bear. He is hoping to surprise her on their anniversary with a small present, but doesn’t have anything to give to her yet. Help Kuma Bear find something nice to give to Cinnamon Bear, and a way to surprise her with it. Kuma Story was originally created as an anniversary gift from SpacePirateCaine to his girlfriend for their 3-year anniversary. She enjoyed it very much, and asked that it be continued, and shared with the rest of the world. Please note that what little text there is in the game is generally in Japanese. There is nothing specifically important written at any point as Kuma Story is intended to be a short, mostly textless adventure game, playable and accessible by anybody in any language.

description: A mysterious guest is coming to the Salach Village. The Inquisitor DLC includes new game mechanic, new story and gameplay adjustment for My Lovely Daughter.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Lincoln
description: The level-80 sense of purpose helped him to reach incredible heights. He is ready to share it with you. Pinch off just a small piece and you will become a great president ... that is a monopolist. And Uncle Abe's inheritance of 100 gold, 50.000 chips and the legendary dice will help to establish yourself in your new status.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Napoleon
description: He majestically walks over conquered lands. He holds his head proudly. He directs his victorious gaze towards new territories. He sets the goal. He reaches one. His main gift to you is a sense of distinctiveness. You'll also get 100 gold and 50,000 chips.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Cleopatra
description: Brush up your leopard grace, get the gold of all the desert sands and the greatness of the sun as a bonus. It's Cleopatra! The great queen of Egypt is ready to give you the vacant seat of her favorite cat. Together you will bring everyone to their knees within a radius of the Business Tour.

title: Business Tour: Crazy Heroes - Wild bird
description: Behold the superman, superpigeon, superpostman! And yeah, he can never have enough "super". He is a real superguy! Long time ago when he was a little kid he found his true calling. He delivers parcels at the speed of light anywhere in the world! But not exactly at the speed of light, because he isn't a very good pilot.

title: Business Tour: Football - Forward Number 10
description: It is so hard for one to pretend to be a normal man, and those wings under one's shirt are not making it any better. But he has to be patient if he wants to play. And he loves to play so much! He may lend you his nimbus, if you want it.

title: Business Tour: Football - Forward Number 7
description: Victory is always around you! Guru of motivation will explain to you why fortitude and self-improvement are important. He will teach you how to turn on your handsome-man mode, and how to go only forward to victory! And of course your self-confidence will grow. Dice, 100 gold and 50.000 chips will only contribute to this.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - King
description: Everyone has a dream. Someone wants a castle made of cotton candy, someone wants to rule the world, and someone wants to build a super-mega monopoly! But often dreams are just dreams... That's when Martin Luther King comes to your rescue! Should you follow him and he will lead to the fulfillment of all your plans for sure.

title: Business Tour: Great Leaders - Caesar
description: This time-management genius can teach you how to plan out your day. Only with him, last on the agenda is always victory over your enemies. For added confidence in your success, the indestructible Caesar pack includes 100 gold, 50,000 chips and his legendary dice. Ave, Caesar!

title: Business Tour: Crazy Heroes - Rainbow Mercenary
description: Do you like to dream, have your head in the clouds, build sweet castles in the air, and ride the rainbow? He definitely doesn't like it. At all! He isn't an ordinary unicorn. He didn't get rose-colored glasses at birth.

title: Broken World
description: "Broken World" is an exciting post-apocalyptic low-poly game where players have to survive in a world overrun by zombies and chaos. Build and strengthen your shelters, fight various threats and explore a dangerous world full of secrets and dangers.

title: Amaranto
description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world divided into districts, Mio and her childhood friend Shizuku hears strange rumors at school about "vampiric" murders. Who is the culprit, and how does it tie to that mysterious girl in white?

title: Fukawa-chan
description: This is a fangame about one of the protagonists of the Danganronpa series. Touko Fukawa doesn't have a fun life. In fact, she has a pretty miserable one. Between bullying, self-loathing, and mental illness, an average day in Touko's life is very painful. And today, you get to follow her through it.

title: Crave
description: Ceaseless hunger draws you yet a bit closer to the gates of Foghorn. Devour men and beasts alike to acquire a wide array of combat abilities. Through shadows and mold, track down the paling memories of this bygone kingdom, all in a classic hand-drawn action platformer.

title: SpellForce III: Reforced
description: SpellForce III Reforced is a unique mix of an epic RPG storyline blended with accessible real-time strategy elements, designed to offer a riveting console experience to fans and newcomers alike.

title: Guy: By Hook or by Crook
description: Guide Guy through his day, first by finding what to do, then hopefully and ultimately achieve the goal, by any mean necessary!

title: Linn the Protector and the Seven Daughters of Ran
description:
Linn, hand maiden of Lady Frigg, must protect Eric - the son of the Jarl of North Anglia-, from being drowned by the seven daughters of Ran.

And then she must face Ran herself.

title: Motivational Hero
description: Motivational Hero is a Emotional and Motivational Puzzle-Platformer 2d with levels based in Motivational Analogies

title: Bright Lights of Svetlov
description: Bright Lights of Svetlov is a short, story-focused first person quest about a Soviet family facing harsh trials. Set in a fictional provincial town, it carefuly recreates the atmosphere and vibe of mid 1980s.

title: Into the Metaverse: Theme Park Dark Ride Experience
description: Into the Metaverse is a VR Dark Ride Pilot about humanity's quest for ever deeper immersion showing scenes from the past, present and future. VR may be the ultimate Dark Ride tech. This is a 10 minute polished Dark Ride "Pilot" that will leave you wanting more.

title: Tower of Magic
description: Randomly generated Magic Tower dungeons A strategy-based fixed-value Roguelike RPG

title: Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle
description: “Lethal Gamble 1 Werewolf Puzzle”is a suspense reasoning emotional work based on werewolf killing rules.A group of college students accidentally came to a mysterious villa. They wanted to play a game of werewolf killing.You have only five days left to refute the truth.

title: Beauty vs. Robot
description: "Beautiful Girl vs Mecha" is a card RPG game with the theme of the future eschatology. Players will be transformed into army commanders, and they will fight through card battles by means of instant battles and four different occupations.

title: Zee.End
description: A secret organization makes a critical mistake in the development of chemical weapons. As a result, the entire population of the Montib island is infected with an unknown virus. You need to survive among zombies on a huge 20x20 km map.

title: Night of the Meteor
description:
'Night of the Meteor' is a non commercial Fan-Adventure in development.

"Ah! An unwelcome visitor!
How silly of me, I should have tied you to my bed!"
That's how Edna Edison (a nurse who's as nasty as she is ugly) used to greet the male visitors, which were unmindfull enough to enter the old Victorian mansion, built on the outskirts of town, where a meteor has crashed over 20 years ago.

Nothing has changed since then. Her husband, Dr.Fred still wasn't at dinner for the past five years and their son, Weird Ed a paramilitary nut is still waiting for his commando package.

So, every time when you play this game, it'll be The Night of the Meteor!

title: Loftus and the Sky Cap
description: Inessa is woken by the smell of smoke. She races down the stair case to discover the workshop torched and no trace of her Master Loftus. The townsfolk are convinced that a dragon must be responsible or that the crazy inventor must simply have blown himself up- but Inessa believes otherwise.

title: Crossfire II
description: Crossfire II is an Retro / Arcade / Top-Down Shooter, originally released in 2002 for the AMIGA. The main part of the game is a classic, fast paced, single player story campaign. Fly different space ships and fight, to save the universe as you know it. Also you get a survival and a local PvP mode.

title: Apex Legends: Bangalore Edition
description:
Includes:

- Exclusive Legendary “Super Soldier" Bangalore Skin
- Exclusive Legendary "Trusty Sidekick" G7 Skin
- Exclusive "Mark of a Hero" Gun Charm
- Exclusive "Striker" Badge
- 1000 Apex Coins

title: Perfect Crime: Collector's Death
description: Love and hate between a collector and several ghostly visitors.

title: Ashes of the Singularity: Escalation - Juggernaut
description: Pummel your enemies into submission with brand new, heavy-hitting Juggernauts! These massive warships may be expensive to make, but they have the potential to dominate the battlefield and turn the tide of a war quickly.

title: Voltage: Episode 2
description: In Episode 2, you try to bring freedom to Voltage and fight against evil forces as you traverse the Voltage Town, Red Forest and many other areas. Your mission is to find resistance scientists, together you might be able to bring peace to the Voltage.

title: Professor Crackbrain: And the Awakening of the Weredog
description: Professor Crackbrain - and the awakening of the weredog is a classic point & click adventure game full of nostalgic allusions, pixelish puzzles and chiptunish music.

title: Tekling 2: Overdrive
description: Suit up and Boot up! Tekling is back in an all new adventure as you battle your way to defeat robots from taking over the world! Wear new suits and use new abilities to stop the robot uprising once and for all!

title: World War Academy: Commander 1
description: The Alliance Army and the Group Army have almost officially broken up, and the war is imminent. I was ordered to come to the Central South Theater command, and that's where the story begins...

title: Ship Surveyor Through the Ages: VR
description: The Lloyd's Register Foundation Heritage & Education Centre is proud to introduce our unique VR experience, set across three different time periods. You take on the role of surveyor, tasked with tracking down and investigating hazards and faults on board three ships throughout history.

title: Breach: Veil Demon DLC
description: Every session is different in Breach with a new type of enemy: The Veil Demon. The Veil Demon Pack is the perfect complement for the demon inside of you.

title: Bunker
description: You have to visit an abandoned bunker and find mysterious artifacts in a limited time, your flashlight charge will not last long and staying in such a place in complete darkness will mean certain death

title: Five Nights at F***boy's 2: Final Mix
description:
Five Nights at F***boy’s 2 is a FNaF fangame and sequel to surprise hit Five Nights at F***boy's created by Sable Lynn and Joshua Shaw in RPG Maker VX Ace.

This version includes the Final Mix: Game of the Year content, including the elusive Afterstory.

title: Lost Valley
description: Lost Valley is an excellent freeware action-oriented RPG that offers over 25 hours of gameplay, a lot of neat weapons and magic items, and smooth animations.

title: Death Blade
description:
Your name is Corwin Ironfist. You are part of the city guard, trapped in an underground complex of a city in grave danger. Due to a mishap very early in the morning, you have no sword and no armor. You have reason to believe that whatever is plaguing the city, is located in this complex. You take a deep breath and move forward, to whatever awaits.

Death Blade is a role playing game designed for the Macintosh. It's interface has been designed to be easy to use and quick to access. This is especially important since combat is real-time (well sorta).

Death Blade is not overly complex as some roleplaying games are. It has been designed to allow even younger adventurers to take part in the quest. While the interface is simple enough for younger users, the graphics and game play should be a challenge for experienced players as well.

There are sixteen levels to Death Blade. Each level poses a different problem that you have to solve. Some levels require a strong sword, while others require a systematic mind.

Research with the game and see if you can discover ways of being more effective. For example, the creatures always attack immediately following their movement phase. It is impossible for you to land an attack before a creature when the creature has just moved forward. However, if you time your movements, you can move forward and attack him before he can advance. It takes practice.

Good luck.

title: Defender of the Crown: Digitally Remastered Edition
description:
This edition is the first release of Defender of the Crown for Windows / Macintosh and it is a remake of the original game. This digitally remastered edition features enhanced graphics and sound, and additional material.

Years later, an original version of the game with original graphics and sounds was also released for Windows, which makes this a remake and a separate game to the regular port of the original MS-DOS version to Windows.

title: Desert Trek
description: The sequel to Camel. Can you make it across the entire desert, keeping one step ahead of the cannibals?

title: Dracula's Castle
description: Duke Nukem gets shot down by a Science experiment gone wrong near Dracula's Castle - get in and make the bastards pay for rising your flight insurance premium yet again.

title: Eric's Ultimate Solitaire
description: A collection of many popular and not-so-popular solo card games. This is more than just a solitaire game, with detailed images, and event-based sounds. The player can choose from 23 different games, and keep information on game play (success, failure, speed).

title: Eternity Inn
description: It's easy to check in, but you can't check out until you've outwitted the innkeeper by solving the puzzles in your room to find the hidden exit! This is a challenging game we've created for puzzle-lovers. Eternity Inn is a freeware game - no registration necessary - and is freely distributable.

title: Dire Vengeance
description: Pandora ventures into the Dark Realm to slay the demons who threaten her world. Collect Soul Orbs to upgrade your abilities and uncover arcane weaponry. Slash your way through frozen wastelands, lava filled chambers, and caverns of putrefying flesh as you slaughter hordes of condemned monstrosities.

title: Lunatic Dawn: Book of Futures
description: Lunatic Dawn - Book of Futures is an RPG Windows PC game released by Artdink. You can be a hero or a villain depending on what tasks you wish to undertake. You can also smuggle, kidnap, assassinate, rescue, kill monsters, deliver items, and more. The game offers non-linear game-play where you can roam as you please in a randomly generated world with each game-play. The game also has Medieval Japan, Arabian, and Medieval European styled environments where you can start from or travel to. You can also recruit your own party members from each area as you wish also. If you are looking for a different type of RPG where you can play as you want, this is a must try.

title: Maverick Gunn and the Eye of Oggun
description: You are Maverick Gunn, treasure hunter and renegade History teacher. You start the morning at home as usual and after a few minutes of conversation with a mysterious and dangerous looking man, you are drawn into the chase for a huge diamond...and face to face with an ancient mystery.

title: Memories Fade
description: Made for MAGS February 2017, with the theme "As Time Goes By". After the loss of his beloved wife, an old man seems to be forgetting her. With the help of an old photo, can his son remind him of the good times they once had?

title: Minifeg: The Search
description: In the search for his father, our hero, Minifeg, gets stuck in time when his newly built machine does not work as expected. Now he must also find out how to return home.

title: Money Mansion
description:
This is Episode 100 of the Maniac Mansion Mania series.
It could also be played without knowing any other episode.

As Fred and Edna come back after a journey, they have to notice that
their house is on sale at Stan's. To buy it back they need one million
dollars.
Fortunately, Fred's uncle Edenezer is that rich he wouldn't mind lending them the money. Or isn't it?

- 3 playable characters with individual abilities
- a huge and completely new location
- countless references to Maniac Mansion, other episodes, other games, movies, series, music and much more.

title: My Father's Secret
description: Your father abandoned you as a child. After many years of searching, you have tracked down where he lives. What awaits you in this mysterious house on the hill?

title: Q1K3
description: An homage to Quake in 13kb of JavaScript.

title: Evan Quest
description: EVAN QUEST - Bad Dudes have taken over New York City. The DoD sends in Evan Quest to stop them. Save the Hostages and clear the Bad Dudes from several progressively challenging levels.

title: Hide Seek Survive
description: Experience true horror as you move from room to room, looking for a doll that can get you out of the most dangerous game of hide and seek ever played. Be careful though because there is something in the house looking for you as well...

title: Chicken Duty
description: You've agreed to watch over the neighbor's chicken while they're away, and now you must lead it to safety as quick as possible!

title: Where's My Lunch?!
description: Where's My Lunch?! is an action stealth adventure game, with the quest of finding your lunch during the zombie apocalypse. Use impromptu weapons such as rakes, vacuums, wax machines, good ole Sally, and more! Set up zombies in environmental traps to help you move closer to your glorious lunch.

title: Piggy: Hunt
description: Piggy: Hunt is a fast-paced survival horror multiplayer game. Survivors must work together to survive and escape from the Infected.

title: YouRiding: Surfing and Bodyboarding Game
description: A realistic surfing and bodyboarding game. Play for the top spot of the ranking at real spots like Kirra in Australia or Supertubes in Portugal, create your own waves and share them to the community, or play against other players in 16 surfers bracket competitions.

title: Sexcraft: Sofiya and the Lewd Clan
description: Play as Sofiya, Defeat monsters, Become a powerful witch and Have sex along the way. Can you beat her old master?

title: Squad: Canadian Armed Forces
description: A new battlefield for SquadThe Canadian Armed Forces DLC is free for all owners of Squad and is an all new faction developed by community members together with Offworld Industries. Featuring two new maps on the North American continent, three new vehicles and completely custom and hand crafted character models it will add a complete new...

title: Spooky Night: Remastered
description: Grimelda is still at it but with some new tricks and treats in store! Spooky Night Remastered is a Casual Fantasy FPS for the whole family We have overhauled and updated the original Spooky Night VR game also available for the Oculus Quest.

title: Combat Mission Shock Force 2: NATO Forces
description: NATO Forces is the third module in the Combat Mission: Shock Force family of contemporary land warfare simulations. Now you have a chance to play with the forces of three additional NATO countries; Germany, Canada, and the Netherlands.

title: Heroes of Dungeon
description: Heroes of Dungeon-a Game based on the mechanics of " 3 in a row" Features Fun and memorable graphics Epic music A wide variety of enemies

title: Mei Qi: Season 6
description: The sixth season of "Mei qi" series contains a total of 6 DLCs, which will be updated one after another. The update cycle is one DLC every 2 weeks.

title: Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire: Blue
description: More Pretty Girls!! Can you solve the puzzle? Find pairs of tiles to delete them. Delete all tiles before time runs out to clear a round. Once you make it to the third round a girl in a sexy costume begins to reveal herself as you delete tiles... As you clear stages, the girls get sexier and sexier!

title: Gubble
description: Gubble is a puzzle game where your goal is to unscrew all the screws on each level in order to win.

title: Anarchy Legends: Online
description: Anarchy Legends Online is a multiplayer tactical action third-person shooter inspired by old competitive multiplayer games focusing on team-based tactics and real individual skills.

title: The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I
description: Let's the show begin! The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I is a prologue of "The Last Show of Mr. Chardish" full game. Together with the Actress Ella, embark on a journey through the past and discover the secrets left by the brilliant Director in his magical performances.

title: Jumping Joe! Friends Edition
description: Jump right into the action in this jolly pick ‘n play platformer. An Indie action game perfect for intense playtimes with your friends and family. Help Joe and his fellas on their upwards journey. Be quick as a flash and dodge roaring cannonballs, vicious bats and other traps.

title: Command Ops 2: Bastogne Vol. 4
description: Bastogne contains 12 scenarios covering the southern shoulder of the 1944 Battle of the Bulge.

title: Welcome to... Chichester 2: Part II - No Extra Regrets For the Future
description: Grendel Jinx is in danger of having to repeat a school year. Refusing to allow this to happen, she enlists the services of the protagonist - her newly found "Best Friend" - and is promptly rebuffed. Grendels drastic actions soon catches the attention of her mother.

title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth3: V Generation - Mini Island
description: Mini Island DLC introduces an island dungeon filled with miniature monsters, but with more experience points to gain!

title: Paper Dolls 2: Escape
description: Ghosts and spirits will prowl the mansion on All Hallows' Eve! Within the new game mode you will act as an exorcist, slaying spirits aplenty! Make sure to explode each wine jar at the opportune moment to blow up as many enemies as possible.

title: Antigraviator: Viper Trails
description: This DLC introduces you to some very exciting new race tracks built in the forest of the Orval planet system, known as the Viper Trails. Strap yourself into your new Venom Class Grav and be the victor!

title: Horizon Chase Turbo: Summer Vibes
description: Summer Vibes is HORIZON CHASE TURBO first DLC. Featuring the most classic arcades roadster, you'll love to put your sunglasses and feel every mile of this warm coast to coast experience.

title: Horizon Chase Turbo: Rookie Series
description: A new campaign tailored for new players. Bring your friends and family together into ROOKIE SERIES!

title: City of God I: Prison Empire - Outrage
description: Outrage have 5 new gangster persioner into your prison.

title: Beyond the Thaw
description: You are a Max Gilbert, a former military doctor. While taking a trip to your usual place of stay, the next moment you find yourself alone in the middle of nowhere, fighting fierce cold and facing series of trials. What is it: reality or mind games, behind which lies your deep secret?

title: How to Survive: Barricade!
description: So, you decided to settle down did you?That’s great but let’s see how long can you survive...Spend your days searching for resources and materials to create obstacles, barricades and traps to defend the occupants of your camp from the hordes of night flesh-hungry monsters.Learn to craft obstacles, barricades and traps!

title: For Honor: Warmonger Hero
description: Prey on the weak as a Warmonger, new playable Hero. Strike and impale with the Flamberge, a legendary two-handed sword!

title: For Honor: Kyoshin Hero
description: Become a Kyoshin, a mystical Samurai whose elegance and prowess will leave everyone in awe on the battlefield.

title: For Honor: Gryphon Hero
description: A well-known veteran has returned! Wield the mighty Bardiche as Gryphon, a new playable hero.

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: World Wonder Ring Stardom Collaboration
description: Stardom, Japan's leading women's professional wrestling promotion, join the Fire Pro ring with 10 new wrestlers, including their signature moves, costumes, entrance themes, and voices! Believe now, shine tomorrow! We are stardom!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Yoshihiro Takayama Charity DLC Part 2
description: Add rings, logos and T-shirts representing legendary Japanese pro-wrestler and MMA combatant Yoshihiro Takayama with this Edit Part DLC.

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Fighting Road - Champion Road Beyond
description:
Wrestler Morio Sumisu’s life ended in tragedy at the height of his career. Now his son has set out on the same path of glory, but can he find a way to the top without following in his father’s haunted footsteps?

Scenario writer SUDA51 returns to the Fire Pro ring for the sequel to his infamous Champion Road scenario that launched his career 26 years ago.

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Entrance Craft
description: Set the tone of the match before you even step in the ring with this entrance sequence editor! Customize your entrance outfit, pre-match taunts, venue lighting and effects, and more!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: World Wonder Ring Stardom Collaboration Part 2
description: Stardom, Japan's leading women's professional wrestling promotion, are back with 11 new wrestlers, including their signature moves, costumes, entrance themes, and voices!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: Fighting Road - 2017 NJPW Junior Heavyweight Championship
description: You never forgot the excitement you felt when your father showed you your first junior heavyweight match... Now you step into the NJPW dojo to realize your childhood dream of becoming the best junior heavyweight the world has ever seen!

title: Fire Pro Wrestling World: New Japan Pro-Wrestling Collaboration
description: NJPW, Japan’s premiere pro-wrestling promotion, joins the roster! Battle alongside and against your favorites in the all-new Fighting Road scenario mode.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Where the Cat and Wolf Play...'
description:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest "Where the Cat and Wolf Play..." is a free DLC quest released in July 2015. In this quest, Geralt investigates a village whose inhabitants have been mysteriously killed. The story centers on a confrontation with a Witcher from the School of the Cat and introduces choices that affect the outcome of the mission.

It adds a new standalone side quest with unique dialogue, a new location, and narrative ties to the broader Witcher lore.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Fool's Gold'
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Fool's Gold' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red on June 3, 2015. In this humorous side quest, Geralt teams up with a character named Hystian to investigate a seemingly cursed village inhabited by pigs.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners'
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red in May 2015. In this contract, Geralt investigates the disappearance of miners near the village of Blandare in Skellige.

title: Wargame: Red Dragon - Norse Dragons
description: Norse Dragons is the third free DLC for Wargame: Red Dragon. Dedicated to the Scandinavian coalition, it features more than 60 new units for Sweden, Denmark & Norway. Effectively propelling this coalition as well as the individual countries into the early 90's era, it will bring them onto an equal footing with the other nations.

title: Wargame: Red Dragon - Second Korean War
description: Second Korean War is Wargame: Red Dragon’s second free DLC. It features a new solo campaign, set in an uchronical 1992 where the previous year's coup against Mikhaïl Gorbatchev has succeeded. The Party's old guard has restored Soviet order, getting closer to its Asian communist neighbors in the process, but is set on a confrontation..

title: Wargame: Red Dragon - The Millionth Mile
description: The Millionth Mile is the first free DLC for Wargame: Red Dragon. Focusing on the Eastern Bloc coalition, it will feature more than 60 new units for Poland, Czechoslovakia & East-Germany, bringing them in the 90's and on an equal footing with Wargame: Red Dragon's main nations.

title: Kalpa
description: A next-generation rhythm game where story and music intertwine. Enjoy a tracklist filled with famous licensed songs and exclusive original songs made by renowned composers Discover an immersive story, and face endless challenges. Your performance will dictate the fate of the world.

title: Snake
description: The classic and pure Snake game.

title: Raindrops
description: Raindrops is a stereo rhythm game, played with your mouse. Notes will be poured from both sides, and the sound will wave towards the direction of succesful hits. Move your mouse, click with both buttons, even scroll to take care of these notes.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Williams
description: Located in California, Lake Williams is surrounded by a stunning backdrop of dry arid land and forest-covered steep hills.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lough Kerr
description: Lough Kerr is a perfectly formed, historic venue found in Ireland where anglers flock to try and catch a national bream record with the biggest being an incredible 21lbs. The lough also contains good sized carp, tench, roach and rudd.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Dylan
description: Located in Minnesota, Lake Dylan is over 2000 acres with 11 different species of fish to target. As well as containing trophy sized bass, this lake also contains giant Muskie, Tiger Muskie and Longnose Gar with the Muskie growing to a huge 53lbs.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Jezioro Bestii
description: Jezioro Bestii or ‘Lake of the Beast’, a scenic lake in the mountains of Poland, is famous for its predators including pike to over 50lbs, zander to over 20lbs and catfish to 85lbs. With 13 different species to catch and 25 boss fish to successfully land, this lake will be a unique challenge.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Talon Fishery
description: Talon Fishery is the epitome of a pleasure fishing complex and gives you four separate lakes in one venue. Each contain their own stock of fish and species and are perfect for honing your match and float fishing skills.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lago Del Mundo
description: Based in Andalucia, Spain, Lago del mundo (Lake of the World) is the first venue to offer fishing from static pegs around the lake as well as from a brand-new rigid inflatable boat. With catfish to 200lbs, huge largemouth (black bass), carp, pike, zander and roach, there is something for everyone!

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Laguna Iquitos
description: Laguna Iquitos, in the heart of the rainforests of Peru adds two new species of fish - the beautiful peacock bass and terrifying giant wolf fish as well as a new style of boat, a kayak. Also catch huge arapaima, black pacu and red tail catfish.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Arnold
description: The habitation around Lake Arnold in Tennessee provides a range of fishing opportunities for the ten different species found here.

title: Fishing Sim World: Bass Pro Shops Edition
description: Fully endorsed by Bass Pro Shops and featuring an array of your favourite Bass Pro Shops equipment. Choose from 8 glorious US locations from Fishing Sim World and compete in career mode or play your way in multiplayer. An underwater camera will allow you to see the moment the fish strikes lure!

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Lake Nelson
description: Lake Nelson is a picturesque fishing venue located in the heart of Texas. Fish for 15 different species including bass to 15lbs, as well as enter three different tournaments and three new career events with 25 new Boss Fish to hunt down and catch.

title: The Black Watchmen: Alone in the Dark Web
description: In the Alone in the Dark Web DLC, you'll need to complete an all new in-client mission that brings you to the brink of the dark web - and insanity. Investigate the hidden secrets behind an occult website to discover the ultimate truths.

title: The Black Watchmen: Mother Russia
description: In the Mother Russia DLC, you'll need to complete an all new in-client mission set that brings you through the cold case files of Agent Msika and the circumstances surrounding her disappearance. Investigate the dark truths behind secret Soviet weapons programs and their modern day counterparts.

title: The Black Watchmen: Whitechapel
description: Rumors have emerged suggesting the return of one of the Agency's most dangerous enemies. Where he goes, mayhem surely follows...

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Dead Ends
description: Step lively as more of Harry's friends join you in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! Includes two new character decks — JARED KINCAID and MORTIMER LINDQUIST — and two new book decks — CHANGES and GHOST STORY.

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Wardens Attack
description:
WE’VE GOT YOUR BACK!
The White Council’s grey cloaks, the Wardens, join the fray in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! This expansion includes two new character decks—Carlos Ramirez and Anastasia Luccio—and two new book decks—Small Favor and Turn Coat.

title: Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Ra Crossover
description:

The Crypt of the Ancients was built 500 years ago, with the finality of offering a place for rest to the Ancients, who are the supposed creators of the world, and no one, but two exceptions, got to come out of it alive. For centuries, many would-be heroes tried to uncover these secrets with no success, because the powerful spirits living inside the crypt ended the lives of those who try to defy them. To warn the incautious people who feel with strength, capacity and courage to assume the challenge of Alaric, it emerges the spirit of Jetraal the Heroic, who died three centuries ago in mysterious circumstances and was the other one who escaped alive from this restless place. His mission is to warn any person who tries to assume the risk that it is an adventure sentenced to failure in advance, as well as to annul the malicious instincts of Alaric.

"Ancient Evil" is a 3D role playing game that uses high resolution graphics in a completely interactive environment, which provides it intensity and helps to wrap the player immediately. The people who plays this game introduce themselves into a story of magicians, mystic arts and illusions where there´s no lack of hand to hand combats and incantations.

description: These luxury family condos found in the Parkland District feature comfortable interiors with modern features while still having room for family. Feel like relaxing, the birds and city chatter ambiance with or without the background classical music playlist.

title: Ambient Channels: Terror Forest - Hell House
description: In the 'Terror Forest' series, a catastrophic nuclear event has caused a mass exodus from the surrounding area. In the 'Hell House' episode you come upon an abandoned house that's been reclaimed for use by an evil being to conduct torture and grotesque human experiments.

title: Ambient Channels: Abandoned Town - Farmhouse
description: In the 'Abandoned Town' series, a man-made environmental disaster has transformed a once quaint town into a ghost town. In the 'Farmhouse' episode you explore an abandoned farmhouse where the contents still remain but the people are long gone. Discover family belongings in the hidden objects game.

title: Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After - Episode 01 Remastered
description: The epic saga of Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After continues! In the aftermath of Operation Babylon, only a few inhabitable places remain on Earth. Follow the Japanese survivors in Seattle as they struggle to rebuild their lives — and defend themselves from the BETA.

title: Football, Tactics & Glory: Football Stars
description: New big mechanic: Giftedness, the ability to buy footballers from abroad, new personnel and infrastructure, a huge amount of statistics, animations of celebrations in the tournaments, new specialization tree: Energy, and many more improvements for you to discover...

title: First Hero: Epic of Gilgamesh
description: "First Hero" is a third person hack 'n' slash, based on the epic of Gilgamesh: the holdest in our history. With an enormous strenght, various weapons and combinations you'll face a lot of soldiers, beasts, traps, demons and even the gods, during your quest to become immortal.

title: Pathfinder Adventures: A Fighter's Tale - Valeros
description: Delve into five scenarios specifically tailored to the Iconic Valeros, 30 new cards, and introduces a new Fighter to the roster of playable characters: the gnome Tontelizi "Legbreaker", master of polearms.

title: Pathfinder Adventures: Rise of the Goblins Deck 2
description: The Rise of the Goblins takes place in an alternate version of the Rise of the Runelords, where the heroes are the Goblins and the villains are the heroes. This is a continuation of the story that follows immediately after the first series of five scenarios. Goblins Only!

title: Professional Farmer 2014: Good Ol' Times
description: 7 additional, historical Tractor models for Professional Farmer 2014:Friend 15FTorino Mk. 25Rainman Model 3Brownman 88Friend Bauer Oliveman Mk. 5FarmMaster 6x1

title: Hero Siege: Class - Shield Lancer
description: The Shield Lancer class

title: Gene Rain: Wind Tower - Sky City's Rebirth
description: "Sky City Rebirth" tells that Alex has fallen into an endless space after boarding the Sky City. The battle is endless, and the enemy's level will be higher and higher. You can get powerful weapons here. Every time you challenge through the reincarnation, you will Get a generous reward.

title: Gene Rain: Wind Tower - Way to Heaven
description: ‘Way To Heaven’ tells the story of the Human rebels army opening the passage to the Sky City. The new chapter tells Alex about the adventures in Oil City, and you will face new giant boss and new enemies.

title: Automobilista: Legendary Tracks Part 1 - Imola
description: Part 1 of Legendary Tracks has arrived - the classic Imola circuit from Italy, oozing history with 4 distinct versions from 4 different decades - 1972, 1988, 2001 and 2016.

title: Wargame: AirLand Battle - Magna Carta
description: Magna Carta for Wargame: AirLand Battle offers 12 new units (one per nation) and new large-scale multiplayer maps. Wargame AirLand Battle therefore has 7 new maps: Gjöll and Ásgard, 2 totally new maps specifically designed for the massive battles with 20 players, and 4 new additional maps for 1 vs 1 up to 3 vs 3 players.

title: Wargame: AirLand Battle - Vox Populi
description: Vox Populi, the first free DLC from Wargame AirLand Battle, has been developed specifically to respond to the demands of the community… and has just landed with a whole arsenal of new features! "Conquest" mode makes a great comeback in Multiplayer mode and against the AI, offering a range of new objectives to commanders all over the world.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Master Chicken and Li
description: This pack unlocks Master Chicken and Li as playable characters.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Kai and Master's Garden
description: This pack unlocks Kai as a playable character. It also unlocks the Master's Garden Level.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Warrior Po and Jombie Master Chicken
description: This pack unlocks Warrior Po as a playable character. It also comes with an alternate Jombie skin for Master Chicken.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends - Rhino Armor Li and Jombie Master Bear
description: This pack unlocks Rhino Armor Li as a playable character. It also comes with an alternate Jombie skin for Master Bear.

title: Euro Fishing: Manor Farm Lake
description: Manor Farm Lake is part of the famous Linear Fisheries complex and is a beautiful and picturesque venue. Don’t be fooled by the idyllic setting though, this 14 acre venue has hundreds of big, hard fighting Carp including many fish over 30lbs and several breaking the 40lb barrier, as well as specimen Roach, Tench, Bream and Catfish to...

title: Euro Fishing: Hunters Lake
description: This 8-acre lake is famed for its quality Roach fishing. The five islands situated around the lake and the number of overhanging trees provide plenty of features to try and help you land that monster 4lb specimen.

title: Euro Fishing: Bergsee
description: Bergsee (Mountain Lake) is found in the foothills of the Austrian mountains where the scenery is as spectacular as the fishing.

title: Euro Fishing: Lilies
description: Lilies is a 10 acre venue that is as beautiful as its residents and is named after the abundance of lilies on the surface of the lake. This venue is known for its big fish with Carp up to 50lbs and Catfish up to 100lbs.

title: Euro Fishing: Le Lac d'or
description: Le Lac d’or (The Golden Lake) is a 25 acre venue surrounded by woodland and nestled in the French countryside. This mature lake is an ideal holiday venue with three log cabins each with their own pegs accommodating up to 4 anglers for you to fish from.

title: Euro Fishing: Waldsee
description: Waldsee is an 10 acre venue hidden deep in the famous forests of Germany. An intimate venue with wooden platforms surrounding the lake but still plenty of different features to fish towards.

title: X-Morph: Defense - European Assault
description: This add-on includes a new story-driven mini-campaign happening on the European front. The action takes place parallel to the original story campaign. It focuses on European military forces trying to repel the X-Morph invasion.

title: X-Morph: Defense - Last Bastion
description: This add-on includes a new story-driven mini-campaign which takes the players to the most remote locations in the world, where the last humans have taken refuge. The events take place on 4 islands, each with unique features.

title: X-Morph: Defense - Survival of the Fittest
description: Fight an endless enemy assault throughout a new Survival campaign with 5 maps specifically crafted for this adrenaline pumping game mode.

title: Buzz Aldrin: Cycling Pathways to Mars
description: Buzz Aldrin wants to be remembered for more than just "kicking up moon dust." He wants his legacy to include laying the groundwork for a permanent human settlement on Mars, and he has a plan. As NASA prepares to send the first humans to Mars, 8i and Time Inc's LIFE VR have collaborated with the celebrated astronaut and...

title: Deltarune: Chapter 2
description:
Deltarune: Chapter 2 is the next installment of the sequel to beloved indie darling Undertale...in a different world! This time around, two more classmates join the protagonists in their adventure as they, too, discover a mysterious world hidden behind a door, called the "Cyber World".

Players with no save data will be able to start right at Chapter 2. “As long as you generally remember what happened story-wise, you’ll be fine,” the developers said in an FAQ.

title: Magical Drop CPC
description: A homebrew CPC conversion by Oscar Sanchez (aka Mochilote) of the 1995 classic from Data East

title: Garrison
description: Traverse a broken empire to help the people and learn the truth. Discover items and combine them in new ways to destroy obstacles or enemies as you explore both side-scrolling and top-down perspective areas. Set out on an action/adventure journey.

title: Girlfight 2024
description: GirlFight 2024 is the girl fighting game with physical effects that make realistic boobs movements and clothing destruction systems.

title: Chigau!!!+
description: Mirai Minato, a boy student who attends Mokuyo High School, is woken up by a noisy childhood friend who takes care of him as usual.

title: Grim Wanderings II
description: This game combines a deep role-playing system inspired by classic board games and a full-fledged 4X strategy

title: Cossacks 3: Summer Fair
description: Cossacks 3: Summer Fair introduces special seasonal event content to all our players.

title: Warlock II: The Exiled - Three Mighty Mages
description: This pack brings you three new exciting Great Mages to choose from in your fight for Ardania. Each mages comes with special faction perks.This pack includes:Chief Justice: The Chief Justice of Dauros Court already passed the sentence on the United One, and now joins the ranks of the Great Mages to personally see the sentence executed.

title: Kuukiyomi 1 2 3+
description:
Minna de Kuki Yomi. The world, this is Japan. Enjoy this bundle with three of the Kuukiyomi games, and see how considerate you can be!

Kuukiyomi 1 2 3+ includes:
- Kuukiyomi: Consider It!
- Kuukiyomi 2: Consider It More! - New Era
- Kuukiyomi 3: Consider It More and More!! - Father to Son

title: Hungry Horace
description: 8-bit hero Horace is often considered the unofficial mascot of the ZX Spectrum. In later years he’d go skiing and battle spiders, but the 1982 game Hungry Horace – now remastered on Steam for your gaming pleasure – saw him run around a maze eating flowers, ringing alarms and avoiding angry parkies.

title: Mirror: The Lost Shards
description: This DLC has 4 more characters, with better animation, more CGs and more enchanting stories!
