title: Sky Mirror: Strolling
description: Relax and stroll in this dreamland, get positive energy and avoid negative energy.

title: Legends of Aria: Citizen's Pass
description: Expand your sandbox with the Legends of Aria Citizen’s Pass, which grants you permanent citizenship to the world of Celador. Build a home, launch a player-run shop, unlock your bank’s full capacity, and more.

title: R.A.I.D
description: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 4-player co-op action.

title: Making History: The Great War - The Red Army
description: The first expansion to the acclaimed WWI strategy game Making History: The Great War takes the action into the turbulent period as the war is ending and empires are beginning to collapse. The Russians have already quit the war and fallen into civil war, and on the western front the final showdown is in progress.

title: Wax Museum: Seek and Find - Mystery Hidden Object Adventure
description: Enjoy the beautiful and extraordinary exhibits of the abandoned Wax Museum! Immerse yourself in a mystical detective story full of secrets and puzzles! The newest hidden object game.

title: Fortune's Tavern: The Fantasy Tavern Simulator - Guns and Goblins
description: Guns and Goblins brings two new things to the world of Fortune's Tavern: Guns and Goblins!

title: Retrold
description: In RETROLD you can play many games inspired by old arcades from 70`s, 80`s and even 90`s.

title: Endless Furry Clicker
description: Welcome to Endless Furry Clicker! The third installment of the "Endless Furry" Series! Just a basic clicker game. Click the Furry and stack your score!

title: Attack on Titan 2: Second Victory
description: A new episode "Second Victory" is added to the Daily Life section in "Story Mode", and to the "Scout Missions" in "Another Mode".

title: Oval Racer Series: Sandbox
description: HOME OF THE OVAL RACER Very First EVER dedicated pc game for UK oval racing Feel what it is like to get on one of the UK Oval Circuits in a Racecar

title: Carnage
description: Dive into exhilarating combat in this roguelite, top-down shooter where survival is key! Face relentless hordes of monstrous foes, and conquer epic boss battles. Play solo or team up in co-op to race against time and see if you have what it takes to survive this mayhem of blood butts and guts!

title: PlayZ
description: PlayZ is arcade-style singleplayer puzzle style game! You have different levels and at each level, you have different gameplay styles! The aim of the game is to finish as fast as you can.

title: Infinite Minigolf: Tortuga
description: Set sail to the lovely Caribbean pirate town of Tortuga and play along side a crazy cast of pirates as you embark on a new Infinite Minigolf adventure! Captain Salvador and his crew of buccaneers have many pirate inspired surprises while you play through the 108 holes across four brand new tournaments.

title: Infinite Minigolf: Hangar 37
description: Put on your space suits and prepare for landing in Hangar 37 on the Intergalactic Spaceport in this sci-fi Infinite Minigolf adventure! Meet a goofy team of aliens and robots who will help you complete four new and challenging courses, consisting 108 brand new minigolf holes.

title: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey - Heintz
description: This is an additional character for Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey. This will allow you to add "Heintz" to your party.

title: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey - Shanon
description: With this DLC you will be able to interact with the new character Shanon and a new outfit will become available to use under the Change Outfit option inside the Atelier. *You need to progress the story to the certain point to add Shanon to your party.

title: Home Designer: Home Sweet Home
description: Help Hazel redesign client homes in this fun Hidden Objects game, "Home Designer: Home Sweet Home".

title: Dark Cave
description: Dark Cave is a third person slasher action game set in a dark fantasy world. Built by one-man development studio Denoriks, powered by the Unreal Engine. Your enemies are ruthless, so survival requires the highest alertness and precision.

title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX - Extra Mission: "VS ???"
description: It's time for an eXtreme challenge! A new mission has been added that pits you against an incredibly powerful Blade. You may even get a small reward if you're victorious...

title: Fighting Fantasy Classics: Caverns of the Snow Witch
description: Deep within the Crystal Caves of the Icefinger Mountains, the dreaded Snow Witch is plotting to bring on a new ice age. A brave trapper dies in your arms and lays the burden of his mission on your shoulders But time is running out – will YOU take up the challenge?

title: Ggg Collection
description: Dodge others as a line, jump as high as you can as a jumper, dodge hornets as a frog, throw pizzas at shades as scaterboy, blow up obstacles as bombman and smile away your foes.

title: The Remainder: Act 1
description: The Remainder is a dark fantasy mystery where you will try to save The High Magus Vyn from certain death. Will you find your way alone or will you reignite a lost love? Is it worth the sacrifice? Do you deserve to be saved?

title: Teenage Blob: Paperperson - The First Single
description: Grab some sandwiches, get on your bike and hit the streets! Paperperson is the first single from the upcoming game/ album split-release Teenage Blob; a colourful art-punk adventure towards the best night of your life!

title: The Trap: Remastered
description: The game includes inside the Buzludzha Monument.

title: Portal Knights: Elves, Rogues, and Rifts
description: Travel to the mysterious moon, Faynore, and discover both a new class of Portal Knight – the rapscallion Rogues – AND a new, playable race of Elves! Corrupt forces from the Hollow Dimension plot Faynore’s demise through treacherous, “roguelite” Rifts – and an Elvish house divided could help them cause another Fracture.

title: Faircroft's Antiques: Treasures of Treffenburg
description: Dive into the world of art with Faircrofts Antiques! Join conservator Mia Faircroft as she explores the town of Treffenburg to find and restore priceless antiques. Tour Treffenburg through 20 beautiful hidden object scenes! Get to know the town's residents and find their connections to the past!

title: Puppy Cross: Kitty Cross
description: Nonograms and cute cats, welcome to Kitty Cross!

title: Spiral Knights: Operation Crimson Hammer
description: Challenge Warmaster Seerus and claim his mighty weapons for your own in this all-new Expansion Mission Pack!

title: Twin-Turbo Supercharged Nitro-Fueled Papamobile
description: Cyber-noir platformer in which you steer high-performance papamobile through a future city in order to deliver a cure that could save humanity.

title: Liberated: Glory to the Heroes
description: The second free story DLC for Liberated - an action-adventure game inside a living, hand-drawn comic book.

title: Liberated: For the Homeland
description: Liberated: For The Homeland is the first of two short story addons for Liberated. In this story-driven epilogue, you’ll peek behind the curtains of an oppressive system operated by very ordinary people. It’s a story of the daily grind and crushing violence against individuality.

title: Ghost Beat
description: Ghost Beat is a rhythm based precision platformer.

title: Decarnation
description: Decarnation is a story rich adventure horror game. Solve cryptic puzzles, fight disturbing enemies, explore a phantasmagorical world of dreams and nightmares, and face the most terrifying monsters from the darkest parts of your soul.

title: My Life As An Archeologist
description: Click your way through 100 levels of archeological treasure hunting, loot and improve your equipment, uncover build-defining artefacts on every boss, choose between three different classes and find the one that best fits your playstyle! Research monsters cards and improve every run!

title: Dragon Mission
description: Order in Chaos is kidnapping all the leaders of Dragonia, only Calanguito can stop them. Your chance to become a hero you've always dreamed of, in this action-packed game.

title: CyberSex 2069
description: Collect loads of “sensitive data” (hentai) on the Cyber by defeating sexy hackers in real time combat. Hack networks and devices to amass even more “data”. What else is the Cyber good for? A good laugh, actually.

title: Amborettio
description: Amborettio is a post-apocalyptic mining/survival RPG with a focus on crafting, equipment upgrades, and resource management. Mine, craft, and fight your way through the caverns as you try to uncover the truth about the PR0T3CH coalition's goals.

title: Flak
description: Send in your spitfires, bombers and divers. Play as the invading force, destroy your opponents before they rebuild their base!
Life is short. Time is precious. Can you discover and solve the mysterious sequence of puzzles that will save the world before you are... eighty-sixed?

title: Stranded 2
description: Following a not highly unexpected crash landing (which seems to happen to you a lot), you find yourself stranded on a hostile alien world full of humour, mystery and quite a bit of walking - Your task is clear, find a way off of this planet and get home. - Should be simple!

title: Logic Light
description: A minimalist puzzle experience to restore the electricity of the houses after a blackout

title: Among Ass 2: Butt Warfare
description: Asses are back in an adrenaline-pumping sequel! Now you can fight back bad asses with big boom-sticks! Gather friends and choose a side of the conflict.

title: Kira and the Life Stone
description: This the journey of Kira a lost soul in the state of limbo trying to get back to life and find out why is he dead. Follow him in his journey of getting back to life and get new powers, fight different enemies and find hidden secrets.

title: Lost Remnant: The End Tides
description: A Mysterious Point & Click Adventure of Discovery, set in the world of Lost Remnant. Inspired by SCP and the 'Hero of The Kingdom' series.

title: Tierra
description: A mystery puzzle adventure, inspired by hidden object escape room games.

title: Caveblazers: Together
description: Caveblazers Together is an online multiplayer mod for Caveblazers - team up with up to 3 friends on your adventures!

title: Escape the City
description: Silva's first map

title: Radiolight
description: Ashwood Creek, 1985. A child disappears without a trace. A local policeman is drawn into a national park, seeking the truth. Mysterious radio signals beckon him further and further. Investigate, survive and face the unknown in Radiolight— an '80s thriller by solo dev Krystof Knesl.

title: Carnival and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Only Hope: Episode 1
description: Decades since we last heard the Gods spoken. The evil soon broke into our world with the full power, causing it to tremble. The world had changed. Colors left us for many centuries, and a new powerful entity dwells. We divided. The matter of blood has never been so important before, as it is now.

title: Serious Sam HD: The Second Encounter - Legend of the Beast
description: Grab a fistful of rockets and step into the bright red shoes of the legendary Sam "Serious" Stone as he reloads for an all-new battle against the nefarious minions of Lord Mental. Hunt down the mysterious ram-god of the Great Obelisk and unlock the secrets buried beneath the mystical temples dotting the sands of ancient Egypt.

title: Beyond Horror: Episode One - A Father's Journey
description: The game is the first episode of a survival horror first person adventure, featuring action, stealth, shooting and puzzle solving. Every chapter has a specific theme and will play differently according to the plot, with tons of references to the classics that made the horror genre what it is today.

title: Lola: The Escape
description: In this challenging action platformer. Help the little cow Lola to escape from the Martians who kidnapped her. Explore and avoid obstacles in each level. Her main ability is to float while she falls.

title: Voidwalkers: Soul Hunters
description: Enter the Realm of Astora and fight for redemption in a non-stop battle for glory! Future Knights is a fast-paced dueling simulation where you are pitted against foes in numerous arenas to prove your worth.

title: My Journey to Your World
description: A casual free-to-play puzzle game with randomly scrambled puzzle pieces that can be solved under a certain time to win.

title: How to Volley Ball
description: A simple game about volleyball made by a member of a school volleyball team. Hope you would enjoy it and arouse your interest of volleyball. Maybe one day you would pick up a ball, walk in the court, join in the team and try the real game. I'll be glad to hear that!

title: Aquarist: My First Job
description: Get your first job in the Aquarist! Learn how to set up aquarium, decorate it and take care of your fish!

title: Hedgie Simulator
description: Trapped within the offices of a large hedge fund called Sipadel Finance. It's your job to take a sip and make the apes dip.

title: Jujubos
description: Jujubos is a puzzle game that you need to use different tools to build a path until the end and rescue all the Jujubos.

title: Legends of Snooker: One Shot
description: Legends of Snooker: One Shot, is a game that will bring out the best of your snooker skills. The puzzle will challenge you with several possible moves that vary according to your progress in the game.

title: Bloodwash
description: A serial killer is terrorizing the city, and Sara's deadbeat boyfriend hasn't done the laundry. Can Sara survive a late-night trip to the laundromat, or will the Womb Ripper perform an early delivery?

title: Voidwalkers: Astora's Darkness
description: You are the chosen, free of all, but in order to transcend, you must be the servant of many. For in order to gain the weak, ye must become the weak. Enter the Void, and walk the path of the Enigma. For many chase a corruptible crown, and you must prove that you are incorruptible.

title: Klondike Re-Imagined
description: Standard 3-card draw Klondike. But with a zillion gizmos to make it tedium-free. If its mundane, the app does it for you! You are just left with the fun stuff. This may be the most advanced solitaire game ever.

title: Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame - Compound
description: Expand your gameplay with the new Monster Energy Supercross - Compound. Discover the outdoor compound with two tracks and test your abilities with new and exciting challenges.

title: Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame 3 - Monster Energy Cup
description: Buy Monster Energy Supercross 3 - Monster Energy Cup now and enjoy the full experience of the most spectacular Supercross race ever!

title: Aircraft War: Shape Wars
description: Aircraft war now continues its adventure with shape wars. Fight the shapes with this new DLC package. New maps and new characters have been added to the game. Have fun.

title: Aircraft War: Tank Wars
description: Distinguished aircraft war followers, now the tanks are involved in the battle, choose your tank and start the war immediately. With this dlc package, 6 player tanks and 5 enemy tanks have been added to the game. Have fun.

title: Aircraft War: Dragon Wars
description: New DLC for Aircraft War. The war continues with all the excitement. Now dragons are involved in the war. You can also play two players from the same computer with the latest update. There is also co-op and versus option in the game.

title: Aircraft War: Car Wars
description: Aircraft War, now with Car Wars continue to have fun. The game adds more excitement to you with 5 different maps with different player cars and enemy cars. You can also play co-op on the same computer screen as your friend. Or, you can choose versus and try to shoot each other with your friend.

title: Mystic Vale: Mana Storm
description: The campaign to restore Gaia’s realm continues as other druids and creatures join the ranks. With the extra resources, will the cursed land finally be cured? Discover 48 new Advancement Cards, 18 Vale Cards, 8 Leaders and for the first-time amulets in a bid to win the fight.

title: Mystic Vale: Vale of the Wild
description: The Vale of the Wild expansion introduces two new mechanics to Mystic Vale, making your cards even stronger and opening up a whole new realm of combo possibilities! Pick your druidic leader and head into battle, the Valley of Life depends on you!

title: Revhead: Turbo
description: Turbo Pack DLC contains more than 60 new components, which gives high performance customisation to the game. It introduces twin turbo setups, intercoolers and additional air intakes to gain more horse power. Contents of this DLC allows the player to build cars with over 2000 horsepower!

title: Generation Zero: Apparel Crafting
description: It’s time to turn your ultimate 80s outfits into battle worthy garments with the addition of the Apparel Crafting in this latest update. By exploring and scavenging in Östertörn and Himfjäll, you will be able to find crafting materials or objects you can strip down for parts. Use these resources to enhance your clothing, making them as strong as they are fashionable.

title: Insights: Maniac Vortex
description: An old school point and click adventure game in a nostalgic pixelart look. Young journalist Thomas wants to write a newspaper article about the psychatric asylum in the small town Fuchsberg. Not knowing yet that he will be going on a great adventure leading to the greatest article of his life.

title: B.D.K
description: B.D.K is a short experimental first person horror game that mainly relies on atmosphere and sounds to create a creepy experience.

title: Presence
description: Presence is a 2D tile based strategy game with RogueLike Elements. Explore randomly generated levels as you battle your way in a fierce turn based combat system. Gather loot and gain XP to ascend the Classes to gain ever more power.

title: Ideology in Friction: Append
description: Following up from the critically acclaimed Dark Fantasy RPG, this DLC features 81 New Event CGs, alterations to existing story events, and an entirely new chapter revolving around Sachiyo - the strongest of the Viktor Knights and Zepp's mentor.

title: Enchanted Kingdom: Descent of the Elders - Collector's Edition
description: Play puzzles and brain teasers in one of the best new mystery seek and find hidden object games free! In this one of the top easy search and find object finding games your goal is to find hidden objects needed to become a hero!

title: Equilibrium
description: This game is developed by a senior high school student who fall in love with games.I will take into consideration the sales to keep updating and develop a bigger service.

title: One Night with Clara
description: A simple NSFW visual novel game. It's full 3D real-time rendering.

title: Search Party: Director's Cut
description: Claire's 8-year-old brother is missing. While looking for him during a search party, she finds herself completely lost and alone in the woods. She eventually spots a strange house in the distance... could Daniel be inside?

title: Space Bar at the End of the Galaxy
description: Space Bar at the End of the Galaxy is a Heist Comedy Space Opera Visual Novel where you play as Captain Leo Mancini, a tenacious and charming Space Pirate always looking for the next big heist.

title: Battlestar Galactica Deadlock: Armistice
description: Armistice is an explosive 8-mission story campaign that brings Season Two of Battlestar Galactica Deadlock to a thrilling conclusion! Unravel Clothos’ plot for dominion, and take part in the legendary Operation Raptor Talon.

title: Wushu Chronicles 2
description: Wushu Chronicles 2 is a martial arts sandbox ARPG game. It is the orthodox sequel to Wushu Chronicles, using the latest self-developed engine flexi3.0, the picture effect is greatly improved. The game uses a seamless big map exploration mechanism, and you can write your arena freely.

title: Cellar: Rags and Knife
description: Adventure game based on a real life story! Get a knife, put on rags and go down!

title: Mind-Blowing Girls 2
description: A puzzle game where you need to assemble a complete image from several pieces.

title: Stellar Monarch: The Age of Technology
description: The first expansion for Stellar Monarch. It focuses on technology and science. New alien races, terraformation, megastructures, construction of a fearsome battlestar, random technologies, etc.

title: WWII: Rising
description: Become a hero during WWII in an Epic Online Multiplayer battles. Play up to 4 different maps with 4 game modes. You can choose to support your teammates with the support class or either fight off the enemy from a long distance with the Recon. The battle has started, come and fight for your country.

title: A Game of Dwarves: Star Dwarves
description: Many Dwarven clans disappeared during the Magic War. One clan even went where no Dwarf has ever gone before; space. Now they have returned and brought with them new and strange technology for their Dwarven brethren.Dig deep and prosper!

title: Territory
description: Territory is an immersive, atmospheric, crafting and survival game. Developed with Unreal Engine 5.

title: Neighbor Watching
description: She is unable to resist our hero's coercion, but remains resolute that she is only doing these things to protect her family. But by reluctantly complying with his lecherous demands, she begins to learn things about herself she never thought possible...

title: 1 Hop
description: Play as a rabbit and go looking for carrots and food bags avoiding the dog. Try to get the mountain first to become the ultimate rabbit, play split screen with your friend and work together to become the King Rabbit.

title: Pepo
description: Pepo is a 2D platformer shooting game that fights boss by firing three colors. Join Pepo's adventure of meeting mutant bosses on the extinct planet and leaving to find Pepo's home!

title: One Piece: Burning Blood - Wanted
description: This amazing Wanted pack gives you access to: 6 alternate versions of playable characters 8 new costumes 4 customizable HUDsA perfect mix to gear up for the fight!

title: One Piece: Burning Blood - Wanted 2
description: This One Piece: Burning Blood - Wanted 2 includes: 4 new playable characters 6 costumes 1 customized HUD

title: Dollar Dash: More Ways to Win
description: Now unlock a completely new game mode "Topscorer" with six maps and a mass of new exciting in-game shop content, such as a new victory dance, costumes and in-game icons! The challenge is set, as each player carries a money bag which can hold $1,000.00 dollars.

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Biker Queen
description:
Includes:
- Valentine 'Viper' Chase hero unlock
- Biker Queen suit
- Black glasses
- 700 Crowns

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Lone Wolf
description:
Includes:
- "Clyde" hero unlock
- "Lone Wolf" outfit
- "Claws" weapon
- 700 Crowns

title: Tic-Toc-Tower: Teslagrad
description: Teslakid, from the game Teslagrad, will be a playable character in this new DLC for Tic-Toc-Tower.

title: Hot Spring Hero
description: A hot spring hotel deep in the forest. There are natural silly hostesses, gluttonous dog-eared female chefs, cat-eared female fishermen, and even the hot spring goddess, all for the revival of this hot spring hotel! The adventurous life with the lovely heroines day and night, look forward to your arrival!

title: Labyrinth 3
description: A relaxing labyrinth game.

title: Femboys of the Phalanx
description: The year was 432 BC and Athens was at its peak. Set out on an adventure and meet Femboys and other characters as you make your way through this interesting time in history.

title: Tomorrow
description: Rescue your bunny from the hands of the artist known as Jaye!

title: Wildlife Park 3: Dino Invasion
description: Living with dinosaurs is only fancifulness? No, it is real now. Blow the time dimension and beam the prehistoric jurassic giants with many other futuristic visitor attractions to your Wildlife Park. Dinosaurs, theme park attractions, a bunch of SF service facilities, extinct plants and new decorations.

title: Universe 25: The Loop
description: A Pythonesque Indie point and click adventure game set in the year 2035. Follow the journey of a bureaucrat as he tracks down a malevolent force running experiments on citizens. Armed with a government issue briefcase and a pet mouse, he tracks down an evil agent only to find more than he expected

title: Space Smack!
description: Space Smack! is a 1 to 4 player party game exploding with chaos and sabotage. Enter into the vast expanse of space and clash in a variety of minigames. In this controller-only game, cooperate or undermine your friends to become victorious!

title: Attack: Helicopter Simulator 2020
description: Attack: Helicopter Simulator 2020 is a simulator about a pilot of a helicopter, who battles in some places. Realistic Physics of helicopters.

title: Automobilista: Donington Park
description: Donington Park is one of the most internationally renowned and historically significant circuits in the world, The latest version of this classic track modelled with LIDAR scan data now features in Automobilista!

title: Automobilista 2: Spa-Francorchamps
description: The epic Spa-Francorchamps arrives for Automobilista 2, initially featuring a laser-scanned version of the modern track as well as the historical variant from 1993.

title: Automobilista: Formula Truck
description: Formula Truck for Automobilista brings the official simulation of the popular Brazilian Formula Truck series - the most competitive truck racing series in the world!

title: Automobilista: Brazilian Touring Car Classics
description: Brazilian Touring Car Classics for Automobilista

title: Automobilista: Snetterton
description: Snetterton is one of the finest circuits in the UK, blending a challenging and complex layout with fast straights to create a unique challenge!

title: Apocalypse Hotel: The Post-Apocalyptic Hotel Simulator! - Museum of Horror!
description: Yes the world has ended, yes most people are dead, and yes you are trying to run a hotel under terrible conditions: but that’s no reason not to think about expanding your business to attract more guests. Transform your parents’ museum for hotel paraphernalia into a museum of macabre horror, one that puts on show some of the horrors that took place in the city since the zombie apocalypse!

title: Roll For Confidence
description:
A wholesome story about what it means to be a strong, confident woman.

Everyone in the town of Fernweh knows and adores Sophia, the sweet co-owner of Screen Time arcade. Well, almost everyone. Sophia is tired of avoiding confrontation and keeping herself small. She wants to be a strong woman, but WHAT DOES THAT EVEN MEAN?

title: Y: The Game
description: Y: The Game is a passion project platformer where you are a Y avoiding enemies and spikes trying to get all of the objectives in levels. Perfect for hardcore speedrunners, imaginative level creators, and casual players.

title: Mandinga: A Tale of Banzo
description: Mandinga: A tale of Banzo is a role-playing game with game style of Japanese RPG classics, with a unique battle system using dice in turn-based combat, full of strategy and challenges. A game with an immersive history, based on a historical moment in Brazil.

title: Citizens: Far Lands
description: Citizens is a blend between turn based city builder and a puzzler for strategy masterminds. Build a thriving settlement, extract and process resources and manage your population by catering to their needs, thus allowing you to build bigger and better!

title: Fantasy Sliding Puzzle 2
description: Challenging sliding puzzles with various levels of difficulty, featuring epic fantasy female characters and backgrounds.

title: Wraiths of Sentinel
description: Harness the phenomenal abilities of an unliving wraith to preserve liberty—or to subvert it. Will you use your powers over quintessence to save your nation, or will you profit from its broken shell?

title: Dumb: Treasure
description: Use a remote-controlled robot to find the treasure lost under the bed.

title: Jaksaljabi
description: Jaksaljabi is a kinetic novel that you can experience unique set-up and story.

title: Sit Down, Please
description: Step into a scientist's shoes in a story driven game which leads you to discover a mysterious and unknown world by torturing characters. In order to find out all the hidden secrets, try to keep the guinea pigs alive for as long as possible by using the scientist's machinery.

title: Tales of a Rabbit: The Story of Willie Hop
description: Tales of a Rabbit: The Story of Willie Hop is a 3D educational platformer about an adventurous rabbit on a grand treasure hunt! This short 3D platformer is designed to teach players how to solve math problems that deal with the order of operations, one-step equations, and two-step equations.

title: Voidwalkers: The Gates of Hell
description: You are one of the Voidwalkers, tasked with a life-long oath to defend the Gates Of Hell from any who would try to cross into the land of the living. After a thousand years without incident, thousands of undead warriors have begun crossing the plane, and it's up to you to stop them!

title: Mechanica: A Ballad of the Rabbit and Mercury
description: 5029 AD, "Guillotine", the Japanese territory on Mercury, a city full of neon signs and drunks. You will explore the beautiful cyberpunk-style 2D world, play music to the residents of Mercury to gather intelligence, and finally achieve the goal of saving the world.

title: Barn Finders: Bid Wars
description: Take part in an endless number of auctions. Win access to more garages, abandoned containers, unclaimed luggage and sell found items for a lot of money. Become the king of bidding. Bid'em All!

title: Bubble Star Party
description: It's a 3D multiplayer world with more than 30 characters with various skills to unlock, and a level editor with more than 500 terrain modules, dozens of obstacles and traps. In addition to built-in levels, you can make your level!Let other players have fun cooperating and competing in your level!

title: Trains Continental
description: Build your own transcontinental railroad in western America of XIX century. Collect and manage tracks, rebuild them to find the most optimal way for the train to cross even the most difficult terrains. Beware though! The clock is ticking and you need to finish the work before the time runs out!

title: First Class Escape: The Train of Thought
description: "First Class Escape: The Train of Thought" is a co-operative atmospheric escape room puzzle game, set in a beautifully realized vintage train. Do you think you have what it takes to solve the puzzles and escape the train?

title: Jìmò Shénmíng de Xīnyuàn Shǒujì
description: What kind of courage and change can the connection between people bring? The story takes place in the ancient eastern country, where a foreign girl from Silazi kingdom got involved with various humans, spirits and even gods. Here, she heard voices unknown to others and met people unknown to others.

title: Tarakan: Point and Click Adventure
description: Tarakan is a puzzle mystery adventure, inspired by escape room style games. Take control of a submarine and visit multiple coastal laboratories. Solve puzzles as you go to unlock the tools you need to solve the mystery!

title: Robogal
description: This is a role-playing game. In the game, you will play the role of bio robot manufacturer. Through the data collection of prototype, you can make the robot customers want.

title: Demon Lord Jill: Revival
description: “Jill”‘s family is a two hundred thousand years-lasted Demon consanguinity. But Jill was in deep trouble as his father passed away. The number of demons and humans were decreasing.

title: Helper Cat
description: Helper cat is a puzzle game, in which your objective is to help a magician, putting his potions in the correct places, but for that you'll have to face all the puzzles in the castle.

title: Fantasy Match Puzzle
description: Are you ready to test your eyes with Fantasy Match Puzzle, your seek and find skills will be challenged like never before. Develops your secret seeker skill to find objects. This is a puzzle game similar to Hidden Object games, in which you have to find the objects while the clock is ticking.

title: Portals World
description: A sci-fi action strategy tower defense digging 2D top down game, Dig, explore, build production and defensive facilities, take care of robot's battery and manage power wisely..

title: VR Hot
description: VR HOT is a virtual adult experience for creating and interacting with dream partners. It gives you the opportunity to explore your most intimate desires in a non-judgmental surrounding. VR HOT offers a virtual environment and a construction kit for dream partners and the interaction with them.

title: Blockee
description: Blockee is a simple slide-puzzle game. Just slide the blocks!

title: Sānguó Yǎnyì zhī Shǔhàn Chuánqí
description: "The Romance of the Three Kingdoms: Legend of Shu Han" is an RPG game with a theme of the history of the Three Kingdoms that happened in China. In the game, player operates Liu Bei's army to suppress anti Han bandits on the vast land of China, maintain the legitimacy of the Han Dynasty.

title: Grow Big or Go Home: Ultimate Edition
description: Play as Bruce, the world's most talented indoor gardener, in this 2D pixel-art puzzle game. Through now 30+ fast-paced levels, you will travel to different locations and eras in order to water, light, and tend to plants with the high-tech magic of a watering can and a reflective mirror.

title: Galaxy Reavers: Titan
description:
A paid DLC for “Galaxy Reavers”, allowing commanders to unlock the giant warship “Titan” and build up a more diverse and powerful fleet to challenge higher level stages!

To allow commanders build up a more diverse and powerful fleet, this DLC will release a special giant warship–the Titan!

Content
1.Unlocks a giant warship, “Titan”.
2.Unlocks a device, “Torpedo IV”.
3.Gains 200 Khorium.

Titan is a giant warship in “Galaxy Reavers”. Like a great castle, it possesses great defense as well as highest CPU value in game. Along with its most enormous space for devices, the full power Titian is nightmare to the enemy fleet!

In addition, there is 200 Gold in this DLC as well, allowing commanders to purchase more powerful warships and devices!

title: Tactical Three Kingdoms: Strategy & War
description: Recruit famous heroes from the Three Kingdoms era to end the turbulent age!

title: 20XX: Draco Character
description: This DLC introduces Draco, a powerful playable Contractor who wields an endless arsenal of unique Weapons. Master the shadow-dashing Vega Claws and the platform-creating Rapture Bubble to destroy your foes in style!

title: Valkyria Chronicles 4: The Two Valkyria
description:
This cataclysmic reunion of "1933 EC. Behind the Empire's towering facade, Crymaria awaits a crucial test with Lieutenant Colonel Selvaria Bles.

This cataclysmic reunion of the two Valkyria will determine Crymaria's fate.

This story can be played after completing Chapter 18 of the main story. Complete this extra story to unlock Crymaria, Nikola, Chiara, and Selvaria for use in the main game, along with swimsuit uniforms for each. To access this story, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories."the two Valkyria will determine Crymaria's fate.

title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth3: V Generation - Let's Get Nepucated
description: Let's Get Nepucated DLC unlocks a special event called Nepucation

title: SpaceXplorer
description: Desktop and VR interactive space experience/game. Fan homage to SpaceX's efforts of inspiring humanity to finally become a spacefaring civilization! Experience launches, flights and landings of starships first-hand, engage with challenging mini-games, explore funny memes and more. :-)

title: Cursed Night: The House
description: 1972, Texas. One night, you had a car accident near the Stafford farm. You wanted to get help, so you went there. But it was your worst decision of your life. What after came...it was the real CURSED NIGHT for you.

title: Speedway Challenge 2021
description: Speedway Challenge 2021 is a 3D speedway game. Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Heroines of Swords & Spells: Green Furies
description: An Anti-Heroic DLC for an epic and funny jRPG adventure with intricately detailed world and story. Revisit this world and look at the familiar story through the eyes of completely different protagonists.

title: The Maze
description: In a pitch dark maze like factory, you must avoid He, secure secret documents, and escape with only a flashlight. If He finds you, He’ll charge from the dark with an axe. Can you survive and escape?

title: Imperiums: Troy
description: Imperiums: Troy is a small-scale tactical scenario that sets the stage for participation in one of the most epic battles of ancient times. Join the greatest of Trojan and Greek heroes and prove your worth on the plains of Troy!

title: Trash Can Dungeon: Battle Against the Zoo
description: This is a sample game created in "RPG Maker MZ" by Shitsudo Kei. Keep the peace in Neo Tokyo in this Dungeon Action RPG

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 4
description:
Dive into the Sunken Kingdom to solve puzzles and unearth the secrets of its Siren Shrines, or battle through waves of Ocean Crawlers and Sirens to raid the Siren Treasuries.

Seasonal progression allows all players to earn Renown and rewards, with a fresh array of Trials and Deeds to boost progress and an optional Plunder Pass to expand the reward pool.

title: Pangea
description: Unique combination of turn-based strategy, tabletop game and roguelike. Make moves according to the roll of the dice on a randomly generated field and destroying enemies in tactical battles. Available 4 different factions.

title: REM Cycles
description: One night, ten people fall asleep and find themselves in someone else's dream. Guide these unlikely heroes as they traverse strange lands filled with enemies and memories. Confront a mysterious antagonist and witness chats between battles while you search for reason in sleep.

title: Mighty!
description: MIGHTY! is a fast-paced top-down roguelike set inside cramped dungeon walls which forces constant resource management and stat min/maxing skills to get as far as you possibly can in an endless creep of levels.

title: Covert Commando
description: A no frills rogue ultra-lite top down dual stick looter shooter.

title: The Survivalists: Monkey Business
description: Survive in style. Add some flair to your wardrobe as you explore The Survivalists. The Monkey Business pack contains 3 player hats and 6 monkey hats, all as part of the Box-ex side quest.

title: Hero Siege: Class - Samurai
description: Samurai is an offensive melee fighter with lots of movability.

title: Hero Siege: Class - Shaman
description: The Shaman- Unlock the Shaman class.

title: Hero Siege: Class - Amazon
description: Get Amazon and exclusive Jungle content!

title: Hero Siege: Class - Marauder
description: Marauder is a semi-ranged class that uses chains, bombs and a flail to demolish it's enemies

title: Inspector Schmidt: A Bavarian Tale
description: "Inspector Schmidt - A Bavarian Tale" is a third-person detective RPG, set in rural Bavaria in 1866. As the young Medical student Valentin Schmidt you will travel to Wolpertshofen in order to write a report of the peoples' living situation for the King, when a sudden death causes turmoil in the small Bavarian village.

title: Fatal Evidence: The Cursed Island - Collector's Edition
description: Play these great object finding games full of puzzles, brain teasers and mini-games! You need to seek and find hidden objects and win this fun search and find finding object games!

title: Soaring
description: Climb upwards and uncover the mystery of your lost egg in this unique platformer. Along the way you will find hidden treasures, brave devious traps and hopefully keep solid footing, its a long way from the top !

title: Big Byz Wars
description: Run'n'Gun in dystopian sci-fi 2.5D side scroller. As a mercenary of the biggest flying city - Byzantium aka 'Big Byz', you will deal with some delicate issues and missions.

title: The Advisor: Episode 1 - Royal Pain
description: The Advisor Series is a player-driven narrative where your choices & decisions, both in the game, and out of the game, determine how future episodes unfold. Play the role of villain protagonist Magnus the Magician, as he wreaks havoc across the land, one well-placed fireball at a time!

title: Mido and Di
description: Mido is an alien kid having nightmares about zombie aliens. One night he draws a creature, Di, and it comes alive to teach Mido how to fight zombies.

title: Tower Tactics: Liberation
description: Tower Tactics: Liberation fuses deck-building games and roguelikes to modernize the tower defense genre like never before - make your way through procedurally generated maps, collect valuable trinkets and manage your arsenal to defend yourself against the Salkoth!

title: Moon Base
description: In this project you can become an astronaut on the first moon base in human history. You can drive a rover, do some jobs with drilling devices, figure out how solar panels work and walk on the moon surface.

title: Slumhack
description: Slumhack is an action-based puzzle game set in a post-pandemic world, one just like ours. Play as Neriko, a young girl living in a modern ghetto born of such reality, and hack your way through the streets of Cyberia to bring back hope and peace to the slum.

title: Idle Expanse: Reality Shifter
description: This DLC unlocks alternate realities 101 through 1000.

title: Idle Expanse: Chronoscope Technology
description: This DLC gives you a preview of whether or not a planet contains Time Crystals or contract givers.

title: Bean and Nothingness
description: A difficult tile-based puzzle game about turning beans into monsters -- and monsters back into beans.

title: Blaster Master Zero: EX Character - Shantae
description:
Shantae joins the underground adventure as a playable character in EX Character Mode!
Fascinate the mutant hordes with the power of magic and fancy dances!

This unlocks the EX Character "Shantae."

title: Blaster Master Zero: EX Character - Shovel Knight
description:
Shovel Knight joins the underground adventure as a playable character in EX Character Mode! Steel thy shovel and dig your way through the depths of the planet!

This unlocks the EX Character "Shovel Knight."

title: Stayhomer
description: "Disinfect" all anti-lockdown protesters.

title: Nights of Azure 2: Bride of the New Moon - Side Story: Time Drifts Through the Moonlit Night
description:
An additional side story, "Time Drifts Through the Moonlit Night", will be added to the game. The side story can be triggered in the Hotel Lobby, after Chapter 2 is completed, and will take place between Chapters 2-7.

Additionally, "Requiem Pink" costume for Aluche, which boosts all parameters, is included in this DLC.

title: Nights of Azure 2: Bride of the New Moon - Side Story: The Foreigner in a Wonderland of Sweets
description: An additional side story, "The Foreigner in a Wonderland of Sweets", will be added to the game. The story is triggered after you return to the hotel after speaking to Eleanor about the "Wonderland of Sweets" in Chapter 3.

title: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed
description:
Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is a video game in the open-world action-adventure genre, serving as a remake of the original 2006 game. It is the sequel to the remade Destroy All Humans! and marks the sixth instalment in the franchise.

In this game, players take on the role of Crypto, navigating through diverse global locations such as England, Russia, and the United States. The objective is to complete various missions and overcome human adversaries. The gameplay incorporates a range of weapons and abilities, allowing players to defeat enemies by employing tactics such as mind-controlling humans and utilizing advanced alien technology.

title: Outcast: A New Beginning
description: Explore the breathtaking alien world of Adelpha, support the local Talans in their struggles and fight your way through fast-paced battles against invading robot forces in this 3rd-person, open world, action adventure sequel to the 1999 cult classic.

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends
description: Race your way to victory on bikes, ATVs and UTVs in MX vs ATV Legends! Featuring massive new open environments, plus a career mode that lets you experience all the risks and rewards of becoming a world-famous professional rider. Become an off-road racing legend in your own right! Your time is now!

title: SuperPower 3
description: Superpower 3 is a modern geopolitical sim in a planet Earth setup. Rule the world or challenge your knowledge about demography, economics, military strategy, as well as political issues across the globe. Compete with or against other players, or just try to do better than the real-life politicians.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake
description: Wish-granting Mermaid’s Tears in the hands of SpongeBob and Patrick… What could go wrong? Sure, the very fabric holding the universe together could come undone, opening portals into wild Wishworlds. But that’s nothing our favorite sponge can’t handle- with the right cosmic costume!

title: Death Trials
description: Before you know it, you've woken up in a SURVIVAL HORROR GAME. Total darkness. It feels like you're in a rusty metal cage, which hangs in mid air. There's a small light against the wall twenty feet away, but you can't get out. Just as your eyes adjust, the cage door slowly opens... You jump from the cage... three feet below to the floor... and into the darkness...

title: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers
description: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers is a soulslike action RPG set in the land of Shu during the dark and tumultuous late Ming Dynasty, plagued by warring factions and a mysterious illness that spawns monstrous creatures.

title: Coin Treasures
description:
Coin Treasures is a game like the classic coin pusher/dozer games combined with incremental progress, realistic physics and stunning graphics.

Unlock artifact spawning which will stay in the world after you've won the item. Collect your own treasure room filled with the treasure you find.

Unlock powerfull powerups but be careful this also unlocks power"downs". Try to get them off the play area to avoid temporary penalties. Collecting the powerups will give you temporary benifits.

The aim of the game is to keep upgrading everything.

title: Color by Number
description: The architect of The Tower designed other buildings as well, but he didn’t always have the Tower’s budget. What’s become of Jake now—and just how many squatters are there?

title: Grey Tower
description: You're no hero, so when your friend Jake asks you to join him in exploring a ruined castle several days' journey to the north, you refuse to have anything to do with the idea. Well, that was weeks ago, and you haven't heard from Jake. Much against your better judgement, you decide to go find out what became of him...and maybe pick up some treasure along the way.

title: Majestic Part I: Alien Encounter
description:
The Majestic was Earth's greatest space liner offering unparalleled luxury and comfort. She disappeared on her maiden voyage, no-one could trace her. Then, about a week later, a lifeboat with survivors was discovered out near the Pleiades but the captain and a couple of other people were still missing. The search went on but turned up nothing and eventually it was abandoned. Some time later a feint signal was detected. It was thought that this could be the Majestic's beacon but it was so very faint that no-one was sure. So a field archaeologist was dispatched to investigate.

Majestic Part 1: Alien Encounter is a science fiction point-and-click adventure game. The player takes on the role of the aforementioned archaeologist who locates the Majestic and explores the ship to discover what happened. Unlike traditional point-and-click adventures, however, the player explores the ship by sending up to four probes into the vessel. Each probe can link to systems, scan, cut holes in things with a torch, and pick up objects for examination. As the game progresses the probes can be upgraded to give them additional capabilities. They are controlled via an interface that displays the probe's view in a window the center of the screen. The same interface is used to save and restore the game.

The game is entirely mouse-controlled and has a point system which measures the player's progress through the game.

title: Deltarune
description: Dive into the parallel story to UNDERTALE! Fight or spare your way through action-packed battles as you explore a mysterious world alongside an endearing cast of new and familiar characters.

title: Mantra II: The Blood of Saric
description: Sequel to Mantra; real-time RPG.

title: Secrets of the Pyramids
description:
Secrets of the Pyramids is an edutainment title that includes 3 modes: a movie, discovery and game mode. The Movie mode presents a dramatic reconstruction of a series of events that could have taken place in Ancient Egypt. The Discovery mode describes Ancient Egypt culture, religion and history.

In the Game mode you will follow Harold Peabody - dreamer, adventurer and optimist - on his quest for the hidden tomb of the mythical Pharaoh Ankh-Re. After finding a way to open the door to the pyramid, the player has to explore the pyramid, find useful items and overcome various obstacles. Stepping on the wrong tile or opening a wrong door may result in the untimely death of the hero. To avoid traps and decipher clues the player has to consult an "English-Hieroglyphics translator" found early in the game.

Secrets of the Pyramids is a short, inventory-based adventure game with a simple interface (with a "look" and "use" icon). The player can only save one game at a time (by pressing the S-key). The game comes with a soundtrack and some sound effects; comments are shown in message windows that pop-up (no voices).

title: Mystery Island
description: Millionaire James Harvey has died and his son inherited it all. Now he is missing. It is your job to solve the mystery!

title: Ocean Bound
description: Ocean Bound is a survival game where you and the crew of your ship are stranded on an unknown island. The main goal is to build a ship to escape back to civilization, but before you can do that you must establish a colony, collect resources and try to stay alive. But once you manage to escape, the next level simply strands you in another island. There are sixty levels in total, featuring all sorts of islands, some as big as continents, and each one requires a different strategy to stay alive.

title: Palace of Sand
description: One of the best World Builder text-based adventures, Palace of Sand sees the player chasing after their pal who's scarpered off to the east to check out the Sultan's daughter.

title: Radical Castle
description:
Radical Castle is a point-and-click adventure game released for Macintosh in 1986 and distributed as shareware.

Players assume the role of the 'Squire', who after mistaking the princess for a serving wench, is given a choice by the King between death and a quest to recover an oracle stolen by a wizard.

title: RoboWar
description: In RoboWar, you design and program robot warriors, and let them battle it out in the arena. A complete programming interface allows you to design the robots appearance, sound effects and behavior.

title: Sensory Overload
description: A dropper game designed to overwhelm your senses. Twisting tunnels, psychedelic patterns, and breathing walls assault your sense of balance as the chaos escalates with every level.

title: Shadow Keep
description: A fun top-town adventure/questing game where you fight weird creatures, find treasure, and talk to entertaining NPCs.

title: SimHarbor
description:
You have been asked to build a harbor for a town near the Atlantic ocean. With a starting capital of £200,000 from the city council, the work begins!

SimHarbor is a harbor building sim. Set up the piers, equipment and storage needed to service over 120 different ships. Expand your infrastructure, balance your finances and protect your harbor from disasters in this compelling sim.

Reading the manual before jumping in is highly recommended, this is a contender for the HyperCard engine's most complicated game.

title: Space Camel
description: An interstellar rendition of Camel or Desert Trek. Keep an eye on the air, fuel, and hull meters!

title: Swamp Witch
description: A World Builder adventure game.

title: The Dungeon Revealed
description: Commercial re-release of the popular shareware roguelike, The Dungeon of Doom. Along with a new look to the interface, this version adds secret "vault" areas and a "Gate Keeper" boss on every fifth level. To escape the dungeon, you must descend to the 40th level and return with the Orb of Carnos.

title: Theldrow
description: Theldrow is a turn-based computer role-playing game, written in 1989 by Glenn Andreas. The game featured a turn-based first person perspective interface similar to early Might and Magic games, pixel art (originally black-and-white), and a very original fantasy setting. It is a very difficult game.

title: Twisted! Deluxe
description: Twisted! Deluxe is an updated, full-color version of Twisted!, an excellent shareware adventure game for the Macintosh by Ray Dunakin. The original Twisted! was a fun text-adventure-with-graphics game coded with World Builder, a now-discontinued adventure game application for the Mac. This Deluxe version features all-new color graphics and a streamlined point-and-click interface in place of a text parser. Twisted! Deluxe starts out similar to the movie of the same name: you are a meteorologist, a "storm chaser" sent to investigate a tornado. Before long, you end up in Land of Ooz, a bizarre fantasy world filled with talking dragons and other strange creatures, and numerous fascinating puzzles that range from math logic, to riddles and traditional inventory-based puzzles.

title: Vampire Castle
description:
"Warning! The Vampire awakes at midnite!"

An adventure game with optional MacinTalk speech.

title: Muddy Water
description: This time you’re on your own. While Jake is enjoying a busman’s honeymoon in Revenue City, Nevada, you learn about a stolen sceptre—and, more important, a major reward. But can you drink the water?

title: A Night in Berry
description:
France - XVIth century.
Mathilde's father has fallen into a coma. When a healer happens to pass in her village, she decides to grab the opportunity to save him.

title: Out of Gas
description:
Travel through space as you mine for resources like gold, iron, oxygen, and gems. Use collected resources at space stations to upgrade guns and shields and improve gas usage. Mostly a peaceful game of exploration, you will have to monitor your ship's gas and ammo usage and may occasionally attract the attention of pirates who will attempt to destroy your ship.

In Out of Gas, the environment beyond the starting area is procedurally generated and completely random. Apart from the special colored asteroids, the dropped resources are also completely random. There is a chance that you will encounter a trade post, where you can trade gems for large amounts of other resources such as gold, iron, and oxygen.

title: Old Woman Beardychin and the Scruffedy Bumtious
description: Old Woman Beardychin is quite content to follow the same routine day after day, when suddenly her life is turned upside down by the arrival, and subsequent departure, of a Scruffedy Bumtious. Thus begins an epic journey, full of peril and mishaps, which takes Beardychin far away from her safe and comfortable home. Will she ever find the Bumtious again?

title: Pendek
description: You are Yandi, a villager who works for the Pandang Logging Company deep in the Sumatran jungle. An accident leaves you stranded and alone in the jungle. You must survive, you must escape. But who knows what you might come across in the process?

title: Perils of Poom
description:
You need money fast so what'd you do? Well, you end up getting a job which involves going round the galaxy in search of a rare (illegal) drug for a large cash reward, of course.

With 4 different planets to visit, a short bonus section to unlock at the end, and..er.. probably some other attributes.

title: Deathsmiles I & II: Gothic wa Mahou Otome Love Max Edition
description:
The Gothic wa Mahou Otome Love Max Edition includes:
・ Game software for PS4 "Death Smiles I / II" (special edition: OST CD + Special DLC )
・ B2 tapestry drawn by Dr. Junya Inoue
・ "Death Smiles" original acrylic panel
・ "Jill Ballard" A4 microfiber towel

title: Forza Horizon 5: Deluxe Edition
description: Your Ultimate Horizon Adventure awaits! Explore the vibrant and ever-evolving open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in hundreds of the world’s greatest cars. The Deluxe Edition includes the full game and Car Pass.

title: Forza Horizon 5: Premium Edition
description:
Your Ultimate Horizon Adventure awaits! Explore the vibrant and ever-evolving open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in hundreds of the world’s greatest cars.
The Premium Edition includes early access to the full game, allowing you to play four days early beginning November 5, 2021. Also included are the expansions Forza Horizon 5 Rally Adventure, Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels, VIP, Car Pass and the Welcome Pack.

title: Nascar 21: Ignition - Day 1 Edition
description: Nascar 21: Ignition redefines the official video game of the world’s most popular stock car racing series. With incredible graphics and immersive gameplay, Nascar 21: Ignition brings a whole new level of authenticity and atmosphere to the Nascar Cup Series.

title: Assetto Corsa Competizione: Day One Edition
description:
Assetto Corsa Competizione, the official GT World Challenge videogame. Thanks to the extraordinary quality of simulation, you will experience the atmosphere of the GT3 championship. Compete against official drivers, teams, cars and official circuits reproduced to the highest quality ever seen.

The Day One Edition includes the 2020 GT World Challenge Pack DLC.

title: Horizon Forbidden West: Launch Edition
description:
Horizon Forbidden West continues Aloy’s story as she moves west to a far-future America to brave a majestic, but dangerous frontier where she’ll face awe-inspiring machines and mysterious new threats.

Horizon Forbidden West Launch Edition includes a voucher code to redeem all Horizon Forbidden West pre-order digital bonuses.

title: Crusader Kings III: Day One Edition
description:
This edition includes:

- Crusader Kings III.
- Garments of the Holy Roman Empire DLC.
- A poster.

title: Beyond a Steel Sky: Beyond a Steel Book Edition
description:
Beyond A Steel Sky: Beyond A SteelBook Edition Includes: Base Game, Limited Edition SteelBook featuring comic artwork by Dave Gibbons, Sticker Sheet, Digital Original Soundtrack

The World: An adventure set within a dynamic world, populated by willful characters and driven by motivations that the player can subvert; In combination with a unique hacking tool, multiple solutions to puzzles emerge from the player's choices

The Story: Unravel dark conspiracies and defeat a terrifying antagonist in this dramatic, humorous, cyberpunk thriller which explores contemporary themes, such as: social control, AI, and total surveillance

The Puzzles: Intelligent puzzles are interwoven with an intriguing dramatic narrative to deliver a compelling gameplay experience.

The Look: A beautifully detailed, comic-book styled world from the mind of legendary comic artist Dave Gibbons (Watchmen)

title: Halo Infinite: Steelbook Edition
description: The Halo Infinite Collector's Steelbook Edition celebrates the return of one of gaming's most iconic franchises in a limited edition collectible metal case.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Day One Edition
description:
The King of Fighters XV, is the fifteenth installment of The King of Fighters series. Transcend beyond your limits with KOF XV! Classic popular characters, heroes and villains revived from the dead, new challengers, and more!

The Day One Edition includes:
- Base game
- DLC Costume: Terry "Garou: Mark of the Wolves

title: Okinawa Rush: Limited Edition
description:
Okinawa Rush is a martial arts platforming game with RPG elements, many items to collect and unique FengShui system.

Okinawa Rush: Limited Edition contents:
- 1 FuturePak
- 1 Magnet coin FuturePak
- Limited Edition Slip Cover
- Standard Sealed game
- Individually Numbered
- Only 2000pcs Produced

title: Mary Skelter Finale: Day One Edition
Koh Lanta: Les Aventuriers
description:
Will you be the last adventurer on the island? 14 adventurers left to their own devices, on an island far from any civilization ... A game of survival and strategy in an idyllic atmosphere ... A television show that brings together several million viewers each season ... Koh-Lanta is a game that will involve dexterity , diplomacy and the nerves of the player to the test: life on an island is not a part of pleasure, and each day will bring its share of surprises ... Manage your daily life well, the events in team or solo, but especially your relationships with other islanders to continue the adventure to the end and be the last adventurer on the island! But beware: if you falter or get eliminated by your peers… the game is over!

Koh Lanta: Les Aventuriers is a game based on the French adaptation of the tv show Survivor, exclusive to France.

title: Cupid Parasite: Day One Edition
description:
Welcome to Cupid Corporation! - Located in the glitzy and trendsetting metropolis of Los York, Cupid Corporation is a daring marriage agency known for its style and success rate.

Our heroine, Lynette Mirror, is Cupid Corporation's top bridal advisor, whose job is to consult in-vogue singles to make their wildest romantic dreams come true! BUT she has one huge secret up her sleeve-she is none other than Celestia's Goddess of Love, Cupid!

Sent to the Human Realm on her heavenly mission of "matchmaking", Lynette meets her biggest challenge yet: the infamous Parasite 5. In order to help these five hopeless men find true love, Lynette and her team concoct the perfect matchmaking plan... REALITY TV.

Will Lynette be able to live up to her name as top bridal advisor and Cupid, or will her dreams get cancelled?

Day 1 Edition

Nintendo Switch Game (with reversible cover sleeve)
6 Trading Cards
Sticker Sheet
Double-Sided A2 Poster
Collector's Box

title: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles - Enhanced Edition
description: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles – Enhanced Edition features DualSense wireless controller haptic feedback and speaker support, 4K resolution and 60 frames per second gameplay, and additional player character accessories.

title: Sakura no Kumo: Scarlet no Koi - Complete Limited Edition
description:
Box contents:
- Game: Sakura no Kumo * Scarlet no Koi
- B2 tapestry
- Consumer version "Sakura no Kumo ＊ Scarlet no Koi" Opening Song "Yumemi Hanabira"
- Telegram version Memo Book

title: Mystic Rhythms
description: In this game, you take the role of a normal and successful guy married to a gorgeous Russian woman. You met her online and following a quick long distance courtship, you paid for her trip out of Russia and the fancy engagement ceremony that followed. Since then life has been good and you've been the envy of many.

title: The Repairing Mantis
description: The Repairing Mantis is a narrative horror game that lets you experience the disturbing, violent nightmare of a mantis on a mission to repair a bridge made of flying squirrel flesh.

title: Harvest Moon: Light of Hope - Special Edition: Doc's & Melanie's Special Episodes
description: Help out Melanie and Doc in two side stories that will unlock new shops! Melanie is in a designing slump, and needs your help for inspiration! Meanwhile, Doc is having trouble in the romance department! Can you help him out?

title: Skotos
description: Grab your Lantern and plunge into the darkness of Skotos, a terrifying first-person platforming game that will make you brave the darkness to survive.

title: Your Show Has Been Cancelled
description: Your favorite show has been cancelled due to unbelievable circumstances. Take down foes who dare to get in your way in randomly-generated dungeon levels as you adventure to figure out what really happened and bring back your show!

title: Monica's Revenge Tragedy
description: Boyish heroine Monica sets out to take revenge. The abuse is frantic in each and the animation is a must-see.

title: Sweet Match 3
description: Sweet Match 3 is a simple match 3 game. Drag and drop the candy and get a high score. Made in Construct 3. Enjoy your game!The game has nice graphics and music.Collect as many Jelly as you can and get the most points.Forward!

title: Drag Engineer
description: If you are interested in programming, you will like the game. You will play an engineer, use the mouse to drag various instructions to write programs, and let them run normally to meet the requirements of the boss. Some levels test your logic ability very much. Please think carefully before you act.

title: Domynyo
description: Post-apocalyptic and Abandonment are the protagonists of the 1st Season. Dark locations and abandoned places in a 4k world. The day-night cycle and climate conditions will influence the game to the point that you could find yourself in the dark seeking for a torch and praying for the storm to end.

title: Wager
description: Wager is roguelike about winning a game of dice against a hacker goose.

title: The Island of Dr. Yepstein
description: The Island of Dr. Yepstein - an uncompromising first-person action shooter that takes place on a paradise tropical island. The player in the role of a super-cool commando will have to meet face to face with dangerous enemies and solve all the secrets of the mysterious island.

title: Skattered Dream
description: A Difficult Platformer, Skattered Dream is a tribute to the classic games of the 80's. It may look dated but this little game that still could can pack a serious punch. Its not easy to survive in this world but boy is it fun!

title: Fire and Ashes
description: It's 1977. Henry Gray awakens in a psychiatric hospital, haunted by the ghosts of his past. Fire and Ashes await: An immersive survival horror where nothing is certain, insanity and reality mix, and voice recognition means every monster will hear you scream - within the asylum and beyond…

title: 69 Erika Love
description: 69 Erika Love - Play an exciting puzzle game with Erika. Everyone's beloved Miss Erica stays after class especially for you. Collect all the pieces of the puzzle and open the reward. Relaxing music and meditative gameplay will allow to have a good rest after work .

title: Haunted Hotel: The Axiom Butcher - Collector's Edition
description: Eleven years after the Axiom Butcher's reign of terror in the hotel, the murders have resumed. It's up to you to uncover the mystery behind this madman and help the hotel guests.

title: Love Colors: Pixel Adventurer
description: Pixel Adventurer includes 110+ new images in new categories and takes you on a world tour painting iconic scenes like the Eiffel Tower, Big Ben and Sydney Opera House as well as other majestic citiescapes and beautiful landscapes.

title: Love Colors: Happy Pixels
description: Happy Pixels features 130+ new images including yummy sweets, exciting sports and vehicles, farming, emotes as well as festive periods for Christmas and Halloween.

title: Love Colors: All in One
description: Love Colors - All in One Pack Includes DLC 1 - Happy Pixels features and DLC 2 - Pixel Adventurer.

title: Project: Cow
description: A strategy game focused on stealth mode, your objective is to escape from the Spaceship hiding in hiding places without the Aliens noticing your movement. Be patient with the cow grandma, the poor thing is old and doesn't move so quickly.

title: Synthwaifu: Neon Space Fighter
description: Synthwaifu: Neon Space Fighter is inspired by the arcade games of the 80s. Destroy waves of enemy spaceships to score points and unlock all the drawings.

title: Vivid Surf
description: Vivid Surf is a new take on the glitch made mechanic called 'surf'. Glide frictionlessly through the surreal environments in a single-player focused campaign. Get rewarded as you improve your skill with a comprehensive timer. Then take the skills you learned to the multiplayer Remball arena.

title: Infinite Cube Defense
description: If you want to spend a little time playing games and keep moving and catching monsters, start right now.

title: Loop Timer
description: A timer cycle permanently

title: Billiards Legend: Black 8 Miracle
description: This is the most challenging billiards game. Exquisite graphics quality, Sidespin, masse, jump ball! Enjoy the billiard ball collision!

title: GHD
description: GHD: It is a multiplayer shooter. Where it puts the players in the face of some of them. And the winning team gets points and coins. There are five game modes. There are many weapons to pick up. This game is different from all games where the battle environment gives a very beautiful impression

title: Koala Quest: Parenthood Prevention
description:
Koala recently got knocked up, but she's not at all enthused about giving birth and raising a kid. It's up to her and her neighbors to find the herbs necessary to end pregnancy.

Action! Diplomacy! Adventure! Elemento! This multi-genre game has it all! Or maybe just those four things.

title: Z: Escape - Aftermath
description: Test or prepare yourself against the main villains.

title: Arizona Sunshine: Dead Man
description: Welcome to the final days before the zombie apocalypse! Arizona Sunshine – Dead Man DLC drops you in an infested US missile base where you will lead a frantic attempt by US Army Special Forces to contain the expanding zombie outbreak in the American Southwest.

title: The Escapists: Santa's Sweatshop
description: After suffering Santa's cruel regime for 20 years, it's time you got back home to enjoy Christmas with your real family. Sick and tired of bad working conditions and rubbish pay, you decide to hit Santa where it hurts most and escape Santa's Sweatshop!

title: Rico: Breakout
description: A mass break-out at the San Amaro prison has brought to the streets a dangerous and unpredictable set of enemies. With a city-wide ordinance in place, the RICO team is drafted in to help.

title: Dialogue Box: The Road Less Traveled
description: A rage-inducing skill based game with a dynamic story that unfolds using the player choices

title: Black Knight: Milena
description: A gifted rookie Black Knight Milena is making her great debut!! …Or at least that was her goal before she messed up on her mission because of her inexperience. And so began her training to become a better Black Knight with Master Celia! If only her behavior could also be improved…

title: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven - Part Two
description: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven: Part Two continues your story as you escape Nightfall with your new group of survivors in search of a safe haven. Continue your story from part one, or skip right to the new chapters with a new character!

title: Classic Tanks 2020
description: Classic Tanks - a pleasant game in the classic style of retro tanks in a new comprehension. Capture bases, complete levels and destroy enemies. The game has more than 20 missions, several types of enemies and bonuses.

title: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings - Great Adventures in New Worlds Vol. 2
description: This bundle will add two new areas to the game: a BLUE REFLECTION tribute area "Blue Sentiment Land" and the "Ventus Mines" area.

title: Earth Attack
description: Tragedy strikes as aliens attack Earth. You're left alone to pilot the last remaining spacecraft on its way back to Earth from Mars Colony. Avoid missiles, asteroids, enemy ships, and more as you accumulate high-scores in Earth Attack!

title: Santa Claus in Trouble HD
description: Help Santa to collect lost christmas presents in this wonderful 3D Jump'n'Run experience. An exciting arcade adventure is just waiting for the kids in your life and especially the kid in you!

title: Escape the Ayuwoki: The Summoning
description: Re-experience the tragic, final moments that occurred in the burning mansion as you try to escape far away from it. You play as Alexa, another survivor from the mansion who is trying to get away from the horrors of this haunting place.

title: Super Indie Square: Fight Against Time
description: In Super Indie Square - Fight Against Time your goal is collect all the coins before time runs out, and any simple mistake is fatal.

title: PBA: Basketball Slam - Arcade Edition
description: PBA Basketball Slam: Arcade Edition! This zany and quirky arcade-style basketball features epic moves, high-flying dunks, and witty commentary that will keep you at the end of your seats. It’s basketball stripped down to its most fun and basic components which makes it easy to pick-up and enjoy.

title: Zombie Hunter
description: In an apocalyptic world full of dangers, the only thing you can trust is the weapon in your hand. Survival must be earned by yourself.

title: The Plague: Kingdom Wars - Dead Rising
description: The Dead Rising DLC adds an optional Undead mode to The Plague: Kingdom Wars campaign. The millions infected with the Black Death will soon turn into an even deadlier plague, as hordes of undead aimlessly roaming Europe, destroying everything in their path.

title: Einar: Loki's Traps
description: Einar is a Viking who, finding himself a god, had a surprise.

title: Impossible Mission Remastered
description: “Stay a while, stay FOREVER!” Race against the clock to gather the pieces of a secret password, platforming through 32 rooms and dodging 90 different deadly robot guards to stop the evil plans of the sinister Elvin Atombender in this all-time classic, now remastered for Steam.

title: fullybroKen
description: Play as single character in a 4x game. Survive. Thrive. Die. Unite the country of Mir. Kill, make hard choice, become anything you want in this unique post-apocalyptic game. Die. With ideas from 4X, Match-3 RPGs, Traditional RPGs and roguelikes, fullybroKEN offers an experience unlike anything else.

title: Rabi-Ribi: Cicini's Halloween!
description: Cicini wants to get everyone hyped for Halloween! Her plans include new mini side story, new areas, new enemies and a whole new boss fight with new music!

title: United Assault: Normandy '44
description: An open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Normandy. Unlock authentic weapons and take part in the unique passive multiplayer.

title: In Fear I Trust: Episode 3 - Iron and Rust
description: “In Fear I Trust” 3rd Episode tells us about the strange events at the local factory. They took place when the player used to work there. The mysterious deaths, the mysterious inspectors. Advancing the episode, the player tries to find out what is really going on and how this is related to VERSA company. Why are people dying on a scheduled basis?

title: Age of Reforging: The Freelands
description: Welcome to medieval high-freedom sandbox adventure CRPG!You'll be a reforger in freelands chosen by the Goddess to embark on medieval adventure tour at your own pace, gathering teammates, seeking survival, and craft your unique legend!

title: Super Lucky's Tale: Gilly Island
description: Welcome back to adventure! "Super Lucky's Tale", returns with an all new chapter. Join Lucky as he journeys to the tropical resort of "Gilly Island" where Lady Meowmalade has hijacked the festivities and is throwing the greatest (worst) party ever.

title: Air Attack
description: Take a 5 minute break to de-stress with this high-intensity, ultra simple, retro arcade shooter! Take down airplanes. Dig tunnels. Hide and seek shelter. Try and beat the highscore. That's all. Afterwards, you will go back to your life with renewed energy of body and mind.

title: Hentaicraft
description: Hentaicraft is a sandbox with an endless open world that consists of cubes. Your possibilities here are limited only by your imagination. Get resources, build, travel and enjoy a cute character!

title: Automobilista: Legendary Tracks Part 3 - Hockenheim
description: Part 3 of Legendary Tracks has arrived - the classic Hockenheimring from Germany, featuring 4 distinct versions from 4 different decades - 1977, 1988, 2001 plus the modern GP versions and several alternative layouts.

title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth3: V Generation - Giant Island
description: The Giant's Island DLC brings exactly that - an island inhabited by stronger enemies! A perfect place to relax in the sun and grind!

title: Bad Vibes
description: BAD VIBES is a weird, wild homage to the golden era of first-person shooters. Trapped in an alien maze, you're forced to survive as long as you can. Run around collecting keys and vaporizing all the baddies that get in your way. The longer you stay alive, the more bad vibes you crush, the higher your score when you win. BAD VIBES is pure shooter madness, the way it was intended to be.

title: Caapora Adventure: Ojibe's Revenge
description: Explore a beautiful world inspired by Amazon rainforest with many secrets, puzzles and creatures from myths and legends from Brazilian Folklore

title: Ignis Universia: Awakening of the Erudite Empress
description: Ignis Universia is a cute and funny JRPG and Visual Novel mix with a seasoning of tongue-in-cheek story that references to old genre classics. May contain references to stereotypes and clichés (RPG, fantasy, music, anime and small doses of other nerdy interests).

title: eSports Manager
description: eSports Manager is an eSports organization manager simulator. Sign players and staff, manage squad, training and tactics to achieve the title of the best team in the world!

title: Affairs of the Court: Choice of Romance - A Life Mage Child
description: If you start a new game beginning in Episode 3: 'Til Death Do Us Part, this option unlocks the ability to make your son Antonio a Life Mage, putting him in line to inherit the throne.

title: Car Trader Simulator: Welcome to the Business
description: Welcome to the prologue to Car Trader Simulator. Here you will learn all the most important in mechanics and economics in the game and you will play your first mission.

title: The Remainder: Act 2
