description: A classic addictive/fun indie mini game for windows that you will play every time!. Do you ever wonder what is like to be in a realistic combat arena and how it feel? Play as Octavius , the greek warrior who is forced to fight in the gladiatorial arenas with many of the best soldiers in the empire..

title: Dkls
description: In DKLS you can be a person, but you can also be a car, a cactus, a microbe, a penguin or even a pencil. Feel the experience of dissociating from your own reality.

title: Triple Take
description: Triple Take is a fast 2D precision platformer where the stage evolves as you complete it! Run, wall jump, climb and swim through increasing difficult levels in vibrant colored worlds!

title: Legend of Labot: The Golden Pearl
description: An action-packed adventure through a breathtaking island of Moran where cute little creatures and powerful monsters live alongside humans. Slay monsters and bosses, collect pearls, unlock powerful abilities and ultimately seek the elusive golden pearl.

title: Unsafe Express
description: Unsafe Express is a cooperative first-person survival horror game for 1-4 players. Navigate through space stations, collect materials and outlast your enemies! Choose your objective based on complexity levels, then cast your vote. Gather items, exterminate hostiles, fulfill missions and repeat!

title: They Are Coming
description: They Are Coming is a hybrid game that combines roguelike, tower defense, and base building in a side-scrolling shooter format. It offers a straightforward gaming experience for pure enjoyment.

title: Wide Open
description: 'Wide Open' was born out of a love for old-school, top-down racing games. We've done our part to make it fresh and set it apart from the rest. With a fully deformable terrain, you can be sure that no lap will be like the last. There are many terrain types like asphalt, dirt, sand, mud, and more!

title: Ghost Terminator
description: Let's vanish some ghosts! Explore, shoot, run, throw grenades, have some fun and get a little scared. Your mission is to find and annihilate all the ghosts.

title: Am I the baddie?
description: Fetch some friends for fun, fast online multiplayer. One of you is the baddie! Everybody else is trying to find the baddie. The baddie is invisible. At least, most of the time...

title: Queen of Zarkov
description: 'Queen of Zarkov' is an 'indie-3rd-person-shooter' that combines elements of 'Escape from Tarkov' with zombies. Embark on missions and loot everything you can, while surviving against different types of zombies and other deadly threats. All your Equipment will be lost if you die, so try to survive!

title: Poly Racing
description: Poly Racing is a low poly casual racing game that for some reason is really fun to drift in. Pick and paint whatever car you like, and just have fun drifting and jumping around. And Poly Racing, early access or not, is going to be a community driven game.

title: Bravest Burden
description: You must protect the last light in a world of darkness. Bravest Burden is a cooperative, multiplayer RPG. In order to survive this brutal world, you will need to look out for each other during your treacherous adventures.

title: Alchemist's Mountain
description: Alchemist's Mountain is a dungeon solving, adventure platformer rendered in hi-bit pixel art. It tells a heartwarming story of courage and endearing characters, looking to find their place in a world of magic and science.

title: Against Ether
description: A fantasy RPG with music based fights where you will help a young girl to change the fate of the world!

title: Void of Space
description: Void of Space is an RPG, horror-survival game, a science fiction adventure. Explore the colonizer ship Genesis IV, abandoned in the atmosphere of an unknown alien planet. Craft items, find weapons and equipment to defend against the hostile life forms you encounter.

title: Crusade of Deitra
description: RPG 2D, Single Player

title: Running Water
description: You are a "Runner" known as subject #0076101, created out of water by a tyrannical A.I. that runs the facility. During testing an error occurs and you are released unexpectedly into the basement where you must run, jump, climb and fight for your freedom using the tools found along the way.

title: Clash of the Metal
description: Hyper Mecha Anime Manga Fighting Unleashed! Clash of the Metal introduces the mecha combat league in a glorious 2D anime styled arcade action fighting game..

title: Beneath the Mountain
description: In Beneath the Mountain, you play as the King of a new Dwarven civilization seeking to find their fortune beneath the mountain. You dig your way through the mountain, encountering many dangerous foes along the way, all while defending your kingdom from periodic Orc invasions.

title: Umbra: Journey Home
description: Umbra: Journey Home is a single-player, 3D puzzle game. Entering lights will cause you to lose control. Create shadows by moving objects in your environment to pass through. Adventure through a mysterious world to discover answers.

title: Noble's Life: Kingdom Reborn
description: Mix of realistic medieval noble simulator with a strategy game of historical depth. Manage your city and villages and make decisions in non-linear events. Command defenses in epic sieges and organize dangerous raids.

title: Force Reboot
description: Force Reboot is a fast-paced nonstop FPS with rogue-lite elements. Force Reboot is entirely focused on nonstop gameplay. You need to get past all of the rooms as fast as you can.

title: Traffic Chase
description: Road racing game. Beep at any traffic driver to start the race! Connect more drivers at any time! Earn money on road races, tune or buy a new car, participate in more racing events. Keep on racing!

title: Cat Capacity
description: A crazy cat lady simulator.

title: Midnight Blues
description: Smash, slash, and shoot your way to freedom through the bloody criminal underworld of a dark, future New York. Midnight Blues features fast-paced, unforgiving combat that will tug at your nerves until every man but you is dead.

title: Facteroids
description: Facteroids is a 3D factory building game about asteroid mining in space. Prospect, mine and manage your production lines in a variety of scenarios and procedurally generated worlds across the entire Solar system.

title: Lost Twins 2
description: A cute puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic of moving the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to help Ben & Abi navigate this mysterious world. Engage in clever puzzles & overcome obstacles to help them re-unite & find their way back home

title: Delicious Fruitworld
description: Delicious Fruitworld is a classic jump 'n' run platformer where the goal is to complete each level with as many points as possible.Points are awarded for fruits distributed in the world and for a good time in which the level was passed. Share your score!

title: Code of the Savage
description: Inspired by the classics from the 80s and 90s - Code of the Savage is a western RPG with a heavy emphasis on exploration and NPC interaction. It features a large, seamless open world to explore. There is a focus on player freedom and the consequences that go along with that.

title: Dinogotchi
description: Dinogotchi is a tamagotchi-like game featuring cute dinosaurs. Take care, evolve, have fun and give lots of love to your little jurassic friends!

title: Below the Ocean
description: Dive deep "Below the Ocean" in search of legendary treasures while using your oxygen lifeline to swing passed obstacles! Run, Jump, Swing, Bubble-Jump, Bungee, Slingshot, Puzzle-Solve, Platform, Treasure-Hunt, BELOW THE OCEAN!

title: Tower to Heaven
description: Tower To Heaven is a simple, fun and pretty JRPG. Climb the tower, relax and battle bad guys and reap the reward.

title: Valor
description: Embark on a epic journey through a range of different environments and arenas. Upgrade, personalize and finetune your characters, overcome different challenges and bossfights to prove the single most important thing: your worth as a gladiator.

title: Fira
description: A lovely and emotional 3rd-person puzzle game centered on Kara: a young woman who deals with a painful past experience. Armed with her elemental skill, help her try to find her way accross a mysterious land and put an end to this pain.

title: SwapOut
description: A roguelike FPS game, focusing on gun customization and fast gameplay. Survive the zombie apocalypse, and possibly end it.

title: Necromancer's Gift
description: Necromancer's Gift is a Monster tamer sprinkled with roguelike elements like permadeath and procedurally-generated maps. Capture and face creatures in turn-based battles as you attempt to rescue your dog from a Necromancer that hates humans.

title: Heart & Soul
description: A romance otome visual novel set in Ancient Greece that follows the myth of Psyche as she falls in love with her mysterious husband. Navigate fickle gods and Psyche's looming tragic fate by making meaningful choices that affect the story and its ending.

title: Shinorubi
description: Shinorubi is a Bullet Hell Shoot'em up in the tradition of Danmaku games. A pure dose of adrenaline and frenetic arcade action. Choose your pilot and a spaceship, face powerful Bosses, and experience many cool Arrange Mods!

title: Turing Complete
description: In this challenging puzzle game, you build a computer from scratch and program it. It is a journey through the layers of abstractions of the computer. The game begins when you are abducted by aliens who are testing your intelligence, and from here a lighthearted sci-fi plot evolves.

title: Dance Like a Butterfly, Shot Like a Bee!
description: The steampunk and biological indie game!

title: Starship
description: An unofficial port of Star Fox 64 for PCs including enhancements.

title: Ninja: Rise of a Hero
description: The path of the ninja is hard! Can you save your beloved and become a hero?

title: Orph: The Lost Boy
description: Orph - The Lost Boy is a first-person horror game where you have to find out what happened with your son. Explore an old orphanage, uncover secrets long forgotten, solve puzzles and don't forget to watch your back.

title: Recall: Empty wishes
description: Recall: Empty wishes is a story-driven game based in Taiwan. The story centers around the desires and memories shared by a brother-sister pair.

title: Caves Of Mars
description: Caves of Mars is a new 2D sci-fi action adventure space shooter game set in the mysterious caves of the planet Mars. Your mission is to navigate your spacecraft through 100 procedurally generated levels, battle against and destroy enemies and alien lifeforms and collect as many gems as possible.

title: Randy and Teddy Adventure Road
description: A puzzle 2.5D platformer where Randy, main character, and Teddy, his pup go on an amazing adventure road! Go with them and travel to 5 different worlds where you'll meet pesky robots that will make this journey hard. Solve challenging puzzles and earn stars and achievements as you go!

title: Eternal Evil
description: A small town is being taken over by ghouls. Solve puzzles, carefully read notes and use various weapons against horrific and evolving enemies to uncover what is behind this gruesome event. Eternal Evil is an old-school survival-horror game.

title: Core Alpha
description: Core Alpha is an arcade first-person shooter, which is made in the best traditions of old-school shooters. Fight and defeat hordes of zombies, as well as destroy infected cores to fight the main enemy.

title: Yacht Dice
description: Yacht Dice is a classic dice game popular around the world, each player by throwing dice statistics score to carry on the game, the player with the highest score wins. Invite friends to play online, or compete against players from around the world.

title: 100 Hidden Birds 2
description: Hidden object game in the cartoon city style. Animation and puzzles. Very large location. Ultra hard! Really very difficult!

title: Rd Mars
description: RD Mars is a top-down shooter where you play as an AI reconstruction of a once-great inventor, Felix Darwins. Explore the laboratory, and learn of his rise and downfall.

title: Puzzle Art: Cats
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with cats.

title: Grid Slayer
description: A unique tactical grid based card game with roguelite elements. Use elemental wizardry to manipulate your environment and defeat overwhelming odds. Test your wits and resolve to rise above the chaos.

title: Smashing time
description: VR destruction simulation, destroy everything in the museum, the oval office, a restaurant or a simple flat ! Wreak havoc and let the devil out !

title: Twelve Floors Below.
description: A claustrophobic horror game taking place in an elevator.

title: Professor of Magical Studies
description: Professor of Magical Studies is an interactive magical school novel by Stephen Granade, where your choices control the story. It’s entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Magical Inspector Momo
description: Magical inspector Momo uncovers the dirty secrets of adults! She must infiltrate without being discovered by anyone and without being caught in a trap!

title: Iris Covenant: Song of the Forgotten Heroes
description: Old School RPG.You accepted a request to save the world from a religious group called Levin Relief Society. Ancient mysteries and unknown dangers are waiting for you ahead the journey.

title: Dungescape!
description: Dungescape! is a casual, minimalist escape-room game in which players control Celeste, a young noblewoman who has been trapped in a series of mazes of ever-increasing size and complexity. More than 40 rooms await to challenge adventurers in this humble kickoff for solo-dev Autism Fanaticism Gaming!

title: Oh, Dungeon Master
description: Oh, Dungeon Master is a dungeon simulator, with elements of a roguelike game. Explore the intricate underground mazes and dense forests to exterminate monsters and find all the pictures!

title: My Inner Darkness is a Hot Anime Girl!
description: My Inner Darkness Is A Hot Anime Girl! is a 3D turn-based RPG game featuring surreal enemy designs and dream-like locations, packed into a gripping story about overcoming the thoughts and memories you would rather not have but can't stop thinking about. You know, the ones that keep you up at night.

title: Pussy 4
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Andarilho: Aliens
description: Survive among aliens!

title: Smelted Kin
description: Science fiction 2D shooter with platformer and metroidvania elements. Players will have to explore a huge research complex consisting of nonlinear levels, which is crowded with robots

title: LineVox 2: Forward to the Past
description: LineVox 2: Forward to the Past - a casual cyberpunk game suitable for both one player and several players with the ability to play on one computer, over a local network or online.

title: Tentacles of Submission
description: Horny kraken with lustful tentacles versus anime girls!

title: Street Legal: Revision
description: Take the STREET ACTION to the next level, in this loving re-release of the 2002 bargain-bin classic! Featuring over 1000 unique swappable parts, 16 detailed vehicles to tune, race, destroy and maintain, a large city to unlock, and much more, now with plenty of fixes and improvements!

title: Cubicus 2
description: Continuation of the first part of the puzzle in which you will find even more levels of varying difficulty.

title: Tactics of World War I
description: Tactics of World War I is a real time tactics (RTT) game that puts you in the role of a military leader in the First World War. It requires you to plan your actions thoroughly and make smart tactical decisions in the blink of an eye.

title: Dirty Wars: September 11
description: Dive into the clandestine life of resistance against Pinochet's military regime where people are captured, tortured and murdered on a daily basis. Solve challenging puzzles and explore Santiago without getting caught in this sinister part its history.

Coop sci-fi battleroyale action offline/online multiplayer game. It's 2300 AC, Beings from planet Venus are back and they declare WAR to humans with zombies. Play Singleplayer or Multiplayer, military weapons with autocombust ammo, make body parts fly, clear the area from deadly hordes, Just action!

title: Get in the Car, Loser!: Battle on the Big Boardwalk
description: Take a break from adventure and relax on the beach in BATTLE ON THE BIG BOARDWALK — an all new story chapter featuring 15 new endgame items, an all new sword to rival the Sword of Fate, our hardest boss yet, and most importantly... beach outfits for everyone you can use at any time.

title: Daggan
description: A sexy furry game where you reproduce to make big armies and build cities.

title: Crossing Guard Joe
description: In Monoxide City where the cars don't stop, only one man can help kids cross the street.

title: Echo: An Indie Tale
description: You are fragile and the world is dangerous. Explore with care and courage. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, in search of something. An outlet? An answer? A hope? A doubt?

title: VR Fitness Gym
description: VR Immersive Fitness Gym: 6 New VR Exercises You Never Experienced. Bored with exercise? Virtual reality, immersive fitness might help you.

title: Covid-19 (Corona Virus)
description: Do you have what it takes to perform everyday tasks and curve balls life gives you to survive this quarantine? If you do you will get out this quarantine successfully and life will go back to normal.

title: A Sinful Camp
description: "Please protect me... Please get me out of here..." Spike was taken to a concentration camp where he met Anna, the goddess he had loved for years, only to find out she was being abused every night in the cell next to his. Spike, who had been peeping at everything in anger and pity, became obsessed with this painful desire.

title: One Pixel TWB
description: 2D platform game with minimalist pixel art graphics, create platforms and shoot a lot to defeat several bosses that have invaded your castle and are trying to destroy your city.

title: Namaiki Dark Elf Sisters
description: The half-human, half-elf Ober grew up discriminated against by his own family due to his mixed heritage, but one day a prophecy flips that life upside down. Now declared as the future head of his family, the sisters that once mistreated him are ordered to serve him and bear his children.

title: The Prisoner of the Night
description: The Prisoner of the Night is a single-player platforming game with a wide range of scenarios, where the lovely girl Nartide must survive terrible monsters and deadly traps in the darkest, scariest night of her life.

title: Protect Sea War
description:
Battle of the Sea is an RTS real-time battle of the sea game - a real battle on your computer!

The game can be free to operate large cruisers, medium-sized cruisers, mine boats, torpedo boats, submarines, aircraft, tanks, soldiers.
Use strategy to defeat the enemy and defend the country's territorial waters.

title: UFO Checkers
description: A classic game of checkers to play with your friends. Turn-based and themed after an alien invasion.

title: Animal Cafe
description: A magical restaurant discovered by animal friends! Choose from 7 cute chefs, cook with roguelike food cards, and experiment with 100+ cookware and sauces. Create flavorful combos, please your guests, and enjoy the cozy charm of Animal Cafe!

title: Cuckoo Curling
description: Curling with the rules of connect four! A fun, healthy and relaxing hobby for everyone. Just watch out for the crocodile.

title: Gardenia
description:
Plant flowers and buy seeds in this puzzle game!

Each flower planted has it's quirks and gives you a certain amount of points when planted. Fill your garden with flowers until you reach the needed points to progress, each stage it will get harder.

title: Indigo Child
description: Play as the mystical Indigo Child and save some souls while wandering through the forest. The game is designed to work with both keyboard and 360 controller. It is a gamejam style experience.

title: Sheep's Quest
description: You`ll love this stimulating Brain Teaser in which you guide a herd of sheep through seven game worlds in an effort to collect enough coins to rebuild their once magnificent farm. Steering the adorable animals around enemies and obstacles to the riches they need is as simple as placing arrows on the ground pointing the way. Featuring colorful graphics and delightful audio, Sheep`s Quest is sure to become one of your favorites!

title: Scarred Stars: Traumatic Edition
description: Enter amusement park from hell and escape with your sanity - if you can! Adventure through a ruined amusement park with a dark past. Escape monsters and discover multiple endings in this survival horror game!

title: Honya Monogatari
description: Honya Monogatari is a bookstore management sim by Kairosoft.

title: Emanate
description: Emanate is a single-level, vertical world filled with jumping patterns made up of various platforming mechanics. The most common of which are the orange/red bounce pads, purple wall-jump pads, and the fading platforms, that vanish from under your feet after a very short amount of time. Combining these simple mechanics urges you to keep moving forward, making for some incredibly challenging and intense platforming gameplay.

title: Alphabet
description: A stage-clearing 3D wire action game that tests your "use of wire movement inertia" and "puzzle-solving skills." The shapes of all 26 stages are based on various letters of the alphabet. Complete the missions for each stage!

title: Synth
description: Synth is a strategic action game, in which the player must find an exit in a procedurally generated landscape. The player is equipped with a laser, bombs, and a device that acts as a vacuum or blower. The overall goal is to reach the highest level possible.

title: Purrfect Tale
description: This story is told through interactive comics. You'll need to consider and make your choices to progress. What will you do when the cat you take in turns into a human? What kind of outfit will you wear for your spring outing...? Each interaction will give you a chance to better understand your cat-eared youth. Each time you try your best, you'll have a chance to get one step closer to your dream. Each action you take will impact the continuation of the story. So, what kind of choices will you make?

title: Railroads Online
description: Build your dream railroad across a huge open world! You can build tracks and stations, drive detailed locomotives, and transport goods to earn money and experience. Play exciting Online Multiplayer sessions with your friends or create your very own Single-player sandbox!

title: Chronicles of Etia: A Samhain Story
description: Episode one of a four-part prequel. A story of magic, mayhem and fairies. A perfect game to get into the Halloween spirit. If you enjoy RPGs from the SNES period then this may be the game for you, as my big inspirations for the game were Lufia and Breath of Fire.

title: Choo-Choo Charles
description: Navigate an island in an old train, upgrade it over time, and use it to fight an evil sentient train that terrorizes your home. Charles is hungry; don't be his next meal.

title: Blade of Darkness
description: A portal from the abyss appeared in the town. In order to protect the town, the protagonist of the warrior decided to enter the portal to prevent the invasion of the abyss.

title: Touhou Monster TD
description: Easy to learn but hard to master, Touhou Monster TD is a unique Tower defense Game. Control your character, level up and unlock tower skills and character talents, use your wisdom to defeat incoming enemies. Travel the Gensokyo, find out why the "Incident" happened this time.

title: Fuyu no Tsuma
description: Fuyu no Tsuma is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Holiday Mosaics: Halloween Puzzles
description: Holiday Mosaics: Halloween Puzzles – enjoy 120 puzzles made from colorful and breathtaking photos

title: Treasure of Cutuma 3rd: Call of Guru
description: The game is a free add-on for the base game. This game is made using the GAMEGURU, FPS engine. An ambitious work that challenges the limits of GAMEGURU.

title: Tiger Striker: MP041
description: This is a shoot em up game. In this game the player combats a large number of enemies by shooting at them in the space. The player will destroy the core of the battleship of enemy to win the game. The DLC includes map pack 041.

Kingslayers is a free-to-play Roguelite featuring both turn-based and real-time strategy elements. Select your team and choose your skills, then jump into a run to see what broken builds you can create!

Once you get your bearings, you can conquer ever-increasing ascension difficulties in single-player mode or enter multiplayer and try to climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Singleplayer- Relax and Enjoy the ride

Theory craft and min-max to your hearts content in this chill mode. See how high you can go in the ascension ranks or just create some cool unique builds. How about a build where you constantly have a Dragon die to make use of its on-death true damage dealing fireball passive? Or one where each shot from the archer fires 30 arrows? There's thousands of builds waiting for you to explore.

Multiplayer- A turn based game where speed and reaction time actually matters.

The multiplayer is designed for fast-paced, chaotic action. You and your opponent will traverse an identical run and meet at different stages to showcase your builds and outwit each other. This isn't your regular turn-based strategy - speed, quick decisions, and quick reactions are going to play a major part in you climbing to the top of the rankings.

description: Every case has a story behind it! You need to find and collect clues in the scene and reason at every level to find the truth. The clues can be associated or cross-layered.

title: Word Game: Episode 0
description: Word game is literally a game of words. Player controls "I" to find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best "I” win!

title: Pieces of Beauty
description: Deemed a Master of the Chinese Bird and Flower Painting Style, Ohara Koson produced hundreds of prints during his life. Discover 7 majestic pieces made by one of Japan's most celebrated artists in this traditional Jigsaw Puzzle Game.

title: Car Wash TD: Tower Defense
description: A simple one-of-a-kind tower defense game where you need to wash cars before they reach the end of the road. Create mazes. Upgrade your towers. Wash all sorts of cars, trucks, boats, and planes.

title: The Dream of Shadowlands: Episode 2
description: Explore a long-forgotten temple crawling with freakish monsters in the second episode of this action-horror RPG, uncovering an ancient history and meeting loveable characters through hand-drawn visuals inspired by 90s anime.

title: Renai Karichaimashita: Koikari - Love For Hire
description: Due to family circumstances, Yuki has only one belief: money will make his little sister happy. And thus, he works part-time jobs late into the night. His plan is to start working full-time after graduation, but his little sister tells him that if he won't go to university, then she won't either.

title: Ancient Warriors Casino Jackpot
description: Ancient Warriors Casino Jackpot - Try your luck, play the BEST Casino game. Experience a luxury classic Ancient Warriors themed casino slots game right now!

title: Super Dungeon Maker: Fink's Awakening
description: Design & Discover trap-ridden dungeons in this free prologue to Super Dungeon Maker - the zelda-inspired dungeon maker where you create & play the dungeons of your dreams and share them with the world.

title: Keyboardkommander
description: A true test of your typing skills, Keyboard Kommander is a fast-paced zombie type’em up, and the story of a conspiracy theorist vindicated. Type through five brutal chapters of gameplay to learn the fate of humanity through the eyes of its would-be savior. Need to kill that zombie? Use your words!

title: NetSpace Saga Ep.1
description: A Space Noir Turn-based Battle JRPG homage of old-classics. In this irreverent story, you follow a crew of Space Truckers as they try to survive in a world of aliens, zombies, robots, androids, the Space Cartels, and terrible secrets, in and out of a virtual Internet that holds its own mysteries.

title: Megajump
description: Only some will reach the top. Will you be one of them? in this precision 3D platformer where every jump is a risk and easy to learn-hard to master controls you will certainly feel rewarded once you start climbing from the Pit of Despair. Just don't fall.

title: Box box
description: The box follows after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box after the box.

title: Wizdom
description: Wizdom is a Role Playing Game、 that focuses on the world of Medieval swords and magic. Based on the Rogue-Like with 3D graphics and Active game system It provides a simple and easy-to-use operation system.

title: Farming Tractor Simulator 2021: Farmer Life
description: Harvest, Cultivate Crops & Live Real Life Of Farmer Simulator As Tractor Driver!

title: Tempo
description: Tempo is a rhythm platforming game, but instead of staying on the beat... You make the beat!

title: Space Defender: Frontier Squadron
description: Lead a squadron against the Drone invasion in a top-down space shooter with RPG depth. Play a voiced story with three endings, hunt pirate captains, step inside the spaceports, send your crew down to the planets you scan, and hold a front that falls without you.

title: CTcity
description: Reality ruins, tiles of CT city block his heart. Imagination flies, plants in the mind become his star. Boy wonders, the road is nowhere to go. Journey begins, the key is just himself. Welcome to CT city!

title: Uncle Office: Uncle Dating Simulator
description: You can play as a newcomer, start a new life, and date 12 uncles

title: Castle of Shikigami 2
description: Castle of Shikigami 2 is the second installment of the dramatic shooter that gained popularity in the arcades, Castle of Shikigami. Players choose one of seven (+1?) characters, each with different unique abilities, and use their shots, special Shikigami attack, and bombs to destroy the enemy. The unique backgrounds of each character are intricately intertwined, creating an interesting storyline for the shooter.

title: LabTrainingVR: Personal Protective - Equipment Edition
description: This basic-level course is designed to enhance laboratory scientists' ability to identify how personal protective equipment (PPE) can help reduce the risk of exposure to hazardous materials, prevent transmission of infectious agents, and demonstrate how to don and doff PPE in the correct order.

title: An Un-epic story: The adventure of Enki and Tiny Freddie
description: Enki and Freddie's contract was simple: defeat a nearby river monster. They knew tentacles would be an issue, but there are other complications too… For example, who left the strange marks on their hands? How do they get rid of them? Find the answers to these mysteries by reading "An Un-epic Story"

title: A Trail of Ooze: Chapter 1
description: A Trail of Ooze is an udderly amoosing point-and-click adventure set on a small Swedish farm. Play as Majros - a sarcastic cow on a mission to save her human and unravel an ooze conspiracy.

title: The Giraffe World
description: Oh no! An evil person has scattered all of the Giraffe's hats, can you help the Giraffe collect them all?

title: Not My President: Level 1
description: This is a 3D-action-shooter. You were sent to a foreign planet to free the kidnapped Earth people. Find all the rocket parts. Assemble the rocket. Free all captives and put them in the rocket. Start the countdown and try not to die during this time.

title: Poker Supreme: Las Vegas
description: Texas Hold'em is a very popular board game and we offer a wide range of poker games for you to choose from. You can challenge yourself against players from all over the world! This addictive game is sure to bring you more fun!

title: Plague Doctor: Contagion - 430 BCE-2020 AD
description: Put yourself in the place of four people in the midst of four devastating historical disease outbreaks. Explore the choices that saved or cost the lives of countless people and the common thread that runs though them all - human nature and greed.

title: Under the Water
description: Travel simulator in the improvised boat around the world completely flooded with water.

title: Hyper Treasure: Macaronic Labyrinth
description: A Super-dimensional Adventure Game. When you press something, happens something ...... Wander through a mysterious world, find your friend, and escape!!

title: Underworld
description: Underworld is a co-op roguelike FPS with waves of monsters, boss fights, and procedurally generated levels. Upgrade your gear, buy weapons, stack buffs, and go deeper into the Underworld to discover its secrets. PC & VR Cross-play.

title: Pax Warrior
description: The game is played from the viewpoint of a U.N. commander, and tasks the player with keeping the peace by making decisions during the Rwandan genocide.

title: Honor of Knight King
description: 《吾王的荣耀》是一款第三人称角色扮演RPG动作游戏，玩家将在竞技场里面与大巫师召唤出来的古代军队进行战斗，您的生存将受到严峻的挑战，残存的军队将视你为敌，只有把他们都消灭了，你才有资格挑战大巫师，在挑战中磨炼自己的反应和直觉，不断变强，直到打败大巫师，让一切重归于平静。

title: Wings of WW2
description: Take to the skies in this 2D depiction of World War 2 in the 1940's. You will be constantly under attack from Enemy war birds hell bent on taking you down.

title: Confessions at Candlewood Lake
description: “Confessions at Candlewood Lake” is a romantic comedy Visual Novel tale of four women who take a surprise long weekend at a luxurious chalet in Candlewood Lake, Connecticut.

title: Rebirth: Beware of Mr.Wang
description: This is a plot-oriented interactive puzzle game. The gameplay uses mouse clicks or drag-and-drop methods to promote the development of the plot. The game tells the story of an ordinary young man who pursues love, grows up in the process of hard work, and finally reaps friendship and love.

title: Strip Black Jack: At the Pub
description: Defeat the woman of your dreams at Strip Blackjack and make her strip for you! What awaits you: Over 80 adult pictures and multiple erotic films! Plus, achievements and hours of fun!

title: Ragdoll Kanojo
description: Have fun with your own virtual ragdoll girl! Customize clothes and style, pose! VR IS OPTIONAL! (But recommended) You can play on your monitor too!

title: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzle 5
description: Challenging 6 x 6 jigsaw puzzles, featuring warrior female characters in epic fantasy settings.

title: Your Sword Is So Big
description: Your Sword Is So Big is an emotional fantasy game. The detailed appearance of the character, a deep combat system and sensual animations will not let you get bored, and the beauty of the local castles and landscapes takes your breath away!

title: Divine Adventure: Act One
description: Step into a large and magical world where you rule not one but two universes. Fight evil, save evil or be evil. What you choose to do defines your character in this text based RPG.

title: Sand Story
description: It's a hot vacation time. Surrounded by an atmosphere of freedom, away from everyday worries, spending free minutes under the starry sky on the seashore, the feelings flare up so often, starting a bright sense of falling in love, which turns into a summer love.

title: Majustsushi Rintiara
description: Rintiara der Lanserge, a sorceress of the Royal Knights, has been fighting against the Rebellion, an organization that does evil all over the world. This time, her mission is to defeat the leaders of the Rebellion in the small country of Ethia. Will she be able to accomplish her mission‼?

title: Cadavers for Dinner
description:
Boukenmeshi features character designs from Takehito Harada. Harada is character designer for the Disgaea franchise, as well as Labyrinth of Refrain and The Witch and the Hundred Knights. Players will gather food and materials from the dungeon as they go, cooking new, weird, and delicious dishes to improve their stats and grow stronger.

The game will incorporate a character generation feature, and involve a party of four characters. Various jobs are available to the party. These include Swordsman, Cook (who can improve the quality and diversity of rations), and even the “Unemployed” Job, which sounds like a Dark Souls-style Deprived character.

Boukenmeshi will also involve survival-game mechanics. This will involve managing the party’s calorie and water intake. Players can cook food while in camp, but also eat ingredients while fighting in strategic battles. These confer status effects and benefits from the consumption.

title: Dragon Quest X Offline: Deluxe Edition
description:
Dragon Quest X Offline is a stand-alone single-player remake of the 2012 MMORPG title Dragon Quest X Online.

Dragon Quest X Offline: Deluxe Edition includes:
- Dragon Quest X: Rise of the Five Tribes Offline game
- Dragon Quest X: The Sleeping Hero and the Guiding Ally Offline DLC
- Dragon Quest X Offline in-game items

After completing the story of both the main game and the DLC, players can carry their progress to the Online version in order to continue their adventure in the world of Dragon Quest X.

title: Microcosmum: Survival of Cells - Campaign Static
description: We are glad to present you with a new additional campaign consisting of 50 missions. In this campaign, all the organisms are static, which can help you to experience the gameplay in another way and apply new tactics. In the course of playing your organisms will get three skills.

title: Plebby Quest: The Promised Land
description: Plebby Quest: The Promised Land will feature two unique stories, one from the Middle East and another from Europe.

title: Hell Yeah! Virtual Rabbit: Missions
description: You thought it was over? Nothing is over!! The Virtual Rabbit Missions will test your shooting and speed-running skills in 50 exciting new challenges. Taking place in a brand new Virtual Reality level, these challenges are spread across 3 difficulty settings and add more than 3 hours of gameplay. Only the mightiest rabbit can survive!

title: Stormworks: Search and Destroy
description: Stormworks: Search and Destroy is the weapons expansion pack for Stormworks. This expansion includes new and fully functioning modular vehicle weapons, hand-held items and mission content. This expansion pack is required for functioning weapons and explosives in Stormworks.

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - Society Islands XP: Bora Bora & Leeward Islands
description: Welcome to Bora Bora and the Leeward Islands, the western part of the Society Islands in the South Pacific. This scenery package for X-Plane features a custom terrain mesh with photo-realistic textures, dense vegetation and country-typical autogen, as well as custom road-networks and sea-routes.

title: AI War 2: The Neinzul Abyss
description: We have encountered the Neinzul before, but never like this. Play as a Necromancer, as a Suzerain, as a Lone Ark, or with or against many of the varied new factions this expansion brings.

title: OMSI 2: Coachbus 250Next
description: Discover the next OMSI 2 add-on in the Coachbus 250 series: Coachbus 250Next!

title: Train Simulator 2022: Salzburg - Wels Route Add-On
description: Climb through the hills and valleys of Austria along the bustling Westbahn, with RSSLO’s Salzburg - Wels route for Train Simulator.

title: Escape Dead Island: Underwater Labs
description: Players will venture into the underwater depths of Ronald Crown’s Lab and discover the horrible truth behind GeoPharm’s research on the island of Narapela. Unlocking these forgotten chambers adds another layer of insanity to Cliff’s zombie infested world.This DLC is free!

title: Ostalgie: Fall of the Curtain
description: The Cold War is coming to an end, and "cradles of the revolution" join the fight for their existence in the system of new world order. But does everyone need the changes?..

title: Darq: The Tower
description: Lloyd is back to explore the mysterious tower filled with new puzzles and creepiness. Playing this DLC does not require finishing the game.

title: The Book of Yorle: Save the Countryside
description: Continue the story in Save The Countryside, the third DLC for The Book Of Yorle. Explore the hillside while fighting against the Evil Ones. Swim in the lake but make sure to hold your breath and don't drown! Search for mysteries that lie beneath the volcano. Find out what happened to the fisherman that supplied the village.

title: Flappy Octane
description: Flappy Octane is an endless level, speed increasing game. It's game set in the future where cars can fly and all we do is pick a car and jump through rings. The rings are generated at random heights and the speed of the game increases. ​How far can you get? Can you get #1 on the leaderboards?

title: Adventurer Manager: Endless Tower
description: Enter the Endless Tower! A bastion of foes lost to time. Here you will be able to battle never-ending waves of foes in dynamically created dungeon maps, which will challenge you more and more the further you rise in the tower! The higher up you get, the greater the rewards will be!

title: 3000th Duel: The Wise Ones
description: 3000th Duel is action-adventure game that has speedy, exciting battles as its charm. Fight against monsters with your own style of battle to travel an unidentified world and discover a secret hidden.

title: Imperiums: Greek Wars - Age of Alexander
description: Imperiums: Age of Alexander DLC takes you on an ultimate grand strategy journey that will challenge your military prowess and political foresight in unique new ways. Relive the clash of major ancient powers on a huge map and earn the title “The Great”.

title: Taimumari: Sweet Legend
description: Himari’s peaceful life didn’t last long. A new evil had appeared in Zaria, threatening the freezing northern lands. However, everything turned out even more surprising than it seemed…

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Night Road: Secrets and Shadows
description: Secrets and Shadows unlocks five new clans, a new Discipline, and two sets of variant powers to explore. Play as five new clans, unleash brand-new powers, and uncover the treasures and horrors of a whole new mission!

title: In Fear I Trust: Episode 4 - The Glimpse
description: In Fear I Trust is a critically acclaimed first-person horror adventure. Explore eerie locations, solve puzzles and unravel the dark truth behind a secret soviet experiment in this story-driven psychological thriller.

title: Wrong Box
description: Wrong Box is a reimagined version of what it felt like to surf the web as a teenager and what it feels like to attempt to access those spaces now. How has the experience of going online changed in the past 10-15 years? What gets preserved and what gets forgotten?

title: Eklips
description: Eklips is a minimalist puzzle game about making squares around a dot. Seems simple enough, but is it really?

title: Disciples: Liberation - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition contains everything you need to take your journey even further. Within, you will find two unique sets of armor, two new weapons, an emotion shard for Avyanna, wallpapers, a digital compendium, the soundtrack, and two packs:

• Yllian Resources Pack - get extra resources to build up your hometown

• Pack with 5 Additional Skill Points - get extra skill points for Avyanna

title: Bringris
description: A non-euclidean, three-dimensional falling block puzzle game. Just like in classic falling block games such as Tetris or Blockout, fill the levels -- once a whole level (30 cubes) is filled, it disappears. Try to fill as many levels as you can!

title: Helltaker: Examtaker
description: Chapter EX: Examtaker is a bonus chapter, following the Abysstaker Ending of the main story.

title: A Noble Circle
description: Hope comes in many dimensions. Find some alongside Mr. Circle. A noble circle's journey through Flatland, a two dimensional world.

title: Toppl.
description: Toppl. is a top down puzzler. Swipe, topple, rotate - Toppl is a perspective puzzle game for fans of spatial brain teasers! The goal is to move and rotate the puzzle pieces so that they match the target-shape. For perfect plays you will be rewarded a star with which you can unlock new stages. Toppl will challenge you over the course of four exciting worlds and 40 different levels with varying puzzle mechanics. For fans of demanding puzzle games is Toppl the right choice!

title: Lines on Sides
description: Arrange the tiles so that their sides match each other in colors. Your task is to arrange the tiles correctly so that each side of them is the same color as the adjacent tiles. When the tiles are properly arranged, black lines appear between them. As a minimalistic game, there are no tutorials or tips in it. You have to understand each mechanic for yourself and use it to solve puzzles. Good luck.

title: My Little Car Wash
description: You're the boss of the car wash - do you get all these cars clean again? The "must have" for all young cars fans! Experiment in your lab and mix your own super wash foam. With the great photo feature you can make funny pictures of yourself. With the permission of your parents you also can send these pictures to your friends. A variety of different vehicles and functions ensures long-lasting gaming fun.

title: Typomancer in the Feather's Way
description: Run, jump and type words to conjure spells and help your typing wizard to disinfect the platforming TyWorld from the slime monsters! Be prepared to type a lot, because it will allow you to reload your feather and control the world around you.

title: Mazeman
description: Mazeman is a game that will challenge you big time thanks to its frantic pace: enter the maze and look for the key while avoiding all kinds of dreadful monsters. Lots of unlockables, monsters, levels, power-ups and collectibles await you in this beautiful endless stream of pixel art mazes filled with some awesome arcade vibes!

title: Relumine
description: Relumine is a puzzle adventure game. A child named Relu delves into an abandoned mine and discovers a magic crystal. With the crystal's power to rotate the world, she explores the ruins of an ancient society, is chased by a giant shadow and guided by mysterious spirits, in search of her long lost Papa.

title: Exit: The Curse of Ophir
description: Prove yourself in a brand new digital adventure: The award-winning game series Exit: The Game now as an app. Escape the curse: Exciting escape room game with an all-new storyline. Conquer the challenge alone: For a single player. The adventure awaits you: Exciting mystery puzzle adventure with multi-layered, creative puzzles. Think beyond the app: Anything can be part of the game! Immerse yourself in the mysterious setting: atmospheric soundtrack, voiced texts and hand-drawn background graphics create a suspenseful atmosphere. Are you ready?

title: Winterlore II
description: There's a new obstacle in Moroi Springs. What is it this time around? Follow the story of Ozana and her new found powers. The traditions she knew inside out bring a new meaning to her way of life and to Mamaie's customs. She'll mend herbs, brew concoctions and cook sweets for the solstice feast. Along the way she'll encounter guests bringing in new beginnings, while others appear uninvited into the home. Winterlore II is the second game set in the universe of Moroi Springs. Uncover the region of Moroi Springs and its mysteries. Discover lost traditions and folklore by solving puzzles. Immerse yourself in the narrative through hand-crafted graphics and an atmospheric soundtrack. Unveil the hidden story by examining old objects and connect the dots.

title: KonMari Spark Joy!
description: Spark Joy! is a storybook puzzle game that takes players through the joyful journey of tidying using the KonMari Method in the form of solving different puzzles. A heartwarming story for everyone. The game features two alternating types of puzzle games, Yin and Yang. “Yin” puzzles help clear the mind through Zen-like garden puzzles. In “Yang” puzzles, players move colorful cubes to a specified shape while clearing away unnecessary blocks. The game’s soundtrack is composed of beautiful tracks with upbeat, uplifting music for “Yang” and soothing notes for “Yin”.

title: Forest Camp Story
description: The great outdoors are calling! Create and run your own campground in this business management sim. Get a lay of the land and find the best places to camp. Before you know it, customers will be setting up tents and taking pictures, making memories that will last a lifetime. But it's not all about peace and solitude. With activities like bird watching, fly fishing, and horse riding, there's no shortage of ways to show your campers a good time! No camping experience? No problem! Set up guided tours to show new campers the ropes, and they'll soon be coming back for more. If you play your cards right, you might get visits from rabbits, squirrels, and other cute critters too! Don't be afraid to branch out and grow your business. Set up a camping goods store in nearby towns to earn extra cash and attract new customers. Get more people interested in your wares, and you might just spark a nationwide camping craze... Answer the call of the wild and start creating the camp of your dreams!

title: Cards! MonkeyBox 2
description:
Lush forests, wild oceans and howling caves. Hot air balloons, cats and deadly deserts.
Swipe your way through a dangerous world. Your fate lies in a deck of cards. Cards! is a story driven puzzle adventure specifically designed with mobile in mind. Simple to start and easy to get lost in. Cards! MonkeyBox 2 is entry #2 of the MonkeyBox Series - a series of playful, experimental, handcrafted titles.

title: Margo: The Bean Adventure
description: Will You Rescue Margo's nation or not? Margo is a bean that was living in peace with his family, but peace could not last so long! An evil sun attacked Margo nation and turned them into black rocks. Now Margo will ride this adventure to rescue his nation by defeating the sun. But through his adventure, he will go through a lot of different puzzles, fight monsters and bosses. 43 levels included. 8 bosses fights with different stages.

title: Stack the Countries
description: Stack the Countries makes learning about the world fun! Watch the countries actually come to life in this colorful and dynamic game! As you learn country capitals, landmarks, geographic locations and more, you can actually touch, move and drop the animated countries anywhere on the screen. Carefully build a stack of countries that reaches the checkered line to win each level. You earn a random country for every successfully completed level. All of your countries appear on your own personalized maps of the continents. Try to collect all 193! As you earn more countries, you begin to unlock the free bonus games: Map It! and Pile Up! Three games in one!

title: Boxing Gym Story
description: Introducing a sim with real punch! Are you the manager this down-on-its-luck boxing gym needs to get back on its feet? Get the town excited about boxing, and more people will start signing up. Stand by the ringside to cheer on your boxers. You never know how a match will go until the very end! And don't forget about marketing - fans are the lifeblood of competitive sports! Rack up more wins, and you'll be able to upgrade your facilities with spa baths, high-class cafeterias, and more. Before you know it, athletes will be lining up to join you! Hire trainers and hone your boxers' skills until they're ready to take on the world! Make your gym unique by outfitting it with facilities of your choice, creating the perfect environment for fostering boxing talent. Don't give up until you get that championship belt! Enjoy all the thrills of an underdog boxing story in Kairosoft's latest management sim game!

title: The Monster Within
description: 50's horror comic themed deck building card game with rougelite progression elements. Stop yourself from turning into a monster, or embrace your inner evil and use your new gifts. Choose from a roster of classic monsters and duke it out in The Monster Within!

title: Nrg
description: Take platforming to the next dimension! Parkour your way around the stage while you collect energy and shoot anyone who gets in your way. Manage your energy level wisely to get the win, then use your earnings to customize your character until your heart's content!

title: Arthurian Legends
description: Arthurian Legends is a medieval first person action game set in the land of Albion during a time of myth and legend. Battle hordes of Saxons, demonic beasts, the undead and worse in thy quest to save Albion from The Masters of the Old Religion.

title: Galaxy's Edge
description: Galaxy's Edge is a SpaceShooter game in which you are a spaceship that has to battle against aliens to save planet earth from destruction.

title: Cinnet
description: An endless night in a house infested with demons in first person!

title: The Cruise 2
description: Space-Invader styled stress relieving retro top-down shooter, with a little taste of dungeon crawling.

title: Jelly Party: Fire
description: A refreshing and fun shooting game, you only need to aim and shoot the tiles flying in all directions. Enjoy shooting in relaxing music!

title: Tanhaji: The Lion Maratha Warrior of Ch. Shivaji
description: The first epic 3d RPG game on Maratha History and Marathi Culture.

title: Zaccaria Pinball: Zankor Deluxe Pinball Table
description: Zankor Deluxe is the next Zaccaria table with a fully animated color display. It also features more modern pinball elements.

title: WRC 9: Toyota Corolla 1999
description: The 1999 champion Toyota Corolla WRC has had the most prestigious drivers behind the wheel and reached the podium in 95% of the races it took part in! A genuine 90s icon!

title: X-Plane 11: FeelThere - KLGA: La Guardia Airport
description: Let’s peek into future and see how the modern La Guardia airport will look like after all constructions and redesign phase is over in around 2023.

title: X-Plane 11: Globall Art SBSP - Congonhas Airport
description: Deputado Freitas Nobre, or simply Congonhas Airport is a domestic airport in the city of São Paulo, the second busiest in Brazil.

title: X-Plane 11: FeelThere - TIST: St. Thomas International Airport
description: TIST public airport located west of the central business district on the island of St. Thomas. It is currently the largest international airport in the United States Virgin Islands and one of the busiest hubs in the eastern Caribbean, our favorite at FeelThere.

title: WRC 10: Subaru Impreza WRC 1997
description: Get behind the wheel of the legendary car driven by Colin McRae and Nicky Grist in 1997, and relive their victory at the Rallye Sanremo in the same year.

title: WRC 10: Arena Panzerplatte SSS
description: Experience the acclaimed German WRC super special stage Arena Panzerplatte at 1:1 scale, famous and loved for its surface changes and many hazards!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: PREG B16mnopux 087
description: Used for regional passenger trains in Poland, Romania, Czech Republic, and Germany this passenger coach features photorealistic fully PBR textures, and many different options.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: PREG B16mnopux 106
description: Used for regional passenger trains in Poland, Romania, Czech Republic, and Germany this passenger coach features photorealistic textures, fully PBR textures, and many different options.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: PREG Bmnopux 003
description: Used for regional passenger trains in Poland, Romania, Czech Republic, and Germany this passenger coach features photorealistic fully PBR textures, and many different options.

title: Chill IV
description: Chill is a relaxing, minimalist maze game.

title: Rekt: Crash Test
description: A high-octane, stunt, arcade game with an addictive combo and trick-based gameplay set in a retro arena. Get behind the wheel - jump, drift, stunt, and compete with others on the way on top the global leaderboard.

title: Running With Rifles: Pacific
description: In RUNNING WITH RIFLES: PACIFIC, you jump back in time to the Pacific theater of World War II, to witness the epic clash between the Imperial Japanese Army and the United States Marine Corps - fighting over tiny specs of turf you've never heard of.

title: Running With Rifles: Edelweiss
description: head to the European of World War II, first parachuting into Sicily before moving on to the invasion of Normandy, Belgium, and more...

title: Train Simulator: B&O Mountain Subdivision: Cumberland - Grafton Route
description: The legendary B&O Mountain Subdivision is an extraordinary, historic, and challenging route - and it is now available for Train Simulator!

title: Don't run out of Soda
description: You'll find yourself in abadoned parking lot, where's mad scientist puts you in difficult situation. You have to escape from his creation. You have five tries.

title: Modular Combat
description: Modular Combat is a role-playing shooter based in the Half-Life universe. Factions face off against each other, and monsters, in the Controlled Combat Testing Facility, which is monitored by a super-computer known as BoSS.

title: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings - New Area: Claudel Prairie
description: This bundle will unlock the "Claudel Prairie" area, created to resemble the vast world of "Atelier Firis," and also will unlock some new character events for Firis.

title: The Lord of The Rings ACG: The Shadow's Fall Expansion
description: The Shadow's Fall is the first expansion for Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game. Coming with 4 new Heroes packs and continuing the Shadow's Reach storyline. Dive further into Bilbo's journey !

title: Dies Irae: Amantes Amentes - Act I: Omnia Vincit Amor (Kasumi & Marie Scenario)
description: Ren Fujii, a young man attending high school in Suwahara City, finds his friendship with his old buddy Shirou Yusa shatter to pieces following a certain incident, ending in a vicious fight that sees Ren hospitalized for two months. he season shifts from autumn to winter - to the dawning weeks of December, with Christmas on the horizon.

title: Arcana: Heat and Cold. Season 1
description: The misfortunes of the unskilled magician who just wanted to make some money and not get into any troubles.

title: Slayaway Camp: Monthly Murderers Series 1
description: Slayaway Camp's first bundle of Monthly Murderer Killers, each with their own special effects, kill animation, and psychotic tendencies.

title: Blade Kitten: Episode 2
description:
Episode 2 continues the story of Kit Ballard, Bounty Hunter, set three months after the original game’s cliffhanger ending. Kit has been living with her once bounty/rival, Justice Kreel, and now seeks to unravel the mysterious threads of the Magasse and their involvement in the troubles on Hollow Wish.

DLC includes 5 additional levels, 3 new blades and 15 unique costumes.

title: Cosmic Cube
description: This is a refreshing horizontal version of the act game, which is still under production and has completed a simple trial version of the first level. It combines combo skills, perfect defense upgrade and other elements. What you want to see will be updated later

title: Coffee Noir: Business Detective Game
description: A unique combination of a business management game and detective novel with elegant graphics in a noir comic-book art style. Experience an advanced business management simulation along with intriguing story set in alternative future of Neo-London.

title: Fisher Online
description: Fisher Online - online wild fishing simulator. Forget about licenses and catch rates. Choose bait or lures and catch fish in Europe and Russia.

title: Fast Detect
description: The experimental graphic story Fast Detect takes place in the postapocalyptic Half-Life 2 universe and is shown from the artist's special point of view.

title: Mini-Dead: Tarot
description: Mini-Dead: Tarot is an expansion for Mini-Dead introducing more bosses, more original music tracks, more achievements and more secrets.

title: Pow!
description: Great physical puzzles. Seconds matter!

title: BrickOut
description: Brickout is a funny game. The aim of the game is to destroy all the bricks and collect any falling power-ups to move to the next level. The game is an ordinary arknoid, with cute graphics and good music. There are 20 levels in the game, can you pass them all?

title: Payload
description: Hack into the retro-futuristic world of Payload! A 3D isometric puzzle-oriented game played on a cube. Its striking graphics and gripping narrative offer a noteworthy experience.

title: Neogeo Pocket Color Selection vol.1: Steam Edition
description: Retro game fans rejoice! Neogeo Pocket Color Selection vol.1: Steam Edition is SNK's legendary handheld console dream collection, containing 10 handheld defining classics, is coming to Steam!

title: Furry Shades of Gay 2: A Shade Gayer - Love Stories Episodes
description: Furry Shades of Gay 2 builds on the first installment of the series to bring you even more love, more puzzles and more hot gay sex! Five new, longer stories with more plot and beautiful art, improved puzzle mechanics, and the hottest sex scenes in the series!

title: Train Simulator 2022: BR Standard Class 4MT Loco
description: *NOTE* This pack is available in the in-game store under the Marketplace tab. You are strongly recommended to find the product there and make your purchase from within the game. The British Railways Standard Class 4 is a class of steam locomotive built during the 1950s primarily for mixed traffic use on secondary routes.

title: Neversong: Coma HD
description: The unaltered, HD Flash classic,"Coma" from 2010, ported to PC in full-screen! A little game about a little boy and a few piano notes.

title: Ball at Work: A Fun and Unique Game of Skill and Patience! - Boss Edition!
description: Stamp your authority in this crazy office with unrestricted access to all levels and many more smashing new features! Participate in the LiveWire series and compete with other users to win prizes and enhance your gameplay experience with exclusive new graphics and themes! LIKE A BOSS!

title: Salvagette
description:
Swipe to move in each of the four directions. Ram into things to destroy them, but avoid the dangerous projectiles.
Upgrade your ship with multiple levels of each of the FOUR upgrades.
Discover each of the FIVE endings, and unlock new music tracks!
Overcome 11 different enemy types, each with a distinct 'elite' form.
Watch replays of your attempts, and see your long-term statistics.
Earn your freedom!
This is an enhanced version of my game 'Salvage', remade and expanded in Godot. On top of new features (listed above), it is now available as a native application on mobile and PC. This should allow it to keep running smoothly into much longer runs, something the original game definitely had trouble with!

title: Rims Racing: Bahrain International Circuit
description: Bahrain International Circuit is an iconic track for motorsport fans. With 5.412km of short straights and slow bends, the changes in pace are highly demanding and present a unique challenge in the middle of the desert!

title: Musical Maze
description:
In the “Musical Maze” adventure, you try in a scattered maze to save your notes from the pause signs. Don't let the pause signs silence you.
Solve the maze, accompanied by music from different regions, and continue your way without being caught by the pause signs.
It consists of minimal 3D models made of notes and played with native instruments, inspired by the sounds of the 7 different continents.
Background sounds specially designed for each section. One sound per move, and these captured sounds repeat in a loop, so you play your own composition. Each level is a new composition.
Millions of players mean millions of compositions.

title: Automation of Sorts
description: Automation* of Sorts is a multiplayer action/puzzle game where you try to keep up with the never-ending maintenance of the automated machines in a variety of poorly-optimized sorting facilities.

title: The Pepper Prince: Episode 2 - The Sadness
description:
A sadness has befallen the Pepper Kingdom. The prince is heartbroken. It is on you to help your friend and find a cure. As the story kicks into gear, you'll be faced with greater challenges and more complex puzzles as you discover new and unexplored worlds, and perhaps even learn the art of putting two items together to make something new!

This DLC unlocks Episode 2 of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1, a quirky point-and-click adventure about love, grief, and the power of friendship. Solve puzzles, meet quirky fairy-tale-inspired characters, and help your friend regain confidence and self-love after heartbreak!

title: Evil Maze
description: Random Iiem and Skills + Hidden elements RPG + Strategy ARPG The game starts in a dark underground maze where a female officer is confined in a prison. She wants to get out of this nightmare maze! Would you like to help her?

title: Bulletstorm: Duke Nukem's Bulletstorm Tour
description:
Play through the entire Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition campaign as Duke Nukem, featuring a fully rerecorded script and brand-new lines from the original voice of Duke!
Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition game required to use this content.

title: Paper Shakespeare: To Date or Not to Date? - Charity Scene: Seriously, Why Are There Still Nazis?
description: Fight robot Nazis. All sales go towards Southern Poverty Law Center, Can't Do Nothing, and Water.org.

title: BasCatball Jupiter: Basketball & Cat
description: Play basketball. In Jupiter. With cats. Are you ready for the whole galaxy's hardest matches? Solve puzzles and win the Bascatball intergalactic championship!

title: The Cycle: Frontier
description: The Cycle: Frontier is a PvP Extraction Shooter driven by suspense and danger. While you search for resources & loot on an alien planet, challenging fights against other players & encounters with vicious creatures constantly threaten your survival & your spoils.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Phantom Parade
description: Jujutsu Kaisen Phantom Parade is a turn-based RPG based on the Jujutsu Kaisen anime and manga series. It focuses on team-based battles, allowing players to utilize characters' cursed techniques, similar to the TV anime.

title: Package Inc
description:
Package Inc. is an inspiring delivery simulator, created by the same developers of Traffix and Railways.
The entire game is available without ads and features lovely milestones that can appeal to those who care most about style. Who wouldn’t like to have the Eiffel Tower in their city?
Package Inc. is a beautiful game about designing a delivery system for a growing city. Build a connection between different hubs and feed multiple destinations, like factories, police stations, cafes, libraries, boutiques, saloons, hotels, pizzerias, pet shops or schools.
As new hubs are active and there is an increase on demand, you can redesign buildings’ position to keep your delivery process as smooth and efficient as possible. Speed and storage capacity are also essential to keep the delivery network running without inconveniences. How long can you keep the orders moving?

title: Ascension: Delirium
description: Long ago, the god Adayu lost his grips on reality, and in his madness, unraveled the realms of Vigil. Heroes from the four factions rose to save their shattered world, and from the ashes rose a new world, New Vigil.

title: Dies Irae: Amantes Amentes - Act II: Nihil Difficile Amanti (Kei & Rea Scenario)
description: Ren Fujii, a young man attending high school in Suwahara City, finds his friendship with his old buddy Shirou Yusa shatter to pieces following a certain incident, ending in a vicious fight that sees Ren hospitalized for two months. he season shifts from autumn to winter - to the dawning weeks of December, with Christmas on the horizon.

title: Hunt: Showdown - The Kid
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter (The Kid) and two Legendary Caldwell Conversion Pistols (Ember and Ash), ideal for dual wielding.

title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Legend of the Kestrel Lancers
description: Join forces with House Davion's Kestrel Lancers and experience first-hand the frontlines of the 4th Succession War. New linear campaign with unique mechanics, authored missions, and custom dialogue and cinematics.

title: LSDriver 1+2: Remastered Collection
description: LSDriver 1 + 2 is a compilation of 2 racing games with real physics and ragdoll style characters that lose parts of their bodies, have fun trying to complete very crazy tracks.

title: Tamale Loco: Rumble in the Desert 2
Aquamarine Submarine
description:
How quick are your reflexes? Are you ready to explore the depths of the sea with all its dangers and adventures? Then Greyheadstudio’s latest aquamarine is your best bet!
In aquamarine you’re the helmsman of a little yellow submarine, trapped deep down in the ocean. You have been tasked with examining the undiscovered parts of the sea and the only way through is in the darkest and most threatening waters. On your journey you will encounter dangerous sea creatures who will try to attack your submarine during your expedition. Beware of Larry the shark, Kraken the octopus, Sammy the jellyfish , Bob the bigfish and many other aquatic predators. Yet your deadliest enemy of all is the giant iceberg located under the water, once you touch it , your travel is over and you have to start your tour all over again. Your goal throughout the game is to travel deep into the waters as far as you can without touching the rocks and encountering the sea’s hooligans.
So how quick are your reflexes ? Ready to get frustrated and let aquamarine play around with your nerves and patience? Don’t be a wuss and see how long you can last in the dangerous world of aquamarine!

title: Dungeon Raiders
description:
Welcome to Dungeon Raiders! A roguelike dungeon crawler game with collectible cards to acquire and loot to find!
Make your way through perilous dungeons, battle monsters with cards and outfit your heroes with the best armour and weapons you find along the way. Any extra loot you find can be sold in your customizable shop for profit! Use your coins to buy better cards, shop improvements and extra heroes to bring along for the journey.
Complete quests to progress through the game to unlock new dungeon levels with greater challenges, stronger monsters and rarer treasure!
Play your cards right to beat monsters who also each have their own unique cards to play against you with different effects and abilities. Mix and match 40+ of your own unique cards that you can collect along the journey to find the best mix of tactics for winning battles.
Start with a small shop to sell extra loot to the local island citizens and use in game coins to expand, buy equipment and decorations to improve your shop rating and attract more customers.

title: Temple Run: Puzzle Adventure
description:
Play TEMPLE RUN as never before! Beat match 3 puzzles to uncover the mysteries of the ancient temple realm. Create powerful combos and use special pieces to become a Temple Champion!
Assist the great adventurer, archeologist and Temple Runner Scarlett Fox as you solve puzzles to overcome the mysterious obstacles along your path.

title: Builderment
description:
Builderment is a factory building game at heart. It’s all about crafting and automation. You start by harvesting resources and crafting items in factories. Use those crafted items to research new technology and recipes to craft ever more complex items.
Earth has run out of resources... You have been sent to a distant planet to extract its infinite resources and craft items to send back to Earth. You'll need to establish a base on this planet to build factories and production lines to automate the assembly of items.

title: The Night is Darkening
description: In a nearly forgotten place, far from the Angel War, a drunken sailor crashes his ship. You have the misfortune of being on it.

title: Airport Renovator
description: Take matters into your own hands and renovate a run-down airport! You have the right tools for the job, so clean up and restore this place. Open up the loot crates and collect pieces of equipment that you can arrange according to your plan. Make this airport an international giant!

title: Zen Pinball Party
description: Zen Pinball Party delivers the ultimate pinball experience with carefully crafted tables that are inspired by some of the biggest brands from DreamWorks Animation and Hasbro, as well as popular pinball classic themes. Players will challenge their friends and family for the highest score on fun and unique tables.

title: Chimeraland
description:
ChimeraLand is an open-world survival game with strong RPG elements set in a prehistoric, mythical world.
You need to gather resources, craft items, grow crops, and research technologies. Start from building a survival shelter to constructing a massive base in outer space!

title: Tower of Fantasy
description:
Embark together on your fantasy adventure!

Set hundreds of years in the future on the distant planet of Aida, the shared open-world MMORPG, anime-infused sci-fi adventure Tower of Fantasy PlayStation, developed by Hotta Studio and Published by Perfect World Games will soon be on PlayStation globally. Players will be able to experience an anime-inspired post-apocalyptic sci-fi art style, freeform character development, and exciting combat through thrilling battles and exciting open-world exploration.

title: Kirby's Dream Land Advance
description: Kirby's Dream Land Advance is a GBA-styled remake of HAL Laboratory's Kirby's Dream Land for Game Boy. Control your favorite pink puffball as you embark on a journey through 5 unique stages to defeat the mischievous King Dedede!

title: Snowbreak: Containment Zone
description:
Snowbreak: Containment Zone is a 3D Sci-Fi Waifu shooter, available on both PC and mobile.

As the Adjutant of the Heimdall Force, you'll fight shoulder to shoulder with your Manifestations. Command a three-person squad in the Containment Zone, weaving flawless combos that dazzle and conquer within a time limit.
Unravel whispered secrets and hidden truths buried beneath the chaos of battle — every moment brings a new mystery to discover. Only with close and unwavering teamwork can you shatter the impossible and rise victorious. And when the fight subsides, retreat to the Base — a sanctuary where quiet moments blossom into deep bonds with your girls, sharing warmth, laughter, and unspoken promises

title: WormsZone.io
description:
A fun, dynamic game with cool graphics! Get growing your worm right now!

You love games with tons of real fun and dynamic action? Then welcome to the Worms Zone.io, an awesome arcade, where you can become the great champion of the arena! Collect yummies and different powerups, defeat enemies, and become the biggest worm of them all!

You think it's hard? Relax, the rules are simple - explore the arena, collect all the food you see, and grow your worms as big as you can imagine - there are no limits!

Stand out from the other players, choose a skin from the wardrobe, or create your own unique style. The further you go, the more skins you unlock.

Worms Zone is also a PVP action game! Watch out for other players and try not to bump into them, otherwise you'll have to start from scratch. However, if you manage to sneak and encircle them, you'll get more points and all the food they had. It is so yummy!

There are several tactics for becoming a champion: "fighter," "trickster" or "builder." Which one will you be?

Worms Zone also has unique graphics! We keep it minimalistic and simple and you'll love it!

title: Mario Kart: Blazing Wheels
description: Mario Kart: Blazing Wheels is a fan-made Mario Kart game created by DJ Coco, released in 2014. The fan-game uses the visual style of Mario Kart: Super Circuit.

title: RGB ON Experience
description: Parkour game with colors, wall running, fast paced movement, weapons, enemies, explosions and more. Shoot the cubes to gain health, eliminate the enemies to gain score, and use slow-mo to control momentum. Customize colors from many palettes - Default Palette, Blurple, Sunrise, Somewhat red, Light pink, Teal, Rodeo, Evergreen and more to come! Try different color blind options to experience more colors.

title: Infernal House
description:
Far away, in the night, a house...
Within its walls is what may be the greatest discovery of the century. After investigating a kidnapping case, you find yourself thrown out of town, in this extraordinary home. Its structure shocks you... It seems to contain a great mystery, much more than a simple abduction...
It will take a lot of common sense and observation to find out what this hell house seems to be hiding!

title: Peur Sur Amityville
description: The player takes on the role of the father of a family that moves into the Amityville haunted house. Little by little, the house comes to life and he has to face more and more horrible events. He is a prisoner of the house and the goal is to get out alive after 24 days.

title: The Alien Island: 3D-Version
description: The Alien Island: 3D-Version is a first-person shooter that takes place on a small island inhabited by alien monsters. Your mission is to kill the aliens, find the treasure, and take the boat back. The world around you is presented in a pseudo-three-dimensional style, with a first-person view. You are armed with a pistol to shoot enemies. In addition to this, you have a compass and a map of the island in our inventory.

title: CyberWhiskey: Guy's Room
description: CyberWhiskey: Guy's Room is a walk and click adventure game set in 2053. You've got twenty minutes to get ready for work while solving puzzles and talking to a sarcastic robot.

title: Bishojo Battlefield
description: Bishojo Battlefield is a game made for iOS and Android.

title: Crystal of Atlan
description: Crystal of Atlan is a Magipunk MMO Action RPG! As a member of the Adventurer's Guild, you'll be missioned to explore the world of Atlan and gradually unveil the mysteries around the Crystals of Atlan, the source of all energy in the world!

title: Reverse Fantasy Legend
description: I have a dream that... will take over all kinds of races in the world beauties...

title: One Punch Man: World
description:
Get ready for "One Punch Man: World", an action game developed by T3 Studio, a subsidiary of Perfect World Games!
