If you are to still the unrelenting pressure to create, then you will have to take a more drastic approach...

Rosin up your bow and take to the streets, searching for the willing dead to join your unholy orchestra. Perhaps then you can finally write the Symphony of Seven Souls!

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator
description: Visit the largest ship graveyard in the world. A dozen kilometers of beach filled with wrecks. Hundreds of ships wrecked on the coast. Thousands of tons of steel. Choose the most valuable ship for you and start the adventure. Play as one of the workers during the most dangerous work in the world!

title: The Groundz
description: The Groundz is a "dope" street dodgeball game within its own multi-dimensional genre of sci-fi action-sport. Players can battle out intense dodgeball rounds within a hyper-realism context that also includes the following unique design features:

title: Despot's Game: Dystopian Army Builder
description: Despot’s Game is rogue-like tactics with turbo-charged battles. Build a team and sacrifice the heck out of them to rush through enemies... and other players!

title: Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix: Cloud Version
description:
Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix is the essential HD remastered collection, featuring:
• Kingdom Hearts Final Mix
• Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories
• Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days (HD Remastered cinematics)
• Kingdom Hearts II Frinal Mix • Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final MIX
• Kingdom Hearts Re:coded (HD Remastered cinematics)

This is is the perfect opportunity to start wielding your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness!

title: Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue: Cloud Version
description:
KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue features 3 magical experiences, all leading up to KINGDOM HEARTS III:
KINGDOM HEARTS Dream Drop Distance HD: A full-HD remaster. Sora and Riku take on the Mark of Mastery exam in preparation for their coming showdown with Master Xehanort.

description: Get better in one of the most popular puzzle games. Shoot gems and try to complete all the levels with three stars in each level. This gem game is easy to play and addicting at the same time.

description:
UNO: The Call of Yara, the latest UNO DLC, is inspired by the exhilarating and liberating atmosphere of Yara! Plunge into the unique ambiance of the tropical paradise that is Yara before planning your next coup or whatever guerrillero stuff you have planned. Have you ever called a guerrilla icon to win an UNO game? Now you have!
This is UNO done the Yaran way!

description:
Hello! You know, I could do with a good cup of tea. Could you please make me one? Don't worry, I'll guide you through it!

Made by three people in 48 hours for the GMTK Game Jam 2020.

description: Village Apothecary is a puzzle game about brewing potions. You are an apothecary, and the villagers need their potions. Get a request, add the ingredients together, and brew the potion. The trick is adding the ingredients in the right order; make a mistake and you'll end up with the wrong result!

description: A stylized horror adventure game

title: CryptoMines

title: Working Tidal
description:
Working Tidal is a Sega Dreamcast inspired, loot grabbing, time attack game built for Haunted PS1's Summer of Shivers game jam.

In it, you'll be given control of a submarine with a limited fuel supply and tasked with diving into various oceanic locations for lost, forgotten, and valuable artifacts as part of a gig for a salvage company.

You can return to locations you've previously unlocked, upgrade your submarine, and view detailed descriptions and models of the items you've found in-game from the main menu.

There are several locations to explore, as well as some narrative segments to see. Total runtime should come in at under an hour, unless you really enjoy your new job.

title: I Spoke to God
description: A short atmospheric horror game for the 2021 Haunted PS1 Summer of Shivers Game Jam. Reach an abandoned facility at the depths of the ocean to figure out what happened. Just some reconnaissance mission, what could go wrong?

title: Insomnious
description:
Insomnious is a survival horror game inspired by Five Nights at Freddy's, however with the added feature of being able to move around the room and get close and personal with the monsters to push them away.

You are trapped in your room for the night, run around the room and hold back the night terrors while trying to get enough rest to fall asleep. These night terrors could come from everywhere, the window, the closest, the painting and even your bedroom door. But just confronting your fears by getting close enough to push them back will keep you safe for the night.

Each night the monsters get more and more aggressive, on top of this the amount of time you have to sleep for increases each night. You have to manage defending yourself against the monsters of the night and getting sleep by making yourself vulnerable and resting in your bed.

The main story mode will take you through 3 nights of progressively more and more difficult scenarios as you listen to your SAM try to get you to sleep.

The challenge mode introduces a collection of 3 unique challenges to try to beat, it's similar to story mode just without any additional lore.

Finally the custom mode allows you to set your own challenges to try to survive. In custom mode you have the ability to change each monster's difficulty (or even disable each monster), change the amount of time you need to sleep before surviving the night and even change the amount time it takes for the nightmare to kill you.

title: Love Duction! The Guide for Galactic Lovers
description: Nanaboshi Kanata is a student traumatized by love whose world gets turned upside down when two girls vying for the Galactic Presidency declare that he will fall in love with them. Aliens, UFOs and even a guidebook for love? Nothing is normal and everything is weird in this comedic visual novel.

title: Pro Flight Simulator
description: With stunningly realistic exterior and cockpit views, you'll feel like a true pilot as you switch between multiple camera angles to find that perfect perspective. Fly through 40 challenging levels.

title: Minigolf Adventure
description: Do you think you have the best minigolf skills? Put them to the test in Minigolf Adventure, an extraordinary single/multiplayer minigolf game with lots of cool modes. With 50+ holes, 3 environments, and great ball physics, you get to test your prowess and see how good you really are at golf. Minigolf Adventure delivers incredible visuals, tons of replay value, many different items and locations to unlock. It’s the ultimate experience for everyone that wants an exciting, fun, and rewarding minigolf game. With Minigolf Adventure, you can train, play against friends and just enjoy your time. Become the ultimate minigolf player today!

description: Myriads: Renaissance is a turn-based strategy game with city-building and 4X mechanics. Set in a fantasy world made up of thousands of floating islands, you must grow your capital and expand your kingdom. Resist waves of powerful corsairs and construct defence towers to survive their incursions.

It features elements from mainstays of the genre, while incorporating everything you have come to expect from massive multiplayer games. You will be able to journey across a massive world, slay monsters, tackle quests and do it all with your friends or trek solo! We're making sure we keep the story hard encoded into the game-play, to ensure we have an engaging tale for all players to follow.

If playing with one player, make friends with the nearest human and convince them to play with you. If they refuse to be friends, suggest being frenemies instead. If they still refuse, make friends with the nearest cat.

Playing this game with a cat is still better than playing this game alone.

You play as QA-Bot1986, a weapon quality assurance robot working for a big and shady corporation called SHOOTOUT INC.
An unexpected glitch occured during your manufacturing, giving your cyber brain the ability to process data at 5861% higher speed than ordinary bots, allowing you to alter your perception of time and make it advance only when you move.

Labyrinth of Legendary Loot is a simple turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler focused on tactical combat. Every room is almost like a puzzle as you try to figure out the best way to defeat all enemies without taking too much damage.
You play as an adventurer entering the Labyrinth with nothing but a dull sword. Worry not! Each loot you find will grant you a unique ability that will help you slay monsters and find even more loot!

You're running late to a meeting and need the most coffee possible to stay productive.

Get through the turnstile as quickly as possible, but first unlock it by using the wallet in your back pocket.

The security protocols are changing and getting more absurd every day, so it'll get more and more difficult to tap your wallet on the sensor and get to the door on time before you get locked out.

Make it through all 13 meetings and celebrate with a company dance party!

Drink some coffee now if you must to get through everything quicker, but DON'T SPILL YOUR COFFEE!

Train Driver 2 is a project simulating the role of a driver and dispatcher created by the TTSK association.

As a driver, you can sit at the controls of one of the locomotives and travel both real and fictional routes. Your task is to choose the composition and type of train and set off on the route, remaining in communication with other players. In addition, you can change the role and take on the role of a traffic controller, then your duties will include organizing work at the railway station, supervising the safe conduct of train traffic on railway routes, issuing timetables. There are many stations and control panels to choose from, it is only up to you which option you choose.

description: Russian fighting game.

title: Nuclear Throne: Territorial Expansion
description: Nuclear Throne: Territorial Expansion is a mod for Nuclear Throne Together (v9940+) that intends to significantly build on top of the base game with brand new content, secrets, and entirely new mechanics for players to explore.

title: Frogatto & Friends
description: This update was significant, and marks when the developers changed it to a commercial game. Earlier versions were available as free downloads on PC platforms.

title: ChefSquad
description: In ChefSquad, a Twitch only online experience, chat plays as the cooks, while the streamer plays as the all-seeing, all-controlling head chef. Work together to get orders out quickly or you'll fail the day. Unlock new foods, challenges and more as you progress through the 6-8 hour campaign together as a community!

title: Idle Pins
description: Idle Pins is an Incremental game made by an Incremental addict for Incremental lovers. Over 250 Pins to collect and merge. Hundreds of upgrades, features and QoL.

title: Slide in the Woods
description: Ride it, see where it takes you.

title: Lava Golf
description:
Dive into a new and unexpected take on golf games! In Lava Golf you do not control the golfer, instead you are the golf ball and your objective is to reach the end portal of each course without falling into the lava.

Armed with unexpected skills for a golf ball, like the ability to dash into the air or to hit the brakes to avoid falling off a platform, you will need to cross all the portal rings of a course to unlock its exit portal. Scattered across the course you'll also find precious experience spheres which will let you gain levels and grant skill points allowing you to unlock new incredible abilities and to enhance your existing ones!

Unlock unique skills, cross all the rings, and most importantly... DO NOT FALL INTO THE LAVA!

title: Fire & Fondness 2
description:
Daytime television just got hot: in the hit gameshow, Fire & Fondness, young lovers put their relationships to the test in the ultimate courtship ritual: attempting to navigate a succession of convoluted, flamethrower-filled deathtraps.

Our lawyers are advising us to clarify that the fire is fake. As are the teleporters. But the relationships are real! (Probably.)

The original Fire & Fondness was the winner of the Godot Community Game Jam 2018. The sequel, which features an original soundtrack, contains nearly thirty-five levels, with new tricks and mechanics around every corner, including a set of super-difficult challenges for expert players.

It also has a dog.

title: Riba
description: An interactive, atmospheric experience about fishing your grandma's bones.

title: Good Dog
description:
Spend a day at your workplace, cheering up patients at the hospital. Wag your tail, smooch and cuddle to lift spirits, but be aware that not everyone responds the same way to every interaction! Find the appropriate one for each patient and cheer them up.

Good Dog is a charity microgame made over a few weeks for fun - it's completely free to play, but any and all money you may choose to donate will go directly to charity.

title: Franchise Hockey Manager 8
description: Franchise Hockey Manager is the latest (2021) version of the Franchise Hockey Manager series. Releasing in October of 2021, FHM8 builds off the successful 7 adding a variety of new features. Franchise Hockey Manager is the only NHL Licensed game on PC.

title: Block Farm Club
description:
BFC is a decentralized game where anyone can earn tokens
and NFTs through farm the game or leisure.

title: No Water in Hell
description: In No Water in Hell, you play as a firefighter through the forces of hell with nothing but a firehose as you spray down demons on your trek throughout the underworld. You'll face monsters of all shapes, sizes, and varieties, each with their own powers and abilities which may make your time in Hell, well....Hell. No Water in Hell is a 2D roguelite which is designed in the same vein of games such as The Legend of Zelda, Enter the Gungeon, and Crypt of the Necrodancer which features top-down gameplay and 4-directional movement.

title: Nuclear Throne Together: Hard Mode
description: Big mod for Nuclear Throne Together.

title: Foobar 0
description: Foobar Zero is an online multiplayer third-person shooter game, with anime-like characters, set in a futuristic world.

title: High-Macs Simulator
description:
"HIGH-MACS simulator" is a 3D shooting game set in the battlefield of the near future.
Players belong to the Japanese Foreign Legion and train various battle situations on the simulator with the aim of becoming a pilot driving an armored fighting vehicle, HIGH-MACS.

title: Skyrush
description: Beautiful, speed focused, racing game

title: X_Purrsonline_X
description: chat with your Online Cat Friends

title: Tonight You Die
description: Wander a dreary city of concrete structures and unknown melodies

title: Conurbation
description: Restore nature to a sprawling urban environment.

title: Black Friday
description: This is a new attempt to integrate store opening and promotion with dungeon exploration (war chess) gameplay. Everyone is welcome to experience it.

title: The Seventh Warrior
description: Retro-themed SNES-Style RPG

title: 404 Shinigami
description:
Due to a totally-accidental fatal injury, you are now on the verge of life or death.

The grim reaper arrives to off you, however... Can you convince him not to make you see the light just yet?

title: Crystal Captor: Memory Chronicle Finale
description:
The cover should tell you how epic it is!

Moses Reeve is the son of two pirates, the laid back Bobby and the broom-wielding Callie. Lately, he has mysteriously been hearing a voice in his head. Recently, his mother decided to adopt him a brother whom he doesn't get along with. But one day, a mysterious portal opens, dropping off a mysterious, pale-looking cloaked-guy desperately seeking the fragmented heart of his beloved Amina, whose soul energy has been crystalised across the galaxy. Thus, Moses becomes a Crystal Captor for destiny's sake, reluctantly allowing his adopted brother to tag along to aid him whose been enticed by the reward money. What epic adventure shall ensue on this quest to save some girl they don't know for some mysterious guy who appeared out of nowhere

title: The Suburb: Not Just Dinner
description: Escape a scary suburban house (and its owners, who want to make you just. like. them). Play as a nonbinary character.

title: Holoscope: Another Day Another Data
description: The story of a femme hacker trying to survive in an aesthetic dystopia.

title: Cyberpet Graveyard
description: cyberpet graveyard: a graveyard of folders filled with unwanted, unlovable, and unsightly cyberpets.

title: La Foret
description: La Foret is a surreal, abstract indie walking simulator inspired by Max Ernst's paintings about mysterious forests. You plant a "tree" and then explore a landscape.

title: Skeletal Dos Dreams
description: don't worry, your files are right where you left them

title: Anti-Goodness Dept.
description: We Don't Like The Bad Ones...

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Become the blade that destroys demons!

In solo play mode, walk the path of Tanjiro Kamado and experience the story depicted in the anime ""Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba"" as Tanjiro fights to restore his sister Nezuko's humanity and battle the demon threat!

Play Versus mode, which allows up to 2 players to battle in offline or online 2v2 battles with any combination of characters! With simple controls and exhilarating gameplay, rise up to become the strongest of the Demon Slayers!

title: PGA Tour 2K21: Baller Edition
description: Unlock the best post-launch gear and apparel from the most popular sports brands with the Baller Edition-an epic value!

title: 13 Jellyfish
description: Made for Ludum Dare 37

title: Kiddo
description: Tired of life?

title: Better Half
description: A misguided attempt at curing his depression with magic leads Thiu having to live with his other self. Mages are apparently as unreliable as you are. What now?

title: Eat the Rich
description: Be a billionaire, team up and betray your friends all at once in EAT THE RICH! A social party game for 6-10 players where you play mini games, vote out the competition, conspire to get ahead, all in a bid to be the richest!

title: 8-Bit Buccaneer
description: Collect treasure! Fight pirates! Get rich!! (and try not to die)

title: Ultimate Pirates
description: Become a Pirate King and sail the Seven Seas!

title: Billy's Nightmare
description: A roguelike game where you use abilities & items based on child logic to help Billy fight his nightmare. Poison bullies with a pair of Stinky Socks, set creepy toys on fire with a Magnifying Glass or make them step on some painful Pego Bricks!

title: Graveyard Shift 2
description: It's Halloween and the local hooligans have nothing better to do than to vandalize your graveyard! You (and perhaps your boney friends) won't stand for it. Hop, Doot, and Smack your way through waves of ornery kids and their agitated parents as you try to protect your spooky home!

title: Runners
description: A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

title: Friday the 13th: Return to Camp Blood
description: Play as Jason & kill the campers.

title: Jolly Roger
description: A short BL Visual Novel about romance and pirates. Spanish and English available.

title: Mother Island
description: Fun to play top-down survival

title: Todo List
description: They lead a very monotonous life. But the destinies are in your hands now. By finishing your todo in different ways, the ending might be different.

title: 10-103: Null Kelvin
description:
A containment breach was declared aboard Installation 14 of the Axiom Orbital Research Station. As part of the emergency procedure, the breached module was detached from the space station, and it has crashed on a remote island in the Arctic Ocean.

An elite Special Response agent, codenamed Specter 8, has been dispatched instantly by high-altitude parachuting to assess the situation locally while Special Response squads mobilize for a full sector sweep.

Operator Morpho will provide intel and advice to Specter 8 for the whole duration of the mission.

title: Crategun
description:
Made for the Opera GX Game Jam

Aliens are attacking oceans by flooding them with boxes. Without any connection with the center, you find yourself in the ocean, endlessly destroying tons of hazardous boxes and your only goal is to stop the flooding no matter what. The boxes contain various weapons, which you will have to figure out how to use.

Gain points by opening the blue boxes with weapons. Avoid touching the water. The difficulty increases with time. Good luck, machine!

title: Scare Crow
description: Hellish mix of adventure and top-down shooter. in the day explore a big living city… and in the night do your “work” efficiently. Best to remember - there are always consequences.

title: Final Fantasy XI Braver
description: A sprawling adventure in the world of Vana'diel.

title: Rom
description: A short atmospheric experience set on a desolate island.

title: Another World
description: After acquiring the rights for Another World from Delphine Software, the original developer decided to, along with the company Magic Productions, port the game to Symbian-powered phones and Windows Mobile. This port would be the basis for the later Windows version used in subsequent re-releases. Alongside some technical improvements, the original developer also changed some parts which he found were not fitting with the pace of the game.

title: Zoo Tycoon 2032
description: A satirical take on the tycoon video game genre. Expect a wild ride.

title: Islander
description: An idle crafting game inspired by games such as Forager and Minecraft made in PICO-8. Use your pickaxe to mine any and all materials you can find, and craft your way off the islands.

title: The Beast
description: A horror-tinged point and click / visual novel set in an eerie cave complex. Developed in a month as part of the Spooktober 7th Annual Visual Novel Jam in 2025.

title: Heisei Pistol Show
description: Lolita-fashioned gay hitman Heart is betrayed by his ex-lover. In order to get revenge Heart and his trustful companion Pistol abandon the organization, but three of the best assassins follow in their footsteps. A colorful bittersweet story.

title: Lurking
description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

title: Mageroom
description:
You are a mage.

A true mage, a tree wizard.

The last of your kind.

I wonder why?

You're locked in a box for a reason.

title: Broccoli Quest
description: BROCCOLI QUEST was made as an exercise in one afternoon using Mosi, a simple HTML engine created by itch user Zenzoa. In Broccoli Quest you play as a strange long-nosed man who's run out of broccoli. Features include: Giving sunglasses to a Goblin, soothing a foul-mouthed pirate, fumbling for broccoli in the dark.

title: MoHo
description:
MoHo is a Sega Dreamcast game developed by Lost Toys and published by Take 2 Interactive in 2000. It is notable for being the only exclusive Dreamcast game for the United Kingdom, despite receiving ratings from the German USK and French SELL ratings bodies and having its back cover description translated into German.

An American release under the name of Ball Breakers was planned for release in November 2000[5], but cancelled near completion; three different rips of a late prototype were leaked simultaneously in 2012.

title: Kawaii Islands
description:
Kawaii Island is a play-to-earn game.

Kawaii Islands creates a fantasy universe on the cloud for multiplayer to experience a whole set of simulation gaming including designing, building, crafting, farming, social networking. Especially, by gamifying several DeFi mechanisms, Kawaii Islands will bring players a new dimension of mixed entertainment and earning.

title: Horizon Chase Turbo: Senna Forever
description: A homage to the legendary driver Ayrton Senna, this Expansion Pack brings an entirely new set of cars, tracks, and features to the game, inspired by Senna's career.

title: Slap the Rocks
description: Slap The Rocks is a new top-down puzzle which will push your brain to the limit. Slap rocks, avoid bushes and flee from stumps! Can you smash your way to the final level? Many levels of complexity! 20 unlocked levels to explore. You choose! Many ways to complete the same puzzle. Beautiful pixel graphics. Captivating and interesting puzzles. The controls are simple and accessible.

title: Angelic Waves
description: An dating sim, rom-com visual novel with character development, love moments, drama and... you're dating an angel girl in secret?! Join the MC's unique love quest of choosing three girls to date, and see how you and chosen girl will grow together.

title: Feztal
description: FEZTAL is a very short game, which can be described as a fusion of FEZ and Portal. Use a combination of Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device and Gomez's unique abilities to navigate through test chambers.

title: Empire of Sin: Day One Edition
Alabama Smith: Escape from Pompeii
description: Join a young archaeologist for an amazing adventure in Alabama Smith - Escape from Pompeii. Help Alabama search for hidden clues, solve perplexing puzzles, and discover the truth about the Amulet of the Ages. Will Alabama solve the mystery before it's too late? Will Anastasia be able to save him from the eruption of Mount Vesuvius? Find out in Alabama Smith - Escape from Pompeii Deluxe!

title: Legendary Mosaics: The Dwarf and the Terrible Cat
description: Legendary Mosaics - The Dwarf and the Terrible Cat invites you on a whimsical puzzle adventure. Something isn't right in the Enchanted Forest. A sinister spell has been cast by the Wicked Wizard, covering everything in eternal darkness. Team up with a cat and Dwarf duo and explore the depths of the forest! Save the fairies in Legendary Mosaics - The Dwarf and the Terrible Cat.

title: Apex Legends: Escape
description:
Danger Lies Within

Apex Legends: Escape (also known as Season 11 of Apex Legends) comes introduces Storm Point, a paradise-looking place with a lot of danger such as wild prowlers and venomous spiders. The new legend Ash is done just overseeing the games: she is ready to win them and prove she's the Apex Predator.

title: Princess Solitaire
description: Princess Solitaire sets off on a journey to the delightful Kingdom of Marderburg. A celebration of its glorious history is in full swing, but one guest was forgotten - the powerful wicked witch! Both the kingdom and the handsome prince are cursed with magical cards. Help the princess fight the evil and neutralize the witch's spells in Princess Solitaire!

title: Hidden Investigation 3: Crime Files
description: Solve one mystery after another to unravel a larger conspiracy that will lead you to your final case. But beware; it may drag you into the abyss forever!

title: Ruka
description: Ruka is a cartoon puzzle game where you play as a clumsy girl who is quite oblivious to the outside world. Maneuver through your Grandfather's manor and survive the mysteries there and find him. But be warned, not everything is as it seems!

title: Super Mario 64 HD
description:
Super Mario 64 HD was a Super Mario 64 fan remake project in Unity. It was taken down by Nintendo.
There is one complete level: Bob-omb Battlefield.

title: Rayze
description: Rayze is an FPS aim racer designed to make training your speed and precision fun. Hit a target to accelerate. Miss and you slow down. Hit a wall and die. Find the fastest route. Get to the finish line as fast as you can. Simple premise makes it easy to get into the game, while global leader boards incite competition and challenging yourself to try for a better time.

title: Radio.Signal
description: A horror-themed visual novel about traversing a hospital in the dark, the creature that lurks within, and a radio.

title: A Divine Wager
description: The gods Hades and Hermes make a bet.

title: The Inverted Spire
description: Dark fantasy set in a brutal dystopian world.

title: Second Puberty
description: An album of seven short games about feelings.

title: One Small Favor
description: Give your girlfriend the best birthday gift ever

title: Behind the Masc
description: A collection of game materials and art that reenvision masculinity

title: From That Moment She Neglected The World
description: An immortal fairy picks up a disciple, raising the disciple so that one day the disciple may slay her and fulfill the end of a prophecy in which the immortal must either die or cause the end of the world.

title: No Stars, Only Constellations
description: This is just a short narrative game about looking up at the sky and thinking about it, while that cute guy next to you just won't shut the fuck up about space.

title: Wolf's Wool
description: An abstract visual novel about wondering what you are under the crumbling cover.

title: Rebirthday
description: My entry for the Meditations Games project. Originally appeared on 2/3/18.

title: An Oath In Kind
description:
"An Oath in Kind" is a kinetic novel about a dethroned demon queen and the one and only knight who remained loyal after her fall.

When Claire finds her queen bleeding across the floor of a forest hollow, she swears to herself that she will fulfill her oath to see Galena to safety... even if Galena would have rather been left there in the mud.

title: The Bog's Heart
description: When a mysterious cough overtakes Meg's (name changeable) childhood town and even the capital physicians can't help, she turns to her scorned great uncle's work on the mysterious creatures of the bog to find a cure. As she sets out into the mysterious bog lands with her trusted canine companion, will she be able to save her town?

title: Noble
description:
Manage the family tree of a Noble House!
Grow your family tree with generations of diverse nobles. Decide their path and write history. Send your lords and ladies to feasts, wars, and tourneys. Become friends or foes with the other noble houses. Create your dynasty!

title: Colossorama
description: Slay, chop and stab until your name is remembered in the Pantheon of Gladiators!

title: Typhoon Force: Storm Fighter
description: Typhoon Force: Storm Fighter is a shoot'em up where you pilot a spaceship and navigate your way through the end of the game by fighting swarms of enemies.

title: Librerama
description: Librerama is a free/libre arcade compilation of very small, fast-paced mini-games (nicknamed "nanogames"), with the main objective being to rack up the highest score possible by winning the most nanogames you can before getting a game over, while they progressively increase in both speed and difficulty.

title: Summoning Pixel Dungeon
description:
A mulitplatform roguelike game based on Shattered Pixel Dungeon that adds new character classes, summons, mechanics, items, a new endgame area and a ton of ways to challenge the seasoned player. It also presents some Undertale inspirations sparkled upon.

This game was discontinued as of July 12, 2024. For remake, look for Summoning PD: Reincarnated.

title: Pixelpusher
description: Delightfully simple online multiplayer action

title: Aerofoil
description: Port of Glider PRO, the classic Macintosh paper airplane game

title: The Anything Gallery
description: Whatever you want to see... this gallery has it!

title: Valley Peaks
description: The mountains are calling! Complete routes of varying difficulty to scale summits in this wholesome yet ribbiting first-person climbing sim. Overcome obstacles, unlock upgrades, explore a mountain paradise, and get chummy with Valley Peaks’ froggy inhabitants as you climb to your heart’s content.

title: Wrong Floor
description: Wrong Floor is a fast-paced, single-player horror shooter where you’re trapped in a malfunctioning elevator, fighting off waves of nightmarish creatures. As the elevator plummets, you'll have to manage your ammo, react quickly, and survive against increasingly intense floors.

title: Lisa: The Pointless - Scholar of the Wilbur Sin Edition
description: A mod of LISA: The Pointless made as a love-letter to the game and its world. Scholar of the Wilbur Sin is an expansion mod that adds new content to every inch of the original adventure. There are new foes to face, new areas to discover, new items to trade, and new stories to enjoy. Recruit three brand new party members on your quest to traverse the wasteland and find a better place.

title: Dead Event
description: Dead Event is a multiplayer open world class based survival game in which the player grows up as a creature. The creature will get bigger overtime and grow with interactions in-game and lose some growth on death. Become part of a player-created ecosystem. Objective is to survive, eat or be eaten..

title: Peril
description: In Peril you play as Robyn, the Daughter of one of the Ranger's who were first sent in through the Slip-gates.

title: Collage
description: Three ordinary people are thrown together, and each retells events in his or her own voice in this unconventionally told, uniquely presented, and ultimately very human novella.

title: Rover Wars
description: If you are up for a casual yet spicy cocktail of action and strategy, but not planning to spend hours learning how to play, then Rover Wars might just be your thing.

title: Hidden Investigation: Who Did It?
description: Hidden Investigation - Who Did It? summons you to the scene of the crime. A cold case is haunting the police department. Assist Agent Sarah as she attempts to crack the case once and for all! Solve puzzles, find hidden objects, and interview a variety of interesting characters. Can you solve the mystery in Hidden Investigation - Who Did It?

title: Spear of Destiny: The Final Journey
description: Amid the turmoil of war, the Alliance has given Agent Walker a mission of the utmost importance – track down and destroy the mythical Spear of Destiny before a sinister enemy can use its supernatural power to turn the tide of war and conquer the world!

title: Jenny's Fish Shop
description: Turn Jenny's humble fish shop into a booming business and use the proceeds to build a spectacular aquarium in Jenny's Fish Shop. Give your fish the perfect environment and feed them and they will grow into the perfect pet for some lucky family! Your choice of adorable pet will give you a helping hand, but it's up to you to make Jenny's dreams come true. Reel in Jenny's Fish Shop!

title: Mahjong: Wolf's Stories
description: Mahjong - Wolf's Stories couples great gameplay with a moving story. Solve your way through hundreds of levels. Explore the forest and help the wolf find his cub. Play in timed mode for an extra challenge, or relaxed mode to sit back and enjoy the journey. Rescue a wolf cub and save the day in the heart-warming story of Mahjong - Wolf's Stories.

title: Alexandra Fortune: Mystery of the Lunar Archipelago
description: Rescue the missing adventurer and uncover an ancient treasure in Alexandra Fortune - Mystery of the Lunar Archipelago!

title: Flowery Vale
description: Flowery Vale is a match 3 garden fantasy where you must gather flowers for your sweetheart. Lose yourself in the stunning beauty of nature as you gather daisies, roses and more in order to decorate your girlfriend's cabin in the woods. Fill baskets with certain blossoms before time runs out, produce a set number of combos or create a certain number of explosions. There's never a dull moment as you create botanical delights to charm your beloved.

title: Frankenstein: The Village
description: Janet and Brad thought they were going on a peaceful holiday until an unfortunate breakdown stopped them outside Frankenstein Burg!

title: Hidden Investigation 2: Homicide
description: Famous police detective, Agent Sarah, is on her way to investigate yet another unsolvable crime! Her journey will take her deep into a web of deceit and uncover a strange revenge plot linked to a long-forgotten case. In the world of puzzles and mystery, Sarah would have never expected to stumble into true love. Follow Sarah as she confronts incredible challenges in her latest adventure!

title: Bloodshore
description:
Bloodshore is an interactive action movie about a televised battle royale between high-profile streamers, entertainers and death row inmates. You control the fate of Nick, a washed-up actor who fights for a life-changing cash prize.

All is not what it seems in this latest season of Kill/Stream, the hottest reality TV show on the planet. Can Nick uncover the truth about Bloodshore Island before his time runs out?

title: Alex Gordon
description: Alex Gordon is a fedora-wearing feline. Help this fabulous cat travel five dazzling game worlds as he collects coins and boxes the bad guys. Alex Gordon must explore every nook and cranny to save his sister from the cunning Monkey King. Will he find the scattered pieces of an ancient amulet before his nemesis releases his sibling? Grab your satchel and take a leap into the nocturnal wonderful world of Alex Gordon in this hissing Adventure.

title: Virtual Farm
description: Turn a small family farm into a booming success in Virtual Farm, a fun simulation that puts you in charge! Choose your crops, water your fields, and collect your produce. Then, visit the market to check the demand for your goods and set the price. Featuring eight kinds of crops to cultivate, gorgeous 3D graphics, and nearly endless fun, Virtual Farm is a special treat for everyone.

title: Sally's Salon: Beauty Secrets
description: Treat yourself to Sally's Salon - Beauty Secrets and catch up with your favorite beautician. She and her new sidekick François are making the town a little more beautiful, one treatment at a time - but when Sally's favorite singer Julio plans to visit the town, she finds herself caught up in a romantic adventure. See what happens in Sally's Salon - Beauty Secrets.

title: Mortimer Beckett and the Book of Gold
description: Get ready for adventure with Mortimer Beckett and the Book of Gold! Featuring introverted thinker Mortimer and spontaneous extrovert Kate, embark on an unexpected journey full of riddles and mysteries. What secrets lie written within the Book of Gold? Discover the beauty of emotion and the value of companionship in Mortimer Beckett and the Book of Gold.

title: Mahjong Fortuna
description: Get to know yourself and your future by discovering this world-famous Mahjong classic!

title: Hotel Mahjong
description: You deserve some time off, don't you think? We already booked you a room in the famous Hotel Mahjong!

title: Mahjong Fortuna 2
description: Now here's a game to expand the mind... Sharpen your mind and self-knowledge in this serene sensation!

title: Pastry Passion
description: Cook up colorful confections with passionate Parisian pattisier Henri! Help an enthusiastic confectioner to cook delicious desserts as you match 3 or more ingredients on the board to deliver the order in time.

title: Delicious: Emily's Childhood Memories
description: Join Emily and her loved ones on an emotional stroll down memory lane!

title: 100% Hidden Objects 2
description: In an exciting journey around the world, 100% Hidden Objects 2 offers you picturesque hidden-object scenes just waiting for your keen eye to spot all the clues within them. Whether you prefer to play in classic mode with a checklist, or would like to track down the objects using pictograms 100% Hidden Objects 2 provides pure hidden object fun!

title: Biggest Little Adventure
description: See the world through a different perspective in Biggest Little Adventure, an epic journey of tiny proportions.

title: Marie Antoinette and the Disciples of Loki
description: The year is 1787 and the French monarchy is living its last years of peace. In Vienna, Mozart is just about to finish his latest opera. Far to the north, in Iceland, a tremendous volcano eruption has already changed the face of Europe forever. What is the link between those events? Join Josepha Duschek, a famous opera singer, as she investigates a mysterious crime and begins her quest for the truth. Uncover the traitorous plots surrounding Marie Antoinette, the Queen of France, and track down the suspicious disciples of Loki. Travel to the marvelous cities of Philadelphia, Versailles, Vienna, and Prague and meet famous historical characters such as Mozart, Benjamin Franklin, Jeanne of Valois, and even Marie Antoinette! Sharpen your skills through puzzles and brainteasers in this Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure!

title: Battle vs. Chess
description: Commanders, assemble your armies! BATTLE vs. CHESS calls for an interactive feather duster, chartering the successful chess game principle into the present day multimedia world. Animated fantasy figurines assemble in magical worlds and await your command! As a Commander, execute skillful maneuvers on the game board and catapult yourself directly into the battle with devastating attacks, chessman vs. chessman.

title: Viking Heroes: Collector's Edition
description: The forces of evil don't stand a chance when the heroic Viking family embarks on an epic quest to save Midgard!

title: Ramses: Rise of Empire - Collector's Edition
description: Ramses - Rise Of Empire Collector's Edition is a captivating Time Management game that will take you back to ancient Egypt. From your first hut to your final palace, raise the great civilization up from the sands of time! Turn small piles of coins into vast treasuries and pursue ambitious projects. Master strategic gameplay in Ramses - Rise Of Empire Collector's Edition today!

title: Heart's Medicine: Season One - Remastered
description: Go back to the beginning of Allison Heart's epic story to become a doctor

title: Rose Riddle: The Fairytale Detective - Collector's Edition
description: Rose Riddle - The Fairy Tale Detective is a magical time management adventure. Join Rose as a rendezvous with her missing parents soon becomes an unexpected excursion to a fairy tale realm! Manage resources, race the clock, and unlock bonus content as you embark on a comical adventure. Play Rose Riddle - The Fairy Tale Detective today!

title: Twisted Lands 2: Insomniac - Collector's Edition
description: Cross the fragile boundaries of reality to find safety in Twisted Lands - Insomniac, a mind-bending thriller.

title: Natalie Brooks: The Treasures of the Lost Kingdom
description: Search for an ancient treasure map and discover the mystery of a terrible curse in Natalie Brooks - The Treasures of the Lost Kingdom. Search stunning scenes for hidden objects and find the ancient treasure map before it's too late. Featuring animated locations, challenging mini-games, and more, this original challenge is a stirring adventure. Join Natalie on her exciting search today!

title: Viking Brothers 3: Collector's Edition
description: Ready your weapons and answer the call of the gods to save the universe from evil!

title: Stray Souls: Stolen Memories - Collector's Edition
description: Guide a mother who pursues a terrifying apparition into a twisted reality to save her daughter. As you explore a strange town in which an evil clown has turned all of the residents into wooden dolls, you'll slowly peel back the layers of a disturbing story that reveals why the mother's husband has never spoken about his past!

title: Baking Bustle: Collector's Edition
description:
Bake up a storm on an epic cooking adventure that spans the world of food! Join Ashley and Scott as they tackle the culinary challenge of their lives in restaurants that serve everything from scrumptious pancakes and gourmet burgers to tasty tacos and succulent soups.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Bonus chapter with a twist
- Strategy guide for each level
- Downloadable soundtrack
- Desktop wallpapers

title: Fall of the New Age
description: Mankind has just got out from the dark Middle Ages. Superstitions and fears still reign the minds of the majority of people, but the germs of science and culture rapidly emerge and grow stronger. But, as it turns out, it doesn’t play into the hands of some of those in power.

title: Stalingrad
description: Stalingrad is a real-time strategy title that places gamers in the middle of the most dramatic periods of World War II, covering major events from June 1942 till January 1943. Built-up upon the enhanced Enigma Engine, the game offers faithful historical recreation of the Stalingrad area, vast tactical options and more than 150 units at your command.

title: Legacy Tales: Mercy of the Gallows - Collector's Edition
description: Solve this pirate mystery to reunite two lost souls.

title: Apothecarium: The Renaissance of Evil - Collector's Edition
description: The story takes place in Italy in the époque of the Renaissance. Disastrous outbreak of plague and leprosy is raving, taking thousands of lives. We play-act for Adriano, - brave and daring as hereditary aristocrat Adriano family member of the Duke of Medici, who sent for the pursuit of his daughter, Claudia. Our hunt leads us to the strangest of places – little town called Apothecarium. Just recently Italy’s brightest minds were fighting over the search of the vaccine against plague. These scientific pioneering and research so as to win the fight with the dreadful disease is the purpose this “amazing city” was built for.

title: East India Company: Gold
description:
In East India Company, players will enjoy building the World's most powerful trading empire & engaging in vigorous battles in both single-player & multiplayer modes, all within a breathtaking cinematic game environment. Starting modestly, you will build your fleet, establish connections to faraway countries, and keep the rivaling nations at bay. Choose from a wide array of ship classes, including a variety of transport and military vessels. Create diverse fleets and assign each of them specific trading routes. Control and upgrade well-situated ports as you form your strategy for domination. Conflicts and wars are inevitable. When hostile fleets engage each other, the spectacular naval battles are fought from a real-time tactical level. For greater tactical depth, command your ship and give independent orders to each of your fleets. Fight against the other European powers to create a trading empire that will rule above all others in this groundbreaking strategy war game!

East India Company Collection Gold Edition 2012 contains:
* East India Company: Designer’s Cut
* Pirate Bay Expansion Pack
* Battle of Trafalgar Expansion Pack
* Privateer Expansion Pack

title: Cathy's Crafts: Platinum Edition
description: Cathy is chasing the dreams of others instead of her own. Should she stay and run the family hardware store or join her boyfriend in New York and become an art buyer?

title: Delicious 2
description: Bring along a recipe for success, because someone needs to turn around Emily's family's restaurant!

title: Monument Builders: Notre Dame
description: Build the greatest cathedral of all in Monument Builders - Notre Dame de Paris, a wonderful journey through architectural history. With almost 200 years in the making, the grand cathedral in Paris inspires as one of the finest examples of French Gothic architecture. Here's your chance to experience this great feat first-hand.

title: The Tale of the Cartographer
description: A pumpkin-like mapmaker a quill and a parchment... What else do you need?

title: Soul Union
description: Psychological Fantasy : Shape the Heart and Mind

title: Allocation
description: A Metroidvania without an interconnected world or character upgrades.

title: HaachamaWare
description:
HaachamaWare: The Game!
Hololive fangame inspired by WarioWare, where you participate in a lot of different mini-games with cute anime characters.

title: Beemis: The Curse of God
description: Become a real life bee and also fight god himself. Take on many bosses and wacky levels as a young bee whose life has been drastically changed by a curse that was maniacally concocted by god.

title: The Lair
description: A retro scrolling beat'em up with a dark fantasy theme.

title: Laserwave
description:
Grab your mouse...

Turn up the volume...

Let the beats flow through you!

Laserwave is a synthwave bullet-hell-like rhythmic shooter where your actions are defined by the music!

title: Pikwip
description: Head to the summit. Local co-op or single player.

title: PS5 Simulator
description: Wait no more, your ultimate PS5 experience is here! Poor cable management, snacks on floor and try to not break your next-game console in this non-AAA-game!

title: Unitres Dreams
description: Unitres Dreams is a free, experimental pixel 2D platformer created by Unlimited Trees with inspirations from games on the Megadrive/Mega CD. It involves a group of friends going on a wacky adventure to get home, having to traverse bright, colorful environments in a strange dimension.

title: Pyo
description: Pyo pyo pyo!

title: Sonic Revert
description:
Sonic Revert is a reimagining of the Sonic gameplay but where Sonic is controlled like a car when he's in running mode.

The game features singleplayer time attack and online multiplayer racing mode.

Some of the classic Sonic mechanics have been modified, such as the homing attack.

The level design is inspired by Trackmania tracks, but filled with badniks, spikes and other dangers.

title: The Baby In Yellow
description: Babysitters often have to deal with unruly children, but this one might be your last... how long will you stay in control?

title: Deliver At All Costs
description: Deliver At All Costs is a thrilling action game where destruction, absurdity and intrigue collide! Step into the shoes of Winston Green — a down-on-his-luck courier with a fiery temper and a mysterious past — as he delivers highly unconventional cargo, leaving a trail of havoc and chaos behind him.

title: Son of Cthulhu
description: Ludum Dare 43

title: Surprise Stack
description: Holidays themed physics puzzle game!

title: Farty Rocket
description: rocket go fly wosh

title: How to Be a Tree
description: How to Be a Tree is a game about the many ways to be a tree!

title: Teeth Simulator
description: Level up your teeth by eating, like you did when you were a baby.

title: Where Is My Hammer: Destroy Everything!
description: Everything is fully destructible, smash it all!

title: Why Can't I Just Speak Normally to My High School Crush?!
description: Tell Senpai how you really feel!

title: Jelly Drift
description: Jelly Drift is a fast- paced, colourful drifting game! With 5 Maps, 7 Cars and various skins to choose from!

title: Deadbeats Encore
description:
Here's a hololive fangame, inspired by Calliope Mori and the Deadbeats.

Play through her songs while trying not to die, y'know, again.

title: Barkour
description: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

title: Oh My Giraffe
description: Eat fruits while being chased by lions.

title: Eli
description: A small Bullet hell about shooting demons.

title: Toziuha Night: Order of the Alchemists
description: This is the story of Xandria, an iron alchemist. She seeks revenge regardless of the consequences. To achieve it, Xandria fights with a powerful whip and the power of chemical elements. Find out more about her in this modern metroidvania adventure.

title: Akuma: Wrath of the Fallen
description: Slash your way through hell in this demonic 2d action platformer !

title: Tower Guy: Remastered
description: A short narrative adventure about a deserted half tower/half man. Alone in a world full of humans..

title: Path of the Rabbit
description: Build a small world full of paths for your rabbit to follow. You can build on top of old tiles, but you can only build five tiles wide, five tiles deep and five tiles tall. Run out of water or carrots, or get stuck on the edge, and it's game over! Each time you place a tile your rabbit gets thirsty, so frequently visit oases to fill up on water. As your rabbit travels along the path, it feeds and gains carrots which are useful when fighting off foes such as foxes. Successfully fighting off three opponents levels your rabbit up and increases its maximum carrots by two. And it will need all the carrots it can get for when the boss arrives!

title: Diskophoros
description: Fast-paced local multiplayer laser disc combat on procedurally generated maps

title: Hanano Puzzle 2
description: A simple puzzle game about making flowers bloom. This game is a sequel to Hanano Puzzle, but you don’t need to play the previous one. Hanano Puzzle 2 is more friendly for beginners.

title: Ultrabouters
description: Ultrabouters is a prototype idea for attempting to liven up fighting games. The goal with Ultrabouters is to attempt to make fighting games more strategic & rewarding as chess is.

title: Angels of Battle
description: A combo based anime 2D fighting game

title: Chaos Sisters
description: Beat'em up of devils beating up heroes: Free demo available!

title: Glitch Dungeon
description: Wield code-manipulating spells to traverse a corrupted labyrinth in this puzzle adventure platformer game.

title: Wibble Wobble
description:
It's a wibbly wobbly world.

Collect stars to boost your score multiplier, avoid hazards, stay alive and get a high score.

title: Tyrant's Realm
description: Tyrant's Realm is a challenging action roguelike. Fill your arsenal with weapons and armor each with their unique gameplay mechanics. Tread carefully in this dark fantasy world because every enemy you face could be your end.

title: Don't Look Away from the Colors
description: 10-15 minutes playtime.

title: Like Them
description: A fast-paced 2D puzzle game where you play as a cheerful ghost, moving in straight lines until hitting a wall. Navigate through a haunted house, dodge traps, evil ghosts, and escape before becoming like them!

title: Hebi Hebi
description: "Mean Bean Machine" meets "Snake" in a mind-bending puzzle game!

title: Krimson
description: Krimson is a challenging gritty rhythm platformer featuring heavy electronic metal music. You're an unknown spawn moving through a hellish world as it shifts rhythmically to the music. One wrong move means death but the checkpoints are often, and death is very short.

title: Gunfighters
description: A wild west multiplayer shooter.

title: Library of Blabber
description:
Explore the Library of Blabber, an infinite structure filled with endless bookshelves of eternal nonsense!

A "little" game focused on exploration and the fun of meaningful discoveries in the noise of random data, inspired by Jorge Luis Borges's story "The Library of Babel".

title: Photobomb
description: A social media investigatory shooter.

title: Pigsaw
description: Escape the nightmarish human abattoir in this blood-soaked Horror FPS.

title: Midnight Shift
description: One girl worked at a gas station in Wisconsin, and during one of her midnight shifts, the most unexpected thing happened to her.

title: AIeyes
description: Walking simulator in a city where the world is seen through a realtime neural network, which is fed simple colored blocks that are translated to textures and forms.

title: Deadlocked
description: Deadlocked is an adrenaline-packed Top-Down shooter where you'll confront hordes of relentless robotic foes. Unleash futuristic weapons, master strategic combat, and prove your mettle against the mechanical onslaught. Can you outmanoeuvre and overpower the relentless enemy threat?

title: Decline's Drops
description: Grab your punching gloves, put your clogs on and smash your way in the world of Decline's Drops, a fully hand-drawn platform-brawler full of weird frogs, bizarre chickens and odd hydras! Avenge your destroyed garden and defeat the 6 heads of the Eternal Corp.! If you can, that is.

title: First Cut
description: This game was a prototype of First Cut: Samurai Duel.

title: Slenderman's Shadow
description:
Slenderman's Shadow is a survival horror game based on the Slenderman mythos. Explore 9 terrifying environments, including an old Hospice, an Elementary school, and a Carnival. Discover new areas, complete your mission, and survive the horrifying being pursuing you.

Slenderman's Shadow is a series of playable maps created (8th Oct 2012) by Marc Steene and Wray Burgess, and later (13th Jan 2013), as a full remake, a survival horror game, based on Slender: The Eight Pages by Parsec Productions.

title: Digital Tamers: ReBorn
description: Train, fight, evolve! Digital Tamers: ReBorn is a casual fighting game for all Digimon fans. Your mission is to take care of your partner, keep it strong, healthy in order to evolve and win battles and several prizes! Excel and win the 12 Championships that will take place throughout the year in order to become a true Digimon Tamer! Live this experience and welcome, to the Digital World!

title: The Sirena Expedition
description: The Sirena Expedition is short PSX-style horror-platformer in which you explore a mysterious underwater facility.

title: Nocturnal Visit
description: Nocturnal Visit is a short horror experience. One late night, you decide to explore this unknown abandoned house hidden in the woods to make an article for your blog. Several rumors say the house is haunted. Your objective/job is to investigate the house to find clues to whether the rumors are real or not.

title: Hungry Ducks
description:
A small game for Haunted PS1 Summer Of Screams.

It's a game about feeding monster ducklings. If there is no food... you become the food!!!

The spoopiness in this one is lagging a bit though. I hope you enjoy it anyway :)

The game does not yet have a propper ending, because I had to finish it in a very small amout of time.

If the mouse sensitivity feels off for some reason, I reccomend downloading the standalone build. There seems to be a weird bug with the mouse sensitivity.

title: There Are Ghosts In These Stalls
description: A short horror game in a bathroom stall.

title: Plead with the Mountain God
description: ​Survive the perilous climb and plead with the mountain god to resurrect your beloved.

title: We Don't Talk About It
description: Art-horror game about how hard it can be to express yourself

title: Dying of Thirst
description: It's midnight and you need water.

title: Future Reality
description: It's the eve of the millennium. Technology has advanced further beyond allowing you to take a breathtaking journey into the future. Are you ready for the most thrilling ride one can possibly imagine?

title: Skywatching
description:
There is something among the stars.
Keep looking up.

A very short horror game. Heavily inspired by LOCAL 58 TV.

title: Silent House
description: You play as John Williams, the victim of a car accident, waking up and finding yourself in a weird room that resembles a prison cell. You make eye contact with a strange man with a bloody knife that looks awfully similar to the psychopath you saw in the newspaper. You must escape at all costs.

title: An Empty Castle: Laputa
description: Reach the Castle in the Sky

title: Artists of a Dead World
description: A lonely city somewhere at the end of the world.

title: Limsod
description: Limsod is an FPS set in a post-apocalyptic universe in which you must fight for survival in a world infested with flesh-eating zombies. Upgrade your equipment and play in a variety of maps and game modes.

title: The Thirteenth Floor
description: The Thirteenth Floor is a PlayStation 1 inspired first person horror experience, take control of the unsuspecting protagonist as you guide him through the thirteenth floor of the Underlook Hotel to discover what horrific events unfolded there.

title: The Undying Beast
description: There was a flash of light, a choir of glass, and the sound of sirens approaching. Then for what seemed like eternity, a black hollow void. Suddenly you found yourself within a new plane. Dead trees and fog is all that surrounds you. You hear no birds or signs of life, but strange cackles and moans sound from the distance. And then you notice out of the corner of your eye you may not be alone here.

title: Headlines from the Deep
description: A short, PS1-style adventure game about fish-based media production.

title: The Last Door on the Left
description: A short PSX inspired horror experience.

title: I Am The Caretaker
description: You are the caretaker. Today is your first day on the job. Your task is to carefully observe and report all anomalies and deviations. Can you handle this task?

title: Townseek
description:
Townseek is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

The whole world is your sea now, so be sure to see all that it has to offer!

title: GigaSword
description: An action-puzzle metroidvania in which you wield a huge, heavy sword

title: Turgor Pressure
description: After a dive team sent to explore an abandoned facility goes missing, you are tasked with piloting a ROV down below the surface of the ocean to see if you can track them down and either guide them back up, or at least confirm that they're dead. Your ROV is equipped with a scanning system to help you determine what may have happened to the team. Good luck out there, and remember: Something's wrong with the ocean.

title: Sushi for Robots
description: These robots are obsessed with sushi and you’re the one serving it to them.

title: This Game is Self-Aware
description: Hang out with our disgruntled self-aware protagonist while bullying him with pop-culture references

title: Limbocore
description: Discover the limbo. Play cards with angels.

title: Nusantara: Bermuda Triangle
description: A fantasy adventure, mystery, drama & romance otome visual novel (GxB) with strong Indonesian flavour. (Not a sequel!)

title: Dank Tomb
description: Solve puzzles in dimly lit corridors and uncover the story of an ancient king gone mad.

title: Snow Cones: Episode 2
description: The world's greatest ice-cream-cone romance-saga continues!

title: Between Stations
description: You can't remember what time it is, but you know it is late. You have just checked into your room at the Brownie Cove Hotel. The bed is lumpy and you can't sleep, but the TV is tempting...

title: Under Pretense of Death
description: Romantic Visual Novel with Point'n'Click elements

title: Kobold Garden
description: Befriend and raise small lizard-like creatures called kobolds in Kobold Garden! Make new friends, solve puzzles, and more all with your kobold companions by your side.

title: Legend of Xenia 3D
description: Tiny first-person Zelda-like with a resolution of 64x64

title: Spellrazor
description:
If you miss the days of creepy, sinister, neon-tinged arcade games (especially the early work of Eugene Jarvis) that reward deep knowledge and skillful play, then this game is for you.

Spellrazor is an early-1980s-tinged Rogue-meets-Defender/Berzerk arcade-adventure game with (gulp) 27 fire buttons, auto-targeting, a bunch of secrets and a rather creepy meta-story.

Being a conversion of a semi-mythical arcade game developed by Duncan Bower in 1981, this version includes the unusual in-game development/debugger console which exposes the weird, glitchy nightmare of the game's mythology.

title: Smalls Island Woes
description: Go to work, the lighthouse won't fix itself.

title: Frontier Diver Progenexis
description: Dive into the depths of END CITY and discover the horrors NT-Field crisis has left in its wake.

title: Candied Carols
description: A wintry, magical holiday romance

title: Remember Places?
description: You are locked inside. The only thing keeping your mind together is your AI best friend. Most places are just a memory to you now.

title: Space Frog!
description: Space Frog! is an indie adventure game about a frog in space.

title: Superstition S2
description: Journey deeper into the unknown.

title: Delphine's Discovery
description: Venture into an abandoned orphanage, solve a mystery, and fall in love.

title: Tower Offender
description:
This game is all about stopping the Hero from getting to the tower to do what heroes to best. You will have some time to prepare and then can continue your efforts as he progresses.

A twist on the traditional tower defence genre, in this game you can run and jump around the level and place traps and obstacles that should hamper the progress of the hero. Once the hero arrives you can continue to move around and adjust the placement of traps, either by placing more, or by moving the ones you have already placed.

A health bar indicates how much damage the hero has received, and once the hero has no health left, the player wins and can progress to the next level.

title: Karlson 2D
description: Karlson is here to kick ass and drink milk, and he's all out of milk.

title: Twinsanity: Omicron
description: Twinsanity: Omicron is an RPG game which is based on the series "Twinsanity The Animated Series". The Story Continues. Two days after defeating Time Shadow, Twinsanity is taking rest in EastCity. Exploring the city, he realises that someone wants his power. Are you ready to solve the mystery?

title: ZFrag
description: Zen Hard Disk Management Tool. Defrag your mind by manually defragging a virtual Hard Disk, sector by sector, or enable the AUTODEFRAG to sit back and watch it do it on its own.

title: Artemis' Minesweeper
description: Artemis' Minesweeper is the a hardcore version of minesweeper, a mashup of minesweeper and a bullet hell shoot 'em up. It features Artemis of the Blue Fan-Game by VTuber Numachi Tamanegi.

title: Friagem
description: A game that mixes the mechanics of pushing boxes to specific locations with elements of horror and suspense.

title: Andy's Apple Farm
description:
In this game, you play a copy of a fictional beta test version of the game "Andy's Apple Farm", a game that was supposed to be released in the mid-1980s. The game isn't actually a beta test, however, the game's version is designed to appear as one.

The game starts to "glitch" and reveal more of the story behind the game. This game has a lot of secrets to discover so it may require several playthroughs to have different experiences and fully understand the game's internal story.

title: Pretty Please
description: Make me pretty please. A short game about a lady who goes into a beauty clinic to "fix a few things". Features several endings and beautiful artwork, made in 3 days for a game jam. The game contains 497 dialogue blocks, containing 3,644 words and 19,587 characters, for an average of 7.3 words and 39 characters per block. The game contains 11 menus, 15 images, 14 screens, and a total of 3 possible endings.

title: Subconscious
description: What if all your daily routines were there only to repress memories you wished were forgotten?

title: Fallout Equestria: Remains
description: Fallout Equestria: Remains, is a side scrolling post apocalypse action RPG game with ponies. With Littlepip or your customizable character in the lead role, a huge assortment of weapons, creepy wasteland environments, raiders, monsters, physics, telekinesis, quests, skills and perks, excellent animations and much more.

title: Jo's House
description: Jo's house is a maze building game where you must rearrange the furniture of the HQ Residential House to create the longest path from Jo's bed to one of the exits (front door, back door or garage). At night Jo will start rolling around the house to either attack you, eat a pie or exit the house. Your goal is to survive 3 nights doing the following 2 things: #1: Don't get hit by Jo. #2: Don't let Jo leave the house.

title: Blandville
description: Blandville is a looting/survival horror game with a winter atmosphere and cryptids roaming the forest.

title: Will Die Alone
description: Some memories aren't meant to stay. We are our memories and our experiences. What happens if you delete some of them? If you change your past and, thus, your future?

title: Endoparasitic
description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must save your research. Drag yourself through the corridors of a secret research lab on a remote asteroid, fight off horribly mutated monsters, inject countless syringes of vaccines, and survive at all costs.

title: Paranormal Entities
description: Investigate the spiritual activity still present in the St. Augustine Asylum

title: Melone in the Dark
description: Know your fruit. Know its name.

title: God Opens the Door
description: God Opens the Door is a short horror game where you flush your mom down the toilet.

title: Mare
description: The game follows Naomi, who awakens to find that they cannot remember their name, memories, and where they are. All they know is they can hear a lone voice calling to them, "Naomi, come find me."

title: Heart Rocket
description: A Love Live fangame where it’s Maki’s birthday and Nico needs to find her a perfect present during school hours. There are 2 routes that will take about 1-2 hours to get both endings.

title: Memorabilia
description: You don't know what this place is but at the end of the path, you have to make your choice.

description: Sit back, play some old arcade game, and tell your computer about your feelings.

description: A virtual museum of the indie studio Majorariatto.

description: You star in tonight's episode of... The Midnight Zone

title: The Rock the Paper and the Scissors
description: Western rhythm game with a humorous twist. You are Lefty the bounty hunter. Use your epic skills to take on a deadly crew of train robbers. Your weapon: Rock Paper Scissors!

title: Poco a Poco
description: Join me, Maestro, the conductor of the world famous frog boy choir, Poco a Poco: “little by little,” we go around town helping sad frogs with our healing music! Can you keep in tune as we save our friends?

title: The Psychedelic Quest
description: Play the psychedelic quest where you fight robots to collect crystals. Upgrade your weapons and find loot in an adventure to defeat the final boss.

title: Leximan
description: Do you like silly hats? Were you that one kid in class who broke reality? Are you eating nutritional slime right now? Embark on a brilliant adventure, using words and incompetence to solve bizarre problems. There are also hat goblins.

title: Uncommon Time
description: Orchestral fantasy RPG

title: Gun Knight
description: A roguelike heavily inspired by Gungeon and Binding of Isaac, you play a Knight whose quest is to venture into a nearby dungeon - utilizing the most powerful magic of all... GUN MAGIC! Starting off with a pistol, instead of picking up items to modify your character - you pick up gun parts in order to modify the weapon itself!

title: Idol Knight
description: A tactical roguelike for #7DRL 2021

title: HopSlide
description: HopSlide consists of two games, not connected in any way.

title: Band Camp Boyfriend
description: Forge new friendships, become a leader, and maybe even find love all while trying to survive band camp!

title: DuckSoup Dungeon
description: Take control of one of the strange heroes in Ducksoup Dungeon and see if you can beat the dungeon. This is a small platformer-roguelike game made for the seven day roguelike challenge.

title: Unicorn Shake
description: A short visual novel about customer service. That's it.

title: Ace of Rope
description: A criminal spared by the gallows can control their broken rope. It's time for revenge.

title: Cats n Wires
description:
reconnect wires to save your cats

from this mysterious world!

title: Desktop Garden
description:
"Type and watch your garden grow! Every keystroke and mouse click lets your plants grow. Decorate your screen, or store them away to keep your screen clear. Place stickers on your plants and give them a name! Can you collect all types of plants?"

Desktop Garden is a productivity tool where you can collect and grow you're own plants while working on your computer.

title: Unaligned
description: Follow your faithful guide to escape the temple in this platformer game. Use your power to jump between worlds in order to overcome obstacles in your way to freedom.

title: Summer Horrordays
description: Summer Horrordays is a Visual Novel/Kinetic Novel featuring a selection of short stories. Each story has different versions that are revealed as the game progresses.

title: Cat Train
description: An idle way to save cats and make happiness. Rescue stray cats! With your train. Cat Train is an idle game where you rescue lost cats with your train and drop them off at Cat Cafes. 100 different pet types to collect, each with their own personality. Saving pets, making happiness!

title: How Are You Doing?
description: Saying some things can be very hard.

title: I Opened the Walls and Found Something Beautiful
description: The world is more than you thought.

title: Gender Dysphoria
description: A short 20 minute non-linear narrative game about negative experiences after coming out as transgender.

title: Parcels and Pollen
description: Sell flowers and make friends!

title: Heartbaked
description: In a beautiful elven village hidden away in a lovely little forest, one pastry chef has just reached the last recipe in a sacred book passed down from her grandmother. Ginger has waited her entire career and quite possibly her life for this, and cannot wait to finally have created everything inside. However, the last recipe requires an ingredient that she doesn't have in her pantry. TRUE LOVE! Ginger must go on a journey to find this true love, hopefully in one of the three admittedly quirky guys she knows. One problem though- she sucks at it. Good luck.

title: Loan Wolf
description: A corporate werewolf vn with wlw monster girls. And student loans.

title: War of Roses
description: Save a flower shop from a corporation. Fall in love. Maybe even at the same time.

title: Cooked with Love
description: Cooked with Love is a short comedy/romance visual novel with crafting elements.

title: Candy Scabs
description: It's the Void's birthday! Bring candy and presents, or else...!!

title: Mnemonic Devices
description: Mnemonic Devices is a sci-fi/romance about a person who loses their memory, and wakes up to find themselves married to someone they don’t know, with a voice in their head who seems to understand more about their life than they do. To top it all off, they find out they have a terrible choice to make. To help them do it, the player is able to view memories of their past to help them decide their future.

title: I’ve Transmigrated as the Supreme Villainess... But I Have No Idea WTF I’m Supposed to Do!
description: Parody Visual Novel of Soul Union.

title: Essence Hunt
description: Essence Hunt is a BxB visual novel.

description:
Created for O2A2 Jam 2021.

A girl in the seat, the artist behind the easel. They have a conversation. The girl's heart is shattered, and the artist's wrist moves no more.

description: A self-care game ( /!\ quite loud music on autoplay, sorry!)

description: queer vampire action with women and swords

title: Dear Genny

On a quiet Saturday in September, Maria goes to her room to text her best friend, Genny, something very important.

Only, it might be too late to tell Genny and Maria doesn't have much in the way of courage.

title: Night Guard: The Last Shift
description: Night Guard is a short horror game with retro style, based on the 80s.

title: Bonkers

No Straight Roads: Encore Edition is an enhanced version of the original music action-adventure that features the rock-tastic base game and festive-focused ‘Christmas Edition’ update, plus brand new content, including an expanded collection of tracks, a new opening cinematic, quality of life improvements and over 500 pieces of fan art available to view and collect throughout Vinyl City.

title: Wildflower: From the Embers
description: Wildflower is a story-driven RPG about a young witch and her life in a new town. You will make friends and solve problems, fight demons and witch hunters, commune with the forest spirits, forage, cook, and craft.

title: Hitme
description: A suicidal boy goes out during a friday's night looking for someone to hit him. Could his beaters become his lovers?

title: Spooky Typing: The Ghost Plague
description: Be prepared to dodge the sharp elements and type the words to eliminate the ghosts. Can you to this fast enough and stop the ghost plage to spread across the world?

title: Akita: King Pig Thinks Pink
description: Explore a fantasy world inhabited by charming creatures, with 2D hand-drawn animations. For 1 player or 2 players cooperatively.

title: Wastelander
description: Wastelander is a minimalist turn-based colony building game with roguelike and deckbuilding elements, where you start from nothing as a castaway on an alien world, build your colony, collect resources and protect yourself from mysterious and destructive atmospheric storms while using the secrets of the alien ruins to find a way to escape. As your colony expands you'll find alien artifacts and buildings, perks, technology upgrades, and consumable items scattered across the map.

title: ConcernedApe's Haunted Chocolatier
description: An RPG/simulation game following a chocolatier living in a haunted castle. In order to thrive in your new role, you will have to gather rare ingredients, make delicious chocolates, and sell them in a chocolate shop.

title: Blooming Panic: Full Bloom Edition
description: Depressed day-in and day-out from a draining corporate job, you become invested in a fantasy webnovel and find a mysterious link to a fan server. Everyone is warm and welcoming, but three members take a special interest in you!

title: Hearts of Iron IV: No Step Back
description:
The bitter fighting of the Eastern Front is given new depth and variety in No Step Back, the expansion to Hearts of Iron IV. With new alternate history paths and game systems, this eagerly awaited add-on presents new challenges for fans of Paradox Interactive’s best-selling grand strategy wargame.

The centerpiece of No Step Back is a series of new National Focus Trees, giving players many new ways to imagine the course of World War II in Eastern Europe. Major nations have been entirely reworked to offer unique challenges and original histories.

title: Just Say the Word!
description:
A new take on a familiar board and parlor game. Fun, quick and easy! Play hands-free, no typing required, with only the sound of your voice. Everyone from 13 to 100 year olds will love it as though they were on their very own game show – right on their own PC!

Each round, one team member becomes The Speaker, whose mission is to make their team say as many of The Words as possible, without using any of the Forbidden Words! Can you describe a Unicorn without mentioning “horn”, “mythical” or “fantasy”? What about “shark” without “jaws”, “bite” or “tornado”?

title: Crush Zone: Demolition Derby
description: Crush Zone: Demolition Derby is a thrilling, action multiplayer, vehicular party game. Where drivers around the word enter and compete in the gladiatorial games for the grand prize.
