description: Don Disguises, Infiltrate a Party, Kill a Prince?!

title: Gura Tambourine
description: Gawr Gura / Hololive rhythm fangame

title: Thursday Laundry
description: This is a short visual novel which will give you the five minutes of casual conversation humans missed during lockdown.

title: Scrambled: Syd City
description: The choice between good and evil, with a human life in the balance... is only a bang away.

title: I Want to Pursue the Mean Side Character!
description:
Beatrix is used to being misunderstood by her fellow peers.
With her sharp eyes, tall height, and ringlets, she looks like the mean villain straight from a novel.

Thus, she decided that if she was forever going to be seen as the mean bully, she might as well reside herself to the role.

However, things change when she becomes fast friends with the new commoner transfer student, to everyone’s surprise including her own.

And more weirdly, how this new transfer student can seem to understand her better than anyone else and can see her for her true self rather than the part she had been reluctantly forced to play!

title: Closing Spaces
description:
Ai and Ren -not so voluntarily dubbed the 'love-love' twins have been inseparable since birth. Together all the time, encased in their little bubble. No one entered, no one left, and nothing else mattered.
Then along comes Takuma, a persistent high school senior who was for some reason repeating the year.

Play as Taku, the happy-go-lucky charmer with a low-key violent side as he worms his way into Ren's closed-off heart.

title: Occult Crime Police
description: The Truth Is Pretty Out There

title: Void Stranger
description:
Void Stranger is a 2D sokoban-style puzzle game where every step counts.

Descend into the forgotten labyrinth teeming with fiendish foes and traps that defy reason. A swift defeat lurks at every corner for those who neither study their surroundings nor think their moves through with care.
Trust you wits and slowly, surely, you will conquer the mysteries before you.

You do remember why you are here, right?
Or have you lost something?
Something very important to you.

title: What-ever Happened to Ruth MacArthur?
description:
'What-ever Happened to Ruth MacArthur' is an interactive narrative experience where you are in search of a missing woman who left leaving only a trail of audiotapes behind her.
Explore a richly detailed, hand crafted environment, and experience the suspenseful narrative.

title: A Nightmare on Sesame Street
description: Freddy Krugar is haunting Elmo's dreams. Will you be able to find a way to wake up before he kills you?

title: A Final Delivery
description: Take a package to a disused cemetary

title: Mycorrhiza
description:
Mycorrhiza is a love letter to horror manga in the form of a visual novel. Some of our biggest inspirations include the works of Junji Ito and Masaaki Nakayama.

While Scott is trying to find a way back home, reality distorts and people’s morals start shifting in cruel and unexpected ways. A peculiar plant transforming animals, a horrifying comedy trend and a strange building trapping people. Each of the three arcs explores different terrors.

As you explore this terrifying world, you'll find out more and more about how and why Scott is trapped in it and what lead up to Scott being spirited away.

The game features a manga aesthetic with animated CGs and character art drawn by a manga artist, a focus on elaborate audio implementation, as well as an honest attempt to make the game accessible by providing visual audio cues and a dyslexic font option.

title: Haunted Corny Maize
description: Welcome to Bailey's Corn Maze! Where during this autumn season you can explore a fun little maze and maybe find a bit of romance along the way. Play as a young woman venturing into the maze all by herself, but with the chance of running into a few monstrous maids that are dealing with some issues ranging from mundane inconveniences to their own personality quirks getting in the way to being literally trapped in the maze until someone rescues them.

title: Ghost Switch
description: A wordless and spooky visual novel

title: I Told You So!
description: Welcome to Tara's webshow, the prime choice for all things spooky and fun!

title: Crowscare
description: A short horror RPG about a young boy excited for his town's upcoming Harvest Festival...

title: Night of the Lesbian Vampires
description: What’s a girl to do when she gets two visitors at midnight who both want her- and some blood?

title: Heart's Blight
description:
Yuri visual novel retelling of the fairy tale Bearskin.

Penniless after returning home from the war, Isako makes a deal with the demon Maku. In exchange for an endless amount of money, Isako must survive ostracization and attempts on her life for seven years without once asking for help. Should she fail, she yields her soul to Maku.

Can Isako come out alive?

title: Lilac & Her Light
description: a story about a girl who lost her colour.

title: Starwatchers: The Search for Cosmic Jam
description: Roadtrip across the universe and create the most delicious jam!

title: I Rarely Go Outside
description: Joel has to deal with an unfortunate situation.

title: Door XP
description: Help a kind Hacker protect systems before they go out of control. Your Controller? A command prompt of course!

title: Happy New Song
description: Rythm game, based on Fireworks!

title: Astrobattle
description: Take control of disabled spacecrafts!

title: Warp Trash Flotilla
description: Warp Trash Flotilla is a space trash aggregator.

title: Word Whip
description: Word Whip is a challenging word puzzle game. Fill in the blank tiles to create words until you reach the goal, across 180 different puzzles. For an additional challenge, you can try finding the most valuable words for each puzzle, as each letter has a point value attached.

title: Blankspace
description: Blankspace is a tactical roguelike where emojis are your tools of strategy. Combine them to generate science, culture, magic, and money. Maximize points with clever synergies. Each run brings new challenges, testing your strategic thinking in a game where no two runs are the same.

title: Newton's Axiom
description: Take control of Newton's Axiom, a state-of-the-art ship lost deep in hostile space. Survive by mining asteroids for metal to build your own fleet and dominate this sector of the galaxy.

title: Asteroids Bangers
description: Asteroid Bangers is a nostalgic game, that attempts to replicate the feeling of flying through space and destroying alien evil spaceships.

title: Sticky Keys
description: Sticky Keys is a game with the theme of "Small World". Use your typing skills to gain score by typing on an incredibly nasty keyboard.

title: Frantic Freddie
description: This game is a remake of the game "Frantic Freddie". The goal of the game is to have Freddie collect all the pots of gold on each level while avoiding all of the enemies. Optionally collect bonus items to earn more points (10,000 points earn an extra life). When all pots have been collected on a level, you will advance to the next level. What makes the game unique, is that the platforms are connected with telephone poles instead of ladders and Freddie cannot walk past a pole. He must climb up one side and down the other. Enemies however can move past the poles! There are 16 levels of increasing difficulty, featuring different enemies on each level. The earlier levels feature 3 enemies each and the later levels have 4 and 5 enemies. Enemy speed increases gradually each level. Every two levels there are interludes to give the player a short rest.

title: Little By Little By Little
description: Little By Little By Little is a slice of life video game following a day in the life of an ordinary college student whose hyperfixation on local graffiti keeps them distracted from their rapidly declining mental health. The game touches upon depression and anxiety, drinking culture, self esteem, and complicated relationships - and how those struggles intersect with everyday life. It also explores the healing power of friendships and the importance of being vulnerable.

title: Sol Traveler
description: Lost in space on an alien spaceship, you must find your way home.

title: Silicon-Galaxy
description: Endless retro style starship battles up to 4 players split screen!

title: Red Room
description: I am a YouTuber and developer who specializes in exploring the Deep WebThe red room was fictional but I made up my imagination.Deep Web's Red Room is now... Wouldn't you experience it?

title: Norman's Sky
description: Explore the universe in 64x64 pixels

title: Anxietyware
description: All you need is a good night's sleep...

title: Water Boiling Simulator
description: It's 2016. Explore through your house in the middle of the night and complete your chores before the water you put on the stove starts boiling. Sounds easy, right? If only you hadn't seen things you were not supposed to see.

title: Irrational
description: The emotional story of a woman with anxiety.

title: A Bit of Light
description:
Find the balance between your obligations and passions while taking care of yourself.

Follow the life of our little protagonist as the weekend unfolds.

Spend your time wisely and make every activity count. As you make choices, you'll see how your head fills with positive or negative thoughts, so make sure you also try to rest a bit so your head doesn't clutter. Try to find the four different endings!

title: re:fleXion
description: A game that explores one individual's mental struggles through their dreams.

title: Wednesday
description: A short story about dreams.

title: Alloys Over Flowers
description: Amnesiac sculptor is pursued by her old fiancé.

title: Serenity at Dusk
description:
Here is where a heavy heart asks for rest.
Jackie Huang learns more about the clients that carry a heavy past who frequent the shop for a little sleep therapy. This 4-month project that serves as both a visual development and motion graphic school project invites you into the mysterious yet magical world of Dr. Feng’s apothecary.

title: The Space Sim
description: The Space Sim is a massive scale space battle simulator, capable of simulating space battles with hundreds of ships. With three unique game modes, 20+ ship types, and dazzling visuals, this game is sure to amaze! Not much more needs to be said, build a massive fleet and watch the fireworks! It also contains the most brilliantly written and acted story of all time, so don't miss out!

title: Final Inferno
description: A turn-based pixel-art RPG with a dantesque story and an elaborate skill system

title: Roar
description: Roar is a boys-love visual novel.

title: Tail Me
description: A short otome game about 2 cat demons struggling to survive in a mysterious forest.

title: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
description: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen as he attempts to romance girls based on e-book tutorials. Will desperation win out in this desire for love, or will knowledge, patience, and logic pave the way to success?

title: Respite
description:
When the sky falls, use it as a blanket.
After a huge fight with his roommates, Ivan finds himself in the apartment alone. As the sun rises and he considers whether or not going to work, he re-explores his apartment and reminisces about past experiences. He’s reminded of the importance of family, friends, and respite.

title: Rogue vs Evil
description: Turn by turn dungeon crawler, grab runic items, learn skills; crush monsters

title: Persona 5: Goro Akechi Dating Simulator
description: Goro Akechi is a character from the hit popular jrpg game Persona 5 and Persona 5 Royal. In this game you could date him and do certain romantic scenarios. This game have 14 endings, some short and some long and it's decided by the options you picked. So if you are a Goro Akechi fan and have him as your husbando, you need to play this game to fulfill your Goro Akechi needs.

title: She's a Bit Sluggish
description: A simple story of a date between a copper robot weeb and a beleaguered slug girl. Nothing can possibly go wrong.

title: Tender
description: In 1991 a young Floridian couple goes missing while hiking. After weeks of intense searching an individual living near the hikers missing area was the only suspect. The individual was interrogated, and his home searched but no clues to the disappearance of the hikers were found by the investigators, so he was released. Until this day no further information is known of the missing hikers.

title: Watch_Dogs 1985
description: Parallel universe Watch Dogs

title: WWI: The First DogFighters
description: Hell shooter that goes on during World War I.

title: Boxcorp Employee Training
description: How efficiently can you run out of space?

title: Tower of Boom
description: 2D Run and gun Rogue-lite with combat that pushes you forward

title: HeartWood
description: Play as a young druid set to purify the wilting Ancient tree to save the forest's life force. With your staff in hand, use and gain new magical plants to help fight against the hordes of creatures. Will you restore the Ancient tree's power, or die trying?

title: Outfoxed
description: Outfoxed was made for the Weekly Game Jam (Week 147) with the theme of Invisible. In the game you play as Ace, trying to infiltrate the C. A. T. S. headquarters to capture some highly secret Intel.

title: Quit the Game to Win
description: It's not as simple as it sounds.

title: Fear Is In The Mind
description: Immerse yourself in Fear Is In The Mind, a psychological horror game where a therapy session twists your reality, revealing your deepest fears as you find a way to mend your fragile mind.

title: Concourse X-Ray
description: Use your x-ray glasses to check passengers for prohibited items.

title: The Tour
description: The Deepening solar system tour is incoming and Jon and his band need to get back in sync. Join them on a tour around the country as they learn their new songs, rock the crowd, and build up the hype for their spacefaring tour.

title: EXO Encounter 667
description: A first-contact story

title: Deflector
description: Deflector is a high-octane bullet hell roguelite set in a deadly world. Upgrade your characters with the DNA you find, evolve them further during your runs and explore the farthest reaches of this microcosm… or die trying.

title: Linecook
description: These busy birds will eat almost anything that falls into their gullet -- what will you feed them? They have their preferences, but people food beats bird food any day of the week! A difficult, chaotic arcade game with local multiplayer support!

title: Falling Kwadrats
description: A well-known puzzle, now for 2 players! One plays the game, while the other picks blocks for him.

title: Starlight Explorers
description: Chart a course for adventure in this lighthearted, all-ages physics sim that will take you to the stars.

title: Push Puzzle: Rescue Adventure
description: Push and move objects to save animals and build a new rescue center.

title: AFK Summoner
description: AFK Summoner is a strategy RPG with AFK gameplay and various features. Summoners can recruit heroes , build a mighty team to explore the land! Heroes fight even when you are away, so write your legend with hands freed!

title: Maya's Dice
description: Maya's Dice is a 2D puzzle-based RPG using the bluffing dice game, Liar's Dice, as a unique and dynamic battle mechanic. Players experience a cyberpunk world and a narrative that questions morality and one's core values.

title: Crawlspace
description: Crawl Space is a puzzle game where you control a 6 legged spider.

title: Task Force 88: Hostile Contact
description: In Task Force 88: Hostile Contact, TF-88 pits their elite team against Chaos, a vicious mercenary unit relentlessly causing world-wide anarchy. You choose which side you're on, and you'll battle in three exotic locales, Castle, Favela, and Desert, as well as in a bonus mystery map.

title: Kid Hallow
description: Wear different costumes to get past different challenges in this precision puzzle platformer. Then build your own challenges in the level editor!

title: Castle Life
description: Castle Life - A game about castle defense, in which the player accumulates money, buys archers and swordsmen for defense, improves his castle, collects gold, calls for rockfalls and fights off catapults.

title: Dim-Egion
description: Single Player Shooting Game with 2D Collision Detection and 3D Rendering

title: Mini Island: Winter
description: Mini Island: Winter is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty!

title: The Robin
description: The Robin tells the story of a school bully who kills a girl named Robin. Thirteen people involved are kidnapped and embark on a desperate journey to survive. The work revolves around who is behind the black hand and who is responsible for the death of Robin these two questions unfold.

title: Jubilee
description:
'If this counsel or this work be of mortals, it will come to nought: but if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.' - The Acts of the Apostles

The shining city of Neo Rome has stood for a thousand years, a bastion of truth and justice. But beneath this glorious dream of peace and prosperity lies a twisted nightmare: the city is ruled by demons who feast upon the helpless souls of humanity.

Slipping through the cracks between dream and nightmare, a young man comes face to face with the horrific truth. But gifted with mysterious powers of prophecy by the finger of God, can he and his allies overthrow this kingdom of demons and usher in the year of Jubilee?

title: Portal: Epic Edition
description: Portal: Epic Edition is widely regarded as one of the most Epic mods to ever hit ModDB and the Portal community as a whole, featuring the iconic campaign of Portal remastered to become more epic to play through, featuring crossover elements with the Half Life series and more!

description: Enigmatic psycho challenges famous detective. Help Sherlock solve riddles and overcome challenges on his way to save the local town from bombing by stopping a mysterious madman.

title: My Loving Wife
description: This is the story of you and your wife. Every day you come home from work to see her and the two of you spend time together. You love her moew than anything and hope you're time together will last forever.

title: Winter Dream

title: Skullfracture
description: Skullfracture is a tridimensional fighting game inspired by Smash Bros where you kick, punch and throw your way to victory by launching the opponent out of the ring!

title: Alanna: The Princess of Puzzles
description: Enjoy this awesome game full of monsters, pixel art based, with excellent music, 4 bosses and 20 levels to explore the castle, use swords and bows, get familiars, a lot of items, and solve different puzzles to go to the next area.

title: I want to keep a Windy
description: A short 2000's VIPRPG game which follows the life of a protagonist in his moments with different Windys throughout different time periods of his life(a Windy being a disposable servant whom which has one day to live upon renting).

title: Kamikaze Veggies
description: A stealth adventure game with an absurd-driven story and third-person perspective for a single-player or co-op. Complete secret war missions, solve the showy puzzles, and save the veggies world!

title: Stick RPG 2: Director's Cut
description:
Thrust into an unfamiliar and bizarre city, find your place amongst the strange citizens by earning money, buying property and building up your stats. Collect the mysterious trans-dimensional artifacts to solve the mystery of Paper Thin City!

The Director's Cut contains tons of new content not available in the online version.

• New areas to explore and new quests to complete
• A total of 25 careers, including Lumberjack, Professor, Escort, Personal Trainer, Light Knight and Dark Lord
• 18 new weapons
• 3 new combat zones
• All cheats unlocked
• Online and offline saving
• Expanded romance system
• 2 new mini-games
• 30 trophies to earn
• Full original soundtrack in MP3 format

title: Impact Point
description:
IMPACT POINT! – A Fast Paced 2-4 Player Top Down Multiplayer 2D Shooter. Be the last man standing to win!

2 Maps, 5-10 rounds, 9 different weapons, 16 cosmetics, and more to come!

title: Creepy Mahjong
description:
You can escape if stuck, but winning or escaping might lead you to a new area and face different challenges.

With the Level Editor, you can create your level design and share it with your friends for an endless challenge!

title: Apex Legends: Loba Edition
description: Traffic in victory with the Apex Legends: Loba Edition.

title: An Essay on Insipidity II
description:
An Essay on Insipidity II, also known as Essay II, is an adventure game that follows the tragedy of a peasant and hunter named Arkhip, which finds himself in the middle of a harsh winter alongside his family, who are almost famishing. With no other options, Arkhip goes out of his home on a journey in hopes to trade their last pouch of money with the local communities for food.
Said journey will also take him deep inside his own soul.

title: Smitty's Journey
description: A 2D puzzle platformer adventure, set in a bustling continent of Dripsdale, natively inhabited by droplet-like creatures called Dropples

title: Backrooms
description: Backrooms is an immersive first-person exploration horror game. Wander through the endless liminal spaces made with procedural generation, try to survive, and find an escape.

title: Ship War
description: Ship War is a board game transferred to the PC, in which a player takes turns with a bot to attack at coordinates on an opponent's unknown map.The main task is to destroy all ships.

title: School for the Friendless
description: Harold ends up going to a school for people with no friends. Here, students are paired together and whoever they're paired with become their roomates, regardless of gender. What if he gets with a girl?

title: An Essay on Insipidity
description:
"An Essay on Insipidity", also known as Essay I, is a purposely bad RTP-made game that aims to be a quick character study and observation of a poverty-living Honduran child named Ernesto, who uses RPG Maker to make a game to try and cope with the harsh reality he lives in.

The dialogue is a mishmash of broken to unintelligible English and Spanish.

title: Chaincards
description: Chaincards is a JRPG where you play as Chain, a young wizard whose goal is to find out his master’s magic notes to reveal the secrets behind his mysterious death

title: Creatures of Energy
description:
In this game turn based game you grow your creatures to destroy the enemy ones.
The board is made out of angle pieces which can rotate. A group of connected pieces is a creature.

title: Homecoming
description: Fourth map of the IKSPQ series: a medium sized blue temple with an outside bit.

title: Virgil's Purgatory
description: Virgil is a man who was decapitated, now he must wander through his own purgatory in search of his true head and perhaps eternal rest. Take your chances with this little metroidvania game.

title: BRG's Red Riding Hood
description: Meet Maisie, a child who is loved by all. She dons her favorite red coat & becomes Red Riding Hood. Journey with her to experience dazzling visuals and an immersive audio experience. Make a life-changing decision that will alter the story.

title: Dasher 3D
description:
Dasher 3D is a top down shooter with time-freezing. And it's controlled with only one button as it's a part of Feldo's 1-Button Jam!

You are the Dasher, a lonely sprite that shoots and well... dashes around. A group of angry bots have attacked you in huge numbers, but you can do something that they can't: Control the time! As you dash around and stop, time freezes and lets you decide to either shoot, or to dash again.

title: Garbage Crew!
description: Garbage Crew! is a game about chaos! You work in a team with two to four players and an angry garbage truck driver. Your job is to empty garbage cans and containers. Sadly, your contract doesn't state what kind of work you are required to do, so your boss loads you with all kinds of extra tasks, including firefighting and forest work. Naturally you are completely understaffed, and your short-tempered driver has no intention of stopping the truck to wait for you, just because you couldn't empty all the garbage cans while extinguishing a raging wildfire. Luckily, there are heaps of powerups that help you with all those tasks, so your stress level won't reach dangerous heights... Or so you thought! Due to an accident in your bosses DIY time reverting device, you travel back into medieval times with seemingly no way to return and to make matters worse, your contract states that you are still required to work! So better get yourself a sword because the town is in the middle of a siege!

title: Jay Arnold's Immortal Quest
description: Design your hero and power him up to levels of god like proportions and achieve immortality. Beware as an evil force is also striving for the same goal as you.

title: Mori
description: Experience lightning-fast combat as Mori, a grieving widow on a quest for revenge. Armed with nothing but a scythe and cloak, carve your way through countless foes, dismantle a criminal empire, and discover what it means to lose yourself.

title: The League of Lonely Geologists
description: In The League of Lonely Geologists you collect rocks and swap notes.

title: Step
description: You might not be lost.

title: Stick Match 2
description: Stick Match 2 is a silly game about a stick on an adventure.

title: 502's Arcade
description: 502's Arcade is a collection of fast paced arcade games. Ghost hunting in an procedural dungeon crawler, fast reflex puzzle solving in a potion shop, blasting through alien enemies and more! Get good old arcade fun featuring modern mechanics and challenge your way to the top of the leaderboards.

title: Gunrail
description: Tower defense on rails!

title: Loop Line
description: A little train game where you're stuck in a loop.

title: Quietcar
description: Quietcar is a horror game taking place on a train.

title: Mad Tanks
description: Epic 3D tank PVP battle! Modern vehicles with future war theme! Adrenaline packed 5v5 online combats! Build your own machine to assault in this action shooter game!

title: Mr. Yeti's Fast Food
description:
Mr. Yeti's Fast Food is a small game for Ludum Dare #33, which theme was "You Are The Monster".
Mr. Yeti is usually a nice guy, napping in the peace and quiet of Yeti Mountains. But sometimes he can get dangerously hungry, and running around looking for food only makes him hungrier. Which means bad luck for anybody who ends up crossing his way in the forests.
Although he doesn't hold a grudge against the punny humans who disturbe his silence with their "skiing", Mr. Yeti does like the w

title: Tentador Leches
description: A weird little VN about a weird little milkman

title: Monkeys!!
description: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

title: Pale Sand, Dark Skies
description: A walk on the beach with a ghost

title: Greenwood: Amaranthus
description: Follow this story about the healing of a rogue mercenary, who is on the run from his past life. On his way, he crosses paths with unlikely allies. On his way through a town, he learns of the local forest that has been marked as dangerous due to a vengeful entity. Not only does he have to get past whoever that is, but he also has to watch out for anything trying to drag him back to his former life as a mercenary.

title: Mimsy & Friends!
description: Bring your girlfriend a cake!

title: 31 Unmarked Games
description: In 31 unmarked games, you'll receive 31 unmarked cassette tapes in a little digital mailbox. Some contain short experiences: playable practical jokes, maybe. Some are little finishable arcade games or platformers. A few of the thirty-one are confounding puzzle-boxes that might even last you an hour or two each.

title: 1-800-Monsters
description: Destroy castles, steal the presents and avoid children on your way to victory.

title: Creeper
description: Piece together video evidence to help catch a killer.

title: The Tiny Train Driver
description: Gather resources, build rails, drive the train, earn coins and unlock new areas!

title: Four Eyes
description: Boy meets alien in a story-driven sci-fi adventure.

title: Pirated Code
description: Tsundere Amnesiac AI x Pathetic Space Pirate

title: Ut: Kissy Cutie
description: In this unofficial sequel of Undertale, Frisk takes on the role of ambassador to bring peace once and for all between humans and monsters. The objective of the game is to convince humans that monsters are not evil. The game plays like a dating sim, but everything is purely platonic. This is not a story of romance, but a story about friendship, struggle, hope and bonds, where discrimination, prejudice, abuse and manipulation are the villains.

title: Arena Circus
description: A visual novel set in a fantasy world where appearance is everything and humans are at the bottom of the totem pole. A disowned prince and a sickly human who got a second chance at life rebel against a corrupt monarchy.

title: Investigator and the Case of the Red Herring
description: Investigator is a point and click whodunnit about an alligator who investigates cases.

title: I Want Out!
description: A short and retro style 'escape the room' game.

title: Intergalactic Wizard Force
description: A twisted saturday morning cartoon adventure

title: Submachine Complete Collection
description:
ALL Submachine games in one package, retouched especially for this collection.
That's 13 games all together.

You also get entire soundtrack of the series.

The pack includes following:

Submachine 1: the Basement
Submachine 2: the lighthouse
Submachine 3: the Loop
Submachine 4: the Lab
Submachine 5: the Root
Submachine 6: the Edge
Submachine 7: the Core
Submachine 8: the Plan

description: A shoutout to cats, night time, and "me" time

description: A Psychological Horror Experience about Traumas of a Soldier from WW2

title: Dismal Anhedonia Land
description: IT WON'T EVER FEEL AS GOOD

title: Last Chance to Green
description: Made for Ludum Dare 34. A game about gardening, old slow computers and radioactive caterpillars.

title: Sybil's Tail
description: Sybil's Tail is a tiny, 15-30 minute long platformer made for PICO-8. Run, jump, slide, grab, and toss your way through 6 bite-sized areas as you search for a mysterious meteorite that fell nearby!

title: Millie and Molly
description: Millie and Molly is a retro inspired puzzle game coded and designed by industry veterans for original Commodore 64 hardware and emulators. The game features 100 original levels spread over five themed worlds, eight pieces of music and even a level editor should you wish to get your creative juices flowing.

title: Deep Inside
description: Deep Inside is a first-person psychological horror game! You are a police officer who has to find out who is behind the most high-profile murders in the city. Use your detective skills to catch the killer, but remember that the truth can be bitter!

title: The Telwynium
description: A 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter- It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

title: Yuurei Station
description: A Japanese ghost story hand-painted with watercolors

title: George and the Printer
description: Help George to fix his deadly printer!

title: FLY: Forever Loving You
description: Incarnez une lycéenne dans ce visual novel / otome game amateur français.

title: Daemonologie
description: A remake of the short folk horror story about the Scottish witch trials in Unreal Engine 5. You play the role of a witchfinder. Speak to the locals and sort their truths from their lies. On the last morning a witch must hang, best you know who by then.

title: Nightmare Drive
description: The apocalypse didn't end the world, it just emptied the roads. Build your vehicle up from salvaged parts, manage resources and drive across endless highways. When midnight comes, the hordes hunt. Customize. Drive. Thrive!

title: Bloodborne PSX
description: A fan demake (PS1 era) of From Software's PS4 exclusive: Bloodborne.

title: Love the Guard, Be the King
description: The Kingdom and its future monarch are in your hands. The choice is yours. Love the Guard or be the king?

title: Red-Handed Robin
description: A fantasy otome about lying and stealing.

title: Cut Short
description: First person horror game

title: Impostor
description: How well do we truly know our loved ones?

description: Explore the town. Find the clues. Solve the murder.

description: After accidentally hexing your childhood friend on Halloween, embark on a journey with your cute Editor to save her.

title: Blink: The Last Night
description: Will make you feel like you're going insane.

description: No doors, no escape. Only your mask and your flashlight can save you!

title: Ghost House
description: A puzzle horror game in an old empty house, use the flash from a camera as your only weapon against the shadowy figures. Solve puzzles as you try to escape this nightmare

title: Embuscade
description: A short horror tale told through a voxelated experience full of secrets.

title: 78 Hour Rain
description: The pale rain is coming.

title: Custodial
description:
You've arrived fashionably late to your comfortable job as a custodian in a quiet facility for anomalous research.

You have mere minutes, again, before you and everyone else in the building are killed.

title: The journey to the party
description: go to the spooookiest party of the year

title: Cozy
description:
Why not stay inside?

Arriving near sundown, you step out of your reliable hatchback, and emerge into the muted stillness of the forest.

Hopefully, your uncle is all right.

title: Willo
description: Help Willo save the graveyard from pesky skelliwags in this stealthy spook-em-up

title: Dufe: Masquerade
description: A villainous duo deal with the most frightening thing they have ever faced: their feelings

title: Comeback
description: A Visual narrative about overcoming the status quo, Fight in a series of different Arenas Levels, In your downtime cook different meals with unique effects and craft equipment to increase your chances.

title: My Master's Birthday
description: You play as a werewolf butler named Damien. it's October 31st, and he wants to impress his master, Victoria, by buying her her favorite foods for her birthday!

title: Battle Live: Halloween Live
description:
Pride Park is preparing for it's annual Halloween Live, where after the regular Battle Live two units face off to end the night of horrors.

Amidst the planning and organizing, the two units chosen to be the stars reminisce about the year prior...

title: Furthest Reach
description: Explore the furthest reaches of space.

title: Shrubnaut
description:
A small metroidvania made in 6 days for a self-imposed Game•A•Week challenge.

Explore a space station with your grapple!

title: Nodomus
description: Void probe live feed

title: Let's Meat Adam
description: Let's MEAT Adam is a Bara, BxB visual novel set in a neon NIGHTMARE of an escape room turned death game. Muscles, Blood, Escape, Trust, Betray, MEAT.

title: Astrofrog
description: Hop from planet to planet to help Frog find his lost spaceship.

title: Solar Blaster: Challenge Stage
description:
The Earth is under attack from the invading alien war machine! Take control of the Solar Blaster fighter ship and strike back!

An action packed space shooter where you’ve got 2 minutes to get the high score.

title: Superhotline Miami Deluxe
description: What happens when you mix super hot with Hotline Miami ? You get Superhotline Miami! Time moves only when you move, but this time, from a top down perspective and with some extra violence. This is an upgraded version of the original Superhotline Miami, it features many improvements used by its sequel Shootout Inc, such as improved bullet hit detection, better hitboxes, AI reworks, new sprites and animations.

title: Wash Your Hands
description: A real time visualisation of the death toll from COVID-19.

title: Space Quest: 2099
description: Campy sci-fi themed space adventure with arena shooter style multiplayer.

title: Cryptid Farm
description: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.

title: The Zium Garden
description:
zium / noun / informal:
1. a virtual gallery game, composed of eclectic and wonderful things.
2. (kind of like a zine, but the museum version)

The Zium Garden is a Museum Exploration Game filled with artwork and installations from artists around the world, working in various mediums and styles.

title: Afternoon Spaghetti
description: The classic tale of cheese, goodwill and transdimensional fridge theft.

title: Pigeon Ascent
description: Take care of your own pigeon as they fight increasingly stronger foes

title: Triad
description:
Triad is about the most difficult puzzle of all: human relationships. The goal of Triad is to fit three lovers in a bed in such a way that everyone can get to sleep comfortably.

Easier said than done! Everyone has their own different needs and sleeping quirks. Plus there's a cat. Can you solve this puzzle? Many have tried - few have succeeded!

title: Cooldog Teaches Typing
description: im cooldog and im teaching the whole world how to type.

title: It's Just the End of the World, Love
description: Two girlfriends celebrate halloween in the zombie apocalypse.

title: Call of Gruty WWII
description: Call of Gruty WWII is a cancelled action shooter game featuring zombies during World War II.

title: Aria at the Funeraria
description: See ghosts and corpse brides at the funeral home.

description: Have you ever dreamed of building your very own video games. but don’t know how to code? If so, then we have a tool...

title: Zombrero
description: A lone gunman defending his last stand in the desert heat

title: Unearth Your Gays
description: Gay dating sim with dead boyfriends.

title: Neyasnoe
description: A fragment of the game about a dude looking for meaning and reasons to live and not finding it; getting lost in the labyrinth of his own thoughts and ceasing to understand other people; smoking a lot and destroying himself.

title: Typos and Brains
description: Help the zombie escape from a mansion... with typing! Typos and Brains is a horror-themed typing game inspired by The Typing of the Dead set in an underground facility. Betrayed by his science team, the zombie now seeks revenge! Help him escape by quickly typing words that appear on the screen.

title: Horde
description: See yourself stuck in the middle of an ever growing virus epidemic. Find or craft weapons and tools to fight against the living and the dead. Build a safe place to survive in this cruel, apocalyptic world.

title: Components
description: PC Builder

title: Evil God Korone
description: An unexpected collaboration from Tsugunohi, the game where horror invades daily life, and VTuber Inugami Korone, from VTuber group hololive. Inugami Korone, who has been live streaming many horror game, has become an evil goddess and taken over Tsugunohi. Now, chop your finger and give it to her.

title: Academy Z: Beginning of the catastrophe
description: A third-person action video game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies in an anime style. Emilia, along with other students, will try to survive in a hostile environment full of difficulties and enemies they will have to face. Will anyone survive?

title: Lore City: Alkahest
description: Brew death for your friends or die by a vengeful spirit holding you hostage.

title: Dawn of Survivors 2
description: Survive, rescue, and evacuate! It’s a new dawn! Dawn of Survivors 2 is the official sequel to its smash hit game, Dawn of Survivors 2! The zombie apocalypse rages on, but this time, you’re evening the score! Dawn of Survivors 2 gives players more resources and firepower to fight the unstoppable hordes. More zombies, more danger, more carnage! So, strap in, load up, and get ready. Because this time, when the zombie hordes come marching, you’re bringing the fight to them!

title: Monster Bash HD
description: Apogee's bash'em and smash'em adventure plunges Johnny Dash into the evil Underworld of Count Chuck, when his dog Tex is kidnapped by Count Chuck along with hundreds of other dogs & cats! Guide Johnny through the Count's gruesome schemes, rescue all the pets, and end this nightmare once and for all!

title: ChromeRivals
description: ChromeRivals is a free to play MMO space shooter game

title: Company Loyalty
description: Your next step up the rusty ladder of the retail industry.

title: Challenge Dream Cat
description: Control the cute cat to move forward. Break through the Various traps and terrain to get a treat. This game is a 3D casual run game that anyone can enjoy.

title: Neo Spectrum
description:
The system has been compromised, it's your job to restore it.
Neo Spectrum is a 2D puzzle platformer game. Use the properties of the different colored blocks to face numerous puzzles and challenges, starting from simple ones like moving platforms to advanced ones where you'll have to manouver quickly around enemies, dodge lasers, walljump and even control multiple characters at once.

title: Wantless: Solace at World’s End
description: Wantless is a PC turn-based tactical RPG set in a bleak future. Fight woes and nightmares made manifest inside your patients' procedurally generated minds, craft your own skills with overwhelming freedom, loot, gear up, customize, earn reputation. Leave your mark on a dying world.

title: Tep the Destroyer
description: Tep the Destroyer is a single player tower defense game where you will face over 50 unique alien monsters of increasing difficulty. Strategically place 8 types of turrets to ensure the maximum damage to your foes. 5 different armor types. 5 different damage types. Weapon effectiveness is greatly influenced by the type of enemy you are fighting. Complete the main quest line for the ultimate challenge! Infinite waves, excessive power ups, and no hope. How long can you survive before the alien horde will destroy you?

title: Riddle School: Legacy Edition
description: This is everyone's journey--to escape from school.

title: Riddle School 2: Legacy Edition
description: Phil escapes school again--middle school this time!

title: Gachi Dash
description: An exciting adventure through the most unusual places in Russia. Visit the places known to every person and feel the atmosphere of the fact that you need to escape from there as soon as possible. Run as fast as you can, but be careful, the exit path is not always straight, so you will have to avoid numerous obstacles! Try your luck in two game modes. Classic gameplay game known and understandable for every. Just jump and try not to die!

title: Riddle School 3: Legacy Edition
description: The largest Riddle School yet; can you escape high school?

title: Riddle School 4: Legacy Edition
description: Phil Eggtree is now stuck in college. How will he escape this time?

title: Fears of Glasses O-O
description: In this game you have to overcome your fears. Monsters from under the bed, monsters who knock on doors, knock out windows, cemetery, bugs, spiders, aliens and much more. All that you are afraid of, you will find in this game.

title: Vacation Adventures: Cruise Director 5
description: Arrange fabulous excursions in the Caribbean, Europe and South America. Visit amazing tourist sights and landmarks in cities such as London, Edinburgh, Barcelona, Vienna and Istanbul. Go inside the world famous Windsor Castle where British Royal Weddings take place. Help passengers with cabins, shopping, dining, leisure on board and at Ports of Call along the way. Collect souvenirs of the cruise. Look for hundreds of hidden objects, items lost by passengers, trash for recycling. Play superb mini-games and earn badges for your achievements.

title: Winding Road
description: Winding Road is an arcade scoring game. Move along the winding road, change shape and collect points.

title: PlanetDrop: A Tiny Space Adventure
description: PlanetDrop: A Tiny Space Adventure is a computer game where you command a spaceship in an orbit of a planet. Your primary task is to capture "drop zones" with your shuttles and commandos. You rely on stealth, agility and speed, rather than on firepower.

title: Knockball Pool
description: Play against yourself or the computer in this physics-based billiards hit!

title: Death Slayer V
description: A virus has escaped a secret lab ran by the Eibmoz Corporation. Everyone is infected... including yourself. You have minutes before you die from the fast acting virus and turn into a "Zombie". There may be a way to stay alive... but it wont be easy!

title: Soulsland
description: Destroy Lord Zaiden's army and save captured souls in this medieval RPG which is happen fictional place called Soulsland

title: Hotel on the Grate
description: Hotel on the Grate is a short(15-20 min), narrative adventure game. Assume the role of an on call therapist and travel across the city on the grate to meet your patients.

title: GDO Masters
description: GDO Masters is a 3D fighting game with mutually assured fun! Pick one from 8 characters and fight for the title of GDO Master!

title: Escape from the Village
description: You are on your way home from a holiday and your car breaks down and you are stranded in the middle of nowhere. You get out of the car, explore the surroundings, and try to get home. Enjoy this escape game set in a deserted mountain village in modern Japan.

title: Kate Don't Wait
description: You are in love with Kate, a beautiful and determined woman who is part of the rebooters movement. She encourages you to keep going by getting involved in the fight against the Accumulator, but you fear that the buts will catch you. Aren't Kate and the reboot worth any risk?

title: Square Dungeon
description: Square Dungeon is a word independent game of dungeon exploration. "Amnesiacs" wake up in an ancient "dungeon". The only way to find their identity and memory is to go to a higher dungeon. In the process, they should make choices and grasp their own destiny.

title: Gimle: The Broken Prophecy
description: Enter the dark world of Norse mythology in a new role-playing game. Play as Brand, a brave warrior on whose shoulders rests the future of the New World. Use his supernatural abilities and make difficult choices that affect the fate of the mythical land.

title: Legend of Krilona
description: Legend of Krilona ist ein RPG Abenteuer bei dem vier Helden durch eine Welt geführt werden, welche noch erkundet werden muss.

title: Block Collide
description: Block collide is a relaxing puzzle game with a minimalistic art style. Move the blocks in the right order so they won’t collide with each other.

title: Red Solstice 2: Survivors - Howell-Barrex Inc.
description: Experience a new story line with new characters and settings. Take on the role as the Strike Commander and bring victory to Howell-Barrex Inc.

title: Cheeky Chickens
description:
70+ fun levels of pig-popping pleasure!

These cheeky chickens are tired of being the main course. It's time for these pigs to pop on a plate.

title: Detective Time
description:
Detective Time is a game in the genre of "short interactive cinema".

The story takes place in an American town. A detective named Randy arrived at the crime scene, where the fishermen found the body of an unknown man in the lake. You need to look for clues, interview witnesses, interrogate suspects, break door locks and safes to figure out who the murderer is. The game has 4 different endings and the outcome will depend on your correct choice.

title: Retro Racers
description: Retro Racers sets the pace for 2D top-down classic racing games. Put the pedal to the metal while speeding by your opponents cars to unlock 12 exciting tracks. Collect the 4 classic power-ups along the way (Acceleration, Top Speed, Nitro Boosts and Traction). Avoid oil slicks and time the opening and closing of gates for shortcuts. Return to your childhood in Retro Racers!

title: UFO No!
description: What would you do in a UFO invasion? How about spacejack a UFO and use their technology against them! 49 Stages of Intensifying Action. Waves of Space Aliens.

title: Crankies Workshop: Whirlbot Assembly

title: Marlow in Apocalyptic Acid World
